en.s: The Battle of Andrassos or Adrassos was fought on 8 November 960 between the Byzantines, led by Leo Phokas the Younger, and the forces of the Hamdanid Emirate of Aleppo under the emir Sayf al-Dawla. It was fought in an unidentified mountain pass in the Taurus Mountains. Sayf al-Dawla had established an emirate based in Aleppo in 945 and quickly emerged as the leading Muslim antagonist of the Byzantine Empire on its eastern frontier.

zh.s: 安德拉索斯战役（又称阿德拉索斯战役）于960年11月8日爆发。拜占庭军队由小利奥·福卡斯率领，与阿勒颇哈姆丹王朝埃米尔赛义夫·道莱率领的军队交战。战役发生在托罗斯山脉一处位置不明的山口。赛义夫·道莱于945年在阿勒颇建立埃米尔国，并很快成为拜占庭帝国东部边境的主要穆斯林对手。

en.t: The Republic of Venice enacts a law confining most of Venice's glassmaking industry to the "island of Murano"
en.s: The Republic of Venice, officially the Most Serene Republic of Venice and traditionally known as La Serenissima, was a maritime republic with its capital in Venice, on the northeastern coast of Italy. Founded, according to tradition, in 697 by Paolo Lucio Anafesto, over the course of its 1,100 years of history it established itself as one of the major European commercial and naval powers.

zh.t: 威尼斯共和国颁布法律，将大部分玻璃制造业限制在“穆拉诺岛”
zh.s: 威尼斯共和国正式名称为最尊贵的威尼斯共和国，传统上称为“Serenissima”。这是一个以威尼斯为首都的海上共和国，位于意大利东北海岸。据传它于697年由保罗·卢基奥·阿纳费斯托建立，在长达1100年的历史中逐渐成为欧洲主要的商业和海军强国之一。

en.t: After his coronation as king of Sweden, Christian II (pictured) gave the order to execute nearly 100 people, mostly noblemen, despite promises of general amnesty
en.s: The Stockholm Bloodbath (Swedish: Stockholms blodbad) was a trial that led to a series of executions in Stockholm between 7 and 9 November 1520. The event is also known as the Stockholm massacre. The events occurred after the coronation of Christian II as the new king of Sweden, when guests in the crowning party were invited to a meeting at Tre Kronor castle.

zh.s: 斯德哥尔摩惨案（瑞典语：Stockholms blodbad）是一场审判，随后于1520年11月7日至9日在斯德哥尔摩发生一系列处决，也称斯德哥尔摩大屠杀。事件发生在克里斯蒂安二世加冕为瑞典国王后，受邀参加加冕庆典的宾客被召集到三王冠城堡开会。

en.s: The Battle of Lagunillas was a battle in the Arauco War on November 8, 1557, between the army of García Hurtado de Mendoza and the Mapuche army near some shallow lakes a league south of the Bio-Bio River.

zh.s: 拉古尼利亚斯战役是阿劳卡战争中的一场战斗，于1557年11月8日爆发。交战双方是加西亚·乌尔塔多·德·门多萨率领的军队和马普切军队，战场位于比奥比奥河以南约一里处的几处浅湖附近。

en.s: The free election of 1576 was the second royal election to be held in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which took place in 1575/1576. In the night of June 28–29, 1574, King Henry III of France secretly left Poland to claim the French throne. The Commonwealth was left without a monarch, and the period of interregnum ended with a double election.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1576年波兰立陶宛王位自由选举
zh.s: 1576年自由选举是波兰立陶宛联邦举行的第二次王位选举，发生于1575至1576年。1574年6月28日至29日夜间，法国国王亨利三世秘密离开波兰，前往继承法国王位。联邦因此失去君主，空位期最终以双重选举告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Guadalupe Island, also known as the Battle of Guadalupe, was a naval action that took place off Guadalupe Island (French: Guadeloupe), Caribbean Sea, on November 8, 1595, between a Spanish force of five frigates commanded by Don Pedro Tello de Guzmán and Don Gonzalo Méndez de Cancio (who was appointed Admiral on August 19, 1595), and an English squadron of nine ships (rear of Francis Drake's fleet), during the unsuccessful English military expedition of 1595 against Spain and their possessions, led by Sir Francis Drake himself, Sir John Hawkins and Sir Thomas Baskerville, as the context of the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604).

zh.s: 1595年11月8日，西班牙和英格兰舰队在加勒比海瓜德罗普岛附近海域交战，史称瓜德罗普岛海战，也称瓜德罗普海战。西班牙一方有五艘护卫舰，由佩德罗·特略·德·古斯曼和贡萨洛·门德斯·德·坎西奥指挥；后者于1595年8月19日获任命为海军上将。英格兰一方有九艘船，是弗朗西斯·德雷克舰队的后卫。这场海战发生在1585至1604年英西战争期间，属于1595年德雷克、约翰·霍金斯和托马斯·巴斯克维尔爵士率领的英军远征西班牙及其属地行动的一部分；远征最终未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of White Mountain (Czech: Bitva na Bílé hoře, German: Schlacht am Weißen Berg) was an early battle in the Thirty Years' War fought on 8 November 1620 (New Style calendar), in which an army of 15,000 Bohemians and mercenaries under Christian of Anhalt were defeated by 27,000 men of the combined armies of Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor, under Charles Bonaventure de Longueval, Count of Bucquoy and the German Catholic League under Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly at Bílá Hora ("White Mountain"), near Prague (now part of the city).

zh.s: 1620年11月8日，三十年战争早期，波希米亚军队与雇佣兵在白山战役中战败。安哈尔特的克里斯蒂安率领1.5万人参战，对手是神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世麾下由布屈瓦伯爵夏尔·博纳旺蒂尔·德·隆格瓦尔指挥的军队，以及天主教联盟由蒂利伯爵约翰·特泽拉斯指挥的军队，合计2.7万人。战役发生于布拉格附近的白山（捷克语：Bílá Hora），该地如今已属于布拉格市区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Pont du Feneau was the last battle of the siege of Saint-Martin-de-Ré by the English forces that had come to help the Huguenot rebellions of La Rochelle. It took place on 8 November 1627. The English lost the battle, and this final failure forced them to withdraw back to England.

zh.s: 费诺桥战役是圣马丹德雷岛围城战的最后一场战斗。英国军队当时前来支援拉罗谢尔的胡格诺派起义军。战斗于1627年11月8日爆发，英国军队战败，最终被迫撤回英格兰。

en.t: The Shunzhi Emperor (portrait shown), the third emperor of the Qing dynasty, was enthroned in Beijing after the collapse of the Ming dynasty as the first Qing emperor to rule over China
en.s: The Shunzhi Emperor (15 March 1638 – 5 February 1661), personal name Fulin, was the second emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the first Qing emperor to rule over China proper. Upon the death of his father Hong Taiji, a committee of Manchu princes chose the 5-year-old Fulin as successor. The princes also appointed two co-regents: Dorgon, the 14th son of Nurhaci, and Jirgalang, one of Nurhaci's nephews, both of whom were members of the Aisin-Gioro clan.

zh.t: 清朝第三位皇帝顺治帝在明朝灭亡后于北京登基，成为首位统治中国的清朝皇帝
zh.s: 顺治帝（1638年3月15日—1661年2月5日），名福临，是清朝第二位皇帝，也是首位统治中国本土的清朝皇帝。父亲皇太极去世后，满洲王公会议推举年仅5岁的福临继位。王公们还任命两位摄政王：努尔哈赤第十四子多尔衮，以及努尔哈赤的侄子济尔哈朗；两人均属爱新觉罗氏。

en.s: The Battle of Arronches was an encounter between the forces of the Portuguese Empire and of the Spanish Empire in 1653, near Arronches, Alentejo. The Portuguese, significantly outnumbered, managed to outflank the Spanish forces and defeat them badly.

zh.s: 1653年11月8日，葡萄牙与西班牙军队在葡萄牙阿连特茹地区的阿龙谢什附近交战。葡萄牙军队虽然兵力较少，仍设法绕到西班牙军队侧翼，并将其击败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: This battle took place on 6, 7, and 8 November 1772, during the Russo-Turkish War (1768–74) in the Gulf of Patras, Greece, when a Russian fleet under Mikhail Konyaev defeated an Ottoman force of frigates and xebecs, destroying all 9 frigates and 10 out of 16 xebecs while losing no ships.

zh.s: 1772年11月6日至8日，俄土战争（1768—1774年）期间，俄罗斯舰队在米哈伊尔·科尼亚耶夫率领下，于希腊帕特雷湾击败奥斯曼舰队。俄军击毁奥斯曼9艘护卫舰和16艘轻型桨帆船中的10艘，自己没有损失舰艇。

en.s: The 1779 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1779, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Candidate Thomas Sim Lee was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against his opponent Edward Lloyd.

zh.s: 1779年马里兰州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。托马斯·西姆·李在马里兰州议会的选举中击败爱德华·劳埃德，当选州长。

en.s: The San Juan Expedition took place between March and November 1780 during the American War of Independence when a British force under the command of John Polson and Captain Horatio Nelson landed in Mosquitia. Their aim was to sail up the San Juan River to capture the strategically crucial towns of Granada and León, located on the north-western shore of Lake Nicaragua.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣胡安远征发生于1780年3月至11月的美国独立战争期间。约翰·波尔森和霍雷肖·纳尔逊上尉率领的英军在莫斯基托海岸登陆，计划沿圣胡安河上行，夺取格拉纳达和莱昂两座战略要地；两城位于尼加拉瓜湖西北岸。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1790 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1790, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Eager Howard was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1790年马里兰州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任联邦党州长约翰·伊格·霍华德在没有对手的情况下参选，由马里兰州议会轻松选出，成功连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.t: 1790 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1790 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on November 8, 1790. The former Continental Congressman John Vining won reelection.

zh.t: 1790年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1790年特拉华州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行。前大陆会议代表约翰·维宁成功连任。

en.s: The 1791 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1791, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican nominee and incumbent Governor Edward Telfair won re-election in a Georgia General Assembly vote as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1791年佐治亚州州长选举于1791年11月8日举行。民主共和党候选人、现任州长爱德华·特尔费尔在佐治亚州议会投票中无人竞争，赢得连任。

en.s: The siege of Nijmegen occurred from 27 October to 8 November 1794 during the Flanders campaign of the War of the First Coalition. It was the last major military confrontation between the forces of the Revolutionary French First Republic and the reactionary First Coalition of European monarchs including William V, Prince of Orange, before the fall of the Dutch Republic in January 1795, which William had ruled as hereditary stadtholder since 1751.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼美根围城战发生于1794年10月27日至11月8日，是第一次反法同盟战争中佛兰德斯战役的一部分。这是法兰西第一共和国革命军与由欧洲君主组成的第一次反法同盟之间最后一次重大军事交锋；1795年1月，荷兰共和国沦陷。自1751年以来，威廉五世一直以世袭执政身份统治该国。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1799 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1799, in order to elect the governor of Georgia. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor James Jackson won re-election in a Georgia General Assembly vote as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1799年佐治亚州州长选举于1799年11月8日举行。现任民主共和党州长詹姆斯·杰克逊在佐治亚州议会投票中无人竞争，赢得连任。

en.s: The 1802 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1802, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor John Francis Mercer was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against his opponent Federalist nominee James Murray in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1802年马里兰州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主共和党籍时任州长约翰·弗朗西斯·默瑟在马里兰州议会的选举中击败联邦党提名人詹姆斯·默里，成功连任。这是上次选举的重赛。

en.s: The Battle of Mariazell or Battle of Grossraming (8 November 1805) saw the advance guard of the French III Corps attack a retreating Austrian force led by Maximilian, Count of Merveldt. The advance guard, led by Étienne Heudelet de Bierre overwhelmed their demoralized enemies, capturing about half of them. Marshal Louis Davout commanded the III Corps. The action occurred during the War of the Third Coalition, which is part of the Napoleonic Wars. Mariazell is located in the Austrian province of Styria, about 50 kilometres (31 mi) south of St. Pölten.

zh.s: 1805年11月8日，法军第三军团前锋进攻由梅尔维尔德伯爵马克西米利安率领的奥军撤退部队，爆发玛利亚采尔战役，又称格罗斯拉明战役。埃蒂安·厄德莱·德比埃尔率领的法军前锋击溃了士气低落的敌军，并俘获约一半人员。达武元帅指挥法军第三军团。此战发生于第三次反法同盟战争期间，该战争属于拿破仑战争的一部分。玛利亚采尔位于奥地利施蒂里亚州，圣珀尔滕以南约50公里。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The siege of Magdeburg (French: Siège de Magdebourg) took place from 25 October to 8 November 1806 during the War of the Fourth Coalition. A French force, initially under the command of Marshal Joachim Murat, then a French army Corps under the command of Marshal Michel Ney, laid siege and eventually obtained the surrender of Franz Kasimir von Kleist's Prussian force that had taken refuge in Magdeburg, Prussia's second city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马格德堡围城战发生于1806年10月25日至11月8日，是第四次反法同盟战争的一部分。法军先由缪拉元帅指挥，随后改由内伊元帅指挥，围困了避难于普鲁士第二大城市马格德堡的普鲁士军队。最终，法军迫使弗朗茨·卡西米尔·冯·克莱斯特率军投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Point Iroquois was a small skirmish fought on the morning of November 8, 1813, as part of Wilkinson's advance up the St. Lawrence towards Montreal. The skirmish occurred on the shores of the St. Lawrence River at Point Iroquois, Dundas County, where the river reached its narrowest point, only 500 yards across.

zh.s: 伊洛魁角战斗是1813年11月8日上午发生的一场小规模冲突，属于威尔金森沿圣劳伦斯河向蒙特利尔推进的行动之一。战斗发生在圣劳伦斯河畔的伊洛魁角，位于邓达斯县。河流在此处最窄，仅约500码宽。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: A presidential election was held in New York on November 8, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins received 29 votes from electors chosen by the New York State Legislature. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a presidential candidate, but unpledged electors received 42 votes from Federalist legislators.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举纽约州结果
zh.s: 1816年美国总统选举纽约州投票于11月8日举行。民主共和党候选人、美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗和纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的竞选组合，获得由纽约州议会选出的总统选举人投下的29票。联邦党没有提名总统候选人，但未承诺支持特定候选人的选举人从联邦党议员手中获得42票。

en.s: The Battle of Pirajá was part of the War of Independence of Brazil, and was fought in the province of Bahia on November 8, 1822.

zh.s: 1822年11月8日，巴西独立战争期间，双方在巴伊亚省的皮拉雅交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1824 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 8, 1824, as part of the 1824 United States presidential election. The junior U.S. senator from Tennessee Andrew Jackson defeated the speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives Henry Clay and the U.S. secretary of state John Quincy Adams. All three candidates represented the Democratic-Republican Party.

zh.t: 1824年美国总统选举印第安纳州投票
zh.s: 1824年11月8日，作为1824年美国总统选举的一部分，印第安纳州举行总统选举投票。来自田纳西州的联邦参议员安德鲁·杰克逊击败联邦众议院议长亨利·克莱和国务卿约翰·昆西·亚当斯。这三名候选人都代表民主共和党。

en.s: The siege of Silistra (July 21 – November 8, 1828) was an unsuccessful Russian siege during the Russo-Turkish War, 1828–1829.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 锡利斯特拉围城战发生于1828年7月21日至11月8日，是俄土战争（1828—1829年）期间俄军一次未能成功的围城战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Louisiana on November 8, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Louisiana voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over Whig candidate Hugh Lawson White. Van Buren won Louisiana by a narrow margin of 3.48%.

zh.t: 1836年美国总统选举路易斯安那州结果
zh.s: 1836年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于11月8日举行。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。路易斯安那州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，击败辉格党候选人休·劳森·怀特。范布伦以3.48个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1836 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1836. Democratic Governor Caleb P. Bennett, elected in 1832 and died in office on May 9, 1836, and was succeeded by State Senate Speaker (and former Governor) Charles Polk Jr., a Whig. Former State House Speaker and State Treasurer Cornelius P. Comegys ran as the Whig nominee to succeed Polk and faced Democratic nominee Nehemiah Clark in the general election.

zh.s: 1836年特拉华州州长选举于11月8日举行。1832年当选的民主党州长凯莱布·P·贝内特于1836年5月9日在任内去世，由辉格党人、州参议院议长兼前州长小查尔斯·波尔克接任。前州众议院议长兼州财务长科尼利厄斯·P·科梅吉斯作为辉格党提名人竞选接替波尔克，并在普选中对阵民主党提名人尼希米·克拉克。

en.s: The Battle of Baker's Farm took place in Lower Canada on November 8, 1838, during the Patriot's War. It was the first and last military success of the Patriotes in the campaign of 1838. 800 Patriotes gathered on a farm near Sainte-Martine, Quebec, and fought off several attacks by Loyalist volunteers. After news of the defeat of Patriote forces at the Battle of Odelltown spread, the massed Patriotes dispersed before the arrival of British troops.

zh.s: 贝克农场战役于1838年11月8日在下加拿大爆发，属于爱国者战争。它是1838年战役中爱国者派唯一一次军事胜利。800名爱国者派成员聚集在魁北克圣马丁附近的一座农场，击退了效忠派志愿者的数次进攻。爱国者派在奥德尔敦战役中战败的消息传开后，他们在英军到达前便四散离开。

en.s: The 1841 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Incumbent Whig Governor John Davis was re-elected to a second consecutive term in office over Democrat Marcus Morton.

zh.s: 1841年11月8日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。辉格党籍现任州长约翰·戴维斯击败民主党候选人马库斯·莫顿，连续第二次当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1842 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1842, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York.

zh.s: 1842年11月8日，纽约州举行州长及副州长选举。

en.s: The 1847 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Incumbent Whig Governor George N. Briggs was re-elected to a fifth term in office over Democrat Caleb Cushing. This was the last election in which the Whig Party received a majority of the vote; after the emergence of the Free Soil Party in 1848, Whigs only won pluralities before fading away entirely by the 1857 election.

zh.s: 1847年11月8日，辉格党籍现任州长乔治·N·布里格斯击败民主党候选人凯莱布·库欣，第五次当选马萨诸塞州州长。这是辉格党最后一次在该州州长选举中获得过半选票。自由土地党于1848年兴起后，辉格党只能以相对多数获胜，并在1857年选举前退出该州州长角逐。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Friedau was a battle in the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 8 November 1848 between the Hungarian Revolutionary Army under the command of General Mór Perczel and the Austrian K.u.K. troops under General Johann Wilhelm Burits de Pournay.

zh.s: 弗里道战役是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争中的一场战斗，于1848年11月8日爆发。匈牙利革命军由莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率领，奥地利皇家和帝国军队由约翰·威廉·布里茨·德·波尔奈将军指挥。

en.s: The 1852–53 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular vote held on November 8, 1852, followed by a legislative vote conducted on January 12, 1853, which elected Whig Party nominee John H. Clifford. The ultimate task of electing the governor had been placed before the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the majority of the vote required for a candidate to be elected through the popular election.

zh.s: 1852—1853年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1852年11月8日举行民众投票，再于1853年1月12日由州议会投票，选出辉格党候选人约翰·H.克利福德。由于民众投票中没有候选人获得当选所需的过半数选票，最终由马萨诸塞州议会选出州长。

en.s: The 1853 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1853. Democratic candidate William A. Barstow won the election with 55% of the vote, winning his first term as Governor of Wisconsin. Barstow defeated Free Soil Party candidate Edward D. Holton and Whig candidate Henry S. Baird. This would be the last Wisconsin gubernatorial election in which there was a Whig candidate on the ballot.

zh.s: 1853年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人威廉·A.巴斯托以55%的得票率胜出，开始他的第一个州长任期。他击败了自由土壤党候选人爱德华·D.霍尔顿和辉格党候选人亨利·S.贝尔德。这是最后一次有辉格党候选人参加威斯康星州州长选举。

en.s: The 1853 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1853, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Former Democratic US Senator for Mississippi John J. McRae defeated the Whig nominee Francis M. Rogers.

zh.s: 1853年密西西比州州长选举于11月8日举行。前民主党籍美国参议员约翰·J.麦克雷击败辉格党候选人弗朗西斯·M.罗杰斯。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1859 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1859. Republican Charles Smith Olden defeated Democratic nominee Edwin R. V. Wright with 50.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1859年11月8日，新泽西州举行州长选举。共和党人查尔斯·史密斯·奥尔登击败民主党候选人埃德温·R·V·赖特，以50.76%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1859 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1859, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Democratic governor Henry Hastings Sibley did not seek a second term.

zh.s: 1859年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长亨利·黑斯廷斯·西布利没有竞选第二个任期。

en.s: The 1859 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1859. Republican Party incumbent Governor Alexander Randall won re-election with 53% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate Harrison Carroll Hobart. This election was one of only four occasions in which a Democrat has carried Door County and the only time in the 19th century; Door County would not vote Democratic again until 1904.

zh.s: 1859年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长亚历山大·兰德尔以53%的得票率赢得连任，击败民主党候选人哈里森·卡罗尔·霍巴特。这是民主党仅有的4次赢得多尔县选举之一，也是19世纪唯一一次。此后，该县直到1904年才再次支持民主党。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1864 was the 20th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 8, 1864. In this match, incumbent president Republican Abraham Lincoln ran for re-election against Democratic candidate George B. McClellan, who tried to portray himself to the voters as the "peace candidate" who wanted to bring the American Civil War to a speedy end. Lincoln was re-elected president by a landslide in the Electoral College. Since the election of 1860, the Electoral College had expanded with the admission of Kansas, West Virginia, and Nevada as free-soil states.

zh.s: 1864年11月8日星期二，美国举行第20次四年一度总统选举。共和党籍现任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯竞选连任，对手是民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦。麦克莱伦试图把自己塑造成“和平候选人”，主张尽快结束美国内战。林肯在选举人团投票中以压倒性优势连任。自1860年选举以来，堪萨斯、西弗吉尼亚和内华达以自由州身份加入美国，选举人团规模随之扩大。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1864
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose 26 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the National Union candidate, Abraham Lincoln, over the Democratic candidate, George B. McClellan. Lincoln won Pennsylvania by a margin of 3.5%.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1864年11月8日，作为1864年美国总统选举的一部分，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出26名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持国家联盟党候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯，击败民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦。林肯以3.5%的优势赢得该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1864
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1864. Wisconsin voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. National Union Party candidate and incumbent President Abraham Lincoln won the state with 56% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's eight electoral votes.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举威斯康星州投票
zh.s: 1864年11月8日，威斯康星州举行总统选举投票。选民选出8名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。国家联盟党候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯以56%的普选票赢得该州及威斯康星州的8张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1864
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1864 were elections for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1864. California's all-Republican delegation was unchanged. This was the first election in which California was divided into districts. Formerly, all three seats were elected at-large.

zh.t: 1864年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1864年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院普选，选出该州联邦众议员。加州全部由共和党人组成的联邦众议员代表团没有变化。这是该州首次划分联邦众议院选区；此前三个席位均由全州选民选举产生。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1864 was Missouri's fourteenth gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 8, 1864 and resulted in a victory for the Union Republican nominee, Thomas Clement Fletcher, over Democratic nominee former Congressman (and former Lt. Gov.) Thomas Lawson Price.

zh.s: 1864年11月8日，密苏里州举行第十四次州长选举。联盟共和党候选人托马斯·克莱门特·弗莱彻击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员及前副州长托马斯·劳森·普赖斯，当选州长。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Minnesota was won by the National Union nominee, incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举明尼苏达州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举明尼苏达州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。明尼苏达州支持国家联盟候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose 16 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois was won by the National Union candidate incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出16名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州支持国家联盟候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1864 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1864, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Illinois. National Union nominee William Bross defeated Democratic nominee Solomon Corning Judd.

zh.s: 1864年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。国家联盟提名人威廉·布罗斯击败民主党提名人所罗门·科宁·贾德。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first presidential election in which Kansas participated, following its admission as the 34th state on January 29, 1861.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举堪萨斯州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举堪萨斯州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。这是堪萨斯州成为美国第34个州后首次参加总统选举；该州于1861年1月29日加入联邦。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by the National Union candidate incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举马里兰州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举马里兰州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马里兰州支持国家联盟候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举密苏里州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举密苏里州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密苏里州支持国家联盟候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors of the Electoral College, two of whom voted for president and vice president. Nevada voted in its first ever presidential election in 1864, having become the 36th state just eight days before the election (on October 31).

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举内华达州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举内华达州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，其中2人投票选出总统和副总统。内华达州于1864年首次参加总统选举；就在投票前8天，即10月31日，该州成为美国第36个州。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Kansas on November 8, 1864. The Republican colonel of the 2nd Kansas Colored Infantry Regiment Samuel J. Crawford defeated the Union judge of the U.S. district court for the District of Kansas Solon O. Thacher. The Union Party was organized in 1862 by opponents of U.S. Senator Jim Lane to contest the 1862 state elections.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1864年11月8日举行州长选举。第二堪萨斯有色步兵团的共和党上校塞缪尔·J·克劳福德击败联邦党候选人索隆·O·撒切尔，后者曾任美国堪萨斯地区联邦地区法院法官。联邦党于1862年由反对联邦参议员吉姆·莱恩的人士组建，参加了当年的州选举。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican Party President Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic candidate, George B.

zh.s: 1864年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持国家联盟党候选人、时任共和党总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档安德鲁·约翰逊。他们击败了民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档乔治·H·彭德尔顿。林肯在该州以24.48个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont voted for the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic candidate, George B.

zh.s: 1864年佛蒙特州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持国家联盟党候选人、时任共和党总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档安德鲁·约翰逊。他们击败了民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档乔治·H·彭德尔顿。林肯在该州以52.20个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in California took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose five electors of the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California was won by the Republican incumbent, Abraham Lincoln, running on the Nation Union ticket with his running mate Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯与竞选搭档安德鲁·约翰逊以国家联盟党候选人身份赢得加州。

en.s: The 1864 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1864. Incumbent Union Party Governor Augustus Bradford did not run for re-election. Union Party candidate Thomas Swann defeated Democratic candidate Ezekiel F. Chambers. The Union Party was a Southern Unionist political movement which supported the Lincoln administration. Most Unionists were former Whigs who had joined the Know Nothing movement in the 1850s, while a minority were Radical Republicans or War Democrats.

zh.s: 1864年马里兰州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任联邦党州长奥古斯塔斯·布拉德福德没有竞选连任。联邦党候选人托马斯·斯旺击败民主党候选人以西结·F·钱伯斯。联邦党是南方统一主义政治运动，支持林肯政府。多数联邦党人原为辉格党人，后来于19世纪50年代加入一无所知党；少数人则是激进共和党人或战时民主党人。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by National Union candidate, incumbent Republican president Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic challenger George B.

zh.s: 1864年密歇根州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。密歇根州支持国家联盟党候选人、时任共和党总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档安德鲁·约翰逊。他们击败了民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档乔治·H·彭德尔顿。林肯在该州以7.2个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by the National Union candidate Republican incumbent President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持国家联盟候选人、伊利诺伊州共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Louisiana voted for incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln. The state (along with Tennessee) chose electors for the election after being captured early in the American Civil War. However, due to war issues, its votes were rejected.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举路易斯安那州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州支持共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯。路易斯安那州和田纳西州在美国内战初期被联邦军占领后，都举行了选举并选出总统选举人。不过，由于战事影响，路易斯安那州的选举人票遭到拒绝。

McClellan and the U.S. representative from Ohio's 1st congressional district George H.

New Hampshire voted for the National Union candidate, incumbent president Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic candidate, George B.

en.s: The 1864 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1864. National Union nominee Henry H. Crapo defeated Democratic nominee William M. Fenton with 55.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1864年密歇根州州长选举于11月8日举行。国家联盟提名人亨利·H·克拉波以55.14%的得票率击败民主党提名人威廉·M·芬顿。

Massachusetts voted for the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican president Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic candidate, George B.

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey voted for the Democratic candidate, George B. McClellan, over the National Union candidate, incumbent president Abraham Lincoln.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举新泽西州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举新泽西州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新泽西州支持民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦，击败国家联盟候选人、时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first time that West Virginia participated in an election since gaining statehood, as it had been admitted as the 35th state on June 20, 1863.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。这是西弗吉尼亚州加入联邦成为第35个州后首次参加总统选举；该州于1863年6月20日加入联邦。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Democratic nominee, 4th Commanding General of the United States Army George B. McClellan of New Jersey and his running mate Representative George H.

zh.s: 1864年特拉华州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自新泽西州的美国陆军第4任总司令乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档、联邦众议员乔治·H·彭德尔顿赢得特拉华州。他们击败了国家联盟党候选人、时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其搭档、参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。麦克莱伦以3.62个百分点的微弱优势获胜。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln of Illinois and his running mate former Senator and Military Governor of Tennessee Andrew Johnson.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举俄勒冈州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。俄勒冈州支持国家联盟候选人、伊利诺伊州共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼田纳西州军事总督安德鲁·约翰逊。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose 10 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. However, due to Tennessee's prior secession and allegiance to the Confederacy, all votes from the state were rejected. Tennessee voted for the National Union candidate, incumbent Republican President Abraham Lincoln.

zh.t: 1864年美国总统选举田纳西州结果
zh.s: 1864年美国总统选举田纳西州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。州议会选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。不过，由于田纳西州此前脱离联邦并加入邦联，该州的所有选举人票都被拒绝。田纳西州支持国家联盟候选人、共和党籍时任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the National Union candidate, Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Andrew Johnson. They defeated the Democratic candidate, George B.

zh.s: 1864年康涅狄格州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持国家联盟党候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯及其搭档安德鲁·约翰逊。他们击败了民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档乔治·H·彭德尔顿。林肯以2.76个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1864 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1864 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1864, as part of the 1864 United States presidential election. State voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky being captured by the Union and driving out the Confederacy early in the war was won by the Democratic candidate, 4th Commanding General of the United States Army George B.

zh.s: 1864年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出11名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。尽管肯塔基州在战争初期被联邦军占领、邦联军被逐出，该州仍支持民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其竞选搭档、联邦众议员乔治·H·彭德尔顿。麦克莱伦以压倒性优势获胜，领先39.64个百分点。

zh.s: 1864年缅因州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。缅因州支持国家联盟党候选人、时任共和党总统亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档安德鲁·约翰逊。他们击败了民主党候选人乔治·B·麦克莱伦及其搭档乔治·H·彭德尔顿。林肯以18.14个百分点的优势赢得该州。

zh.s: 1864年密苏里州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。共和党提名人、前密苏里州众议员乔治·史密斯击败民主党提名人卢克·W·伯里。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1864 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1864. Incumbent Governor Horatio Seymour ran for re-election to a second consecutive term in office but was defeated by National Union candidate Reuben E. Fenton.

zh.s: 1864年纽约州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任州长霍雷肖·西摩竞选连任，争取连续第二个任期，但败给了国家联盟党候选人鲁本·E.芬顿。

en.s: The 1864 New York state election was held on November 8, 1864, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a Canal Commissioner and an Inspector of State Prisons, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly.

zh.s: 1864年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、一名运河委员、一名州监狱督察，以及州众议院全部议员。

en.s: The 1864 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Governor John Albion Andrew was re-elected to a fifth term in office over Democrat Henry W. Paine.

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Florida, 1870
en.s: The election to the United States House of Representatives in Florida was held on November 8, 1870 for the 42nd Congress, the last election in which Florida had a single Representative.

zh.s: 1870年11月8日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出第42届国会代表。这是佛罗里达州仅有一名联邦众议员的最后一次选举。

en.s: The 1870 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Liberal Republican nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Missouri's 4th district Joseph J. Gravely won the election as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1870年密苏里州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。自由共和党提名人、前密苏里州第4选区联邦众议员约瑟夫·J·格雷夫利在没有对手的情况下当选。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1870 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870, in order to elect the Governor of Nevada. The Democratic nominee Lewis R. Bradley won the election against Republican nominee and Nevada State Senator Frederick Augustus Tritle.

zh.s: 1870年内华达州州长选举于11月8日举行，旨在选出内华达州州长。民主党候选人刘易斯·R·布拉德利击败共和党候选人、内华达州参议员弗雷德里克·奥古斯都·特里特尔，当选州长。

en.s: The 1870 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870, in order to elect the Governor of Kansas. Incumbent Republican Governor of Kansas James M. Harvey defeated Democratic nominee Isaac Sharp.

zh.s: 1870年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍时任州长詹姆斯·M·哈维击败民主党提名人艾萨克·夏普。

en.s: The 1870 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870. Incumbent Democratic Governor Gove Saulsbury was unable to seek re-election. Former State Senator James Ponder ran as the Democratic candidate to succeed Saulsbury and faced Republican nominee Thomas B. Coursey. As Black Delawareans gained the right to vote, Republicans were confident about their chances, and the Democratic Party responded by presenting itself as the "white man's party."

zh.s: 1870年特拉华州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长戈夫·索尔斯伯里不能竞选连任。前州参议员詹姆斯·庞德作为民主党候选人竞选接替索尔斯伯里，并在普选中对阵共和党提名人托马斯·B·考西。随着非裔特拉华居民获得投票权，共和党人对胜选充满信心，民主党则自称“白人政党”以应对。

en.s: The 1870 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870, to elect the governor of Tennessee. The Democratic nominee, former Confederate general John C. Brown overwhelmingly defeated Republican nominee William H. Wisener by a margin of 31.10%.

zh.s: 1870年田纳西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人、前邦联将军约翰·C.布朗以31.10个百分点的优势大胜共和党候选人威廉·H.威斯纳。

en.s: The 1870 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1870, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Incumbent Republican William Hugh Smith was narrowly defeated by Democrat Robert B. Lindsay. The run-up to the election was marred by political and racist terrorism by the Ku Klux Klan, in support of Lindsay.

zh.s: 1870年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党州长威廉·休·史密斯险败给民主党人罗伯特·B.林赛。选举前夕，三K党为支持林赛，进行了带有政治和种族主义色彩的恐怖活动。

en.s: The 1870 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870. Incumbent Governor John T. Hoffman won re-election to a second term in office over Republican Stewart L. Woodford. As of 2026, this is the most recent time a former mayor of New York City was elected Governor of New York or to any higher office.

zh.s: 1870年纽约州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任州长约翰·T.霍夫曼击败共和党人斯图尔特·L.伍德福德，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。截至2026年，这是纽约市前市长最近一次当选纽约州州长或其他更高职位。

en.s: The 1870 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1870, and resulted in a victory for the Liberal Republican nominee, former Senator Benjamin Gratz Brown, over incumbent Republican governor Joseph W. McClurg. The election centered on the restoration of political rights for Confederates and Confederate sympathizers, leading to a split in the state Republican Party. In addition to support for re-enfranchisement, Liberals supported tariff reform and were critical of President Ulysses S.

zh.s: 密苏里州州长选举于1870年11月8日举行，自由共和党提名人、前参议员本杰明·格拉茨·布朗击败时任共和党州长约瑟夫·W·麦克卢格。选举焦点是恢复邦联成员及其支持者的政治权利，这导致州共和党分裂。自由派除了支持恢复选举权，还支持关税改革，并批评总统尤利西斯·S。

en.s: The 1870 New York state election was held on November 8, 1870, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the New York State Comptroller, two Canal Commissioners and an Inspector of State Prisons, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. This followed the 1870 New York special judicial election.

zh.s: 1870年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、州财务主管、两名运河委员、一名州监狱督察，以及州众议院全部议员。此前，该州还举行过1870年特别司法选举。

en.s: The 1870 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Governor William Clafin was re-elected to a third consecutive one-year term, defeating Democrat John Quincy Adams II and abolitionist attorney Wendell Phillips, running on the Labor Reform ticket. In the concurrent but separate election for lieutenant governor, Republican Joseph Tucker was also re-elected to a third term.

zh.s: 1870年11月8日，马萨诸塞州州长威廉·克拉夫林击败民主党候选人小约翰·昆西·亚当斯和代表劳工改革派参选的废奴主义律师温德尔·菲利普斯，连续第三次赢得一年任期。同日举行的副州长选举中，共和党人约瑟夫·塔克也第三次当选。

en.s: The Siege of Verdun was a battle fought in France during the Franco-Prussian War from 13 October until 8 November 1870. The siege was launched by the Legion of Saxony. After fierce resistance by the French army at the fortress of Verdun (longer resistance than any other French fortress), the siege ended with Verdun taking the lead with German Army goods.

zh.s: 凡尔登围城战是普法战争期间法国的一场战斗，从1870年10月13日持续至11月8日。围城由萨克森军团发起。法国军队在凡尔登要塞顽强抵抗，抵抗时间超过其他法国要塞；围城最终以凡尔登被德军攻占而告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1873 Newfoundland general election was held on November 8, 1873 to elect members of the 11th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Colony of Newfoundland. The Anti-Confederates led by Charles Fox Bennett formed the government; a "new" Conservative party led by Frederick Carter formed the opposition.

zh.s: 1873年纽芬兰大选于11月8日举行，选出纽芬兰殖民地第11届议会的议员。查尔斯·福克斯·贝内特领导的反联邦派组建政府；弗雷德里克·卡特领导的新保守党成为反对派。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 8 November, with a second round of voting on 15 November. They were a snap election, called by Prime Minister Marco Minghetti to strengthen his majority. Only 571,939 men of a total population of around 28 million were entitled to vote. Right-wing candidates emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament with around 48% of the seats in Parliament.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 意大利于11月8日举行大选，第二轮投票于11月15日举行。这次提前选举由首相马尔科·明盖蒂发起，目的是巩固其多数席位。约2800万人口中，只有571,939名男性有投票资格。右翼候选人以约48%的议席成为议会中最大的阵营。
zh.n: 原文资料框将此条日期定为首轮投票日。

en.s: The 1881 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1881. The Readjuster Party candidate William Evelyn Cameron won in a historic upset election. The Readjusters were a unique state mixture of Republicans, Conservative (or "New Departure") Democrats, freedmen, poor voters, and those in favor of "re-adjusting" the state debt owed to Northern banks for the various internal improvements financed before the war. Some of those internal improvements went to West Virginia, as they were physically located in there, as it counter-seceded from Virginia, who had sided with the Confederacy during the Civil War.

zh.s: 1881年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。调整党候选人威廉·伊夫林·卡梅伦在一次具有历史意义的选举中意外获胜。调整党是一个独特的州内联盟，成员包括共和党人、保守派（又称“新出发派”）民主党人、获得自由的黑人、贫困选民，以及支持重新调整该州欠北方银行债务的人。这些债务用于战前的各类内部建设，其中一些建设项目位于西弗吉尼亚州。内战期间，该州脱离弗吉尼亚并加入联邦。

en.s: The 1881 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1881, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives William W. Braden defeated Democratic nominee Rudolph Lehmicke, Greenback nominee Ebenezer Ayres and Prohibition nominee G.A. Armstrong.

zh.t: 1881年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1881年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、前明尼苏达州众议员威廉·W·布雷登击败民主党提名人鲁道夫·莱米克、绿背党提名人以便尼泽·艾尔斯和禁酒党提名人G·A·阿姆斯特朗。

en.s: The 1881 Minnesota attorney general election was held on November 8, 1881, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general William John Hahn defeated Democratic nominee George N. Baxter, Greenback nominee Joseph McKnight and Prohibition nominee Alfred W. Bangs.

zh.t: 1881年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1881年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任代理总检察长威廉·约翰·哈恩击败民主党提名人乔治·N·巴克斯特、绿背党提名人约瑟夫·麦克奈特和禁酒党提名人阿尔弗雷德·W·班斯。

en.s: The 1881 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1881. Republican nominee Jeremiah McLain Rusk defeated Democratic nominee Nicholas D. Fratt and two other nominees with 47.57% of the vote. This was the last Wisconsin gubernatorial election held in an odd-numbered year. In 1882, a constitutional amendment was carried moving gubernatorial elections to even-numbered years.

zh.s: 1881年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人耶利米·麦克莱恩·拉斯克以47.57%的得票率击败民主党提名人尼古拉斯·D·弗拉特和另外两名候选人。这是威斯康星州最后一次在奇数年举行州长选举。1882年，一项宪法修正案获得通过，将州长选举改为在偶数年举行。

en.s: The 1881 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1881, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Frederick Von Baumbach defeated Democratic nominee Alfred J. Lamberton, Greenback nominee George C. Chamberlain and Prohibition nominee William W. Regan.

zh.s: 1881年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州务卿弗雷德里克·冯·鲍姆巴赫击败民主党提名人阿尔弗雷德·J·兰伯顿、绿背党提名人乔治·C·张伯伦和禁酒党提名人威廉·W·里根。

en.s: The 1881 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1881, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. It was a rematch between Republican nominee Charles A. Gilman, now the incumbent, who defeated Democratic nominee Edward P. Barnum, Greenback Labor nominee Alexander P. Lane and Prohibition nominee George B. Kingsley.

zh.s: 1881年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人查尔斯·A·吉尔曼时任副州长，这是他与其他候选人的再次交锋。他击败了民主党提名人爱德华·P·巴纳姆、绿背工党提名人亚历山大·P·莱恩和禁酒党提名人乔治·B·金斯利。

en.s: The 1881 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1881, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Governor John M. Stone ran for reelection to a second full term, but lost the Democratic nomination to Robert Lowry.

zh.s: 1881年11月8日，密西西比州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·M·斯通原本争取第二个完整任期，但在民主党提名竞选中败给罗伯特·洛里。

en.s: The 1881 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1881, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent governor John S. Pillsbury was not nominated for a fourth term, in favor of Lucius Frederick Hubbard, who was elected.

zh.s: 1881年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任州长约翰·S.皮尔斯伯里未能获得第四个任期的提名；卢修斯·弗雷德里克·哈伯德获得提名并当选。

en.s: The 1881 mayoral election in Buffalo, New York, saw the election of former Erie County Sheriff Grover Cleveland, who defeated architect and alderman Milton Beebe by what was considered a broad margin. Cleveland would not serve out his entire term as mayor, as he would be subsequently elected Governor of New York the following year.

zh.s: 1881年11月8日，纽约州布法罗市举行市长选举。曾任伊利县警长的格罗弗·克利夫兰以较大优势击败建筑师兼市议员米尔顿·比比，当选市长。他并未做满市长任期，第二年便当选纽约州州长。

en.s: The 1881 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8.

en.s: The 1887 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1887. Incumbent Republican governor Oliver Ames was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic former U.S. representative Henry B. Lovering.

zh.s: 1887年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长奥利弗·艾姆斯击败民主党籍前联邦众议员亨利·B·洛弗林，成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1887 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1887. Incumbent Democratic Governor Henry Lloyd did not seek re-election. Democratic candidate Elihu Emory Jackson defeated Republican candidate Walter B. Brooks.

zh.s: 1887年马里兰州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长亨利·劳埃德没有竞选连任。民主党候选人伊莱休·埃默里·杰克逊击败共和党候选人沃尔特·B·布鲁克斯。

en.s: The 1887 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 8, 1887. Incumbent Republican William Larrabee defeated Democratic nominee Thomas J. Anderson with 50.18% of the vote.

zh.s: 1887年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月8日星期二举行。共和党籍时任州长威廉·拉勒比以50.18%的得票率击败民主党提名人托马斯·J·安德森。

en.s: In the 1887 Iowa State Senate elections Iowa voters elected state senators to serve in the twenty-second Iowa General Assembly. Elections were held in 32 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1887 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. The general election took place on November 8, 1887.

zh.s: 1887年艾奥瓦州参议院选举中，选民选出第22届艾奥瓦州议会的州参议员。该州50个参议院选区中有32个举行选举。州参议员任期为四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1887年选举中全州50个参议院选区的地图。普选于1887年11月8日举行。

en.s: The 1887 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 8, 1887, to elect the mayor for San Diego. This was the first mayoral election since the position was abolished due to an 1852 city bankruptcy. William Jefferson Hunsaker was elected Mayor with a majority of the votes.

zh.s: 1887年圣迭戈市长选举于11月8日举行。这是1852年因城市破产而废除市长职位后，首次举行市长选举。威廉·杰斐逊·亨萨克以多数票当选市长。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term and over the People's Party (Populists) nominee James B. Weaver. Harrison won Montana by a margin of 2.65%. This was the first time that Montana voted in a national electtion.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举蒙大拿州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，作为1892年美国总统选举的一部分，蒙大拿州举行投票。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。蒙大拿州支持共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党候选人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰（他竞选第二个非连续任期），以及人民党候选人詹姆斯·B·韦弗。哈里森在该州以2.65%的优势获胜。这是蒙大拿州首次参加全国总统选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 36 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate former Congressman and Assistant Postmaster General Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois. Cleveland and Stevenson defeated the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate U.S. Ambassador to France Whitelaw Reid of Ohio.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举纽约州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，纽约州举行总统选举投票。作为1892年美国总统选举的一部分，当时全美44个州均参加选举。纽约州选民选出36名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、纽约州前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的前联邦众议员兼助理邮政部长阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得纽约州。他们击败了共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森（来自印第安纳州）及其竞选搭档、美国驻法国大使怀特劳·里德（来自俄亥俄州）。

en.t: United States presidential election in Kansas, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Kansas voters chose 10 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Kansas was won by the Populist nominees, James B. Weaver of Iowa and his running mate James G. Field of Virginia. Weaver and Field defeated the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Whitelaw Reid of Ohio.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举堪萨斯州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，堪萨斯州举行总统选举投票。作为1892年美国总统选举的一部分，当时全美44个州均参加选举。堪萨斯州选民选出10名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。人民党候选人詹姆斯·B·韦弗（来自艾奥瓦州）及其竞选搭档詹姆斯·G·菲尔德（来自弗吉尼亚州）赢得堪萨斯州，击败共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森（来自印第安纳州）及其竞选搭档怀特劳·里德（来自俄亥俄州）。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1892 was the 27th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 8, 1892. It witnessed a re-match of the closely contested presidential election in 1888. Former Democratic President Grover Cleveland and incumbent Republican President Benjamin Harrison both ran for election to a second term. In 1888, Cleveland won the popular vote over Harrison, but lost in the electoral college, thus losing the election. In this re-match, Cleveland won both the popular and electoral vote, thus becoming the first and to date only person in American history to be elected to a second, non-consecutive presidential term.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日星期二，美国举行第27次四年一度总统选举。这是1888年激烈选举的再次对决。民主党籍前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰和共和党籍现任总统本杰明·哈里森都竞选连任。1888年，克利夫兰赢得普选票，却在选举人团投票中落败。这次，克利夫兰同时赢得普选票和选举人团票，成为美国历史上首位、也是迄今唯一一位当选非连续第二任期总统的人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 32 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，作为1892年美国总统选举的一部分，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出32名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党候选人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次竞选非连续的第二个总统任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, former President Grover Cleveland over the Republican candidate, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 17.46%.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举弗吉尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，作为1892年美国总统选举的一部分，弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出12名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森。克利夫兰以17.46%的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1892 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1892. Democrat George Theodore Werts defeated Republican nominee John Kean with 49.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日，新泽西州举行州长选举。民主党人乔治·西奥多·沃茨以49.65%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·基恩。

en.s: The 1892 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1892. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Knute Nelson defeated Democratic Party of Minnesota challenger Daniel W. Lawler and People's Party candidate Ignatius L. Donnelly.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人克努特·纳尔逊击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人丹尼尔·W·劳勒和人民党候选人伊格内修斯·L·多纳利。

en.s: The 1892 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. Republican Charles H. Sheldon was elected, defeating Independent A. L. Van Osdel and Democratic nominee Peter Couchman.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日，南达科他州举行州长选举，选出任期两年的州长。共和党人查尔斯·H·谢尔登当选，击败独立候选人A·L·范奥斯德尔和民主党候选人彼得·库奇曼。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1892
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1892 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1892. California gained one seat as a result of the 1890 Census, which was won by the Populist Party. Democrats also picked up an open Republican seat.

zh.t: 1892年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院普选，选出该州联邦众议员。根据1890年人口普查，加州增加了一个席位，该席位由人民党赢得。民主党还从共和党手中夺得一个空缺席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1892
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1892. Wisconsin voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Democratic Party candidate Grover Cleveland won the state with 48% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举威斯康星州投票
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，威斯康星州举行总统选举投票。选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰以48%的普选票赢得威斯康星州及该州12张选举人票。

en.s: On 8 November 1892, the anarchist Émile Henry carried out a bomb attack in Paris. The attack was carried out in response to the army being sent against the striking workers of the Compagnie minière de Carmaux. Henry sent a parcel bomb to the company's headquarters in Paris, located on Avenue de l'Opéra.

zh.t: 卡尔莫—邦昂方炸弹袭击
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，无政府主义者埃米尔·亨利在巴黎实施炸弹袭击。此次袭击是为了回应军队镇压卡尔莫矿业公司的罢工工人。亨利把一枚包裹炸弹寄到该公司位于巴黎歌剧院大道的总部。
