en.s: The 1892 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Incumbent Democratic Governor James E. Boyd did not seek re-election. Lorenzo Crounse, the Republican nominee, defeated both the Democratic nominee, J. Sterling Morton, and the Populist nominee, Charles Van Wyck.

zh.s: 1892年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长詹姆斯·E·博伊德没有竞选连任。共和党提名人洛伦佐·克劳斯击败民主党提名人J·斯特林·莫顿和民粹党提名人查尔斯·范·怀克。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nevada was won by the Populist nominees, James B. Weaver of Iowa and his running mate James G. Field of Virginia.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举内华达州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举内华达州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。内华达州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民粹党提名人、来自艾奥瓦州的詹姆斯·B·韦弗及其竞选搭档、来自弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯·G·菲尔德赢得内华达州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in California was held on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent President Benjamin Harrison’s administration had been plagued by divisions within his party and by controversy over foreign relations, notably with Italy and Chile.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。当时的时任总统本杰明·哈里森政府饱受党内分裂和外交争议困扰，尤其是与意大利和智利的外交问题。

en.s: The 1892 Texas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1892, to elect the governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jim Hogg was re-elected to a second term with a plurality of the vote over George W. Clark, an independent Democrat with the backing of the Republican Party and state railroad interests, and Populist judge Thomas L. Nugent.

zh.s: 1892年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长吉姆·霍格赢得多数选票，成功连任，击败独立民主党人乔治·W·克拉克。克拉克得到共和党和州内铁路利益集团支持；民粹党法官托马斯·L·纽金特也参与竞选。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey voted for the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term, over Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举新泽西州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举新泽西州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新泽西州支持民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，助其争取第二个非连续任期；他击败了共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor James M. Seibert defeated Republican nominee John N. Weeks, People's nominee J. B. Dines and Prohibition nominee David L. Steward.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州审计长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人、时任州审计长詹姆斯·M·塞伯特击败共和党提名人约翰·N·威克斯、人民党提名人J·B·戴恩斯和禁酒党提名人大卫·L·斯图尔德。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term over incumbent President Republican Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举康涅狄格州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举康涅狄格州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，助其争取第二个非连续任期，击败共和党籍时任总统本杰明·哈里森。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 8, 1892. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was narrowly won by the Republican Party candidate, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, with 47.66% of the popular vote. The Democratic Party candidate, former President Grover Cleveland, garnered 47.53% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举俄亥俄州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举俄亥俄州投票于11月8日举行。该州选民选出23名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森以微弱优势赢得俄亥俄州，获得47.66%的普选票；民主党候选人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰获得47.53%。

en.s: The 1892 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Incumbent Republican Governor Joseph W. Fifer was defeated by Democratic nominee John Peter Altgeld who won 48.74% of the vote. Altgeld was the first Democratic Governor of Illinois elected since 1852, before the foundation of the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1892年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人约翰·彼得·奥尔特盖尔德以48.74%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长约瑟夫·W·费弗。自1852年以来，伊利诺伊州首次选出民主党州长；当时共和党尚未成立。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose thirteen electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举肯塔基州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举肯塔基州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。肯塔基州选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the overthrow of Reconstruction Republican government, Louisiana, like most of the former Confederacy, established a Democratic-dominated but highly fraudulent political system in which the dominant Bourbon planter class used the newly enfranchised blacks to protect their power against potentially threatening poor whites.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举路易斯安那州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。重建时期的共和党政府被推翻后，路易斯安那州和大多数前邦联州一样，建立了由民主党主导且舞弊严重的政治体系。占主导地位的波旁种植园主阶层利用新获得选举权的黑人选民巩固权力，防范可能构成威胁的贫困白人。

en.s: The 1892 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Acting Governor Norman Bushnell Willey was defeated for renomination at the Republican convention. Republican nominee William J. McConnell defeated Democratic nominee John M. Burke and Populist nominee Abraham J. Crook with 40.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年爱达荷州州长选举于11月8日举行。代理州长诺曼·布什内尔·威利在共和党大会上未能获得连任提名。共和党提名人威廉·J·麦康奈尔以40.74%的得票率击败民主党提名人约翰·M·伯克和民粹党提名人亚伯拉罕·J·克鲁克。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Robert F. Walker defeated Republican nominee David Murphy, People's nominee William R. Littell and Prohibition nominee Walter Emmett Johnson.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人罗伯特·F·沃克击败共和党提名人大卫·墨菲、人民党提名人威廉·R·利特尔和禁酒党提名人沃尔特·埃米特·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1892 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on 8 November 1892 in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Illinois. Democratic nominee Joseph B. Gill defeated Republican nominee and incumbent Lieutenant Governor Lyman Beecher Ray and other third party candidates.

zh.s: 1892年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党提名人约瑟夫·B·吉尔击败共和党提名人、时任副州长莱曼·比彻·雷和其他第三党候选人。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1892, in 32 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 8, 1892 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections). In Florida, the gubernatorial election was held in October for the first time, having previously been held on the same day as federal elections.

zh.s: 美国于1892年11月8日在32个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同时进行。阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佛罗里达州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行了选举。佛罗里达州首次于10月举行州长选举；此前该州州长选举一直与联邦选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举新罕布什尔州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举新罕布什尔州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次争取第二个非连续任期。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. This election arguably marked the end of Reconstruction in Mississippi, with voter turnout plunging by over half following the introduction of poll taxes in the state two years prior.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举密西西比州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举密西西比州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。密西西比州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。这次选举或可视为密西西比州重建时期结束的标志；此前两年该州引入人头税，投票率随后下降了一半以上。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举特拉华州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举特拉华州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得特拉华州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举佛蒙特州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举佛蒙特州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次争取第二个非连续任期。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose 15 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Texas was won by the Democratic nominees, Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举得克萨斯州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举得克萨斯州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得得克萨斯州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 17 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Missouri was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举密苏里州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举密苏里州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出17名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得密苏里州。

en.s: The 1892 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Republican nominee John Butler Smith defeated Democratic nominee Luther F. McKinney with 50.17% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人约翰·巴特勒·史密斯以50.17%的得票率击败民主党提名人卢瑟·F·麦金尼。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent acting state treasurer Lawrence Vest Stephens defeated Republican nominee Frederick J. Wilson, People's nominee D. N. Thompson and Prohibition nominee Monroe Ingraham.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州财务长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人、时任代理州财务长劳伦斯·韦斯特·斯蒂芬斯击败共和党提名人弗雷德里克·J·威尔逊、人民党提名人D·N·汤普森和禁酒党提名人门罗·英格拉姆。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得西弗吉尼亚州。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee John Baptiste O'Meara defeated Republican nominee Rudolph W. Mueller, People's nominee George W. Williams and Prohibition nominee William S. Crouch.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州副州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人约翰·巴蒂斯特·奥米拉击败共和党提名人鲁道夫·W·穆勒、人民党提名人乔治·W·威廉姆斯和禁酒党提名人威廉·S·克劳奇。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. This was the first time Idaho participated in a presidential election, having become the 43rd state on July 3, 1890.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举爱达荷州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举爱达荷州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。爱达荷州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。这是爱达荷州首次参加总统选举；该州于1890年7月3日成为美国第43个州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Arkansas voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Arkansas was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举阿肯色州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举阿肯色州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。阿肯色州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得阿肯色州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Minnesota voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Minnesota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Whitelaw Reid of New York.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举明尼苏达州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举明尼苏达州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。明尼苏达州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自印第安纳州的时任总统本杰明·哈里森及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的怀特劳·里德赢得明尼苏达州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the former president Grover Cleveland and the former first assistant U.S. postmaster general Adlai Stevenson I defeated the Republican ticket of the incumbent president Benjamin Harrison and the former U.S. ambassador to France Whitelaw Reid. Cleveland defeated Harrison in the national election with 277 electoral votes.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举印第安纳州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举印第安纳州投票于11月8日举行。民主党组合、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰和前美国邮政部第一助理部长阿德莱·史蒂文森一世，击败共和党组合、时任总统本杰明·哈里森和美国前驻法大使怀特劳·里德。克利夫兰最终以277张选举人票赢得全国选举。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Uniquely, this remains the only presidential election where Michigan used the congressional district method of distributing electoral votes rather than the traditional election of each elector by the state as a whole.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举密歇根州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举密歇根州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出14名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。密歇根州在此次总统选举中首次、也是唯一一次采用按国会选区分配选举人票的方式，而不是由全州选民共同选出所有总统选举人。

en.s: The 1892 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. People's Party nominee Davis Hanson Waite defeated Republican nominee Joseph Helm with 46.68% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。人民党提名人戴维斯·汉森·韦特以46.68%的得票率击败共和党提名人约瑟夫·赫尔姆。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Whitelaw Reid of New York by a margin of 5.29%.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自印第安纳州的时任总统本杰明·哈里森及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的怀特劳·里德以5.29个百分点的优势赢得艾奥瓦州。

en.s: The 1892 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Frederick P. Brown defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Peter Nelson, People's nominee Henry B. Martin and Prohibition nominee Hans H. Aaker.

zh.s: 1892年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州务卿弗雷德里克·P·布朗击败民主党提名人、前明尼苏达州参议员彼得·尼尔森，人民党提名人亨利·B·马丁和禁酒党提名人汉斯·H·阿克。

en.s: The 1892 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota Senate David Marston Clough defeated Democratic nominee Henry H. Hawkins, People's nominee Swan Nelson and Prohibition nominee Ole Kron.

zh.s: 1892年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任明尼苏达州参议员戴维·马斯顿·克拉夫击败民主党提名人亨利·H·霍金斯、人民党提名人斯旺·尼尔森和禁酒党提名人奥勒·克朗。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. South Dakota participated in its first ever presidential election, having been admitted as the 40th state on November 2, 1889.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举南达科他州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举南达科他州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。南达科他州首次参加总统选举；该州于1889年11月2日加入联邦，成为美国第40个州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington participated in its first ever presidential election, having become the 42nd state on November 11, 1889.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举华盛顿州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举华盛顿州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。华盛顿州首次参加总统选举；该州于1889年11月11日成为美国第42个州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次争取第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The 1892 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Incumbent Democratic Governor George Wilbur Peck narrowly defeated Republican nominee John Coit Spooner, becoming the first Democratic governor of Wisconsin to be reelected since Nelson Dewey in 1849. During this era, Wisconsin leaned Republican but was competitive, with all but two gubernatorial elections since the Civil War having been decided by single digits.

zh.s: 1892年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长乔治·威尔伯·佩克以微弱优势击败共和党提名人约翰·科伊特·斯普纳，成功连任。自1849年纳尔逊·杜威以来，他是首位成功连任的威斯康星州民主党籍州长。当时威斯康星州总体上倾向共和党，但选情具有竞争性；内战后举行的州长选举中，只有两次的胜负差距超过9个百分点。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. This election marks the end of Reconstruction and the beginning of Jim Crow-era politics in Florida.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举佛罗里达州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举佛罗里达州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。佛罗里达州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。这次选举标志着佛罗里达州重建时期的结束，以及吉姆·克劳时代政治的开始。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee's white citizenry was divided according to partisan loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举田纳西州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举田纳西州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州白人选民仍按战争期间形成的党派立场分化。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 11 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. North Carolina was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。北卡罗来纳州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得北卡罗来纳州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举罗得岛州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举罗得岛州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次争取第二个非连续任期。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maryland was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举马里兰州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举马里兰州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得马里兰州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. In its early days as a state, Colorado had, like the Plains States to its east, been solidly Republican.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举科罗拉多州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举科罗拉多州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。在建州初期，科罗拉多州与其东部的大平原州一样，一直坚定支持共和党。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent president Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, former president Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举缅因州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举缅因州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；克利夫兰此次争取第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1892, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Alexander A. Lesueur defeated Republican nominee Henry T. Alkire, People's nominee David B. Page and Prohibition nominee Edwin E. McClellan.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人、时任州务卿亚历山大·A·勒叙尔击败共和党提名人亨利·T·阿尔凯尔、人民党提名人大卫·B·佩奇和禁酒党提名人埃德温·E·麦克莱伦。

en.s: The 1892 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Republican nominee John E. Rickards defeated Democratic nominee Timothy E. Collins and Populist nominee William Kennedy with 41.17% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人约翰·E·里卡兹以41.17%的得票率击败民主党提名人蒂莫西·E·柯林斯和民粹党提名人威廉·肯尼迪。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Oregon was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Whitelaw Reid of New York.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举俄勒冈州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自印第安纳州的时任总统本杰明·哈里森及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的怀特劳·里德赢得俄勒冈州。

en.s: The 1892 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Democratic nominee Elias Carr defeated Republican nominee David M. Furches with 48.3% of the vote. Harry Skinner unsuccessfully ran for the Populist nomination.

zh.s: 1892年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人伊莱亚斯·卡尔以48.3%的得票率击败共和党提名人大卫·M·弗奇斯。哈里·斯金纳曾竞选民粹党提名，但未能胜出。

en.s: The 1892 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. People's Party nominee Lorenzo D. Lewelling defeated Republican nominee Abram W. Smith with 50.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。人民党提名人洛伦佐·D·卢埃林以50.04%的得票率击败共和党提名人亚伯拉姆·W·史密斯。

en.s: The 1892 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. People's Party nominee Eli C. D. Shortridge defeated incumbent Republican Andrew H. Burke with 52.43% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年北达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。人民党提名人伊莱·C·D·肖特里奇以52.43%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长安德鲁·H·伯克。

en.t: 1892 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 1892 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held on November 8, 1892, for two seats in the 53rd Congress. These elections were held at the same time as the 1892 presidential election and election for governor.

zh.t: 1892年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1892年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第53届国会的2名联邦众议员。这次选举与1892年总统选举和州长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1892 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. It was a rematch of the 1890 Connecticut gubernatorial election. Democratic nominee Luzon B. Morris defeated Republican nominee Samuel E. Merwin with 50.31% of the vote. Unlike the previous election, which resulted in a deadlock and neither candidate inaugurated as governor, Morris's win was not challenged this time, and he was inaugurated governor on January 4, 1893.

zh.s: 1892年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月8日举行，是1890年州长选举的重赛。民主党提名人卢宗·B·莫里斯以50.31%的得票率击败共和党提名人塞缪尔·E·默文。上次选举陷入僵局，两名候选人都没有就任州长；这次莫里斯的胜选没有受到质疑，他于1893年1月4日宣誓就任州长。

en.t: 1892 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1892 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 8, 1892, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They coincided with the election of Grover Cleveland as president for the second, noncontinuous time, defeating incumbent Benjamin Harrison. Elections were held for 356 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 44 states, to serve in the 53rd United States Congress.

zh.s: 1892年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月8日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则提前在6月或9月举行选举。这些选举与格罗弗·克利夫兰第二次、非连续当选总统同时进行；他击败了时任总统本杰明·哈里森。美国44个州共选出356名联邦众议员，组成第53届国会。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, former President Grover Cleveland, who was running for a second, non-consecutive term, over Republican nominee, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党提名人、前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，助其争取第二个非连续任期，击败共和党提名人、时任总统本杰明·哈里森。

en.s: The 1892 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Thomas Jefferson Majors, a Republican, defeating Populist nominee Charles D. Shrader and Democratic nominee Samuel N. Wolbach as well as Prohibition Party nominee James Stephen.

zh.t: 1892年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1892年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任副州长托马斯·杰斐逊·梅杰斯击败民粹党提名人查尔斯·D·施雷德、民主党提名人塞缪尔·N·沃尔巴赫和禁酒党提名人詹姆斯·斯蒂芬。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 8, 1892. As North Dakota had been admitted to the Union as the 39th state on November 2, 1889, this was the first presidential election in which North Dakota cast electoral votes. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举北达科他州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举北达科他州投票于11月8日举行。北达科他州于1889年11月2日加入联邦，成为美国第39个州；这是该州首次在总统选举中投下选举人票。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming participated in its first ever presidential election, having become the 44th state on July 10, 1890.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举怀俄明州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举怀俄明州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。怀俄明州首次参加总统选举；该州于1890年7月10日成为美国第44个州。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出24名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.s: The 1892 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, pitting the Republican nominee, incumbent governor Ira Joy Chase, who had succeeded to the office the previous year following the death of governor Alvin Peterson Hovey, against the Democratic nominee, Indiana Secretary of State Claude Matthews. The campaign focused primarily on depressed farm prices and farmers' desires to inflate the currency to alleviate debt problems.

zh.s: 1892年印第安纳州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州长艾拉·乔伊·蔡斯在上任前一年，因州长阿尔文·彼得森·霍维去世而接任；他的对手是民主党提名人、印第安纳州务卿克劳德·马修斯。竞选主要围绕低迷的农产品价格，以及农民希望增加货币供应、缓解债务问题展开。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Democratic nominees, former President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、来自纽约州的前总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得阿拉巴马州。

en.s: The 1892 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Incumbent Democratic governor William Russell was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican Lt. Governor William H. Haile.

zh.s: 1892年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长威廉·拉塞尔击败共和党副州长威廉·H·黑尔，成功连任，开始第三个任期。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 8, 1892. All contemporary 44 states were part of the 1892 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Whitelaw Reid of New York.

zh.t: 1892年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州结果
zh.s: 1892年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部44个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自印第安纳州的时任总统本杰明·哈里森及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的怀特劳·里德赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.s: The New Orleans general strike was a general strike in the U.S. city of New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, that began on November 8, 1892. Despite appeals to racial hatred, black and white workers remained united. The general strike ended on November 12, with unions gaining most of their original demands.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日，美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良市爆发总罢工。尽管有人煽动种族仇恨，黑人和白人工人仍团结一致。总罢工于11月12日结束，工会争取到了大部分原先提出的要求。

en.s: The 1892 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, former Congressman William J. Stone, over the Republican candidate former Congressman William Warner, Populist candidate Leverett Leonard, and Prohibition candidate John Sobieski.

zh.s: 1892年密苏里州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人、前国会议员威廉·J.斯通获胜，击败共和党候选人、前国会议员威廉·华纳、民粹党候选人莱弗里特·伦纳德和禁酒党候选人约翰·索别斯基。

en.s: The 1892 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Republican nominee John McGraw defeated Democratic nominee Henry J. Snively and Populist nominee Cyrus W. Young, with 36.96% of the vote.

zh.s: 1892年华盛顿州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党候选人约翰·麦格劳以36.96%的得票率击败民主党候选人亨利·J.斯尼夫利和民粹党候选人赛勒斯·W.扬。

en.s: The 1892 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1892, to elect the governor of West Virginia. Democrat William A. MacCorkle won the election in another close race, though not as close as the one four years earlier.

zh.s: 1892年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党人威廉·A.麦考克尔在又一场激烈选举中获胜，但这次差距大于四年前。

en.s: The 1892 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1892. Democratic nominee Peter Turney defeated Republican nominee George W. Winstead, and Incumbent Governor John P. Buchanan, who ran as a Populist, with 47.86% of the vote. During the primaries, Governor Buchanan, lacking the support among Democrats, withdrew from the Democratic primary to run as a populist for re-election.

zh.s: 1892年田纳西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人彼得·特尼击败共和党候选人乔治·W.温斯特德和以民粹党候选人身份参选的现任州长约翰·P.布坎南，得票率为47.86%。初选期间，布坎南因缺乏民主党内支持而退出民主党初选，转而以民粹党人身份竞选连任。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 8, 1892. Incumbent mayor Hugh J. Grant was not a candidate for a third consecutive term in office. He was succeeded by Thomas Francis Gilroy, who defeated Republican Edwin Einstein in a landslide. Gilroy's margin of victory "exceed[ed] by nearly 20,000 the greatest majority obtained by a New York mayoralty candidate in twenty-four years."

zh.s: 纽约市市长选举于1892年11月8日举行。现任市长休·J.格兰特没有竞选连续第三个任期。他的继任者托马斯·弗朗西斯·吉尔罗伊大胜共和党人埃德温·爱因斯坦。吉尔罗伊的领先票数“比过去24年来纽约市市长候选人取得的最高多数票还多近2万票”。

en.t: 1892 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1892 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 8, 1892, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen and many poor whites, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1892年11月8日，佐治亚州举行美国总统选举投票。选民选出13名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州在19世纪70年代初剥夺了大批刚获得选举权的获释奴隶和贫困白人的投票权；它是最早大规模采取此举的前南方邦联州。

en.s: The 1892 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on Tuesday November 8, to elect the next attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee Henry W. Childs defeated Democratic nominee John Nethaway. People's Party nominee and formerUnited States Representative from Minnesota's 3rd congressional district. John L. MacDonald and Prohibition nominee Robert Taylor.

zh.t: 1892年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1892年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人亨利·W·蔡尔兹击败民主党候选人约翰·内瑟韦，当选总检察长。人民党候选人、前联邦众议员约翰·L·麦克唐纳，以及禁酒党候选人罗伯特·泰勒也参加了选举。

en.t: On 8 November 1895, German physics professor Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays while experimenting with Lenard tubes and Crookes tubes and began studying them
en.s: An X-ray is a form of high-energy electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength shorter than those of ultraviolet rays and longer than those of gamma rays. Roughly, X-rays have a wavelength ranging from 10 nanometers to 10 picometers, corresponding to frequencies in the range of 30 petahertz to 30 exahertz (3×1016 Hz to 3×1019 Hz) and photon energies in the range of 100 eV to 100 keV, respectively.

zh.t: 1895年11月8日，德国物理学教授威廉·伦琴在实验伦纳德管和克鲁克斯管时发现X射线，并开始对其进行研究
zh.s: X射线是一种高能电磁辐射，波长短于紫外线、长于伽马射线。其波长大致为10纳米至10皮米，对应频率约为30拍赫至30艾赫（3×10¹⁶至3×10¹⁹赫），光子能量约为100电子伏至100千电子伏。

en.s: The 1898 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. Incumbent Governor Andrew E. Lee ran on the Fusion Party ticket (as opposed to the People's Party ticket, on which he had won in 1896) and was re-elected, defeating Republican nominee Kirk G. Phillips and Prohibition Party candidate Knute Lewis. Lee won by 370 votes or 0.54%, the second-smallest margin in South Dakota gubernatorial election history (beaten only by Lee's election in 1896, which he won by 319 votes or 0.39%).

zh.s: 1898年11月8日，南达科他州举行州长选举，选出任期两年的州长。时任州长安德鲁·E·李改以融合党候选人身份参选；他在1896年是以人民党候选人身份当选。李成功连任，击败共和党候选人柯克·G·菲利普斯和禁酒党候选人纳特·刘易斯。李以370票、0.54%的优势获胜，是南达科他州州长选举史上第二小的差距；更小的差距是李在1896年当选时的319票、0.39%。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1898
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1898 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1898. Republicans took an open Democratic seat and defeated the two Populist incumbents.

zh.t: 1898年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1898年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院普选，选出该州联邦众议员。共和党从民主党手中赢得一个空缺席位，并击败两名人民党籍时任众议员。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1898 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1898. Republican Foster McGowan Voorhees defeated Democratic nominee Elvin W. Crane with 48.91% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年11月8日，新泽西州举行州长选举。共和党人福斯特·麦高恩·沃里斯以48.91%的得票率击败民主党候选人埃尔文·W·克兰。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1898. Democratic Party of Minnesota candidate John Lind defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger William Henry Eustis. This is the second of three successive elections in which John Lind ran as a candidate for a coalition formed from the Democrats and the People's Party.

zh.s: 1898年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行州长选举。明尼苏达州民主党候选人约翰·林德击败共和党候选人威廉·亨利·尤斯蒂斯。这是林德连续三次以民主党和人民党组成的联盟候选人身份参选中的第二次。

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 1898, to elect members to the Senate of the 31st and 32nd Minnesota Legislatures. On the coattails of Democrat John Lind's gubernatorial campaign, the Minnesota Democratic Party saw a minor resurgence in the Senate. The Party consolidated much of the third party support that had become a large factor in the elections of 1890 and 1894.

zh.s: 1898年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第31届和第32届明尼苏达州议会的参议员。在民主党人约翰·林德州长竞选带动下，明尼苏达州民主党在州参议院有所回升。民主党整合了大部分第三党支持者；这些选民在1890年和1894年选举中曾发挥重要作用。

en.s: The 1898 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Republican Governor Edward Scofield defeated Democratic nominee Hiram Wilson Sawyer with 52.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长爱德华·斯科菲尔德以52.55%的得票率击败民主党提名人海勒姆·威尔逊·索耶。

en.s: The 1898 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Populist Governor Silas A. Holcomb did not stand for re-election. Populist and Democratic fusion nominee William A. Poynter defeated Republican nominee Monroe Hayward with 50.19% of the vote. A party calling itself the Liberty Party held a convention on August 2, 1898, and had originally nominated candidates for governor and lieutenant governor.

zh.s: 1898年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月8日举行。民粹党籍时任州长西拉斯·A·霍尔科姆没有竞选连任。民粹党和民主党联合提名的威廉·A·波因特以50.19%的得票率击败共和党提名人门罗·海沃德。一个自称“自由党”的政党于1898年8月2日召开大会，最初曾提名州长和副州长候选人。

en.s: The 1898 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1898, in order to elect the first Attorney General of Connecticut upon the creation of the office by the Connecticut General Assembly in 1897. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of the State of Connecticut Charles Phelps defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Connecticut State Senate Levi N. Blydenburgh.

zh.t: 1898年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1898年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州设立总检察长职位后的首任总检察长；该职位由康涅狄格州议会于1897年设立。共和党提名人、时任康涅狄格州务卿查尔斯·菲尔普斯击败民主党提名人、前康涅狄格州参议员利瓦伊·N·布莱登伯格。

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1898, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Wallace B. Douglas defeated Democratic nominee John F. Kelly and Prohibition nominee Daniel W. Doty.

zh.t: 1898年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1898年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任明尼苏达州众议员华莱士·B·道格拉斯击败民主党提名人约翰·F·凯利和禁酒党提名人丹尼尔·W·多蒂。

en.s: The 1898 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Silver Party Governor Reinhold Sadler defeated Republican nominee William McMillan, Democratic nominee George Russell, and Populist nominee J. B. McCullough with 35.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年内华达州州长选举于11月8日举行。银党籍时任州长莱因霍尔德·萨德勒以35.67%的得票率击败共和党提名人威廉·麦克米伦、民主党提名人乔治·罗素和民粹党提名人J·B·麦卡洛。

en.t: 1898 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1898 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 8, 1898, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They were held during the middle of President William McKinley's first term. Elections were held for 357 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 45 states, to serve in the 56th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1898年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月8日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则提前在6月或9月举行。这些选举在威廉·麦金莱总统首个任期中段举行。美国45个州共选出357名联邦众议员，组成第56届国会。

en.s: The 1898 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican nominee George E. Lounsbury defeated Democratic nominee Daniel N. Morgan with 54.17% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人乔治·E·朗斯伯里以54.17%的得票率击败民主党提名人丹尼尔·N·摩根。

en.s: The 1898 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Democratic nominee Charles S. Thomas defeated Republican nominee Henry R. Wolcott with 62.89% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人查尔斯·S·托马斯以62.89%的得票率击败共和党提名人亨利·R·沃尔科特。

en.s: The 1898 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican nominee Frederick B. Fancher defeated Democratic nominee David M. Holmes with 59.22% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年北达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人弗雷德里克·B·范彻以59.22%的得票率击败民主党提名人大卫·M·霍姆斯。

en.s: The 1898 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican nominee William Eugene Stanley defeated People's Party incumbent John W. Leedy with 51.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人威廉·尤金·斯坦利以51.81%的得票率击败人民党籍时任州长约翰·W·利迪。

en.s: The 1898 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican nominee Frank W. Rollins defeated Democratic nominee Charles F. Stone with 54.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人弗兰克·W·罗林斯以54.24%的得票率击败民主党提名人查尔斯·F·斯通。

en.t: 1898 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The Wyoming United States House election for 1898 was held on November 8, 1898. Former Republican representative Frank Wheeler Mondell defeated Democratic Constantine P. Arnold with 54.71% of the vote, making Mondell the first former representative to regain his seat in Wyoming and the first to hold the office for two terms.

zh.t: 1898年怀俄明州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1898年怀俄明州联邦众议员选举于11月8日举行。共和党前联邦众议员弗兰克·惠勒·蒙德尔以54.71%的得票率击败民主党人康斯坦丁·P·阿诺德。蒙德尔成为怀俄明州首位重新当选的前联邦众议员，也是该州首位任满两届的人。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1898, in 28 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 8, 1898 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Maine, Oregon, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections).

zh.s: 美国于1898年11月8日在28个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州、俄勒冈州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行了选举。

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1898, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Robert C. Dunn defeated Democratic nominee George N. Lamphere, Prohibition nominee Delburt U. Weld and Midroad-Populist nominee Charles H. Hopkins.

zh.t: 1898年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1898年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州审计长罗伯特·C·邓恩击败民主党提名人乔治·N·兰菲尔、禁酒党提名人德尔伯特·U·韦尔德和中间路线民粹党提名人查尔斯·H·霍普金斯。

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Lyndon A. Smith defeated Democratic-People's nominee and candidate for lieutenant governor in the 1896 election James Madison Bowler, Prohibition nominee Addison H. Gilmore, and Midroad Populist nominee and former member of the United States House of Representatives from Minnesota's 5th district Kittel Halvorson.

zh.s: 1898年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人林登·A·史密斯击败民主党—人民党联合提名人詹姆斯·麦迪逊·鲍勒；鲍勒也曾在1896年竞选副州长。其他败选者包括禁酒党提名人艾迪生·H·吉尔摩，以及中间路线民粹党提名人、前明尼苏达州第5选区联邦众议员基特尔·哈尔沃森。

en.s: The 1898 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican State Senator Jacob H. Neff defeated Democratic-Populist-Silver Republican Fusion Los Angeles City Councilman Edward L. Hutchinson with 50.83% of the vote.

zh.t: 1898年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1898年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党州参议员雅各布·H·内夫以50.83%的得票率击败民主党、民粹党和银共和党联合提名人、洛杉矶市议员爱德华·L·哈钦森。

en.s: The 1898 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Republican Governor William A. Richards had declined to run again, so the Republican Party instead nominated DeForest Richards. The Democratic Party joined forces with the Free Silver Republicans to jointly nominate former State Representative Horace C. Alger for Governor. The Populist Party, though reduced in influence from earlier elections, nominated E. B.

zh.s: 怀俄明州州长选举于1898年11月8日举行。时任共和党州长威廉·A·理查兹拒绝再次参选，共和党因此改为提名德福雷斯特·理查兹。民主党与自由白银共和党联合提名前州众议员霍勒斯·C·阿尔杰竞选州长。民粹党虽比早年影响力减弱，仍提名了E·B。

en.s: The 1898 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898, and featured Populist and Democratic fusion nominee Edward A. Gilbert defeating Republican nominee George A. Murphy as well as Prohibition nominee Newell S. Lowrie and Socialist Labor nominee J. J. Kerrigan. Early in 1898, there was speculation that incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor James E.

zh.t: 1898年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1898年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月8日举行。民粹党与民主党联合提名的爱德华·A·吉尔伯特击败共和党候选人乔治·A·墨菲、禁酒党候选人纽厄尔·S·洛里和社会主义工党候选人J·J·克里根。1898年初，曾有传言称时任副州长詹姆斯·E·哈里斯可能竞选州长。

en.s: The 1898 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Democrat Frank Steunenberg defeated Republican nominee Albert B. Moss with 48.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年爱达荷州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长弗兰克·斯托伊嫩伯格以48.83%的得票率击败共和党提名人阿尔伯特·B·莫斯。

en.s: The 1898 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Democratic governor Robert Love Taylor did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee Benton McMillin defeated Republican nominee James Alexander Fowler with 57.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1898年田纳西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长罗伯特·洛夫·泰勒没有竞选连任。民主党提名人本顿·麦克米伦以57.92%的得票率击败共和党提名人詹姆斯·亚历山大·福勒。

en.s: The 1898 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Incumbent Republican Governor Roger Wolcott was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democratic former mayor of Lawrence Alexander B. Bruce.

zh.s: 1898年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长罗杰·沃尔科特击败民主党人、劳伦斯市前市长亚历山大·B·布鲁斯，成功连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 1898 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. It featured a three-way campaign between major party candidates William Stone and George Jenks, as well as a strong showing by prohibitionist Silas Swallow.

zh.s: 1898年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。主要政党候选人威廉·斯通和乔治·詹克斯展开三方竞选，禁酒派候选人西拉斯·斯沃洛也表现强劲。

en.s: The 1898 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1898, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Albert Berg defeated Democratic nominee Julius J. Heinrich, Prohibition nominee Archibald A. Stone and People's nominee Michael F. Wesenberg.

zh.s: 1898年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州务卿阿尔伯特·伯格击败民主党提名人朱利叶斯·J·海因里希、禁酒党提名人阿奇博尔德·A·斯通和人民党提名人迈克尔·F·韦森伯格。

en.s: The 1898 New York state election was held on November 8, 1898, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer and the state engineer, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1898年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、州务卿、州财务主管、总检察长、州财政部长和州工程师，以及州众议院和州参议院全部议员。

en.s: The 1898 California gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898, to elect the governor of California. Republican lawyer Henry Gage defeated Democratic-Populist-Silver Republican Fusion Congressman James G. Maguire. For the eighth time in nine elections, the incumbent party failed to retain the governorship. However, that string of flips ended with this election, as Republicans won the next nine consecutive gubernatorial elections in California.

zh.s: 1898年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党律师亨利·盖奇击败民主党、民粹党和银共和党联合提名的国会议员詹姆斯·G.马奎尔。此前9次选举中有8次执政党未能保住州长职位，但这一轮政党轮替到此为止；此后共和党连续赢得加利福尼亚州接下来的9次州长选举。

en.s: The 1898 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1898. Republican incumbent Frank S. Black was defeated for re-nomination by Theodore Roosevelt, the former United States assistant secretary of the Navy and a returning hero of the Spanish–American War. In the general election, Roosevelt defeated judge Augustus Van Wyck. Roosevelt outmaneuvered party bosses, particularly U.S. senator Thomas C.

zh.s: 纽约州州长选举于1898年11月8日举行。时任共和党州长弗兰克·S·布莱克在党内提名中败给西奥多·罗斯福；罗斯福曾任美国海军助理部长，并在美西战争中成为归国英雄。大选中，罗斯福击败法官奥古斯都·范·威克。罗斯福在党内斗争中胜过了多名党魁，尤其是联邦参议员托马斯·C。

en.t: 1898 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida for two seats in the 56th Congress were held November 8, 1898

zh.t: 1898年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1898年11月8日，佛罗里达州举行美国众议院选举，改选第56届国会的两个席位。

en.s: The 1899 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1899. Incumbent Republican Governor Roger Wolcott did not run for re-election to a fourth one-year term. Lt. Governor W. Murray Crane was elected to succeed him, defeating Democrat Robert Treat Paine.

zh.s: 1899年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长罗杰·沃尔科特没有竞选连任，争取第四个一年任期。副州长W·默里·克兰当选接替他，击败民主党人罗伯特·特里特·佩因。

en.s: The 1900 Newfoundland general election was held on 8 November 1900 to elect members of the 19th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the self-governing British colony. The Liberal Party led by Robert Bond formed the government. The railway policy of the Conservative government under James S. Winter was highly unpopular, which led to the party's defeat under Alfred Morine's leadership.

zh.s: 1900年纽芬兰大选于11月8日举行，选出自治英国殖民地纽芬兰第19届议会的议员。罗伯特·邦德领导的自由党组建政府。詹姆斯·S.温特领导的保守党政府推行的铁路政策很不受欢迎，阿尔弗雷德·莫林领导的保守党因此败选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Nevada, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 8, 1904 throughout all 45 states, which was part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Nevada was won by the Republican ticket of incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt NY) and Senator Charles W. Fairbanks (IN) by margin of 23.79 percentage points, roughly mirroring the results of the national popular vote. Following this election, Nevada would eventually become a bellwether that reflected the results of every Presidential election with the exceptions of 1908 and 1976.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举内华达州投票
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，内华达州举行总统选举投票。作为1904年美国总统选举的一部分，全美45个州都参加了选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福（来自纽约州）和竞选搭档、参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯（来自印第安纳州）以23.79个百分点的优势赢得内华达州，得票情况与全国普选结果大致相同。此后，内华达州逐渐成为能反映总统选举全国结果的风向标州，1908年和1976年除外。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 39 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate incumbent Vice President Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana. Roosevelt and Fairbanks defeated the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge of the New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Senator Henry G.

zh.s: 1904年纽约州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。纽约州选民选出39名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。纽约州选民支持共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、时任副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯；他们击败了民主党候选人、纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、参议员亨利·G·戴维斯。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states, were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate incumbent Vice President Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana. Roosevelt and Fairbanks defeated the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge of the New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Senator Henry G.

zh.s: 新泽西州的1904年美国总统选举于1904年11月8日举行。当时美国45个州均参与总统选举。新泽西州选民选出14名选举人进入选举人团，由其选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人获胜：时任总统西奥多·罗斯福（纽约州）及其竞选搭档、时任副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯（印第安纳州）。罗斯福和费尔班克斯击败民主党候选人、纽约州上诉法院首席法官奥尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、参议员亨利·G。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1904 was the 30th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 8, 1904. Incumbent President and Republican candidate Theodore Roosevelt, having succeeded to the presidency upon the assassination of William McKinley in September 1901, was elected to a term in his own right. During the election campaign, Republicans emphasized Roosevelt's success in foreign affairs and his record of firmness against monopolies. The nominee of the Democratic Party was Alton B. Parker, Chief Judge of the New York Court of Appeals. As there was little difference between the candidates' positions, the race was largely based on their personalities; the Democrats argued the Roosevelt presidency was "arbitrary" and "erratic."

zh.s: 1904年11月8日星期二，美国举行第30次四年一度总统选举。共和党籍现任总统西奥多·罗斯福在1901年9月威廉·麦金莱遇刺后接任总统，此次成功当选一个完整任期。竞选期间，共和党强调罗斯福在外交方面的政绩，以及他打击垄断的强硬立场。民主党提名纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。两名候选人的政见差异不大，竞选主要围绕他们的个人风格展开；民主党人则称罗斯福政府“专断”且“反复无常”。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 8, 1904 throughout 45 states (Oklahoma was still a territory that would participate in the next election). Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker. Roosevelt won Montana by a landslide margin of 20.42%. It was the first time Montana was won by a Republican candidate since it was won by Benjamin Harrison in 1892.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举蒙大拿州投票
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行总统选举投票。全美45个州都参加了本次选举；当时俄克拉何马仍是领地，要到下次选举才参加。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。蒙大拿州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福，击败民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。罗斯福以20.42个百分点的巨大优势赢得该州。这是自本杰明·哈里森于1892年赢得蒙大拿州以来，共和党候选人首次在该州获胜。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 8, 1904 throughout 45 states (Oklahoma was still a territory that would participate in the next election). Voters chose 34 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker. Roosevelt won Pennsylvania by a landslide margin of 40.67%.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举投票。全美45个州都参加了本次选举；当时俄克拉何马仍是领地，要到下次选举才参加。选民选出34名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福，击败民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。罗斯福以40.67个百分点的巨大优势赢得该州。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1904
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1904 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1904. Republicans won the three Democratic-held districts, giving California an all-Republican House delegation, which it would maintain until 1910.

zh.t: 1904年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院普选，选出该州联邦众议员。共和党赢得三个原由民主党控制的选区，使加州联邦众议员代表团全部由共和党人组成；这一局面一直持续到1910年。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1904 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1904. Republican Edward C. Stokes defeated Democratic nominee Charles C. Black with 53.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，新泽西州举行州长选举。共和党人爱德华·C·斯托克斯以53.50%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·C·布莱克。

en.s: The 1904 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. Governor Duncan Clinch Heyward faced no opposition in the Democratic primary nor the general election to win a second two-year term as governor.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。州长邓肯·克林奇·海沃德在民主党初选和普选中都无人竞争，连任第二个两年任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1904. Wisconsin voters chose thirteen electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate and incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt won the state with 63% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's thirteen electoral votes.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举威斯康星州投票
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，威斯康星州举行总统选举投票。选民选出13名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福以63%的普选票赢得该州及威斯康星州的13张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1904
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, Chief Judge of the New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker over the Republican candidate, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举弗吉尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，作为1904年美国总统选举的一部分，弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出12名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克，击败共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福。

Herreid, was unable to run again due to term limits. Republican nominee Samuel H. Elrod was elected, defeating Democratic nominee Louis N. Crill, Socialist candidate Freeman Knowles, Prohibitionist candidate W. J. Edgar, and Populist candidate R.

zh.s: 南达科他州于1904年11月8日举行州长选举，选出任期两年的州长。时任共和党州长查尔斯·N·赫雷德受任期限制，无法再次参选。共和党提名人塞缪尔·H·埃尔罗德当选，击败民主党提名人路易斯·N·克里尔、社会党候选人弗里曼·诺尔斯、禁酒党候选人W·J·埃德加，以及民粹党候选人R。
