en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举肯塔基州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举肯塔基州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the overthrow of Reconstruction Republican government, Louisiana, like most of the former Confederacy, established a Democratic-dominated but highly fraudulent political system that would from 1890 be challenged by the rise of the Populist Party due to declining conditions for farmers.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举路易斯安那州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。重建时期共和党政府被推翻后，路易斯安那州和大多数前邦联州一样，建立了民主党主导且舞弊严重的政治体系。自1890年以来，农民处境恶化，民粹党随之兴起，对这一体系构成挑战。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker, over the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党提名人阿尔顿·B·帕克，击败共和党提名人、总统西奥多·罗斯福。帕克曾担任纽约州上诉法院首席法官。

en.s: The 1904 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee Henry Roberts defeated Democratic nominee A. Heaton Robertson with 54.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人亨利·罗伯茨以54.88%的得票率击败民主党提名人A·希顿·罗伯逊。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B.

zh.s: 1904年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。罗得岛州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福，他击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。罗斯福以24.42个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 8, 1904. Voter chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. With the disfranchisement of African-Americans by a poll tax in 1889, Florida became a one-party Democratic state, which it was to remain until the 1950s—apart from the anti-Catholic vote against Al Smith in 1928.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举佛罗里达州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举佛罗里达州投票于11月8日举行。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1889年，人头税剥夺了非裔美国人的选举权，此后佛罗里达州成为一党主导的民主党州，并一直持续到20世纪50年代；1928年，部分选民因反天主教情绪而反对艾尔·史密斯，是例外。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Texas voters chose 18 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Texas was won by the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Henry G.

zh.t: 1904年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。得克萨斯州选民选出18名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、来自西弗吉尼亚州的亨利·G·戴维斯赢得得克萨斯州，击败了共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。帕克以49.55个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举特拉华州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举特拉华州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得特拉华州。

en.s: The 1904 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Democratic nominee Robert Broadnax Glenn defeated Republican nominee Charles Joseph Harris with 61.72% of the vote. At the time, Glenn was an attorney and former member of the state Senate, while Harris was a businessman and former member of the United States Industrial Commission.

zh.s: 1904年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人罗伯特·布罗德纳克斯·格伦以61.72%的得票率击败共和党提名人查尔斯·约瑟夫·哈里斯。当时格伦是一名律师、前州参议员；哈里斯是一名商人，曾任美国工业委员会委员。

en.s: The 1904 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee George H. Utter defeated Democratic incumbent Lucius F. C. Garvin with 48.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年罗得岛州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人乔治·H·厄特以48.94%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长卢修斯·F·C·加文。

en.s: The 1904 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee John Christopher Cutler defeated Democratic nominee James Moyle with 49.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年犹他州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人约翰·克里斯托弗·卡特勒以49.97%的得票率击败民主党提名人詹姆斯·莫伊尔。

en.s: The 1904 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Republican Governor John H. Mickey won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic and Populist fusion nominee George W. Berge with 49.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长约翰·H·米奇击败民主党与民粹党联合提名人乔治·W·伯格，以49.67%的得票率连任，开启第二个任期。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee Jacob F. Gmelich defeated Democratic nominee James Cowgill, Socialist nominee Charles A. Richardson, Prohibition nominee Daniel L. Sims, People's nominee James M. Burrus and Socialist Labor nominee Otto Schwitzgebel.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州财务长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人雅各布·F·格梅利希击败民主党提名人詹姆斯·考吉尔、社会党提名人查尔斯·A·理查森、禁酒党提名人丹尼尔·L·西姆斯、人民党提名人詹姆斯·M·伯勒斯和社会劳工党提名人奥托·施维茨格贝尔。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 8, 1904. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker. Roosevelt won the state by a narrow margin of 3.91%.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举密苏里州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举密苏里州投票于11月8日举行。选民选出18名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密苏里州以3.91个百分点的微弱优势支持共和党提名人、西奥多·罗斯福总统，击败民主党提名人、纽约州上诉法院前首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举爱达荷州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举爱达荷州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1904 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Edmund G. McGilton, a Republican, defeating Adelbert Townsend, the Populist and Democratic fusion nominee, as well as Prohibition nominee Isaiah Lightner and Socialist nominee Thomas Carroll.

zh.t: 1904年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1904年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任副州长埃德蒙·G·麦吉尔顿击败民粹党和民主党联合提名人阿德尔伯特·汤森、禁酒党提名人以赛亚·莱特纳和社会主义党提名人托马斯·卡罗尔。

en.s: The 1904 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Republican Governor John L. Bates ran for a third term, but was defeated by Democratic nominee William L. Douglas. Despite Douglas’s wide victory, Republican Theodore Roosevelt won the state in a landslide in the concurrent presidential election.

zh.s: 1904年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长约翰·L·贝茨竞选第三个任期，但败给民主党提名人威廉·L·道格拉斯。尽管道格拉斯以较大优势胜出，共和党人西奥多·罗斯福仍在同时举行的总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was decisively won by the Republican Party candidate, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt, with 59.75% of the popular vote. The Democratic Party candidate, Alton B.

zh.s: 1904年俄亥俄州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出23名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福以59.75%的得票率在俄亥俄州大胜。民主党候选人阿尔顿·B·帕克仅获34.32%的选票。罗斯福以25.43个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the incumbent president Theodore Roosevelt and the senior U.S. senator from Indiana Charles W. Fairbanks defeated the Democratic ticket of the chief judge of the New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker and the former U.S. senator from West Virginia Henry G.

zh.t: 1904年印第安纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年11月8日，印第安纳州举行总统选举。共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福与来自印第安纳州的资深联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯组成的竞选组合，击败了民主党组合：纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克和来自西弗吉尼亚州的前联邦参议员亨利·G·戴维斯。

en.s: The 1904 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee Elmore Y. Sarles defeated Democratic nominee Marthinus F. Hegge with 70.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年北达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人埃尔莫尔·Y·萨尔斯以70.71%的得票率击败民主党提名人马蒂努斯·F·黑格。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W.

zh.t: 1904年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出7名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。他们击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、前参议员亨利·G·戴维斯（西弗吉尼亚州是他的家乡州）。罗斯福以13.23个百分点的优势获胜。虽然罗斯福在该州领先超过13个百分点，但该州仍比全国平均水平更倾向民主党约5个百分点。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 8, 1904, throughout all forty-five contemporary states as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In its first presidential election during its statehood year, Utah – with its large reserves of silver – had voted five-to-one for Democrat/Populist William Jennings Bryan, who ran on a platform of monetizing silver.

zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了选举。犹他州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。犹他州在建州后首次参加总统选举时，因拥有大量银矿储量，曾以五比一的票数支持主张将白银货币化的民主党／民粹党候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。到了1900年经济复苏后，犹他州的政治倾向更接近全国整体；1890年禁止一夫多妻制后，共和党对当地占主导地位的后期圣徒教会的敌意也逐渐消退。1904年总统选举前，新当选但尚未就任的参议员、摩门教使徒里德·斯穆特进一步推动共和党与后期圣徒的关系缓和。许多传统新教国会议员反对斯穆特就任，担心宗教影响政治；摩门教先知兼教会会长约瑟夫·F·史密斯则明确表示，教会成员应在政治事务上依照自己的良知行事。虽然斯穆特是共和党人，在1902年由犹他州议会选出后至1904年总统竞选期间遭到两大党针对，但他始终与时任总统罗斯福保持通信。

en.s: The 1904 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee Edward W. Hoch defeated Democratic nominee David M. Dale with 57.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人爱德华·W·霍克以57.92%的得票率击败民主党提名人大卫·M·戴尔。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举佛蒙特州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举佛蒙特州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党提名人、西奥多·罗斯福总统及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Colorado was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举科罗拉多州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举科罗拉多州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得科罗拉多州。

en.s: The 1904 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Peter E. Hanson defeated Democratic nominee John E. King, Socialist nominee J. Edward Carlson and Prohibition nominee Hendrick A. Rygh.

zh.s: 1904年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州务卿彼得·E·汉森击败民主党提名人约翰·E·金、社会党提名人J·爱德华·卡尔森和禁酒党提名人亨德里克·A·里格。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Minnesota voters chose 11 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Minnesota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举明尼苏达州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举明尼苏达州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。明尼苏达州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得明尼苏达州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the 1898 overthrow of its Populist/Republican fusion government by white Democrats in the Wilmington massacre, North Carolina would see a radical restructuring of its politics due to the disenfranchisement of its large African-American population.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。1898年，白人民主党人在威尔明顿大屠杀中推翻民粹党与共和党的联合政府；此后，北卡罗来纳州因大量非裔居民被剥夺选举权，政治格局发生了重大变化。

en.s: The 1904 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee John McLane defeated Democratic nominee Henry F. Hollis with 57.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人约翰·麦克莱恩以57.83%的得票率击败民主党提名人亨利·F·霍利斯。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.s: The 1904 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904, in all 92 counties in the state of Indiana. Frank Hanly was elected governor over his Democratic opponent, John W. Kern.

zh.s: 1904年印第安纳州州长选举于11月8日在该州全部92个县举行。弗兰克·汉利当选州长，击败民主党对手约翰·W·克恩。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 16 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B. Parker.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出16名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持共和党提名人、西奥多·罗斯福总统，击败民主党提名人、纽约州上诉法院前首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following the Panic of 1893 and the Populist movement, Michigan would turn from a competitive Republican-leaning state into a rigidly one-party polity dominated by the Republican Party.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举密歇根州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举密歇根州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1893年经济恐慌和民粹主义运动之后，密歇根州将从一个倾向共和党、但选情有竞争性的州，逐渐转变为由共和党主导的一党州。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee William Werner Wilder defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Albert Otis Allen, Socialist nominee William M. Brandt, Prohibition nominee George H. Gibson, People's nominee William H. Mills and Socialist Labor nominee Joseph W. Molineux.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人威廉·维尔纳·怀尔德击败民主党提名人、时任州审计长阿尔伯特·奥蒂斯·艾伦、社会党提名人威廉·M·布兰特、禁酒党提名人乔治·H·吉布森、人民党提名人威廉·H·米尔斯和社会劳工党提名人约瑟夫·W·莫利纽克斯。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate John C. McKinley defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent acting lieutenant governor Thomas Lewis Rubey, Socialist nominee William Lincoln Garver, Prohibition nominee Andrew T. Osbron, People's nominee Abram E. Nelson and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Kaucher.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任密苏里州参议员约翰·C·麦金利击败民主党提名人、时任代理副州长托马斯·刘易斯·鲁比、社会党提名人威廉·林肯·加弗、禁酒党提名人安德鲁·T·奥斯本、人民党提名人亚伯拉姆·E·尼尔森和社会劳工党提名人西奥多·考彻。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. North Dakota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W.

zh.t: 1904年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年北达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。北达科他州支持共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。他们击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、来自西弗吉尼亚州的前参议员亨利·G·戴维斯。罗斯福以54.73个百分点的优势赢得该州。北达科他州得票率为75.12%，是罗斯福在全国得票率第二高的州，仅次于佛蒙特州。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee Herbert S. Hadley defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri Senate Elliott Woolfolk Major, socialist nominee George Bullock, Prohibition nominee Austin F. Butts, People's nominee Charles J. Anderson and Socialist Labor nominee Joseph Stief.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人赫伯特·S·哈德利击败民主党提名人、前密苏里州参议员埃利奥特·沃尔福克·梅杰、社会党提名人乔治·布洛克、禁酒党提名人奥斯汀·F·巴茨、人民党提名人查尔斯·J·安德森和社会劳工党提名人约瑟夫·斯蒂夫。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Henry G. Davis of West Virginia.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、纽约州首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、来自西弗吉尼亚州的亨利·G·戴维斯赢得阿拉巴马州。

en.s: The 1904 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Republican Governor Richard Yates Jr. was denied renomination by his party. Republican nominee Charles S. Deneen defeated Democratic nominee Lawrence B. Stringer with 59.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长小理查德·耶茨没有获得本党连任提名。共和党提名人查尔斯·S·德宁以59.09%的得票率击败民主党提名人劳伦斯·B·斯金格。

en.s: The 1904 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Shortly after he began his second term in 1903, Governor DeForest Richards died in office, elevating Secretary of State Fenimore Chatterton to the Governorship and triggering a special election in 1904 to fill the balance of Richards's term. Chatterton ran for re-election, but was defeated for renomination at the Republican convention by Bryant B.

zh.s: 1904年怀俄明州州长选举于11月8日举行。州长德福雷斯特·理查兹在1903年开始第二任期后不久便去世，国务卿费尼莫尔·查特顿继任州长，因此该州于1904年举行特别选举，填补理查兹任期的剩余部分。查特顿竞选连任，但在共和党代表大会上输给布莱恩特·B·布鲁克斯，未获提名。前联邦众议员、前领地州长约翰·E·奥斯本获民主党提名。布鲁克斯借助罗斯福在总统选举中的压倒性胜利，彻底击败奥斯本。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举田纳西州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举田纳西州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州仍按战争期间形成的政治立场分化。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Kansas voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kansas was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举堪萨斯州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举堪萨斯州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。堪萨斯州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得堪萨斯州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B.

zh.t: 1904年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州压倒性地支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福；他击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。罗斯福以22.28个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1904 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. According to the tabulated results, Democratic nominee Alva Adams defeated incumbent Republican James Hamilton Peabody with 50.64% of the vote. Peabody successfully contested the results based on allegations of Democratic voter fraud in Denver and was installed as Governor on March 17, 1905, after Alva Adams had served for over two months.

zh.s: 1904年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。根据计票结果，民主党提名人阿尔瓦·亚当斯以50.64%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长詹姆斯·汉密尔顿·皮博迪。皮博迪以丹佛存在民主党选民舞弊为由成功对选举结果提出异议，并于1905年3月17日就任州长；此前亚当斯已任职两个多月。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the 26th and sitting President of the United States Theodore Roosevelt (R–New York), who assumed office after the Assassination of William McKinley, running with the 26th Vice President of the United States Charles W.

zh.s: 1904年怀俄明州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。时任美国第26任总统西奥多·罗斯福代表共和党赢得怀俄明州；他在威廉·麦金莱遇刺后继任总统，竞选搭档是美国第26任副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。罗斯福和费尔班克斯以66.72%的得票率获胜，击败了纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、参议员亨利·G·戴维斯（得票率29.08%）。罗斯福以37.64个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose 27 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州投票于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了此次总统选举。该州选民选出27名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党提名人、来自纽约州的时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in California took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican incumbent, Theodore Roosevelt and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州投票于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持共和党籍时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. The winner in Maryland depended on the votes, supposedly due to the "Wilson Law" designed to make it easier for Democrats to cast ballots for both Presidential electors and Congress by a simple turning down of a single fold in the ballot paper.

zh.s: 1904年马里兰州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。该州选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。马里兰州的胜者取决于选票，据信这与“威尔逊法”有关；该法原本旨在让民主党选民只需将选票折起一道，就能同时为总统选举人和国会议员投票。民主党候选人阿尔顿·B·帕克和亨利·G·戴维斯获得7张选举人票；共和党候选人罗斯福和费尔班克斯赢得普选票，并获得1张选举人票。罗斯福的普选票优势按票数计为美国史上第二小，仅高于1832年亨利·克莱在马里兰州的4票优势。本次选举中，马里兰州比全国平均水平更倾向民主党18.81个百分点。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1904. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 1904年美国总统选举俄勒冈州结果
zh.s: 1904年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于11月8日举行。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1904 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Democratic Governor Joseph Toole was re-elected, defeating Republican nominee William Lindsay and Socialist nominee Malcolm G. O'Malley with 53.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长约瑟夫·图尔以53.79%的得票率击败共和党提名人威廉·林赛和社会党提名人马尔科姆·G·奥马利，成功连任。

en.s: The 1904 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. It saw the election of Republican nominee Lawrence Y. Sherman, who defeated Democratic nominee Thomas F. Ferns and five other candidates. The Democratic and Republican nominees were chosen by their respective parties' state conventions.

zh.s: 1904年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人劳伦斯·Y·谢尔曼击败民主党提名人托马斯·F·芬斯和其他5名候选人，当选副州长。民主党和共和党分别由本党州代表大会选出提名人。

en.t: 1904 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1904 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 8, 1904, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They coincided with the election to a full term of President Theodore Roosevelt. Elections were held for 386 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 45 states, to serve in the 59th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1904年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月8日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则提前在6月或9月举行。这些选举与西奥多·罗斯福当选完整任期总统同时进行。美国45个州共选出386名联邦众议员，组成第59届国会。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B.

zh.t: 1904年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年康涅狄格州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。康涅狄格州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福；他击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。罗斯福以19.97个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1904 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Though incumbent Republican Governor John Hunn was eligible to run for re-election, he declined to do so. Instead, as the intra-party battle in the Republican Party between the Addicks and anti-Addicks factions continued, Hunn stepped aside to avoid additional conflict. The Addicks, or Union Republicans, nominated Henry C.

zh.s: 1904年特拉华州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·亨恩虽有资格竞选连任，但决定不参选。共和党内部的阿迪克斯派与反阿迪克斯派持续争斗，亨恩为避免党内进一步冲突而退让。阿迪克斯派（联合共和党人）提名亨利·C·康拉德竞选州长；反阿迪克斯派（正规共和党人）则提名约瑟夫·H·钱德勒。10月12日，两派达成协议，共同提名倾向正规共和党人的实业家普雷斯顿·利。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Mississippi was won by the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Henry G.

zh.t: 1904年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年密西西比州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出10名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。密西西比州支持民主党候选人阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档亨利·G·戴维斯。他们击败了共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。帕克以85.48个百分点的巨大优势赢得该州。密西西比州得票率为91.07%，是帕克在1904年得票率第二高的州，仅次于南卡罗来纳州。

en.s: The 1904 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Democratic governor James B. Frazier defeated Republican Winchester mayor Jessie M. Littleton with 55.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年田纳西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长詹姆斯·B·弗雷泽以55.72%的得票率击败共和党人、温彻斯特市长杰西·M·利特尔顿。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. South Dakota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W.

zh.t: 1904年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1904年南达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。南达科他州支持共和党候选人、时任总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Republican nominee John Ephraim Swanger defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Sam Baker Cook, Socialist nominee Charles W. Wilkerson, Prohibition nominee William F. Brennecke, People's nominee Abram Neff and Socialist Labor nominee O. M. Howard.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人约翰·伊弗雷姆·斯旺格击败民主党提名人、时任州务卿萨姆·贝克·库克、社会党提名人查尔斯·W·威尔克森、禁酒党提名人威廉·F·布伦内克、人民党提名人亚伯拉姆·内夫和社会劳工党提名人O·M·霍华德。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1904, in 34 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 8, 1904 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine and Vermont, which held early elections). In Wyoming, a special election was held following the death of Governor DeForest Richards in April 1903.

zh.s: 美国于1904年11月8日在34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同时进行。阿肯色州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州和佛蒙特州提前举行选举。1903年4月州长德福里斯特·理查兹去世后，怀俄明州举行了特别选举。

en.s: The 1904 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee Frank R. Gooding defeated Democratic nominee Henry Heitfeld with 58.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年爱达荷州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人弗兰克·R·古丁以58.74%的得票率击败民主党提名人亨利·海特菲尔德。

en.s: The 1904 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Democratic nominee Napoleon B. Broward defeated Republican nominee Matthew B. MacFarlane with 79.16% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人拿破仑·B·布劳沃德以79.16%的得票率击败共和党提名人马修·B·麦克法兰。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Theodore Roosevelt, over the Democratic nominee, former Chief Judge of New York Court of Appeals Alton B.

zh.s: 1904年缅因州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。缅因州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统西奥多·罗斯福；他击败了民主党候选人、前纽约州上诉法院首席法官阿尔顿·B·帕克。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Arkansas was won by the Democratic nominees, Chief Judge Alton B. Parker of New York and his running mate Henry G.

zh.s: 1904年阿肯色州美国总统选举于11月8日举行。当时美国全部45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出9名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。阿肯色州支持民主党候选人阿尔顿·B·帕克及其竞选搭档、来自西弗吉尼亚州的亨利·G·戴维斯。

en.s: The 1904 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Ray W. Jones of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Fendall G. Winston.

zh.s: 1904年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。明尼苏达州共和党籍时任副州长雷·W·琼斯击败明尼苏达州民主党挑战者芬德尔·G·温斯顿。

en.s: The 1904 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1904, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Edward T. Young defeated Democratic nominee Thomas McDermott.

zh.t: 1904年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1904年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党提名人、前明尼苏达州参议员爱德华·T·杨击败民主党提名人托马斯·麦克德莫特。

en.s: The 1904 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Incumbent Republican Governor Robert M. La Follette defeated Democratic nominee George Wilbur Peck and Social-Democratic nominee William A. Arnold with 50.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长罗伯特·M·拉福莱特以50.55%的得票率击败民主党提名人乔治·威尔伯·佩克和社会民主党提名人威廉·A·阿诺德。

en.t: 1904 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana
en.s: The 1904 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana were held on November 8, 1904, to elect the seven members from Louisiana to the United States House of Representatives. Democratic dominance in Louisiana politics continued, with Democrats winning all seats.

zh.t: 1904年路易斯安那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1904年路易斯安那州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州7名联邦众议员。民主党在路易斯安那州继续占主导地位，赢得全部席位。

en.t: 1904 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory
en.s: The 1904 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory was held on November 8, 1904 to elect the state's non-voting delegate. Incumbent Republican won re-election with 56.99% of the vote.

zh.t: 1904年夏威夷领地联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 1904年夏威夷领地联邦众议院代表选举于11月8日举行，选出该领地派往联邦众议院的无表决权代表。共和党籍时任代表以56.99%的得票率成功连任。

en.s: The 1904 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1904, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，西弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。

en.s: The 1904 New York state election was held on November 8, 1904, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer, the state engineer, the chief judge and an associate judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、州务卿、州财务主管、总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师、州上诉法院首席法官及一名法官，以及州众议院和州参议院全部议员。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 8, 1904. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. This election would solidify the State of Washington as a one-party Republican bastion, which it would remain at a Presidential level apart from the 1910s GOP split until Franklin D.

zh.s: 华盛顿州的1904年美国总统选举于1904年11月8日举行。当时美国45个州均参与总统选举。选民选出5名选举人进入选举人团，由其选出总统和副总统。这次选举巩固了华盛顿州作为共和党一党优势州的地位；除了20世纪10年代共和党分裂时期外，该州在总统选举层面一直保持这一格局，直到富兰克林·D。

en.s: The 1904 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, Joseph W. Folk, over the Republican candidate, former mayor of St. Louis Cyrus Walbridge, and several other candidates representing minor parties. Folk defeated Harry B. Hawes and Kansas City mayor James A. Reed for the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 1904年密苏里州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人约瑟夫·W.福克击败共和党候选人、圣路易斯前市长赛勒斯·沃尔布里奇和几个小党候选人，赢得选举。福克此前击败哈里·B.霍斯和堪萨斯城的詹姆斯·A.里德，获得民主党提名。

en.s: The 1904 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1904. Republican nominee Albert E. Mead defeated Democratic nominee George Turner and Socialist nominee David Burgess, with 51.34% of the vote.

zh.s: 1904年华盛顿州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党候选人阿尔伯特·E.米德以51.34%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔治·特纳和社会党候选人大卫·伯吉斯。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 8, 1904, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，佐治亚州举行美国总统选举投票。选民选出13名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州在19世纪70年代初剥夺了大批刚获得选举权的获释奴隶的投票权；它是最早大规模采取此举的前南方邦联州。

en.s: The 1904 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Governor S. W. T. Lanham was re-elected to a second term over Republican J. G. Lowden.

zh.s: 1904年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州长选举。现任州长S·W·T·兰纳姆击败共和党候选人J·G·洛登，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: 1904 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1904 United States presidential election in Iowa was held on Tuesday November 8, All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1904 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana.

zh.s: 1904年艾奥瓦州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行。所有当时的45个州都参加了1904年美国总统选举。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人：纽约州现任总统西奥多·罗斯福和他的竞选搭档、印第安纳州的查尔斯·W.费尔班克斯。

en.s: The 1906 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Thomas Mitchell Campbell was elected to a two-year term in office. This was the first election in which a party held a primary to determine its nominee. Thomas Mitchell Campbell won the Democratic nomination over a four-man field including M. M. Brooks, Oscar Branch Colquitt and Charles K.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1906年举行州长选举。托马斯·米切尔·坎贝尔当选，任期两年。这是首次有政党举行初选来确定提名人。坎贝尔在民主党提名角逐中击败四名对手，包括M·M·布鲁克斯、奥斯卡·布兰奇·科尔奎特和查尔斯·K。

en.s: The 1908 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Governor Thomas Mitchell Campbell was re-elected to a second term in office. Campbell defeated State Representative Robert R. Williams in the Democratic primary by a wide margin, which was tantamount to victory in the general election.

zh.s: 1908年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州长选举，现任州长托马斯·米切尔·坎贝尔再次当选。他此前在民主党初选中大幅领先州众议员罗伯特·R·威廉姆斯；当时赢得该党提名，基本就等于赢得州长选举。

en.s: The 1910 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1910 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched incumbent Republican Jay Bowerman against Democratic challenger Oswald West. After the resignations of George Chamberlain (to take up a Senate seat) and Frank W. Benson (due to illness), then President of the Oregon Senate Jay Bowerman took up the role as Governor for the remainder of the term. Bowerman sought election as governor in his own right on a platform advocating modernization of highways, economies in government administration, and tight control of state land management.

zh.s: 1910年11月8日，俄勒冈州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长杰伊·鲍尔曼与民主党挑战者奥斯瓦尔德·韦斯特角逐。乔治·张伯伦辞职出任联邦参议员、弗兰克·W·本森因病辞职后，时任俄勒冈州参议院议长鲍尔曼接任州长，完成剩余任期。他以州长身份参选，政纲主张公路现代化、节省政府行政开支，并严格管理州属土地。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1910. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Adolph Olson Eberhart defeated Democratic Party of Minnesota challenger James Gray.

zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州州长选举于1910年11月8日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人阿道夫·奥尔森·埃伯哈特击败了明尼苏达州民主党挑战者詹姆斯·格雷。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1910
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1910 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1910. Complete Republican dominance of California's congressional delegation ended when Democrats narrowly won one district.

zh.t: 1910年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1910年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举旨在选出该州的联邦众议员，并与1910年11月8日举行的联邦众议院普选同时进行。民主党险胜一个选区，结束了共和党对加州国会代表团的全面优势。

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1910 was held on November 8, 1910.

zh.s: 1910年加利福尼亚州州长选举于1910年11月8日举行。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Gubernatorial election of 1910 was held on November 8, 1910. The candidates were Republican John Tenner, Democrat Webster Grim, Keystone Party leader William Berry, and Socialist John W. Slayton.

zh.s: 1910年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。候选人包括共和党人约翰·坦纳、民主党人韦伯斯特·格里姆、基斯通党领袖威廉·贝里和社会党人约翰·W·斯莱顿。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1910 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1910. Democrat Woodrow Wilson defeated Republican nominee Vivian M. Lewis with 53.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年新泽西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党人伍德罗·威尔逊以53.93%的得票率击败共和党提名人维维安·M·刘易斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1910 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Democratic nominee James H. Hawley defeated incumbent Republican James H. Brady with 47.42% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年爱达荷州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人詹姆斯·H·霍利以47.42%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长詹姆斯·H·布雷迪。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held 31 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 8, 1910 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Maine and Vermont, which held early elections). In Oregon, the gubernatorial election was held on the same day as federal elections for the first time, having previously been held in June.

zh.s: 美国于1910年11月8日在31个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州和佛蒙特州提前举行了选举。俄勒冈州首次在联邦选举同一天举行州长选举；此前该州一直在6月举行。

en.s: The 1910 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Primary elections were held on September 6, 1910. Republican nominee Francis E. McGovern defeated Democratic nominee Adolph J. Schmitz and Socialist nominee William A. Jacobs, with 50.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行，初选于同年9月6日举行。共和党提名人弗朗西斯·E·麦戈文以50.57%的得票率击败民主党提名人阿道夫·J·施米茨和社会党提名人威廉·A·雅各布斯。

en.s: The 1910 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent acting Attorney General John H. Light defeated Democratic nominee Talcott H. Russell.

zh.t: 1910年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1910年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任代理总检察长约翰·H·莱特击败民主党提名人塔尔科特·H·罗素。

en.s: The 1910 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Republican nominee Chase S. Osborn defeated Democratic candidate Lawton T. Hemans with 52.85% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年密歇根州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人蔡斯·S·奥斯本以52.85%的得票率击败民主党候选人劳顿·T·赫曼斯。

en.s: The 1910 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Democrat Judson Harmon defeated Republican nominee Warren G. Harding with 51.61% of the vote. Harding would be elected to the Senate in 1914, and then to the Presidency in 1920.

zh.s: 1910年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长贾德森·哈蒙以51.61%的得票率击败共和党提名人沃伦·G·哈丁。哈丁后来于1914年当选联邦参议员，并于1920年当选总统。

en.s: The 1910 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican governor Eben S. Draper was defeated for re-election to a third term by former Republican Eugene Foss, running as a Democrat.

zh.s: 1910年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长埃本·S·德雷珀竞选连任，争取第三个任期，但败给前共和党人尤金·福斯；福斯此次以民主党人身份参选。

en.s: The 1910 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Democratic Governor Ashton C. Shallenberger was defeated in the Democratic primary. Republican nominee Chester Hardy Aldrich defeated Democratic nominee James Dahlman with 51.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长阿什顿·C·沙伦伯格在民主党初选中落败。共和党提名人切斯特·哈代·奥尔德里奇以51.90%的得票率击败民主党提名人詹姆斯·达尔曼。

en.t: 1910 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1910 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 8, 1910, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the State of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Socialist parties' nominations took place on August 2, 1910.

zh.t: 1910年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1910年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州5名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出1人。共和党、民主党和社会党的初选均于1910年8月2日举行。

en.s: The 1910 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent B. B. Comer was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1910年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍时任州长B·B·科默受任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.s: The 1910 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican Walter R. Stubbs defeated Democratic nominee George H. Hodges with 49.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长沃尔特·R·斯塔布斯以49.76%的得票率击败民主党提名人乔治·H·霍奇斯。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee Fred W. Johnson, Socialist nominee Torkel Hoiland and Prohibition nominee Frank F. Marzahn.

zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败民主党提名人弗雷德·W·约翰逊、社会党提名人托克尔·霍伊兰德和禁酒党提名人弗兰克·F·马尔赞。

en.s: The 1910 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican Governor Robert S. Vessey ran for re-election to a second term. He faced two serious competitors in the Republican primary: colorful disbarred attorney George W. Egan and former Governor Samuel H. Elrod, and won the primary only with a narrow plurality. In the general election, he faced Democratic nominee Chauncey L.

zh.s: 1910年南达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·S·维西竞选连任第二个任期。在共和党初选中，他面临两名有力对手：因律师资格被取消而颇具争议的律师乔治·W·伊根，以及前州长塞缪尔·H·埃尔罗德；维西仅以微弱优势赢得提名。普选中，他面对民主党候选人昌西·L·伍德。

en.s: The 1910 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Republican nominee Robert P. Bass defeated Democratic nominee Clarence E. Carr with 53.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人罗伯特·P·巴斯以53.36%的得票率击败民主党提名人克拉伦斯·E·卡尔。

en.s: The 1910 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican Aram J. Pothier defeated Democratic nominee Lewis A. Waterman with 49.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年罗得岛州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长阿拉姆·J·波蒂耶以49.60%的得票率击败民主党提名人刘易斯·A·沃特曼。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1910. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Samuel Y. Gordon defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Merrill C. Tifft, Public Ownership Party candidate Lewis M. Ayer, and Prohibition Party candidate J. D. Engle.

zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人塞缪尔·Y·戈登击败明尼苏达州民主党挑战者梅里尔·C·蒂夫特、公共所有权党候选人刘易斯·M·艾尔和禁酒党候选人J·D·恩格尔。

en.s: The 1910 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Democrat Oscar Branch Colquitt, a member of the Texas Railroad Commission, won re-election to his first term as Governor of Texas.

zh.s: 1910年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。民主党人奥斯卡·布兰奇·科尔基特是得克萨斯州铁路委员会委员，他成功连任州长，开始首个任期。

en.s: The 1910 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican Governor Bryant B. Brooks declined to seek re-election. The leading Republican candidates to succeed him were initially former U.S. Senator Joseph M. Carey and Attorney General William E. Mullen. However, shortly before the Republican convention, Carey announced he would instead run as an independent candidate. Shortly thereafter, Mullen was formally nominated by the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1910年怀俄明州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长布莱恩特·B·布鲁克斯决定不再竞选连任。最初，前联邦参议员约瑟夫·M·凯里和总检察长威廉·E·马伦是接替他的主要共和党候选人。但在共和党大会前不久，凯里宣布改以独立候选人身份参选。不久后，马伦获共和党正式提名。

en.s: The 1910 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Democrat John Burke defeated Republican nominee C. A. Johnson with 49.96% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年北达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长约翰·伯克以49.96%的得票率击败共和党提名人C·A·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1910 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Melville R. Hopewell, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Ralph A. Clark as well as Socialist Party nominee George L. Slutter and Prohibition Party nominee Samuel Lichty.

zh.t: 1910年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1910年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任副州长梅尔维尔·R·霍普韦尔击败民主党提名人拉尔夫·A·克拉克、社会党提名人乔治·L·斯拉特和禁酒党提名人塞缪尔·莱希。

en.t: 1910 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1910 congressional elections in Wisconsin were held on November 8, 1910, to determine who would represent the state of Wisconsin in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 62nd Congress from March 4, 1911, until March 4, 1913. The election coincided with the 1910 Wisconsin gubernatorial election. Wisconsin had eleven congressional districts at the time.

zh.t: 1910年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1910年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。联邦众议员任期为两年，当选者于1911年3月4日至1913年3月4日在第62届国会任职。这次选举与1910年威斯康星州州长选举同时举行。当时该州有11个国会选区。

en.s: The 1910 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Republican nominee Tasker Oddie defeated Democratic incumbent Denver S. Dickerson with 50.59% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年内华达州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人塔斯克·奥迪以50.59%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长丹佛·S·迪克森。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general George T. Simpson defeated Democratic nominee John M. Freeman.

zh.t: 1910年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人、时任总检察长乔治·T·辛普森击败民主党提名人约翰·M·弗里曼。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 1910, to elect members to the House of the 37th Minnesota Legislature. The Minnesota Republican Party won a large majority of seats, followed by the Minnesota Democratic Party, the Prohibition Party, and the Public Ownership Party. The new Legislature convened on January 3, 1911.

zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第37届明尼苏达州议会的众议员。明尼苏达州共和党赢得大多数席位，其后依次是明尼苏达州民主党、禁酒党和公共所有权党。新一届州议会于1911年1月3日召开。

en.s: The 1910 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Democrat John F. Shafroth defeated Republican nominee John B. Stephen with 51.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长约翰·F·沙弗罗斯以51.04%的得票率击败共和党提名人约翰·B·斯蒂芬。

en.t: 1910 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1910 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 8, 1910, while Maine and Vermont held theirs early in September, in the middle of President William Howard Taft's term. Elections were held for all 391 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 46 states, to the 62nd United States Congress The conservative Taft contended with major factional splits within his Republican Party.

zh.s: 1910年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月8日举行，缅因州和佛蒙特州则提前在9月举行。这些选举在威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱总统任期中段举行。46个州共选出联邦众议院全部391名议员，组成第62届国会。保守派塔夫脱与共和党内各派系严重分裂的局面相抗衡。

en.s: The 1910 Oklahoma elections were held on November 8, 1910, in the U.S. State of Oklahoma. Oklahoma voters elected statewide officials and members of the United States House of Representatives, and also determined the permanent state capital city of Oklahoma City by referendum.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1910年11月8日举行选举，选出全州公职人员和联邦众议员，并通过公投确定州首府为俄克拉何马城。

en.s: The 1910 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Republican Los Angeles City Councilman Albert Joseph Wallace defeated Democratic Los Angeles County Civil Service Commissioner Timothy Spellacy with 45.09% of the vote.

zh.t: 1910年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1910年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍洛杉矶市议员阿尔伯特·约瑟夫·华莱士以45.09%的得票率击败民主党籍洛杉矶县公务员委员会委员蒂莫西·斯佩拉西。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 1910, to elect members to the Senate of the 37th and 38th Minnesota Legislatures. The Minnesota Republican Party won a large majority of seats, followed by the Minnesota Democratic Party, the People's Party, and the Prohibition Party. The new Legislature convened on January 3, 1911. 14 Republicans and 4 Democrats were uncontested.

zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第37届和第38届明尼苏达州议会的参议员。明尼苏达州共和党赢得大多数席位，其后依次是明尼苏达州民主党、人民党和禁酒党。新一届州议会于1911年1月3日召开。14名共和党人和4名民主党人没有对手。

en.s: The 1910 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Republican Beryl F. Carroll defeated Democratic nominee Claude R. Porter with 49.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 1910年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长伯里尔·F·卡罗尔以49.81%的得票率击败民主党提名人克劳德·R·波特。

en.s: The 1910 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1910, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Samuel G. Iverson defeated Democratic nominee Thomas J. Meighen.

zh.t: 1910年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1910年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党提名人、时任州审计长塞缪尔·G·艾弗森击败民主党提名人托马斯·J·梅根。

en.s: The 1910 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Incumbent Democratic governor Malcolm R. Patterson initially sought a third term but withdrew from the race after securing his party's nomination. Senator and former Democratic governor Robert Love Taylor was nominated after Patterson's withdrawal. On the Republican side, Ben W. Hooper defeated Alfred A. Taylor, Robert's brother, for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 1910年田纳西州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任州长马尔科姆·R·帕特森最初争取第三个任期，但在获得本党提名后退出竞选。参议员、前民主党籍州长罗伯特·洛夫·泰勒在帕特森退出后获提名。共和党方面，本·W·胡珀在初选中击败罗伯特的兄弟阿尔弗雷德·A·泰勒，赢得共和党提名。

en.s: The 1910 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910. Democratic nominee Simeon E. Baldwin defeated Republican nominee Charles A. Goodwin with 46.48% of the vote. This was the first such election in which a candidate won with only a plurality of the vote, as the state constitution no longer required a subsequent vote by the Connecticut General Assembly in the absence of a majority.

zh.s: 1910年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人西缅·E·鲍德温以46.48%的得票率击败共和党提名人查尔斯·A·古德温。这是该州首次出现候选人以相对多数而非过半数得票获胜的州长选举；州宪法已不再规定，如果无人获得多数票，就由州议会另行投票决定。

en.s: The 1910 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1910, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Lee Cruce defeated Republican J. W. McNeal. Also on the ballot were J. T. Cumbie of the Socialist Party and George E. Rouch of the Prohibition Party.

zh.s: 1910年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党人李·克鲁斯击败共和党人J.W.麦克尼尔。社会党候选人J.T.坎比和禁酒党候选人乔治·E.劳奇也参加了选举。

en.s: The 1910 New York state election was held on November 8, 1910, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer, the state engineer and two judges of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1910年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、州务卿、州财务主管、总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师、州上诉法院两名法官，以及州众议院和州参议院全部议员。

en.s: The 1910 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1910 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1910 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1910年11月8日，美国艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，选民在50个选区中的22个选区选出州参议员。该州参议员每届任期四年。

en.s: The Hauran Druze Rebellion was a violent Druze uprising against Ottoman authority in the Syrian province, which erupted in 1909. The rebellion was led by the al-Atrash family in an aim to retain regional autonomy, but ended in the suppression of the Druze forces, significant depopulation of the Hauran region, and the execution of key Druze leaders in 1911.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 豪兰德鲁兹起义是1909年在奥斯曼帝国叙利亚省爆发的一场德鲁兹人武装起义，由阿特拉什家族领导，旨在维护当地自治。起义最终遭到镇压，豪兰地区人口大幅减少，多名德鲁兹领袖于1911年被处决。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1912 Colorado gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1912. Democratic state Senator Elias M. Ammons defeated the Progressive, Republican and Socialist candidates future Senator Edward P. Costigan, Clifford C. Parks and Charles A. Ashelstrom with 42.91% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍州参议员伊莱亚斯·M·阿蒙斯以42.91%的得票率击败进步党、共和党和社会党的候选人：未来的联邦参议员爱德华·P·科斯蒂根、克利福德·C·帕克斯和查尔斯·A·阿舍尔斯特伦。

en.s: The Fao Landing occurred from 6 November to 8 November 1914 with British forces attacking the Ottoman stronghold of Fao and its fortress. The landing was met with little resistance from the Ottoman defenders who fled after intense shelling. It was the first military operation of the Mesopotamian Campaign, during the First World War, which was carried out to protect British oil supplies in the Persian Gulf.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法奥登陆发生于1914年11月6日至8日。英军进攻奥斯曼帝国在法奥的据点及其要塞。奥斯曼守军抵抗不多，在遭到猛烈炮击后撤离。这是第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战役中的首次军事行动，行动目的是保护英国在波斯湾的石油供应。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Don Civil War was a military action between the Don Cossacks (in alliance with the White movement in Southern Russia) and supporters of Lenin's Council of People's Commissars, primarily in the Don Host Oblast, which took place from November 1917 to the spring of 1920. It was part of the Russian Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 顿河内战是顿河哥萨克（与俄罗斯南部的白军结盟）和列宁领导的人民委员会支持者之间的军事冲突，主要发生在顿河州，时间从1917年11月持续到1920年春。该冲突是俄国内战的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Charge at Huj (8 November 1917), also known by the British as the Affair of Huj, was an engagement between forces of the British Empire's Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) and the Ottoman Turkish Empire's, Yildirim Army Group during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. It took place during the Pursuit phase of the Southern Palestine Offensive which eventually captured Jerusalem a month later.

zh.s: 胡杰冲锋（1917年11月8日，英方也称胡杰事件）是第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，英帝国埃及远征军与奥斯曼帝国耶尔德勒姆集团军之间的一场交战。此战发生在南巴勒斯坦攻势的追击阶段，一个月后英军最终攻占耶路撒冷。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: General elections were held in Romania between 4 and 8 November 1919. The Romanian National Party emerged as the largest party in Parliament, winning 169 of the 568 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 76 of the 216 seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1919年11月4日至8日举行大选。罗马尼亚民族党成为议会第一大党，在568个众议院席位中赢得169席，在216个参议院席位中赢得76席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Eichenfeld massacre was a 1919 attack against the Mennonite colonists of Eichenfeld by the Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine. Rising tensions between the native Ukrainian peasantry and Mennonite landowners had culminated with attacks on the latter, as insurgents took control of southern Ukraine and began carrying out reprisals against those that had collaborated with the Central Powers and the White movement.

zh.s: 1919年11月8日，乌克兰革命起义军袭击艾兴费尔德的门诺派移民。乌克兰农民与门诺派地主长期关系紧张。起义军控制乌克兰南部后，开始报复曾与同盟国和白军合作的人，紧张局势最终演变为这场袭击。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1921 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1921 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1921年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1921 New York City mayoral election took place on November 8, 1921, resulting in a victory for Democratic Party candidate John Francis Hylan. Hylan faced Manhattan borough president and Republican Party candidate Henry Curran, and the Socialist Party candidate Jacob Panken. Hylan was the son of an Irish-Catholic immigrant and affiliated with Tammany Hall machine politics. Curran had run as a coalition candidate for the Republican factions.

zh.s: 1921年纽约市市长选举于11月8日举行，民主党候选人约翰·弗朗西斯·海兰获胜。海兰的对手包括曼哈顿区区长、共和党候选人亨利·柯伦，以及社会党候选人雅各布·潘肯。海兰是爱尔兰天主教移民之子，与坦慕尼协会的政治机器有联系。柯伦则以共和党内各派系联合候选人的身份参选。

en.s: The 1921 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 8, 1921, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee William S. Gordy Jr. defeated Republican nominee Oliver Metzerott, Labor nominee Robert L. Long and Socialist nominee Clarence H. Taylor.

zh.s: 1921年马里兰州州财务长选举于11月8日举行。民主党提名人小威廉·S·戈迪击败共和党提名人奥利弗·梅泽罗特、劳工党提名人罗伯特·L·朗和社会党提名人克拉伦斯·H·泰勒。

en.s: The 1921 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1921. Republican nominee William A. Magee was elected by a large margin over Democratic candidate William N. McNair.

zh.s: 1921年匹兹堡市长选举于11月8日星期二举行。共和党候选人威廉·A.梅吉以较大优势击败民主党候选人威廉·N.麦克奈尔，当选市长。

en.s: The Beer Hall Putsch, also known as the Munich Putsch, was a failed coup d'état led by Nazi Party leader Adolf Hitler, General Erich Ludendorff, and other Kampfbund leaders in Munich, Bavaria, on 8–9 November 1923, during the Weimar Republic. Inspired by Benito Mussolini's March on Rome, Hitler's goal was to use Munich as a base for a march against Germany's national government in Berlin.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 啤酒馆政变又称慕尼黑政变，是纳粹党领袖阿道夫·希特勒、埃里希·鲁登道夫将军及其他战斗联盟领导人于1923年11月8日至9日在魏玛共和国巴伐利亚州慕尼黑发动的一场失败的政变。受贝尼托·墨索里尼进军罗马的启发，希特勒计划以慕尼黑为基地，向柏林进军，推翻德国中央政府。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 8 November 1925. The result was a victory for the Democratic Party, which won 83 of the 163 seats in the House of Representatives and 39 of the 70 seats in the Senate. With a military coup the following year and the subsequent Estado Novo period, they were the last truly multi-party elections in the country until the 1975 Constituent Assembly election.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1925年11月8日举行议会选举。民主党获胜，在163个众议院席位中赢得83席，在70个参议院席位中赢得39席。次年发生军事政变，随后进入新国家时期；直到1975年制宪议会选举前，这都是葡萄牙最后一次真正的多党选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The third legislative council election to Madras Presidency after the establishment of dyarchical system of government by the Government of India Act, 1919, was held in November 1926. Justice party lost the election to Swaraj Party. However, as the Swaraja Party refused to form the Government, the Governor of Madras set up an independent government under the leadership of P. Subbarayan and with the support of nominated members.

zh.t: 1926年马德拉斯省立法议会选举
zh.s: 1926年11月，英属印度马德拉斯省举行立法议会选举。这是1919年《印度政府法》实行双重统治后，该省第三次选举议会。正义党败给自治党，但自治党拒绝组阁。马德拉斯省总督随后任命P·苏巴拉扬领导政府，并依靠委任议员支持。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1927 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1927, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Dennis Murphree, as he had not served a full term, was eligible for and ran for election. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election; therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1927年密西西比州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任民主党籍州长丹尼斯·墨菲里没有完成完整任期，因此有资格竞选连任。他参加了选举。当时，民主党候选人通常在普选中没有对手，因此民主党初选才是真正的竞争，赢得初选就几乎等于当选。

en.s: The 1927 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1927. Republican nominee Flem D. Sampson defeated the Democratic nominee, former governor and former U.S. Senator J. C. W. Beckham, with 52.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1927年肯塔基州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党提名人弗莱姆·D·桑普森以52.09%的得票率击败民主党提名人、前州长兼前联邦参议员J·C·W·贝克汉姆。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 1927 to fill the 72 seats of the New York City Board of Aldermen, in addition to elections to the New York State Assembly and various other questions on the ballot. 66 Democrats and 6 Republicans were elected to the Board. Brooklyn lost its sole Republican alderman.

zh.s: 1927年11月8日举行选举，选出纽约市市议会72名议员，同时还举行纽约州州众议院选举，并对多项其他议题进行投票。66名民主党人和6名共和党人当选市议员。布鲁克林失去了唯一一名共和党籍市议员。

en.s: The 1927 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 8, 1927. Incumbent James Rolph Jr. was re-elected with 56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1927年旧金山市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长詹姆斯·罗尔夫以56%的得票率赢得连任。

en.s: The 1932 Greek Cup final was the inaugural final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 8 November 1931 at Leoforos Alexandras Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and Aris. The eight goals that were scored in the match marked a goal-scoring record for a Cup final.

zh.s: 1932年希腊杯决赛是希腊杯历史上的首场决赛。比赛于1931年11月8日在利奥福罗斯·亚历山德拉斯体育场举行，参赛双方是雅典AEK和塞萨洛尼基阿里斯。全场共打进8球，创下杯赛决赛的进球纪录。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Yugoslavia on 8 November 1931. Voters were presented with a single list of candidates supporting the royal dictatorship of King Alexander. The list was headed by Prime Minister Petar Živković.

zh.s: 1931年11月8日，南斯拉夫举行议会选举。选民只能从一份支持亚历山大国王王权独裁统治的候选人名单中投票。这份名单由首相佩塔尔·日夫科维奇领衔。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 8, 1932. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by New York Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt in a 27-point sweep-out landslide against incumbent president Herbert Hoover, who failed to gain reelection. Hoover proved to be a better foreign charity organizer than U.S. President during these early years of the Great Depression, and was overwhelmingly voted out of office.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举新墨西哥州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，新墨西哥州举行总统选举投票。全美48个州都参加了选举。新墨西哥州选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福以27个百分点的巨大优势赢得该州，击败未能连任的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛。胡佛在大萧条初期，与其说像一位美国总统，不如说更像一名海外慈善活动组织者。选民以压倒性优势将他赶下台。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 8, 1932 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 36 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, President Herbert Hoover, over the Democratic nominee, New York Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt. Hoover won Pennsylvania by a margin of 5.51%. This is the last election where the Republican candidate carried Philadelphia County in a presidential election. This was also the last election until 1988 that Pennsylvania did not vote the same as neighboring New York.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举投票。全美48个州都参加了选举。选民选出36名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人、总统赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。胡佛以5.51%的优势赢得该州。这是共和党候选人最后一次在总统选举中赢得费城县；宾夕法尼亚州也直到1988年才再次与邻州纽约投票支持不同的总统候选人。

en.s: The 1932 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Governor of Montana John E. Erickson, who was first elected governor in 1924 and was re-elected in 1928, ran for re-election. He won the Democratic primary with a plurality and advanced to the general election, where he faced Frank A. Hazelbaker, the Lieutenant Governor of Montana. Despite the fact that Franklin D. Roosevelt carried the state in a landslide in the presidential election that year, Erickson only narrowly defeated Hazelbaker to win re-election to his third and final term as governor, though he would later resign just a few months into his term to appoint himself to the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行州长选举。时任州长约翰·E·埃里克森于1924年首次当选，并于1928年连任，此次竞选连任。他以相对多数赢得民主党初选，进入普选，对手是蒙大拿州副州长弗兰克·A·黑泽尔贝克。尽管富兰克林·D·罗斯福在同年的总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得蒙大拿州，埃里克森仍以微弱优势击败黑泽尔贝克，赢得第三个、也是最后一个州长任期。几个月后，他辞职并任命自己接任联邦参议员。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 8, 1932. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1932 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 47 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by Democratic Governor of New York Franklin D. Roosevelt, who was challenging embattled incumbent Republican President Herbert Hoover. Roosevelt ran with Speaker of the House John Nance Garner of Texas, and Hoover ran with incumbent Vice President Charles Curtis of Kansas.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举纽约州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，纽约州举行总统选举投票。全美当时的48个州都参加了本次选举。纽约州选民选出47名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。纽约州民主党州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败共和党籍时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，赢得该州。罗斯福的竞选搭档是来自得克萨斯州的众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳；胡佛的竞选搭档是时任副总统、来自堪萨斯州的查尔斯·柯蒂斯。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1932 as part of the 1932 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York. Hoover's running mate was incumbent Vice President Charles Curtis of Kansas, while Roosevelt ran with incumbent Speaker of the House John Nance Garner of Texas.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举佛蒙特州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佛蒙特州举行投票；当时全美48个州都参加了选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、来自纽约州的州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。胡佛的竞选搭档是来自堪萨斯州的时任副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯；罗斯福则与来自得克萨斯州的众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳搭档。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1932
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1932 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1932. This election began the transition of California from a solidly Republican state to a swing state, which it would be for the next 60 years. California gained nine seats as a result of the 1930 Census; it would have been six if the House seats were reapportioned in 1920 since California would have had 14 seats as a result of the 1920 Census.

zh.t: 1932年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院普选。这次选举标志着加州从共和党长期占优的州转变为摇摆州的开端；此后60年，加州一直是摇摆州。1930年人口普查后，加州增加了九个联邦众议院席位。如果当时按1920年人口普查结果重新分配席位，加州只能增加六席，因为依据1920年人口普查，该州本来会有14个席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 8, 1932 as part of the 1932 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 17 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, over the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California. Roosevelt ran with Speaker of the House John Nance Garner of Texas, and Hoover ran with incumbent Vice President Charles Curtis of Kansas.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，马萨诸塞州举行投票；当时全美48个州都参加了选举。选民选出17名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛。罗斯福的竞选搭档是来自得克萨斯州的众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳；胡佛的竞选搭档是来自堪萨斯州的时任副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1932 was the 37th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 8, 1932. The election took place against the backdrop of the Great Depression that ruined the promises of incumbent President and Republican candidate Herbert Hoover to bring about a new era of prosperity. The Democratic nomination went to the well-known governor of the most populous state, New York's Franklin D. Roosevelt, who had been reelected governor in a landslide in 1930. Roosevelt united all wings of his party, avoided divisive cultural issues, and brought in a leading Southern conservative as his running mate, House Speaker John Nance Garner of Texas.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日星期二，美国举行第37次四年一度总统选举。选举正值大萧条期间，经济危机使共和党籍时任总统赫伯特·胡佛带领美国进入繁荣新时代的承诺破灭。民主党提名人口最多的州——纽约州——的知名州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福；他于1930年以压倒性优势连任州长。罗斯福团结了民主党各派，避开容易引发分歧的文化议题，并邀请南方保守派领军人物、得克萨斯州众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳担任竞选搭档。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1932
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1932. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1932 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 16 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Democratic nominees, Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Speaker of the House John Nance Garner of Texas. Roosevelt and Garner defeated the Republican nominees, incumbent Republican President Herbert Hoover of California and incumbent Vice President Charles Curtis of Kansas.

zh.t: 1932年美国总统选举新泽西州投票
zh.s: 1932年11月8日，新泽西州举行总统选举投票。全美当时的48个州都参加了本次选举。新泽西州选民选出16名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳赢得该州，击败共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛及其竞选搭档、来自堪萨斯州的时任副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯。

en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1932 in Minnesota as part of the 1932 United States presidential election.
