This would be the last time that Democrats would win Ohio Class 3 Senate seat until Frank Lausche did so in 1956.

zh.t: 1932年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1932年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。时任参议员罗伯特·J·布尔克利原本是为填补弗兰克·威利斯任期剩余部分而当选，此次成功当选完整任期。这是民主党人最后一次赢得俄亥俄州第三类联邦参议员席位，直到1956年弗兰克·劳舍尔胜出。

en.s: The 1932 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1932. Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party candidate Konrad K. Solberg defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Theodore G. Streissguth and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Ruth Hayes Carpenter.

zh.s: 1932年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月8日举行。明尼苏达农民—劳工党候选人康拉德·K·索尔伯格击败明尼苏达州共和党挑战者西奥多·G·斯特赖斯古特和明尼苏达州民主党候选人露丝·海斯·卡彭特。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年南达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。该州由州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福胜出。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年艾奥瓦州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。该州由州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福胜出。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Speaker John Nance Garner, with 69.41% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Herbert Hoover (R–California), running with Vice President Charles Curtis, with 30.59% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，内华达州于1932年11月8日举行投票，选出3名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。纽约州州长富兰克林·罗斯福与众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，获得69.41%的普选票，赢得内华达州；在任总统、加利福尼亚州共和党人赫伯特·胡佛与副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，获得30.59%。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。该州由州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福胜出。

en.s: The 1932 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Richard R. Nacy defeated Republican nominee A. H. Steinbeck and Socialist nominee Barnett Cohen.

zh.t: 1932年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 密苏里州于1932年11月8日举行州财政部长选举。民主党候选人理查德·R·纳西击败共和党候选人A·H·斯坦贝克和社会党候选人巴内特·科恩。

en.s: The 1932 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee John T. Lyons, Democratic nominee Jerry A. Harri and Communist nominee Robert Turner.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1932年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人约翰·T·莱昂斯、民主党候选人杰里·A·哈里和共产党候选人罗伯特·特纳。

en.s: The 1932 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Forrest Smith defeated Republican nominee and former state auditor George Ernst Hackman and Socialist nominee D. C. Miller.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1932年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人福里斯特·史密斯击败共和党候选人、前州审计长乔治·恩斯特·哈克曼和社会党候选人D·C·米勒。

en.s: The 1932 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1932. Democrat Harry H. Woodring, the incumbent Governor of Kansas, was narrowly defeated by Alf Landon, a Republican. Landon polled 34.82%, Woodring 34.14%, and John R. Brinkley, an independent, polled 30.58%.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党人阿尔夫·兰登以34.82%的得票率险胜民主党籍时任州长哈里·H·伍德林（34.14%）。独立候选人约翰·R·布林克利获得30.58%。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Speaker John Nance Garner, with 95.98% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Herbert Hoover (R–California), running with Vice President Charles Curtis, with 3.55% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1932年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，密西西比州于11月8日举行投票，选出9名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。纽约州州长富兰克林·罗斯福与众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，获得95.98%的普选票；在任总统、加利福尼亚州共和党人赫伯特·胡佛与副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，获得3.55%。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，田纳西州于11月8日举行投票，选出11名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪以来，田纳西州一直因当年形成的政治立场而分裂。

en.s: The 1932 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Henry Horner defeated Republican nominee and former Governor Len Small with 57.62% of the vote. Incumbent first-term Republican Governor Louis Lincoln Emmerson did not run for re-election.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人亨利·霍纳以57.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人、前州长伦·斯莫尔。共和党籍首届任期州长路易斯·林肯·埃默森没有寻求连任。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since statehood, North Dakota had been overwhelmingly Republican at state level and in many presidential elections, although progressive Democrat Woodrow Wilson was able to carry the state in both his campaigns in 1912 and 1916, in the second due to his anti-war platform.

zh.t: 1932年美国北达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，北达科他州于11月8日举行投票，选出4名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。自建州以来，北达科他州在州级选举和许多次总统选举中一直由共和党占优势。不过，进步派民主党人伍德罗·威尔逊在1912年和1916年两次竞选总统时都赢得了该州；第二次获胜与他的反战政纲有关。

en.s: The 1932 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Edwin C. Johnson defeated Republican nominee James D. Parriott with 57.23% of the vote.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人埃德温·C·约翰逊以57.23%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·D·帕里奥特。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Duncan U. Fletcher won re-election to a fifth term. Fletcher's victory in the June 7 primary was tantamount to election, as the Republican Party did not field a candidate for this election.

zh.t: 1932年佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员邓肯·U·弗莱彻成功连任，开始第五个任期。他在6月7日的党内初选中获胜，实际上已锁定席位，因为共和党没有派出候选人参选。

en.s: The 1932 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican John Gilbert Winant defeated Democratic nominee Henri Ledoux with 54.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长约翰·吉尔伯特·温纳特以54.20%的得票率击败民主党候选人亨利·勒杜。

en.s: The 1932 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee David Sholtz defeated Republican nominee William J. Howey with 66.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人大卫·肖尔茨以66.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·J·豪伊。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose thirteen representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1932年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，北卡罗来纳州于11月8日举行投票，选出13名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州曾是邦联州，长期实行种族隔离法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政坛也一直由民主党主导。

en.s: The 1932 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932, to elect the governor of Arkansas, concurrently with the election to Arkansas's Class III U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic governor Harvey Parnell had won office in 1928, and reelection in 1930.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举，同时还选举该州联邦参议院第三类席位，并与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。民主党籍时任州长哈维·帕内尔于1928年当选，并在1930年连任。

en.s: The 1932 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Hill McAlister defeated Republican nominee John McCall and Independent nominee Lewis S. Pope with 42.8% of the vote. In the primary, McAlister's main competitors were Lewis S. Pope and former governor Malcolm R. Patterson. McAlister won the primary by 9,570 votes with Pope getting second.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人希尔·麦卡利斯特以42.8%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·麦考尔和独立候选人刘易斯·S·波普。党内初选中，波普和前州长马尔科姆·R·帕特森是麦卡利斯特的主要对手。麦卡利斯特以9,570票的优势赢得初选，波普排名第二。

en.s: The 1932 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Henry H. Blood defeated Republican nominee William W. Seegmiller with 56.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 犹他州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人亨利·H·布拉德以56.39%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·W·西格米勒。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the nationwide presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states. Since the 1890s, Alabama had been effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1932年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，阿拉巴马州于11月8日举行投票，选出11名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。与其他州将选举人作为一组投票不同，阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选举每位选举人。自19世纪90年代以来，阿拉巴马州实际上一直由民主党一党执政。

en.s: The 1932 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. It saw the election of Democrat Thomas Donavan, who defeated incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Fred E. Sterling.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党人托马斯·多诺万当选，击败共和党籍时任副州长弗雷德·E·斯特林。

en.s: The 1932 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Governor George W. P. Hunt sought the Democratic nomination but lost in the primary to Benjamin Baker Moeur. Moeur's pre-gubernatorial experience included serving as the Secretary of the Board of Education for Arizona State Teachers College, which later became Arizona State University.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。时任州长乔治·W·P·亨特争取民主党提名，但在党内初选中败给本杰明·贝克·莫尔。莫尔此前曾担任亚利桑那州立师范学院教育委员会秘书；该校后来成为亚利桑那州立大学。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Arkansas was held on November 8, 1932, as part of the concurrent 1932 United States presidential election held throughout all forty-eight contemporary states. State voters chose nine electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. Except for the Unionist Ozark counties of Newton and Searcy where Republicans controlled local government, Arkansas since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic one-party Democratic “Solid South” state.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，阿肯色州于11月8日举行投票，和当时美国全部48个州同期参与。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。除纽顿县和瑟西县这两个由统一派控制地方政府的奥扎克山区县外，重建时期结束后，阿肯色州一直是民主党占主导地位的“南方民主党铁票仓”。

en.s: The 1932 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Paul V. McNutt defeated Republican nominee Raymond S. Springer with 55.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人保罗·V·麦克纳特以55.02%的得票率击败共和党候选人雷蒙德·S·斯普林格。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年科罗拉多州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。该州由州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福胜出。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年缅因州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出5名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Democratic nominee, the 44th Governor of New York, Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年怀俄明州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、纽约州第44任州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得怀俄明州。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Democratic nominee, former Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、前州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part, and state voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah, like every state west of the Appalachian Mountains, voted for Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，犹他州于11月8日举行投票。当时美国全部48个州都参加了选举，犹他州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。犹他州和阿巴拉契亚山脉以西的其他各州一样，把选票投给了富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1932 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932, and featured Democratic nominee Walter H. Jurgensen defeating the incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor, Republican Theodore W. Metcalfe, as part of a Democratic landslide in the state connected to Franklin D. Roosevelt's election as president.

zh.t: 1932年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1932年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人沃尔特·H·尤尔根森击败共和党籍时任副州长西奥多·W·梅特卡夫。当年民主党在该州大胜，这与富兰克林·D·罗斯福当选总统有关。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1932 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Roy McKittrick defeated Republican nominee Henry Depping and Socialist nominee Burl O. Hereford.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1932年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党候选人、密苏里州参议员罗伊·麦基特里克击败共和党候选人亨利·德平和社会党候选人伯尔·O·赫里福德。

en.t: 1932 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1932 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 73rd United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 8, 1932, while Maine held theirs on September 12. They coincided with the landslide election of President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

zh.s: 1932年美国举行联邦众议院选举，选出第73届国会众议员。大部分选举于1932年11月8日举行，缅因州则在9月12日举行。选举与富兰克林·D·罗斯福压倒性当选总统同期进行。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose 26 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was narrowly won by the Democratic Party candidate, Franklin D. Roosevelt, with 49.88% of the popular vote. The Republican Party candidate, President Herbert Hoover, garnered 47.03% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，俄亥俄州于11月8日举行投票，选出26名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福以49.88%的普选票险胜，共和党候选人、总统赫伯特·胡佛获得47.03%。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年马里兰州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得马里兰州。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the governor of New York Franklin D. Roosevelt and the speaker of the United States House of Representatives John Nance Garner defeated the Republican ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Herbert Hoover and the vice president of the United States Charles Curtis.

zh.t: 1932年美国印第安纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，印第安纳州于11月8日举行投票。纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳组成的民主党搭档，击败了在任总统赫伯特·胡佛与副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯组成的共和党搭档。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年爱达荷州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得爱达荷州。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Millard Tydings was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican Wallace Williams.

zh.t: 1932年美国马里兰州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 马里兰州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员米勒德·泰丁斯击败共和党候选人华莱士·威廉斯，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 8, 1932. Interim Democratic senator Cameron A. Morrison ran for election to a full term, but was defeated in the Democratic primary by Robert Rice Reynolds. Reynolds defeated Republican Jacob F. Newell in the general election.

zh.t: 1932年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党临时参议员卡梅伦·A·莫里森争取当选完整任期，但在民主党初选中败给罗伯特·赖斯·雷诺兹。雷诺兹随后在大选中击败共和党候选人雅各布·F·纽厄尔。

en.s: The 1932 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Farmer–Labor nominee Harry H. Peterson defeated Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Henry N. Benson, Democratic nominee Ray G. Moonan and Communist nominee Thomas Foley.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1932年11月8日举行州检察长选举。农工党候选人哈里·H·彼得森击败共和党候选人、时任州检察长亨利·N·本森、民主党候选人雷·G·穆南和共产党候选人托马斯·福利。

en.s: The 1932 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Frank Gaines Harris defeated Republican nominee James J. Barrett with 62.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1932年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人弗兰克·盖恩斯·哈里斯以62.13%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·J·巴雷特。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Senator George H. Moses ran for re-election to a third full term but was defeated by Democratic former governor Fred H. Brown. Although the state voted for incumbent Republicans Herbert Hoover and John G. Winant in the concurrent presidential election and gubernatorial election, respectively, Moses ran significantly behind the top of the ticket and was narrowly defeated by Brown.

zh.t: 1932年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员乔治·H·摩西争取连任第三个完整任期，但败给民主党候选人、前州长弗雷德·H·布朗。虽然新罕布什尔州在同期总统选举和州长选举中分别支持共和党籍时任总统赫伯特·胡佛和约翰·G·温纳特，摩西的表现却远不如同党总统候选人，最终以微弱差距败给布朗。

en.t: 1932 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1932 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 8, 1932, to elect the states At-large representative. This election coincided with the state's Governor election. Incumbent democrat Dennis Chávez won re-election by a landslide margin of 28 percentage points, slightly outperforming Franklin Roosevelt in the concurrent Presidential election by 1.1 percentage points.

zh.t: 1932年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1932年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州唯一的众议员席位。这次选举与该州州长选举同期举行。民主党籍时任众议员丹尼斯·查韦斯以28个百分点的优势大胜连任，其表现比同期总统选举中的富兰克林·罗斯福高出1.1个百分点。

en.s: The 1932 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Governor C. Douglass Buck ran for re-election to a second term. He unanimously won renomination at the Republican state convention. In the general election, Buck faced the Democratic nominee, Landreth L. Layton, the scion of a prominent family in Delaware politics. Despite the nationwide Democratic landslide, Republicans performed well in Delaware; Herbert Hoover narrowly won Delaware over Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年特拉华州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长C.道格拉斯·巴克竞选连任第二个任期。他在共和党州代表大会上全票获得提名。普选中，巴克面对民主党候选人兰德雷思·L·莱顿；莱顿出身于特拉华州政坛的显赫家族。尽管民主党在全国大获全胜，共和党仍在特拉华州表现不俗；赫伯特·胡佛以微弱优势击败富兰克林·D·罗斯福，赢得该州。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John J. Blaine ran for a second term in office but lost the Republican primary to John B. Chapple. In the general election, Chapple was defeated by F. Ryan Duffy.

zh.t: 1932年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·J·布莱恩争取连任第二个任期，但在共和党初选中败给约翰·B·查普尔。查普尔随后在大选中败给F·瑞安·达菲。

en.s: The 1932 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. In a rematch of the previous election, Democratic nominee William Comstock defeated incumbent Republican Wilber M. Brucker with 54.92% of the vote. Comstock was finally elected governor after his fourth consecutive nomination by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·康斯托克在与上次选举的再次交锋中，以54.92%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长威尔伯·M·布鲁克。康斯托克在连续第四次获民主党提名后，终于当选州长。

en.s: The 1932 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Theodore F. Green defeated incumbent Republican Norman S. Case with 55.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人西奥多·F·格林以55.20%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长诺曼·S·凯斯。

en.s: The 1932 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Arthur Seligman won reelection to a second term. This was the first gubernatorial election in which Rio Arriba County voted for a Democrat. Seligman was the last Democrat until Jack M. Campbell in 1964 to carry Mora County.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长阿瑟·塞利格曼成功连任，开始第二个任期。这是里奥阿里巴县首次在州长选举中支持民主党候选人。直到1964年杰克·M·坎贝尔获胜前，塞利格曼是最后一位赢得莫拉县的民主党人。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Otis F. Glenn was unseated by Democrat William H. Dieterich.

zh.t: 1932年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员奥蒂斯·F·格伦败给民主党候选人威廉·H·迪特里希，未能连任。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Senator and Senate Majority Leader James E. Watson ran for a third term in office, but was defeated by Frederick Van Nuys in a landslide. This marked the first time in history that a Senate leader lost re-election, and the only time they were a Republican.

zh.t: 1932年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 印第安纳州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员、参议院多数党领袖詹姆斯·E·沃森争取第三个任期，但在选举中惨败给弗雷德里克·范·努伊斯。这是参议院党派领袖首次在连任竞选中落败，也是唯一一次有共和党籍领袖遭此结果。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Outside a few Presidential and gubernatorial elections, Washington was a virtually one-party Republican state during the “System of 1896”, where the only competition was via Republican primaries.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，华盛顿州于11月8日举行投票，选出8名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。除少数总统选举和州长选举外，在“1896年体制”期间，华盛顿州实际上是共和党一党占主导的州，党内初选是唯一有竞争的选举。

en.s: The 1932 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Governor Philip La Follette was defeated in the Republican primary, and in the midst of the Great Depression and nationwide voter dissatisfaction with the Republican Party, Democratic nominee Albert G. Schmedeman defeated Republican nominee Walter J. Kohler Sr. and Socialist nominee Frank Metcalfe with 52.48% of the vote.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长菲利普·拉福莱特在党内初选中落败。大萧条期间，全国选民对共和党不满，民主党候选人阿尔伯特·G·施梅德曼以52.48%的得票率击败共和党候选人小沃尔特·J·科勒和社会党候选人弗兰克·梅特卡夫。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得西弗吉尼亚州。

en.s: The 1932 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democratic governor Joseph B. Ely was re-elected to a second term in office. This was the only election between 1910 and 1944 in which the Democratic candidate received a majority of the popular vote.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约瑟夫·B·伊利成功连任，开始第二个任期。1910年至1944年间，民主党候选人只有这次获得了过半普选票。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Senator Hiram Bingham III ran for a second full term in office but was defeated by Democratic U.S. Representative Augustine Lonergan. This was the first time since 1879 that Democrats won this Senate seat, and the first since 1881 that they won either seat.

zh.t: 1932年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员希勒姆·宾厄姆三世争取连任第二个完整任期，但败给民主党籍联邦众议员奥古斯丁·朗尼根。这是自1879年以来民主党首次赢得该参议员席位，也是自1881年以来首次赢得该州任一参议员席位。

en.s: The 1932 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democrat Wilbur Lucius Cross defeated Republican nominee John H. Trumbull with 48.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长威尔伯·卢修斯·克罗斯以48.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·H·特朗布尔。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1932 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee John C. B. Ehringhaus defeated Republican nominee Clifford C. Frazier with 70.07% of the vote. At the time, Ehringhaus was an attorney and former state legislator; Frazier was an attorney, based in Greensboro.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·C·B·厄林豪斯以70.07%的得票率击败共和党候选人克利福德·C·弗雷泽。当时，厄林豪斯是律师，曾任州议员；弗雷泽也是律师，常驻格林斯伯勒。

en.s: The 1932 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Clyde L. Herring defeated incumbent Republican Dan W. Turner with 52.77% of the vote.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人克莱德·L·赫林以52.77%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长丹·W·特纳。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Senator Hattie Caraway, who had been appointed to succeed her late husband Thaddeus H. Caraway in 1931 and won a special election to complete his term in January, ran for a full term in office. In winning, Caraway became the first woman ever elected to a full term in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1932年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿肯色州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员哈蒂·卡拉韦于1931年获任命，接替已故丈夫撒迪厄斯·H·卡拉韦；同年1月，她又在特别选举中获胜，完成丈夫的任期。她在本次选举中获胜，成为美国历史上首位通过选举获得完整任期的女性联邦参议员。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in California took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose 22 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Democratic challenger, New York Governor Franklin Roosevelt, in a landslide over the Republican incumbent, Herbert Hoover, carrying every county except Riverside.

zh.t: 1932年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，加利福尼亚州于11月8日举行投票，选出22名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州选民以压倒性优势支持民主党挑战者、纽约州州长富兰克林·罗斯福。除河滨县外，罗斯福赢得了所有县。

en.s: The 1932 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932, and featured incumbent Governor Charles W. Bryan, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, newspaper publisher and former state legislator Dwight Griswold, to win a third and final two-year, non-consecutive term in office.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长查尔斯·W·布赖恩击败共和党候选人德怀特·格里斯沃尔德，赢得第三个、也是最后一个非连续两年任期。格里斯沃尔德是报社出版人，曾任州议员。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was essentially a one-party Republican state during the Fourth Party System from 1896 to 1928, with the party winning almost every statewide election during the period.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，俄勒冈州于11月8日举行投票，选出5名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。1896年至1928年的第四政党体系时期，俄勒冈州基本上是共和党一党占主导的州；共和党在这段时期几乎赢得了所有全州选举。

en.s: The 1932 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932, to elect the governor of Texas. Democratic nominee and former governor of Texas Miriam A. Ferguson defeated Republican nominee Orville Bullington.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州长米丽娅姆·A·弗格森击败共和党候选人奥维尔·布灵顿。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 8, 1932, as part of the concurrent United States presidential election held in all 48 contemporary states. Florida voters chose seven electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the disfranchisement of blacks at the beginning of the 1890s, Florida had been a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1932年美国佛罗里达州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，佛罗里达州于11月8日举行投票，与当时美国全部48个州的总统选举同期进行。佛罗里达州选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。自19世纪90年代初非裔居民被剥夺选举权以来，佛罗里达州一直由民主党一党执政。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.s: 1932年特拉华州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。特拉华州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Louisiana voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1932年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，路易斯安那州于11月8日举行投票，选出10名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州一直由民主党主导，成为一党制州。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Kansas was held on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election held throughout all forty-eight contemporary states. State voters chose nine electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. Kansas had been a powerfully Republican state during the 1920s (as it had been during its first quarter-century of statehood), although it did not possess the isolationist sentiment found in Appalachia or the Upper Midwest.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，堪萨斯州于11月8日举行投票，与当时美国全部48个州的选举同期进行。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。堪萨斯州在20世纪20年代一直是共和党占优势的州，建州后的前25年也大致如此，但当地并没有阿巴拉契亚地区或美国中西部上部那样的孤立主义情绪。

en.s: The 1932 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Governor Warren Green ran for re-election to a second term. He defeated former Governor Carl Gunderson in the Republican primary and faced former State Representative Tom Berry, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Aided by Democratic presidential nominee Franklin D. Roosevelt's landslide victory in South Dakota, Berry defeated Green for re-election in a landslide.

zh.s: 南达科他州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长沃伦·格林争取连任第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击败前州长卡尔·冈德森，并在大选中对阵民主党候选人、前州众议员汤姆·贝里。民主党总统候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福在南达科他州大胜，为贝里助力；贝里也以压倒性优势击败格林。

en.s: The 1932 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Republican nominee William Langer defeated Democratic nominee Herbert C. DePuy with 54.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 北达科他州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·兰格以54.75%的得票率击败民主党候选人赫伯特·C·德普伊。

en.t: 1932 United States House of Representatives election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1932 United States House of Representatives election in Minnesota was held on November 8, 1932, to elect nine members of the U.S. House of Representatives from the state's at-large seats.

zh.t: 1932年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1932年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州全州范围内的9名联邦众议员。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate elections in Colorado
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate elections in Colorado took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles W. Waterman announced that he would not seek re-election to a second term. Attorney Karl C. Schuyler won the Republican nomination to succeed Waterman and faced former Senator Alva B. Adams, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. However, shortly before the primary elections took place, Waterman died in office.

zh.t: 1932年科罗拉多州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员查尔斯·W·沃特曼宣布不争取连任。律师卡尔·C·舒勒赢得共和党提名，将在大选中对阵民主党候选人、前参议员阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯。不过，初选举行前不久，沃特曼在任内去世。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Senator Smith Brookhart, a controversial progressive figure within the conservative Iowa Republican Party, was defeated in the June Republican primary by Henry A. Field. Field was in turn defeated in the general election by Democrat Louis Murphy. Brookhart also entered the general election as the candidate of the Progressive Party but finished a distant third.

zh.t: 1932年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员史密斯·布鲁克哈特是保守派共和党内部颇具争议的进步派人物，他在6月的共和党初选中败给亨利·A·菲尔德。菲尔德随后在大选中败给民主党人路易斯·墨菲。布鲁克哈特也以进步党候选人身份参加大选，但远远落后，排名第三。

en.s: The 1932 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1932, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Dwight H. Brown defeated Republican nominee and former State Treasurer of Missouri Lorenzo Dow Thompson, Socialist nominee George A. Kovaka, Communist nominee Frank Brown and Socialist Labor nominee Roland Plato.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1932年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党候选人德怀特·H·布朗击败共和党候选人、前密苏里州财政部长洛伦佐·道·汤普森、社会党候选人乔治·A·科瓦卡、共产党候选人弗兰克·布朗和社会主义工党候选人罗兰·普拉托。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate elections in Arizona took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Hayden ran for reelection to a second term, again defeating his 1926 challenger former U.S. Senator Ralph H. Cameron in the general election. Hayden, then U.S. Congressman for Arizona's at-large Congressional district, was elected to his first term in 1926 when he defeated the incumbent Cameron, and would be successfully reelected to his second term in a rematch in 1932, by a wide margin.

zh.t: 1932年亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员卡尔·海登争取连任第二个任期，在大选中再次击败1926年的对手、前参议员拉尔夫·H·卡梅伦。海登于1926年担任亚利桑那州联邦众议员时首次当选参议员，击败了当时在任的卡梅伦；1932年两人再次交锋，海登以较大优势成功连任。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democratic senator Elmer Thomas ran for re-election to a second term. Thomas faced a crowded path to renomination, and only won the Democratic primary following a runoff election with attorney Gomer Smith. On the Republican side, oil magnate Wirt Franklin similarly won the Republican nomination in a runoff election.

zh.t: 1932年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1932年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员埃尔默·托马斯争取连任第二个任期。党内提名竞争激烈，他在与律师戈默·史密斯进行的决选中获胜，才拿到民主党提名。共和党方面，石油大亨沃特·富兰克林也在决选中赢得提名。

en.s: The 1932 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Democrat George White defeated Republican nominee David Sinton Ingalls with 52.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1932年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长乔治·怀特以52.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人大卫·辛顿·英格尔斯。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年康涅狄格州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose 19 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by the Democratic candidate Franklin D. Roosevelt, who defeated incumbent Republican Herbert Hoover, receiving 52.36% of the popular vote and the state's 19 electoral votes.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，密歇根州于11月8日举行投票，选出19名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败共和党籍时任总统赫伯特·胡佛，赢得密歇根州。罗斯福获得52.36%的普选票和该州全部19张选举人票。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican Senator Peter Norbeck ran for re-election to a third term. After easily turning back a challenge from former State Senator Harry F. Brownell in the Republican primary, Norbeck faced attorney Ulysses Simpson Grant Cherry, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Owing in part to Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1932年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任参议员彼得·诺贝克竞选连任第三个任期。他在共和党初选中轻松击退前州参议员哈里·F·布朗内尔的挑战，随后在普选中对阵民主党候选人、律师尤利西斯·辛普森·格兰特·切里。部分原因是富兰克林·D·罗斯福在南达科他州大获全胜，参议员选举竞争比1926年更加激烈；但诺贝克仍以明显优势击败切里，赢得第三个、也是最后一个任期。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by Governor of New York Franklin D.

zh.t: 1932年亚利桑那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1932年亚利桑那州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福以民主党候选人身份赢得亚利桑那州。

en.s: The 1932 Wyoming gubernatorial special election took place on November 8, 1932. Just several weeks into his second term, Republican governor Frank Emerson died in office. Secretary of State Alonzo M. Clark ascended to the governorship, and a special election was called for 1932. Clark ran for re-election, but was defeated in the Republican primary by State Treasurer Harry R. Weston. Meanwhile, former state senator Leslie A.

zh.s: 1932年怀俄明州州长特别选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍州长弗兰克·埃默森第二个任期刚开始几周便在任内去世。州务卿阿朗佐·M·克拉克接任州长，随后州内决定举行特别选举。克拉克竞选连任，但在共和党初选中败给州财政部长哈里·R·韦斯顿。与此同时，前州参议员莱斯利·A·米勒曾在1930年代表民主党挑战埃默森但未当选；这次他再次竞选州长，并赢得民主党初选。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 23 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, over the Republican nominee, incumbent President Herbert Hoover of California.

zh.t: 1932年美国得克萨斯州总统选举
zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，得克萨斯州于11月8日举行投票，与当时美国全部48个州的选举同期进行。该州选民选出23名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。得克萨斯州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统赫伯特·胡佛。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Speaker John Nance Garner, with 63.39 percent of the popular vote, against incumbent President Herbert Hoover (R–California), running with Vice President Charles Curtis, with 35.08 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1932年美国总统选举期间，密苏里州于11月8日举行投票，选出15名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。纽约州州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福与众议院议长约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，获得63.39%的普选票，赢得密苏里州；在任总统、加利福尼亚州共和党人赫伯特·胡佛与副总统查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，获得35.08%。

en.s: The 1932 New York state election was held on November 8, 1932, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the chief judge, a U.S. senator and two U.S. representatives-at-large, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate. Incumbent Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt did not seek reelection, and instead successfully ran for President.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，纽约州举行选举，改选州长、副州长、州财务主管、总检察长、州上诉法院首席法官、一名联邦参议员、两名全州选出的联邦众议员，以及州众议院和州参议院全部议员。时任州长富兰克林·D·罗斯福没有竞选连任，转而竞选总统并获胜。

en.t: 1932 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1932 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 8, 1932, as part of the 1932 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，佐治亚州举行美国总统选举投票。选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，除北部少数历来支持联邦的县外，佐治亚州一直是民主党占主导地位的州；这些例外主要包括范宁县，也包括皮肯斯、吉尔默和汤斯县。

en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 8, 1932. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wesley Livsey Jones ran for a fifth term in office, but was defeated by former State Representative Homer Bone. Bone defeated Jones in a landslide. The percentage margin of 27.9 points may be the largest for any incumbent major-party nominee in Senate history.

zh.t: 1932年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1932年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党参议员韦斯利·利夫赛·琼斯竞选第五个任期，但败给了前州众议员霍默·博恩。博恩以压倒性优势击败琼斯，领先27.9个百分点，这可能是美国参议院历史上大党现任候选人败选的最大差距。

en.s: The 1932 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1932. Democratic nominee Clarence D. Martin defeated Republican nominee John Arthur Gellatly with 57.29% of the vote. Martin was the first Democrat elected governor of Washington with an absolute majority. He was also the first Democratic gubernatorial candidate in Washington to ever win Pacific County and San Juan County and the first since 1892 to win Jefferson County.

zh.s: 1932年华盛顿州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人克拉伦斯·D.马丁以57.29%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·阿瑟·盖拉特利。马丁是首位以绝对多数票当选华盛顿州州长的民主党人。他也是首位赢得太平洋县和圣胡安县的民主党州长候选人，并且是自1892年以来首位赢得杰斐逊县的民主党州长候选人。

en.s: The 1932 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1932 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 30 of the Iowa Senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in Iowa. A statewide map of the 50 state senate districts in the 1932 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，美国艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，选民在50个选区中的30个选区选出州参议员。该州参议员每届任期四年。

en.s: The 1932 United States Senate elections coincided with the Democrat Franklin D. Roosevelt's landslide victory over the incumbent Herbert Hoover in the presidential election. The 32 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，美国举行参议院选举，第三组32个席位定期改选，部分空缺席位也举行特别选举。同日的总统选举中，民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福以明显优势击败争取连任的赫伯特·胡佛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1932 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Incumbent Democrat C. Ben Ross defeated Republican nominee Byron Defenbach with 61.73% of the vote.

zh.s: 1932年11月8日，爱达荷州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长C·本·罗斯以61.73%的得票率击败共和党候选人拜伦·德芬巴赫，赢得连任。

en.t: 1932 New York City special mayoral election
en.s: The 1932 New York City special mayoral election was held on November 8. It was triggered by the resignation of incumbent Democratic Mayor Jimmy Walker on September 1, after his administration had become embroiled in scandal. Democratic nominee John P. O'Brien easily defeated Republican Lewis H. Pounds and Socialist Morris Hillquit. Acting Mayor Joseph V. McKee also featured as a write-in candidate.

zh.s: 1932年纽约市市长特别选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党市长吉米·沃克于9月1日辞职，此前其政府卷入丑闻，因而触发特别选举。民主党候选人约翰·P.奥布莱恩轻松击败共和党人刘易斯·H.庞兹和社会党人莫里斯·希尔奎特。代理市长约瑟夫·V.麦基也以写入候选人的方式参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 8, 1936. Florida voters chose seven electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the disfranchisement of blacks at the beginning of the 1890s, Florida had been a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1936年美国佛罗里达州总统选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1936年11月8日举行总统选举，选出7名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。自19世纪90年代初非裔居民被剥夺选举权以来，佛罗里达州一直由民主党一党执政。

en.s: The siege of Madrid was a two-and-a-half-year siege of the Republican-controlled Spanish capital city of Madrid by the Nationalist armies, under General Francisco Franco, during the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939). The city, besieged from October 1936, fell to the Nationalist armies on 28 March 1939. The Battle of Madrid in November 1936 saw the most intense fighting in and around the city when the Nationalists made their most determined attempt to take the Republican capital.
en.n: Spanish Civil War: Francoist troops fail in their effort to capture Madrid, but begin the three-year Siege of Madrid afterwards.

zh.s: 马德里围城战是西班牙内战（1936—1939）期间，弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军领导的民族主义军队对共和派控制的首都马德里实施的两年半围城。围城始于1936年10月，城市于1939年3月28日被民族主义军队攻陷。1936年11月的马德里战役是城内及周边战斗最激烈的阶段，当时民族主义军队最坚决地试图夺取共和派首都。
zh.n: 西班牙内战期间，佛朗哥派军队未能攻占马德里，但随后开始对该城进行长达三年的围困。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: The Eternal Jew (German: Der ewige Jude) was an exhibition of antisemitism displayed at the Library of the German Museum in Munich from 8 November 1937 to 31 January 1938. The displays, with photographs and caricatures, focused on antisemitic canards falsely accusing Jews of negatively affecting Nazi Germany through Cultural Bolshevism, exemplified in the exhibition poster presenting a kaftan-wearing "eastern" Jew holding gold coins in one hand and a whip in the other.

zh.s: 《永恒的犹太人》（德语：Der ewige Jude）是一场反犹主义展览，于1937年11月8日至1938年1月31日在慕尼黑德国博物馆图书馆展出。展览使用照片和漫画，宣扬反犹主义谎言，诬称犹太人通过“文化布尔什维主义”等方式损害纳粹德国。展览海报上，一个穿着长袍的“东方”犹太人一手拿着金币，另一手拿着鞭子。

en.s: The Battle of Sabiñánigo took place during the Spanish Civil War near Alto Gállego and the town of Sabiñánigo in 1937 as part of the Aragon front. As part of the Republican strategy, the 43rd and 27th divisions moved to the north, amounting to about 14,000 men and 16 pieces of artillery under the command of Mariano Bueno.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨比尼亚尼戈战役发生在1937年西班牙内战期间，地点在阿拉贡战线的上加列戈地区和萨比尼亚尼戈镇附近。共和军按作战计划向北调动第43和第27师，约有1.4万人和16门火炮，由马里亚诺·布埃诺指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1938 was held on November 8, 1938.

zh.s: 1938年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。
