en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1938
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1938. Republican Ernest W. Gibson, Sr. successfully ran for re-election to another term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic candidate John Mcgrath. Gibson, Sr. died in June 1940 and his son, Ernest W. Gibson, Jr., was appointed to fill the seat until a special election could be held in November 1940.

zh.t: 1938年佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1938年佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。共和党人欧内斯特·W·吉布森成功连任。民主党候选人约翰·麦格拉思败选。吉布森于1940年6月去世，其子欧内斯特·W·吉布森二世获任命接替他，直到1940年11月举行特别选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1938 took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican George Aiken ran successfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Democratic candidate Fred C. Martin.

zh.s: 1938年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任共和党州长乔治·艾肯成功连任，开启第二个任期，击败民主党候选人弗雷德·C·马丁。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Elections for the Second National Assembly were held on November 8, 1938, under a new law that allowed block voting which favored the governing Nacionalista Party (which the Democratica and the Pro-Independencia factions reconciled). As expected all the 98 seats of the National Assembly went to the Nacionalistas. Jose Yulo who was Quezon's Secretary of Justice from 1934 to 1938, was elected Speaker.

zh.s: 第二届国民议会选举于1938年11月8日举行。新法允许选民对政党名单整体投票，使执政的国民党受益；民主党派和独立派也与其合流。选举结果如预期，国民党赢得国民议会全部98个席位。何塞·尤洛曾在1934至1938年担任奎松的司法部长，此次当选议长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1938 occurred on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic governor George Howard Earle III was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate Arthur James defeated Democratic candidate Charles Alvin Jones to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1938年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任民主党州长乔治·霍华德·厄尔三世没有竞选连任。共和党候选人阿瑟·詹姆斯击败民主党候选人查尔斯·阿尔文·琼斯，当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1938 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Harold Stassen defeated Farmer–Labor Party incumbent Elmer Benson.

zh.s: 1938年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月8日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人哈罗德·斯塔森击败农民—劳工党籍的时任州长埃尔默·本森。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1938
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James J. Davis successfully sought re-election, defeating Democratic nominee George Howard Earle III.

zh.t: 1938年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1938年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。时任共和党参议员詹姆斯·J·戴维斯成功连任，击败民主党提名人乔治·霍华德·厄尔三世。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1938, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 8, 1938. Elections took place on September 12 in Maine. Governor Herbert H. Lehman was only able to win reelection due to the votes he received on the American Labor Party's ballot line. In New York, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term.

zh.s: 美国于1938年11月8日在33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。缅因州的选举于9月12日举行。纽约州州长赫伯特·H·雷曼依靠美国劳工党选票行列的支持才成功连任。纽约州州长任期也首次改为四年，此前为两年。

en.s: The 1938 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and former Secretary of the State of Connecticut Francis A. Pallotti defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent acting Attorney General Charles J. McLaughlin and Socialist nominee Harry Schwartz.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1938年11月8日举行州检察长选举。共和党候选人、前州务卿弗朗西斯·A·帕洛蒂击败民主党候选人、时任代理检察长查尔斯·J·麦克劳克林和社会党候选人哈里·施瓦茨。

en.s: The 1938 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Progressive Governor Philip La Follette was defeated by Republican nominee Julius P. Heil. Primary elections were held on September 20, 1938.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。进步党籍时任州长菲利普·拉福莱特败给共和党候选人朱利叶斯·P·海尔。党内初选于1938年9月20日举行。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Elmer Thomas ran for re-election to a third term. He faced a spirited challenge in the Democratic primary from Congressman Gomer Smith and Governor E. W. Marland, but won the nomination with a slim plurality. In the general election, Thomas faced former State Senator Harry O.

zh.t: 1938年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1938年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任参议员埃尔默·托马斯竞选连任第三个任期。他在民主党初选中遭到众议员戈默·史密斯和州长E. W. 马兰德的激烈挑战，但仍以微弱优势赢得提名。普选中，托马斯面对共和党候选人、前州参议员哈里·O·格拉瑟。

en.s: The 1938 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic governor Gordon Browning lost his re-election bid in the primary and was defeated by Democratic nominee Prentice Cooper. In the general election, Cooper defeated Republican nominee Howard Baker Sr. with 71.7% of the vote.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长戈登·布朗宁在党内初选中争取连任失败，败给民主党候选人普伦蒂斯·库珀。库珀随后在大选中以71.7%的得票率击败共和党候选人霍华德·贝克 Sr.。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Senator Augustine Lonergan ran for a second term in office but was defeated by Republican John A. Danaher. Socialist candidate Bellani Trombley placed a strong third, possibly aided by the coattails of Jasper McLevy's competitive campaign for Governor and dissatisfaction with Lonergan by organized labor in the state.

zh.t: 1938年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员奥古斯丁·朗尼根争取连任第二个任期，但败给共和党人约翰·A·丹纳赫。社会党候选人贝拉尼·特朗普利名列第三，表现突出；这可能得益于杰斯珀·麦克利维竞争力强的州长竞选，以及州内工会对朗尼根的不满。

en.s: The 1938 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee Raymond E. Baldwin defeated Democratic incumbent Wilbur Lucius Cross with 36.43% of the vote.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人雷蒙德·E·鲍德温以36.43%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长威尔伯·卢修斯·克罗斯。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator George McGill ran for re-election to his second full term. Former Governor Clyde M. Reed won the Republican nomination to face McGill in a crowded field and ended up defeating him in a landslide, winning 56% of the vote in a year of nationwide Republican gains.

zh.t: 1938年堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员乔治·麦吉尔争取连任第二个完整任期。前州长克莱德·M·里德在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，随后以压倒性优势击败麦吉尔，获得56%的选票；当年共和党在全国选举中也有所斩获。

en.s: The 1938 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Governor Leslie A. Miller ran for re-election to his third term, and his second full term. Nels H. Smith, a former State Representative and former state highway commissioner, won a crowded Republican primary and advanced to the general election against Miller.

zh.s: 怀俄明州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长莱斯利·A·米勒争取第三个任期，这也是他的第二个完整任期。前州众议员、前州公路专员内尔斯·H·史密斯在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，进入大选与米勒对决。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican Senator Gerald Nye ran for re-election to his third term. He faced a strong challenge in the Republican primary from colorful Governor William Langer, but narrowly won renomination. Langer subsequently ran as an independent against Nye in the general election, and won the endorsement of the Nonpartisan League.

zh.t: 1938年北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 北达科他州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员杰拉尔德·奈伊争取连任第三个任期。在共和党初选中，他面临州长威廉·兰格这位风格鲜明的强劲对手，但最终以微弱优势赢得提名。兰格随后以独立候选人身份在大选中挑战奈伊，并获得无党派联盟的支持。

en.s: The 1938 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938, to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent Bibb Graves was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长比布·格雷夫斯受任期限制，不能连续竞选第二个任期。

en.s: The 1938 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 1938, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1938年11月8日（星期二）举行州参议院选举，选出35名任期四年的参议员。选举沿用1901年《阿拉巴马州宪法》划定的选区。由于民主党在州内占主导地位，州议会席位通常在民主党初选中就已决定。

en.s: The 1938 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the Governor of Arkansas. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Arkansas Carl E. Bailey defeated Republican nominee Charles F. Cole.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长卡尔·E·贝利击败共和党候选人查尔斯·F·科尔。

en.s: The 1938 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Democratic nominee John Moses defeated Republican nominee John N. Hagan with 52.47% of the vote.

zh.s: 北达科他州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·摩西以52.47%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·N·哈根。

en.s: The 1938 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Leon 'Red' Phillips defeated Republican former State Senator Ross Rizley. Also on the ballot were John Wesley Lanham of the Prohibition Party and Independent John Franing.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党人利昂“红色”菲利普斯击败共和党候选人、前州参议员罗斯·里兹利。禁酒党候选人约翰·韦斯利·兰厄姆和独立候选人约翰·弗雷宁也参加了选举。

en.s: The 1938 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Paul A. Rasmussen and Democratic nominee Hugh T. Kennedy.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1938年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人保罗·A·拉斯穆森和民主党候选人休·T·肯尼迪。

en.s: The 1938 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. In a rematch of the previous election, Republican nominee Frank Fitzgerald this time defeated incumbent Democratic Frank Murphy with 52.78% of the vote. This was the fourth of six consecutive gubernatorial elections in Michigan in which the incumbent party was defeated.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。这是上次选举的再次交锋，共和党候选人弗兰克·菲茨杰拉德这次以52.78%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长弗兰克·墨菲。这是密歇根州连续六次州长选举中的第四次，时任州长所属政党未能保住席位。

en.s: The 1938 California Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican Alameda County District Attorney Earl Warren defeated Democratic write-in candidate Carl S. Kegley and Townsend Party nominee Walter Emmett Barry with 66.16% of the vote.

zh.t: 1938年加利福尼亚州检察长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于1938年11月8日举行州检察长选举。共和党候选人、阿拉米达县地方检察官厄尔·沃伦以66.16%的得票率击败民主党写入式候选人卡尔·S·凯格利和汤森德党候选人沃尔特·埃米特·巴里。

en.s: The 1938 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial elections were both held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Walter H. Jurgensen was convicted of a felony in March 1938 and barred from running for a fourth term as lieutenant governor in June, 1938, leaving the 1938 lieutenant gubernatorial race wide open.

zh.t: 1938年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1938年11月8日举行了两场副州长选举。时任副州长沃尔特·H·尤尔根森于1938年3月被判重罪，6月又被禁止争取第四个副州长任期，因此当年的副州长选举竞争激烈，席位空缺。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator F. Ryan Duffy ran for a second term in office. In a three-way race, Alexander Wiley defeated Duffy and Lieutenant Governor Herman L. Ekern. Primary elections were held on September 20. Senator Duffy was unopposed for the Democratic nomination. The Republican primary was a rematch of the 1936 gubernatorial primary; Wiley defeated John B.

zh.t: 1938年威斯康星州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1938年威斯康星州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员F. Ryan Duffy竞选连任第二个任期。在三方竞争中，亚历山大·威利击败达菲和副州长赫尔曼·L·埃克恩。初选于9月20日举行。达菲在民主党初选中没有对手。共和党初选是1936年州长初选的重赛；威利击败了约翰·B·查普尔。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate special election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate special election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1938, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The special election came upon the death of incumbent Democratic Senator Nathan L. Bachman who had died in office. Democratic Governor Gordon Browning appointed George L.

zh.t: 1938年田纳西州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1938年田纳西州美国参议院特别选举于11月8日举行，与其他联邦参议院选举、众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员内森·L·巴克曼在任内去世，因此举行此次特别选举。民主党籍州长戈登·布朗宁任命乔治·L·贝里接任。

en.s: The 1938 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican Governor Leslie Jensen declined to seek re-election and instead unsuccessfully ran for the U.S. Senate. Harlan J. Bushfield, the former chairman of the South Dakota Republican Party, won the Republican primary to succeed Jensen. In the general election, he faced Democratic nominee Oscar Fosheim, a state representative from Miner County, in the general election.

zh.s: 1938年南达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长莱斯利·詹森没有寻求连任，而是转而竞选联邦参议员，但未能当选。前南达科他州共和党主席哈兰·J·布什菲尔德在共和党初选中胜出，成为詹森的接替人选。普选中，他面对民主党候选人奥斯卡·福斯海姆；福斯海姆是米纳县的州众议员。

en.s: The 1938 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Former governor James Michael Curley defeated incumbent governor Charles F. Hurley in the Democratic primary, but Curley was defeated by former Speaker of the Massachusetts House of Representatives Leverett Saltonstall in the general election. Saltonstall's victory returned control of Beacon Hill to the Republicans after an unprecedented eight years of Democratic governors.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。前州长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利在民主党初选中击败时任州长查尔斯·F·赫利，但在大选中败给马萨诸塞州众议院前议长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔。索尔顿斯托尔获胜后，共和党重新掌控灯塔山，这是民主党州长连续执政八年后首次发生这种情况。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Guy M. Gillette, who won a special election to complete the unexpired term of Richard Louis Murphy, won a full term in office by defeating Republican former Senator Lester J. Dickinson. Gillette and Dickinson had briefly served together in the final months of 1936. Primary elections were held on June 6.

zh.t: 1938年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员盖伊·M·吉列特曾在特别选举中获胜，完成理查德·路易斯·墨菲未满的任期；本次选举中，他击败共和党前参议员莱斯特·J·迪金森，赢得完整任期。吉列特和迪金森曾在1936年最后几个月短暂同为参议员。党内初选于6月6日举行。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent first-term Democrat William H. Dieterich retired. Fellow Democrat Scott W. Lucas was elected to succeed him.

zh.t: 1938年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍首届任期参议员威廉·H·迪特里希退休，同党人士斯科特·W·卢卡斯当选接替他。

en.s: The 1938 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee Payne Ratner defeated Democratic incumbent Walter A. Huxman with 52.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人佩恩·拉特纳以52.10%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长沃尔特·A·赫克斯曼。

en.s: The 1938 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Democratic nominee Herbert O'Conor defeated incumbent Republican Harry Nice with 54.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人赫伯特·奥康纳以54.62%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长哈里·尼斯。

en.s: The 1938 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Governor Rawghlie Clement Stanford declined to run for reelection, with pharmacy and cattle ranch owner Robert Taylor Jones winning the Democratic nomination to succeed Stanford. Robert Taylor Jones defeated Jerrie W. Lee in the general election, and was sworn into his first and only term as Governor on January 2, 1939, becoming Arizona's sixth Governor.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。时任州长罗利·克莱门特·斯坦福没有争取连任，药剂师兼牧场主罗伯特·泰勒·琼斯赢得民主党提名接替他。琼斯在大选中击败杰里·W·李，于1939年1月2日宣誓就职，开始其唯一一个州长任期，并成为亚利桑那州第六任州长。

en.s: The 1938 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Democratic Assemblyman Ellis E. Patterson defeated Republican physician Walter Scott Franklin with 50.73% of the vote.

zh.t: 1938年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于1938年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党籍州众议员埃利斯·E·帕特森以50.73%的得票率击败共和党候选人、医生沃尔特·斯科特·富兰克林。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Senator Hattie Caraway ran for a second term in office. After narrowly defeating U.S. Representative John Little McClellan in the Democratic primary, she easily won the general election over Republican C.D. Atkinson. McClellan would later be elected at the other Senate seat in 1942 and served with Caraway until 1945.

zh.t: 1938年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿肯色州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员哈蒂·卡拉韦争取连任第二个任期。她在民主党初选中以微弱优势击败联邦众议员约翰·利特尔·麦克莱伦，随后在大选中轻松击败共和党候选人C·D·阿特金森。麦克莱伦后来于1942年当选该州另一个参议员席位，并与卡拉韦共事至1945年。

en.s: The 1938 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Farmer–Labor nominee John T. Lyons and Democratic nominee J.B. Bonner.

zh.t: 1938年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1938年11月8日举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任州审计长斯塔福德·金击败农工党候选人约翰·T·莱昂斯和民主党候选人J·B·邦纳。

en.s: The 1938 California Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican Frank C. Jordan won both the Democratic and Republican primaries, and easily defeated Communist nominee Leo Gallagher and Prohibitionist nominee Nellie S. Harriss in the general election with 90.34% of the vote.

zh.t: 1938年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于1938年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党籍时任州务卿弗兰克·C·乔丹同时赢得民主党和共和党的初选，随后在大选中以90.34%的得票率轻松击败共产党候选人利奥·加拉格尔和禁酒党候选人内莉·S·哈里斯。

en.s: The 1938 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee William C. Walsh defeated Republican nominee Leo Weinberg and Labor nominee Morris Levitt.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1938年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党候选人威廉·C·沃尔什击败共和党候选人利奥·温伯格和劳工党候选人莫里斯·莱维特。

en.s: The 1938 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Clyde Tingley was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长克莱德·廷格利受任期限制，不能争取连续第三个任期。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Senator Robert J. Bulkley ran for re-election to a second full term in office, but was defeated by the Republican nominee, former state Senator Robert A. Taft, the elder son of former President and supreme court chief justice William Howard Taft.

zh.t: 1938年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员罗伯特·J·布尔克利争取连任第二个完整任期，但败给共和党候选人、前州参议员罗伯特·A·塔夫脱。塔夫脱是前总统、最高法院首席大法官威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱的长子。

en.s: The 1938 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate C. Elmer Anderson defeated Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party challenger John J. Kinzer and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Ray M. Lang.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1938年11月8日举行副州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人C·埃尔默·安德森击败明尼苏达州农工党候选人约翰·J·金泽和明尼苏达州民主党候选人雷·M·兰。

en.s: The 1938 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1938. In the election for governor of Oregon, Republican nominee Charles A. Sprague defeated Democratic nominee Henry L. Hess. Incumbent governor Charles Martin lost in the Democratic primary to Hess, an attorney and former state senator from La Grande. Hess was a strong supporter of President Franklin Delano Roosevelt's New Deal while Martin was a frequent critic of the program.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人查尔斯·A·斯普拉格击败民主党候选人亨利·L·赫斯。当时的州长查尔斯·马丁在民主党初选中败给赫斯。赫斯是律师，曾任州参议员，来自拉格兰德；他大力支持富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统的新政，而马丁则经常批评这项政策。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Alva B. Adams ran for re-election to a second term. Adams faced Denver attorney Archibald A. Lee, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Despite the nationwide Republican landslide, including Republicans' landslide victory in the gubernatorial election that year, Adams's popularity translated into an easy re-election campaign.

zh.t: 1938年科罗拉多州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯争取连任第二个任期。他在大选中对阵共和党候选人、丹佛律师阿奇博尔德·A·李。尽管共和党在全国选举中大胜，并在当年的州长选举中也取得压倒性胜利，亚当斯仍凭借人气轻松连任。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Frederick Van Nuys was narrowly re-elected to a second term in office over Raymond E. Willis by a margin of 5,197 votes out of over 1.5 million cast.

zh.t: 1938年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 印第安纳州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员弗雷德里克·范·努伊斯以微弱优势连任第二个任期。他以5,197票之差击败雷蒙德·E·威利，选举总票数超过150万。

en.s: The 1938 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee John W. Bricker defeated Democratic nominee Charles W. Sawyer with 52.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·W·布里克以52.45%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·W·索耶。

en.s: The 1938 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Democratic politician W. Lee O'Daniel defeated Republican nominee Alexander Boynton with 96.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党政治人物W·李·奥丹尼尔以96.84%的得票率击败共和党候选人亚历山大·博因顿。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 8, 1938. Primaries were held April 12, 1938.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1938年11月8日（星期二）举行选举。党内初选于1938年4月12日举行。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Millard Tydings was re-elected to a third term in office, easily defeating Republican Oscar Leser. Primary elections were held on September 12. Millard Tydings faced a primary challenge from U.S. Representative David John Lewis, who was backed by President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1938年马里兰州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1938年马里兰州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员米勒德·泰丁斯成功连任，开始第三个任期，并轻松击败共和党候选人奥斯卡·莱瑟。初选于9月12日举行。泰丁斯在党内遭到联邦众议员戴维·约翰·刘易斯挑战；刘易斯得到总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福支持，参与总统清除民主党保守派的行动。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate elections in South Dakota
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate elections in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican Senator Peter Norbeck died in office on December 20, 1936. Herbert E. Hitchcock was appointed by Governor Tom Berry as Norbeck's replacement. Two elections for the same Senate seat were held on the same day; one as a special election to fill the remainder of Norbeck's six-year term, and another to select a Senator to serve the next six-year term.

zh.t: 1938年南达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 南达科他州于1938年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员彼得·诺贝克于1936年12月20日在任内去世。州长汤姆·贝里任命赫伯特·E·希区柯克接替他。同一天举行了两场针对同一参议员席位的选举：一场特别选举，用来填补诺贝克六年任期剩余的部分；另一场则选出下一届六年任期的参议员。

en.s: The 1938 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee J. Millard Tawes defeated Republican nominee William G. Jack, Union nominee James O. Harrison, Socialist nominee William T. Elder, Labor nominee Etta Gibson and Communist nominee Needham Horton.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1938年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人J·米勒德·托斯击败共和党候选人威廉·G·杰克、统一党候选人詹姆斯·O·哈里森、社会党候选人威廉·T·埃尔德、劳工党候选人埃塔·吉布森和共产党候选人尼德姆·霍顿。

en.s: The 1938 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee William Henry Vanderbilt III defeated Democratic incumbent Robert E. Quinn with 54.17% of the vote. This was the last time until 1958 a Republican was elected Governor of Rhode Island.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·亨利·范德比尔特三世以54.17%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长罗伯特·E·奎因。这是共和党人直到1958年才再次当选罗得岛州州长。

en.s: The 1938 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Democratic nominee Edward P. Carville defeated Republican nominee John A. Fulton with 61.86% of the vote.

zh.s: 内华达州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人爱德华·P·卡维尔以61.86%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·A·富尔顿。

en.s: The 1938 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee George A. Wilson defeated Democratic incumbent Nelson G. Kraschel with 52.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人乔治·A·威尔逊以52.71%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长纳尔逊·G·克拉舍尔。

en.s: The 1938 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938, and featured incumbent Governor Robert L. Cochran, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, Speaker of the state legislature Charles J. Warner, as well as former Democratic Governor Charles W. Bryan, who ran as an Independent, to win a third and final two-year term in office.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长罗伯特·L·科克伦击败共和党候选人、州议会议长查尔斯·J·华纳，以及以独立候选人身份参选的前民主党州长查尔斯·W·布赖恩，赢得第三个、也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The 1938 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Republican nominee Ralph Lawrence Carr defeated Democratic incumbent Teller Ammons with 59.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人拉尔夫·劳伦斯·卡尔以59.50%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长特勒·阿蒙斯。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate special election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate special election of 1938 in New Jersey was held on November 8, 1938. The vacancy was created when incumbent Senator A. Harry Moore resigned to become Governor of New Jersey. Interim appointee John Gerald Milton did not run in the election. Former Republican U.S. Senator William Warren Barbour returned to the Senate after defeating Democrat William H. J.

zh.t: 1938年新泽西州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1938年新泽西州美国参议院特别选举于11月8日举行。现任参议员A. Harry Moore辞职出任新泽西州州长，因此出现席位空缺。临时接任的John Gerald Milton没有参加此次选举。曾任共和党籍联邦参议员的William Warren Barbour重返参议院，击败民主党候选人William H. J. Ely当选。

en.s: The 1938 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1938, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former governor of Minnesota Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent acting attorney general William S. Ervin and Democratic nominee John D. Sullivan.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1938年11月8日举行州检察长选举。共和党候选人、前州长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败农工党候选人、时任代理检察长威廉·S·欧文和民主党候选人约翰·D·沙利文。

en.t: 1938 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1938 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 8, 1938 to elect the state's at-large member to serve in the United States House of Representatives in the 76th United States Congress. This election coincided with other state and local offices such as the Governor election. John Dempsey ran for re-election to a third term and won by 16.97 percentage points.

zh.t: 1938年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1938年11月8日（星期二）举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州全州范围内的众议员，代表新墨西哥州出席第76届国会。选举与该州州长等州和地方职位的选举同期举行。约翰·登普西争取第三个任期，并以16.97个百分点的优势获胜。

en.s: The 1938 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Republican Francis P. Murphy defeated Democratic nominee John L. Sullivan with 57.08% of the vote.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1938年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长弗朗西斯·P·墨菲以57.08%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·L·沙利文。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate special election in New York
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate special election in New York was held on November 8, 1938, to complete the unexpired term of Senator Royal S. Copeland, who died in office on June 17, 1938. U.S. Representative James M. Mead of Buffalo defeated Edward F. Corsi to win the seat.

zh.t: 1938年纽约州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1938年纽约州美国参议院特别选举于11月8日举行，以完成参议员罗亚尔·S.科普兰的未满任期。科普兰于1938年6月17日在任内去世。纽约州美国众议员、布法罗人詹姆斯·M.米德击败爱德华·F.科西，当选参议员。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1938 in New York was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert F. Wagner was re-elected to a third term over Republican John Lord O'Brian.

zh.s: 1938年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党参议员罗伯特·F.瓦格纳击败共和党人约翰·洛德·奥布赖恩，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 8, 1938. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Homer Bone was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Ewing D. Colvin.

zh.t: 1938年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1938年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党参议员霍默·博恩击败共和党人尤因·D.科尔文，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1938 United States Senate elections occurred in the middle of Franklin D. Roosevelt's second term. The 32 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. The Republicans gained eight seats from the Democrats, though this occurred after multiple Democratic gains since the 1932 elections.

zh.s: 1938年美国参议院选举在富兰克林·D.罗斯福第二个任期期间举行。常规选举改选32个第3类席位，另举行特别选举填补空缺。共和党从民主党手中赢得8席，不过此前共和党在1932年以来的多次选举中曾遭遇席位流失。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1938 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Incumbent Democratic governor Barzilla Clark ran for re-election, but was defeated in the August primary by former three-term governor C. Ben Ross. The general election was won by Republican nominee C. A. Bottolfsen, who received 57.30% of the vote.

zh.s: 1938年11月8日，爱达荷州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长巴齐拉·克拉克在8月党内初选中败给曾任三届州长的C·本·罗斯。共和党候选人C·A·博托尔夫森随后在大选中以57.30%的得票率当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1938 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1938 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1938 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1938年11月8日，美国艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，选民在50个选区中的22个选区选出州参议员。该州参议员每届任期四年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: A special election was held in Ohio's 4th congressional district after the Democratic incumbent, Frank Le Blond Kloeb, resigned when he was appointed as a district court judge on the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio. Walter H. Albaugh, the winner, was elected to finish Kloeb's term. The special election resulted in a gain for Republicans, picking up a seat that they had not held since five years prior to the election.

zh.t: 1938年俄亥俄州第四国会选区补选
zh.s: 1938年11月8日，俄亥俄州第四国会选区举行补选。民主党籍众议员弗兰克·勒布隆·克勒布获任联邦地区法官后辞职，留下空缺。共和党人沃尔特·H·阿尔博当选，接替他完成剩余任期；共和党由此夺回阔别数年的席位。

en.t: Georg Elser attempts to assassinate Adolf Hitler
en.s: Johann Georg Elser (German: [ˈɡeːɔʁk ˈɛlzɐ] ; 4 January 1903 – 9 April 1945) was a German carpenter who planned and carried out an elaborate assassination attempt on Adolf Hitler and other high-ranking Nazi leaders on 8 November 1939 at the Bürgerbräukeller in Munich (known as the Bürgerbräukeller Bombing). Elser constructed and placed a bomb near the platform from which Hitler was to deliver a speech.

zh.t: 格奥尔格·埃尔塞企图刺杀阿道夫·希特勒
zh.s: 德国木匠约翰·格奥尔格·埃尔塞（德语：[ˈɡeːɔʁk ˈɛlzɐ]；1903年1月4日—1945年4月9日）于1939年11月8日在慕尼黑市民啤酒馆策划并实施刺杀阿道夫·希特勒及其他纳粹高层的行动，这一事件也称市民啤酒馆爆炸案。埃尔塞在希特勒原定发表演讲的讲台附近安放了炸弹。

en.s: The 1940 Cupa României final was the seventh final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Venus București and Rapid București, and was won by Rapid București after 4 games. This final is unique in the history because the winner decided after 4 games, 3 games ended draw after extra-time and just after the third reply Rapid București won with 2–1.

zh.s: 1940年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项罗马尼亚重要足球杯赛的第七届决赛。布加勒斯特维纳斯队对阵布加勒斯特快速队，后者经过4场比赛夺冠。这场决赛在赛事历史上独一无二：双方踢了4场才分出胜负，其中前3场在加时赛后仍打成平局；第三次重赛结束后，布加勒斯特快速队以2比1获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Elaia–Kalamas (Greek: Μάχη Ελαίας-Καλαμά, romanized: Machi Elaias-Kalama) took place in Epirus on 2–8 November 1940. The battle was fought between the Greeks and the Italians during the initial stage of the Greco-Italian War in World War II. The Royal Italian Army, deployed on the Greek-Albanian border, launched an offensive against Greece on 28 October 1940.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃莱亚—卡拉马斯战役（希腊语：Μάχη Ελαίας-Καλαμά，转写：Machi Elaias-Kalama）于1940年11月2日至8日在伊庇鲁斯发生。二战希意战争初期，希腊和意大利军队在此交战。1940年10月28日，部署在希腊—阿尔巴尼亚边境的意大利王国军队向希腊发动进攻。

en.s: Operation Terminal was an Allied operation during World War II. Part of Operation Torch (the Allied invasion of West Africa, 8 November 1942) it involved a direct landing of infantry into the Vichy French port of Algiers with the intention of capturing the port facilities before they could be destroyed.

zh.s: “终端”行动是第二次世界大战期间盟军的一次军事行动，属于“火炬”行动的一部分。1942年11月8日盟军登陆西非期间，步兵直接登陆维希法国控制的阿尔及尔港，意在港口设施被摧毁前将其占领。

en.s: Operation Torch (8–16 November 1942) was an Allied invasion of French North Africa during World War II. Torch was a compromise operation that met the British objective of securing victory in North Africa while allowing American armed forces the opportunity to begin their fight against Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy on a limited scale. The French colonies were aligned with Germany via Vichy France but the loyalties of the population were mixed.

zh.s: 火炬行动（1942年11月8日至16日）是第二次世界大战期间，盟军对法属北非发动的入侵。该行动兼顾了英国确保北非战局胜利的目标，也让美国军队得以有限度地开始对抗纳粹德国和法西斯意大利。法属殖民地通过维希法国站在德国一方，但当地民众的立场不一。

en.s: Operation Reservist, also known as the Suicide Charge at Oran, was an Allied military operation during the Second World War. Part of Operation Torch (the Allied invasion of North Africa), it was an attempted landing of troops directly into the harbour at Oran in Algeria.

zh.s: 1942年11月8日，盟军在第二次世界大战期间发起“预备役行动”，试图从海上直接进入阿尔及利亚奥兰港登陆。这次行动是盟军登陆北非的“火炬行动”的一部分，也被称为“奥兰自杀冲锋”。

en.s: Convoy TAG 18 was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the second World War. It was the 18th of the numbered TAG Convoys from Trinidad and Aruba to Guantánamo. The convoy was shadowed from 1 to 4 November by U-160 skippered by Kapitänleutnant Georg Lassen (Knight's Cross with Oak Leaves) and joined on 5 November by U-129 – skippered by Hans-Ludwig Witt (Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: TAG 18号船队是二战期间的一支商船队，也是从特立尼达和阿鲁巴驶往关塔那摩的第18支编号TAG船队。11月1日至4日，乔治·拉森海军中尉指挥的U-160号潜艇跟踪了这支船队；11月5日，汉斯-路德维希·维特指挥的U-129号潜艇加入跟踪。拉森获颁带橡叶的骑士十字勋章，维特获颁铁十字骑士勋章。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Koromokina Lagoon was fought between the United States Marine Corps and Imperial Japanese Army forces on Bougainville Island. It took place on 7–8 November 1943 during the Bougainville campaign of the Pacific War. In response to the Allied landings on Bougainville at Cape Torokina, Japanese General Hitoshi Imamura, commander of the 8th Area Army at Rabaul, determined to launch a counterattack.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科罗莫基纳泻湖战役发生在布干维尔岛，由美国海军陆战队与日本帝国陆军交战。战役于1943年11月7日至8日进行，是太平洋战争布干维尔战役的一部分。盟军在托罗基纳角登陆后，驻拉包尔的第八方面军司令今村均决定发动反击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1944 in New York was held on November 8, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert F. Wagner was re-elected to a fourth term over Republican Thomas J. Curran. Wagner would not complete the term, resigning in June 1949 due to ill health.

zh.s: 1944年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党参议员罗伯特·F.瓦格纳击败共和党人托马斯·J.柯伦，赢得第四个任期。瓦格纳因健康状况不佳，于1949年6月辞职，未能完成任期。

en.s: The Battle of the Scheldt in World War II was a series of military operations to open up the Scheldt river between Antwerp and the North Sea for shipping, so that Antwerp's port could be used to supply the Allies in north-west Europe. The operations were carried out by the First Canadian Army, with assistance from Polish and British units which had been attached.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 二战期间的斯海尔德河战役是一系列军事行动，目的是打通安特卫普与北海之间的斯海尔德河航道，让安特卫普港能够为西北欧盟军提供补给。行动由加拿大第一集团军实施，并有配属的波兰和英国部队协助。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Infatuate was the code name given to an Anglo-Canadian operation in November 1944 during the Second World War to open the port of Antwerp to shipping and relieve logistical constraints. The operation was part of the wider Battle of the Scheldt and involved two assault landings from the sea by the 4th Special Service Brigade and the 52nd (Lowland) Division.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “狂喜”行动是1944年11月二战期间英加联军的一项行动，目的是开放安特卫普港的航运，缓解后勤压力。该行动属于斯海尔德河战役的一部分，包括由第四特种勤务旅和第52（低地）师从海上实施的两次登陆。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The coup d'état of 8 November 1947 (Thai: รัฐประหาร 8 พฤศจิกายน พ.ศ. 2490) was a military coup d'état that took place in Thailand on the evening of 8 November 1947 and ended in the early morning hours of 9 November. The coup ousted the government of Pridi Banomyong's frontman, Luang Thamrong, to make royalist Khuang Aphaiwong Prime Minister of Thailand.

zh.s: 1947年11月8日政变（泰语：รัฐประหาร 8 พฤศจิกายน พ.ศ. 2490）是泰国军方发动的一场政变，开始于1947年11月8日晚间，结束于11月9日凌晨。政变推翻了銮探荣领导的比里·帕侬荣派政府，扶植保皇派的宽·阿派旺出任泰国总理。

en.s: The 1947 Victorian state election was held in the Australian state of Victoria on Saturday 8 November 1947 to elect 65 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election resulted in a landslide defeat for the Labor government of John Cain, which lost 14 seats and was reduced to 17, its lowest number since 1932.

zh.s: 1947年维多利亚州议会选举于11月8日星期六在澳大利亚维多利亚州举行，选出州立法议会65名议员。约翰·凯恩领导的工党政府惨败，失去14席，仅剩17席，为1932年以来最低。

en.s: Operation Léa was a French Union military operation between 7 October and 8 November 1947 during the First Indochina War. It is also known as the Việt Bắc campaign (Chiến Dịch Việt Bắc) by the Viet Minh. It was an attempt by the French General Valluy to crush the Việt Minh. An airborne force would capture the Việt Minh leadership and three French columns would strike into the Việt Minh heartland.

zh.s: 利亚行动是法国联盟军在第一次印度支那战争期间开展的一次军事行动，时间为1947年10月7日至11月8日。越盟也称之为“越北战役”（Chiến Dịch Việt Bắc）。法国将军瓦吕伊试图借此击溃越盟。计划由空降部队俘获越盟领导层，并派出三支法国纵队进攻越盟腹地。

en.s: Elections for the members of the Senate were held on November 8, 1949 in the Philippines. While President Elpidio Quirino won a full term as President of the Philippines after the death of President Manuel Roxas in 1948, and his running mate, Senator Fernando Lopez won as Vice President, their Liberal Party won all of the contested seats in the Senate. Despite factions created in the administration party, Quirino won a satisfactory vote from the public. It was the only time in Philippine history where the duly elected president, vice president and senators all came from the same party, the Liberal Party.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日，菲律宾举行参议员选举。1948年总统曼努埃尔·罗哈斯去世后，现任总统埃尔皮迪奥·季里诺在本次选举中赢得完整总统任期，他的竞选搭档、参议员费尔南多·洛佩斯当选副总统。尽管执政党内部分裂，自由党仍赢得所有改选席位，季里诺也获得了令其满意的公众支持。这是菲律宾历史上唯一一次正式当选的总统、副总统和参议员全部来自同一政党——自由党。

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections were held on November 8, 1949 in the Philippines. Incumbent President Elpidio Quirino won a full term as President of the Philippines after the death of President Manuel Roxas in 1948. His running mate, Senator Fernando Lopez won as Vice President. Despite factions created in the administration party, Quirino won a satisfactory vote from the public. It was the only time in Philippine history where the duly elected president, vice president and senators all came from the same party, the Liberal Party.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日，菲律宾举行总统、立法机构和地方选举。1948年总统曼努埃尔·罗哈斯去世后，现任总统埃尔皮迪奥·季里诺赢得完整总统任期。他的竞选搭档、参议员费尔南多·洛佩斯当选副总统。尽管执政党内部分裂，季里诺仍获得了令其满意的公众支持。这是菲律宾历史上唯一一次正式当选的总统、副总统和参议员全部来自同一政党——自由党。

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections were held on November 8, 1949, in the Philippines. Incumbent President Elpidio Quirino won a full term as President of the Philippines after the death of President Manuel Roxas in 1948. His running mate, Senator Fernando Lopez won as Vice President. Despite factions created in the administration party, Quirino won a satisfactory vote from the public. It was the only time in Philippine history where the duly elected president, vice president and senators all came from the same party, the Liberal Party. Carlos P. Romulo and Marvin M.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1949年11月8日举行总统、立法机构和地方选举。时任总统埃尔皮迪奥·季里诺在总统曼努埃尔·罗哈斯于1948年去世后赢得完整任期；他的竞选搭档、参议员费尔南多·洛佩斯当选副总统。尽管执政党内部存在派系，季里诺仍获得了相当可观的选票。这是菲律宾历史上唯一一次通过选举产生的总统、副总统和参议员均来自同一政党——自由党的情况。作者卡洛斯·P·罗慕洛和马文·M·格雷在《马格赛赛的故事》一书中指控季里诺通过军事行动大规模舞弊并恐吓反对派，称这是一场“肮脏的选举”。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1949 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1949. David Lawrence of the Democratic Party was reelected to a second term. Despite commanding a powerful position within both local politics and the state party, Lawrence faced a major primary challenge after he failed to gain the endorsement of the AFL-CIO. However, he achieved a moderate victory over union leader Ed Leonard, in part due to the surprising support of the Republican business community, which championed Lawrence's urban renewal projects. After the primary scare, Lawrence defeated Republican Timothy "Tice" Ryan, an attorney, by what was then the biggest margin in city mayoral history.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长选举。民主党人大卫·劳伦斯连任第二个任期。尽管劳伦斯在当地政治和州党内都拥有强大地位，但他未能获得美国劳工联合会—产业工会联合会（AFL-CIO）支持，因此在初选中遭遇有力挑战。劳伦斯击败工会领袖埃德·伦纳德，取得不算大的胜利；共和党商界出人意料地支持劳伦斯，部分原因是他推动城市更新项目。惊险赢得初选后，劳伦斯在普选中以当时该市市长选举史上最大差距击败律师、共和党人蒂莫西·“泰斯”·瑞安。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1949 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1949. Incumbent Republican Alfred E. Driscoll defeated Democratic nominee Elmer H. Wene with 51.54% of the vote. For the first time, the Governor of New Jersey was elected to a 4-year term, as oppose to 3 years.

zh.s: 1949年新泽西州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任共和党州长阿尔弗雷德·E·德里斯科尔以51.54%的得票率击败民主党提名人埃尔默·H·韦恩。新泽西州州长首次改为四年一任，此前任期为三年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1949 occurred on Tuesday, November 8, 1949, between incumbent Mayor of Boston James Michael Curley, city clerk and former acting mayor John B. Hynes, and three other candidates. Hynes was elected to his first term. Boston voters also approved changing the structure of future mayoral contests to include a preliminary election, to select two final candidates in advance of each general election.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日（星期二），波士顿举行市长选举，候选人包括民主党籍时任市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利、书记官兼前代理市长约翰·B·海因斯，以及另外三人。海因斯当选，开始第一个任期。波士顿选民还通过提案，决定今后的市长选举加入预选，以便在每次大选前选出两名最终候选人。

en.s: The 1949 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1949, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Lewis Preston Collins II defeated Republican nominee E. Thomas McGuire.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1949年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、时任副州长刘易斯·普雷斯顿·柯林斯二世击败共和党候选人E·托马斯·麦圭尔。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1949 took place on November 8, 1949, in New York City. The candidates were incumbent Mayor William O'Dwyer, a Democrat, and former City Council President and 1945 mayoral candidate Newbold Morris, a Republican, as well as other, third-party candidates. Morris was also the nominee of the Liberal Party, and additionally ran on the City Fusion ballot line.

zh.s: 纽约市于1949年11月8日举行市长选举。候选人包括民主党籍时任市长威廉·奥德怀尔、共和党候选人纽博尔德·莫里斯（曾任市议会主席并参加1945年市长选举），以及其他第三党候选人。莫里斯同时获得自由党提名，并以“城市融合党”名义参选。

en.s: The 1949 United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 8, 1949, in two states. In New Jersey, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 3-year term.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日，美国有两个州举行州长选举。新泽西州首次选出任期四年的州长，此前该州州长任期为三年。

en.t: 1949 United States Senate special election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate special election of 1949 in New York was held on November 8, 1949. On June 28, 1949, incumbent senator Robert F. Wagner resigned due to ill health. On July 7, John Foster Dulles was appointed by Governor Thomas Dewey to fill the vacancy temporarily. The Republican State Committee nominated Dulles to succeed himself. The Democratic State Committee nominated former Governor Herbert H.

zh.t: 1949年纽约州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 纽约州于1949年11月8日举行联邦参议员特别选举。1949年6月28日，时任参议员罗伯特·F·瓦格纳因健康原因辞职。7月7日，州长托马斯·杜威任命约翰·福斯特·杜勒斯暂时填补空缺。共和党州委员会提名杜勒斯接任该席位，民主党州委员会则提名前州长赫伯特·H。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1949 saw the reelection of Thomas A. Burke to a third consecutive term.

en.s: In the 1949 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor William M. Tuck, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. State Senator John S. Battle was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against Republican Walter Johnson.

zh.s: 1949年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长威廉·M·塔克因任期限制不能连任。民主党提名州参议员约翰·S·巴特尔，与共和党候选人沃尔特·约翰逊竞逐州长职位。

en.s: The 1951 Cupa României final was the 14th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between CCA București and Flacăra Mediaș, and was won by CCA București after a game with four goals. It was the third cup title in the history of CCA București. Flacăra Mediaș was the second club representing Divizia B which reached the Romanian Cup final, after CAM Timișoara which accomplished this in 1938.

zh.s: 1951年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项罗马尼亚重要足球杯赛的第14届决赛。布加勒斯特CCA队对阵梅迪亚什火焰队，CCA队在一场打进4球的比赛中获胜。这是CCA队队史上第三次夺得杯赛冠军。梅迪亚什火焰队是第二支闯入罗马尼亚杯决赛的乙级联赛球队；第一支是1938年闯入决赛的蒂米什瓦拉CAM队。

en.s: Philadelphia's municipal election of November 8, 1955 involved contests for mayor, district attorney, all seventeen city council seats, among other offices. Citywide, the Democrats took majorities of over 130,000 votes, continuing their success from the elections four years earlier. Richardson Dilworth, who had been elected district attorney in 1951, was elected mayor. Victor H. Blanc, a city councilman, was elected district attorney. The Democrats also kept fourteen of seventeen city council seats, losing one district seat while gaining another, and kept control of the other citywide offices.

zh.s: 1955年11月8日，费城举行市政选举，改选市长、地方检察官、全部17个市议会席位及其他职位。全市范围内，民主党以超过13万票的优势取得多数，延续了四年前选举的胜利。理查森·迪尔沃思于1951年当选地方检察官，此次当选市长；市议员维克托·H·布朗克当选地方检察官。民主党还保住17个市议会席位中的14席，失去一个选区席位、同时赢得另一个，并继续控制其他全市性职位。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1955 occurred on Tuesday, November 8, 1955 between Mayor John B. Hynes and State Senator John E. Powers. Hynes was elected to his third term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 27, 1955.

zh.s: 1955年波士顿市长选举于11月8日星期二举行，候选人为市长约翰·B·海因斯和州参议员约翰·E·鲍尔斯。海因斯当选，开启第三个任期。非党派市政初选于1955年9月27日举行。

en.s: The 1955 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1955. Democratic nominee Happy Chandler defeated Republican nominee Edwin R. Denney with 58.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于1955年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人“快乐”钱德勒以58.02%的得票率击败共和党候选人埃德温·R·丹尼。

en.s: The 1955 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1955, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Hugh L. White was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election, so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1955年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长休·L·怀特受任期限制，不能争取连任第二个任期。当时通常由民主党候选人在大选中不受挑战，因此民主党初选才是真正的竞争，赢得初选也就相当于当选。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1955 took place on November 8, 1955, and saw the election of Philip L. Bayt to a second non-consecutive term. Bayt's opponent was Republican James O. Birr.

zh.t: 1955年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 印第安纳波利斯于1955年11月8日举行市长选举。菲利普·L·贝特当选，赢得第二个非连续任期。共和党候选人詹姆斯·O·比尔是他的对手。

en.s: The 1955 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 8, 1955. George Christopher was elected with 66% of the vote.

zh.s: 1955年旧金山市长选举于11月8日举行。乔治·克里斯托弗以66%的得票率当选。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1955 saw the re-election of Anthony J. Celebrezze. Mayor Celebrezze ran unopposed in the general election by virtue of having captured a majority of votes in the primary election, under the laws of the city charter.

zh.s: 1955年克利夫兰市长选举中，安东尼·J.塞莱布雷兹再次当选。根据市宪章，塞莱布雷兹在初选中获得多数票后，已确定赢得大选，因此没有对手参选。

en.s: The 1955 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 8. The elections took place midway through the first term of Governor Robert Meyner. Eleven of New Jersey's 21 counties held regular elections for Senator. The Democratic Party gained Camden, Essex and Salem counties.

zh.s: 1955年11月8日，新泽西州举行州参议院选举，全州21个县中的11个县改选州参议员。当时州长罗伯特·梅纳尔的首个任期进行到中段。民主党在卡姆登、埃塞克斯和塞勒姆三县赢得席位。

en.s: The 1956 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1956. Democratic nominee Luther E. Barnhardt defeated Republican nominee Joseph A. Dunn with 66.71% of the vote.

zh.t: 1956年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1956年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人卢瑟·E·巴恩哈特以66.71%的得票率击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·A·邓恩。

en.s: Pan Am Flight 7 was a westbound round-the-world flight operated by Pan American World Airways. On November 8, 1957, the Boeing 377 Stratocruiser serving the flight, named Clipper Romance of the Skies, crashed in the Pacific Ocean en route to Honolulu International Airport from San Francisco. The crash killed all 36 passengers and eight crew members.

zh.s: 泛美航空7号班机是一班向西飞行、环绕世界的航班，由泛美世界航空公司运营。1957年11月8日，执飞该航班的波音377“同温层巡航者”客机“天空浪漫号”在太平洋上空坠毁，当时正从旧金山飞往檀香山国际机场。机上36名乘客和8名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 1960
en.s: The 1960 presidential election in Hawaii was held on November 8, 1960 as part of the United States presidential election of 1960. This was the first presidential election in which Hawaii participated; the state had been admitted to the Union just over a year earlier. The islands favored Democrat John F. Kennedy by the narrowest of margins: 115 votes, or 0.06%. Initially it appeared Republican candidate Richard Nixon had won in the state, as he was 141 votes ahead after the first count. A court-ordered recount was still underway when Hawaii's Republican governor signed the certificate from the GOP electors giving the state's three electoral votes to Nixon.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举夏威夷州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，夏威夷州举行总统选举投票，这是该州首次参加美国总统选举。夏威夷刚在一年多前加入联邦。该州以极微弱的优势支持民主党人约翰·F·肯尼，双方仅相差115票，即0.06个百分点。最初计票后，共和党候选人理查德·尼克松领先141票，看似赢得该州。法院下令重新计票仍在进行时，夏威夷州共和党州长签署了共和党选举人团的认证书，把该州三张选举人票交给尼克松。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election was held on November 8, 1960. The Democratic Party candidate John F. Kennedy, narrowly won the state of Texas with 50.52% of the vote to the Republican candidate Vice President Richard Nixon's 48.52%, a margin of 2%, giving him the state's 24 electoral votes. Despite the presence of U.S. Senator Lyndon B. Johnson on the Democratic ticket, the results in Texas made the state the 10th closest state in the election. Nixon's strong performance in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, Harris County, and the Panhandle, kept the race close.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举得克萨斯州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日举行美国总统选举，民主党候选人约翰·F·肯尼以50.52%的得票率险胜共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（48.52%），赢得得克萨斯州24张选举人票，领先幅度为2个百分点。尽管民主党候选人搭档中有得克萨斯州联邦参议员林登·B·约翰逊，得克萨斯州仍是当年全美竞争第十激烈的州。尼克松在达拉斯—沃思堡地区、哈里斯县和狭长地带表现强劲，使选情保持胶着。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 8, 1960 throughout all 50 states, but not The District of Columbia, which was not part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon, over the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy. Kennedy ultimately won the national election with 49.72% of the vote.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举弗吉尼亚州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举投票。全美50个州都参加了选举，哥伦比亚特区则没有参加。选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼。肯尼最终以49.72%的得票率赢得全国选举。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent United States Senator James E. Murray, who was first elected to the Senate in a special election in 1934 and was re-elected in 1936, 1942, and 1948, and 1954, declined to seek re-election, creating an open seat. United States Congressman Lee Metcalf won out in a crowded Democratic primary and faced off against former United States Congressman Orvin B. Fjare, who won in a similarly-crowded Republican primary. Following a close general election, Metcalf narrowly defeated Fjare to win his first term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1960年美国联邦参议院蒙大拿州选举
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员詹姆斯·E·默里于1934年首次在特别选举中当选，并于1936、1942、1948和1954年连任；他决定不再参选，留下空缺席位。联邦众议员李·梅特卡夫在竞争激烈的民主党初选中胜出，对手是共和党初选获胜的前联邦众议员奥尔文·B·菲亚雷。普选十分接近，梅特卡夫以微弱优势击败菲亚雷，当选参议员，开始第一个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 8, 1960 throughout all 50 states, but not The District of Columbia, which was not part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana narrowly voted for the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon, over the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy. Nixon won Montana by a slim margin of 2.32%.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举蒙大拿州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行总统选举投票。全美50个州都参加了选举，哥伦比亚特区则没有参加。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。蒙大拿州以微弱优势支持共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼。尼克松以2.32%的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent Vice-President Richard Nixon (R-California) with 50.9% of the popular vote against U.S. Senator John F. Kennedy (D-Massachusetts) with 49.1%. Kennedy ultimately won the national vote however, defeating Nixon. This was the very first presidential election that Alaska participated in.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举阿拉斯加州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，阿拉斯加州举行总统选举投票。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任副总统理查德·尼克松以50.9%的普选票赢得阿拉斯加州；来自马萨诸塞州的民主党联邦参议员约翰·F·肯尼获得49.1%。肯尼最终赢得全国选举，击败尼克松。这是阿拉斯加州首次参加总统选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 8, 1960 as part of the 1960 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont was won by the Republican nominee, incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon of California, and his running mate Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. of Massachusetts, defeating Democratic Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts and his running mate Senate Majority Leader Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas. Nixon took 58.65% of the vote to Kennedy's 41.35%, a margin of 17.30%.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举佛蒙特州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佛蒙特州举行总统选举投票；当时全美50个州均参加选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任副总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、来自马萨诸塞州的美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼及其竞选搭档、来自得克萨斯州的参议院多数党领袖林登·B·约翰逊。尼克松得票率为58.65%，肯尼为41.35%，差距为17.30个百分点。

en.s: The 1960 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Governor of Montana J. Hugo Aronson, who was first elected governor in 1952 and was re-elected in 1956, declined to run for re-election. Donald Grant Nutter, a former state senator, narrowly won the Republican primary, and advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Paul Cannon, the Lieutenant Governor of Montana and the Democratic nominee. Nutter defeated Cannon by a fairly wide margin, winning his one and only term as governor, as he would die just a year into his term.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行州长选举。时任州长J·雨果·阿伦森于1952年首次当选，并于1956年连任；他决定不再参选。前州参议员唐纳德·格兰特·纳特在共和党初选中以微弱优势获胜，进入普选，对手是蒙大拿州副州长、民主党候选人保罗·坎农。纳特以较大优势击败坎农，赢得唯一一个州长任期；他在任职仅一年后便去世。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1960 as part of the 1960 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Hampshire was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon of California, and his running mate Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. of Massachusetts. Nixon and Lodge defeated the Democratic nominees, Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts and his running mate Senate Majority Leader Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举新罕布什尔州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，新罕布什尔州举行总统选举投票；当时全美50个州都参加了选举。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的时任副总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、来自马萨诸塞州的美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇，击败民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼及其竞选搭档、来自得克萨斯州的参议院多数党领袖林登·B·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1960 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. John A. Volpe was elected Governor of Massachusetts to replace Foster Furcolo. Volpe defeated Democrat Joseph D. Ward in the race. Also running were Henning A. Blomen of the Socialist Labor Party of America and Guy S. Williams of the Prohibition Party. In the race for Lieutenant Governor, Democrat Edward F. McLaughlin, Jr., defeated Republican Augustus G. Means, Prohibition candidate Thomas Maratea, and Socialist Labor candidate Francis A. Votano.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。约翰·A·沃尔普当选州长，接替福斯特·弗科洛。沃尔普击败民主党人约瑟夫·D·沃德。其他候选人包括美国社会主义劳工党人亨宁·A·布洛门和禁酒党人盖伊·S·威廉斯。副州长选举中，民主党人小爱德华·F·麦克劳克林击败共和党人奥古斯都·G·米恩斯、禁酒党候选人托马斯·马拉泰亚和社会主义劳工党候选人弗朗西斯·A·沃塔诺。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 8, 1960 as part of the 1960 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose 16 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts, over the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon of California. Kennedy ran with Senate Majority Leader Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, while Nixon's running mate was Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. of Massachusetts.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举马萨诸塞州投票

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1960 in Minnesota as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate,0 U.S. Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts won the state over incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon by a margin of 22,018 votes, or 1.42%. Kennedy went on to win the election nationally, but by the closest margin since Woodrow Wilson's re-election in 1916. This was the last presidential election held in Minnesota before the elimination of the 9th congressional district in 1963.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举明尼苏达州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，明尼苏达州举行总统选举投票。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的联邦参议员约翰·F·肯尼以22,018票、即1.42%的优势击败时任副总统理查德·尼克松，赢得该州。肯尼最终在全国获胜，但这是自伍德罗·威尔逊1916年连任以来差距最小的一次。此后直到1963年取消第九国会选区前，这是明尼苏达州最后一次在该选区尚存时举行总统选举。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1960 was the 44th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 8, 1960. The Republican Party nominated incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon, while the Democratic Party nominated John F. Kennedy, U.S. Senator from Massachusetts. The incumbent President, Republican Dwight D. Eisenhower, was not eligible for re-election after being elected the maximum two times allowed by the Twenty-second Amendment; he was the first President affected by that amendment. This was the first presidential election in which voters in Alaska and Hawaii were able to participate, as both had become states in 1959.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日星期二，美国举行第44次四年一度总统选举。共和党提名时任副总统理查德·尼克松，民主党提名来自马萨诸塞州的联邦参议员约翰·F·肯尼。根据《第二十二条修正案》，总统最多只能当选两次，因此共和党籍时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔无法竞选连任；他是首位受该修正案限制的总统。这也是阿拉斯加和夏威夷加入联邦后首次参加总统选举；两地于1959年成为州。

en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1960 was held on 8 November 1960 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. The general election was fought between the Democratic incumbent, B. Everett Jordan, and the Republican nominee, Wilkes County attorney and 1956 Republican gubernatorial nominee Kyle Hayes. It was Jordan's first election to a full term, as he had been elected in a 1958 special election to complete the term of Kerr Scott, who had died in office. The simultaneous victories of Jordan, gubernatorial nominee Terry Sanford and presidential nominee John F.

zh.t: 1960年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1960年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任参议员B·埃弗里特·乔丹击败共和党候选人、威尔克斯县律师R·凯尔·海斯，成功连任完整任期。乔丹、州长候选人特里·桑福德和总统候选人约翰·F·肯尼迪同时获胜；民主党直到2008年才再次在北卡罗来纳州同日赢下这三项重要选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1960. All 50 states were part of the 1960 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 16 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Democratic nominees, Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts and his running mate Senate Majority Leader Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas. Kennedy and Johnson defeated the Republican nominees, Vice President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. of Massachusetts.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举新泽西州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，新泽西州举行总统选举投票。全美50个州都参加了本次选举。新泽西州选民选出16名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼及其竞选搭档、来自得克萨斯州的参议院多数党领袖林登·B·约翰逊赢得该州，击败共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的副总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、来自马萨诸塞州的美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alabama, 1960
en.s: The United States presidential election in Alabama, 1960 was held on November 8, 1960. Eleven Democratic electors were elected, of whom six voted for Harry F. Byrd and five for John F. Kennedy. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other 49 states. There were 22 electors on the ballot, eleven Republicans and eleven Democrats. Voters could vote for up to eleven candidates. As a result of a state primary, the Democratic Party had a mixed slate of electors, five being pledged to Kennedy and the remaining six being unpledged.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举投票。民主党选出11名选举人，其中6人把票投给哈里·F·伯德，5人投给约翰·F·肯尼。阿拉巴马州选民不像其他49个州那样对整组选举人投票，而是逐名投票。选票上有22名候选选举人，民主党和共和党各11人；选民最多可以投给11人。州内初选后，民主党提出了一组混合名单：5名选举人承诺支持肯尼，另外6人则未作承诺。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 8, 1960. All 50 states were part of the 1960 United States presidential election. New York voters chose forty five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by Democratic Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts, who was running against incumbent Republican Vice President Richard Nixon. Kennedy was running with Texas Senator, and strongest opponent in the 1960 Democratic Primaries, Lyndon B. Johnson for Vice President, and Nixon ran with internationally popular United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr..

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举纽约州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，纽约州举行总统选举投票。全美50个州都参加了本次选举。纽约州选民选出45名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。来自马萨诸塞州的民主党参议员约翰·F·肯尼击败共和党籍时任副总统理查德·尼克松，赢得该州。肯尼的副总统竞选搭档是来自得克萨斯州的参议员、1960年民主党总统初选中的主要对手林登·B·约翰逊；尼克松的竞选搭档是当时在国际上颇有声望的美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 8, 1960. This was the first year where all 50 current states were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by Massachusetts Senator John F. Kennedy by a narrow 1 point margin. In his first bid for the presidency, Republican nominee incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon was defeated in an electorally sound nationwide Democratic victory.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举新墨西哥州投票
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，新墨西哥州举行总统选举投票。这是现有50个州首次全部参加美国总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼以1个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松首次竞选总统，但在全国选举中以明显差距败给民主党人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1960. Wisconsin voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Richard Nixon won the state with 52% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举威斯康星州结果
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举威斯康星州投票于11月8日举行。该州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人理查德·尼克松以52%的普选票赢得威斯康星州及其12张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1960
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1960 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1960. Democrats and Republicans each swapped a seat, leaving the balance at 16 Democrats and 14 Republicans.

zh.t: 1960年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1960年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举旨在选出该州的联邦众议员，与11月8日举行的联邦众议院普选同时进行。民主党和共和党各自从对方手中赢得一个席位，最终席位数为民主党16席、共和党14席。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election took place on November 8, 1960 throughout all 50 states, but not The District of Columbia, which was not part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 32 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania narrowly voted for the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy, over the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon.

zh.t: 1960年美国总统选举宾夕法尼亚州结果
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举于11月8日在全部50个州举行，但哥伦比亚特区不在本次选举范围内。选民选出32名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以微弱优势支持民主党提名人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪，击败共和党提名人、副总统理查德·尼克松。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1960
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic incumbent Senator Absalom Willis Robertson defeated Independent Democrat Stuart Baker and Social Democrat Clarke Robb and was re-elected to a third term in office.

zh.s: 1960年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍时任参议员阿布萨隆·威利斯·罗伯逊击败独立民主党人斯图尔特·贝克和社会民主党人克拉克·罗布，成功连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: General elections were held in Puerto Rico on 8 November 1960. Luis Muñoz Marín of the Popular Democratic Party was re-elected as governor, whilst the PPD also won a majority of the vote in the House of Representatives elections. Voter turnout was 84.6%.

en.s: The United States Senate election of 1960 in Massachusetts was held on November 8, 1960 with Republican Incumbent Leverett Saltonstall defeating his challengers.

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1960 took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Robert Stafford did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate F. Ray Keyser, Jr. defeated Democratic candidate Russell F. Niquette to succeed him.

zh.s: 1960年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任共和党州长罗伯特·斯塔福德没有竞选连任，争取第二个任期。共和党候选人F·雷·凯泽二世击败民主党候选人拉塞尔·F·尼凯特，接替他出任州长。

en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1960 was Missouri's fortieth gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 8, 1960 and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, Missouri Attorney General John M. Dalton, over the Republican candidate, Edward G. Farmer.
