en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose 27 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In the nation's second-closest race following Hawaii, Illinois was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1960年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出27名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。在全国竞争最激烈的州份中，伊利诺伊州仅次于夏威夷州。民主党参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪代表马萨诸塞州参选，竞选搭档为参议员林登·B·约翰逊，并在伊利诺伊州胜过共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松及其搭档、前驻联合国大使亨利·卡伯特·洛奇二世。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 8, 1960. Primaries were held on April 12.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1960年11月8日星期二举行选举。初选于4月12日举行。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Carl Curtis ran for re-election to a second term. He was initially set to face Governor Ralph Brooks, the Democratic nominee, but two months before the election, Brooks died and was replaced on the ballot by Robert B. Conrad, Brooks's administrative assistant.

zh.t: 1960年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员卡尔·柯蒂斯争取连任第二个任期。他原定对阵民主党候选人、州长拉尔夫·布鲁克斯，但布鲁克斯在选举前两个月去世，民主党随后由他的行政助理罗伯特·B·康拉德接替参选。

en.s: The 1960 Maine gubernatorial special election was a special election held to officially elect a governor of Maine following the death of Democratic Governor Clinton Clauson. It took place on November 8, 1960, concurrently with the presidential election, a U.S. Senate election, U.S. House of Representatives elections, and other state and local elections.

zh.s: 1960年缅因州州长特别选举是一次特别选举，旨在克林顿·克劳森州长（民主党）去世后正式选出州长。选举于1960年11月8日举行，与总统选举、联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举及其他州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 60.45 percent of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年堪萨斯州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州）与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得60.45%的普选票，赢得堪萨斯州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Clifford P. Case defeated Democratic nominee Thorn Lord with 55.69% of the vote. This election was the first time since 1924 where an incumbent Republican Senator was re-elected to this seat.

zh.t: 1960年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新泽西州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员克利福德·P·凯斯以55.69%的得票率击败民主党候选人索恩·洛德。这是自1924年以来，共和党籍时任参议员首次在该席位上成功连任。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on 8 November 1960, in 27 states. The elections were concurrent with the House elections, the Senate elections and the presidential election. In Minnesota, this was the last election on a 2-year cycle, before switching to a 4-year term for governors.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日，美国有27个州举行州长选举。这些选举与联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举和总统选举同期进行。明尼苏达州的这次选举是该州最后一次采用两年一届的周期，此后州长改为四年一任。

en.s: The 1960 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee John A. Notte Jr. defeated incumbent Republican Christopher Del Sesto with 56.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·A·诺特二世以56.64%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长克里斯托弗·德尔·塞斯托。

en.s: The 1960 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democrat Gaylord A. Nelson won the election with 51.5% of the vote, retaining his position as Governor of Wisconsin. The results were almost exactly the opposite of the simultaneous presidential election, with Nelson's margin of victory being about half a point narrower than that of Richard Nixon.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党人盖洛德·A·纳尔逊以51.5%的得票率胜选，继续担任州长。这次结果与同期总统选举几乎正好相反：纳尔逊的胜选差距比理查德·尼克松的胜选差距窄了约半个百分点。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Thomas E. Martin did not run for re-election to a second term. Jack Miller won the open seat by defeating Democratic Governor Herschel Loveless.

zh.t: 1960年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员托马斯·E·马丁没有争取连任第二个任期。杰克·米勒击败民主党籍州长赫歇尔·洛夫莱斯，赢得这个空出的席位。

en.s: The 1960 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee Harvey Cloyd Philpott defeated Republican nominee S. Clyde Eggers with 58.98% of the vote.

zh.t: 1960年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1960年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人哈维·克洛伊德·菲尔波特以58.98%的得票率击败共和党候选人S·克莱德·埃格斯。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 55.5% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年亚利桑那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年亚利桑那州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州）与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得55.5%的普选票，赢得亚利桑那州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. All surrounding states (California, Arizona, Utah, Idaho, and Oregon) voted for Nixon. Nevada was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年内华达州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。周边各州（加利福尼亚州、亚利桑那州、犹他州、爱达荷州和俄勒冈州）都支持尼克松。内华达州由民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1960 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee Hilary A. Bush defeated Republican nominee Harry E. Hatcher with 55.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1960年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人希拉里·A·布什以55.97%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈里·E·哈彻。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in New Mexico took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Senator Clinton Anderson won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1960年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员克林顿·安德森成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1960 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Milton Carpenter defeated Republican nominee F. P. Graves.

zh.t: 1960年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 密苏里州于1960年11月8日举行州财政部长选举。民主党候选人米尔顿·卡彭特击败共和党候选人F·P·格雷夫斯。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jennings Randolph won re-election to a full term, defeating Republican Governor Cecil H. Underwood in a landslide.

zh.t: 1960年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员詹宁斯·伦道夫以压倒性优势击败共和党籍州长塞西尔·H·安德伍德，成功当选完整任期。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. of Massachusetts, with 58.21% of the popular vote, against Massachusetts Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年南达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州）与竞选搭档、来自马萨诸塞州的美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得58.21%的普选票，赢得南达科他州；民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: The 1960 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Warren E. Hearnes defeated Republican nominee Joseph M. Badgett.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1960年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员沃伦·E·赫恩斯击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·M·巴杰特。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Hubert H. Humphrey defeated Republican Minneapolis Mayor P. Kenneth Peterson, to win a third term.

zh.t: 1960年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员休伯特·H·汉弗莱击败共和党候选人、明尼阿波利斯市长P·肯尼斯·彼得森，赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 1960 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee Matthew E. Welsh defeated Republican nominee Crawford F. Parker with 50.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人马修·E·韦尔什以50.39%的得票率击败共和党候选人克劳福德·F·帕克。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In the nation's third-closest race, Missouri was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年密苏里州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。密苏里州是全美竞争第三激烈的州，由民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the Civil War, Tennessee's white citizenry had been divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，田纳西州于11月8日举行投票，选出11名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后，田纳西州的白人居民一直因当年形成的政治立场而分化。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Paul Douglas was reelected to a third term.

zh.t: 1960年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员保罗·道格拉斯成功连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年特拉华州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得特拉华州，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1960 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Republican incumbent George Dewey Clyde defeated Democratic nominee William Arthur Barlocker with 52.66% of the vote. This was the last time until 1984 that Utah would elect a Republican governor.

zh.s: 犹他州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长乔治·杜威·克莱德以52.66%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·阿瑟·巴洛克。这是共和党直到1984年才再次在犹他州赢得州长选举。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry Dworshak won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.t: 1960年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 爱达荷州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员亨利·德沃夏克成功连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1960 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Karl Rolvaag of the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Art Ogle.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1960年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党—农工党籍时任副州长卡尔·罗尔瓦格击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人阿特·奥格尔。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with former United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 52.56% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年俄勒冈州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州）与竞选搭档、前美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得52.56%的普选票，赢得俄勒冈州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: The 1960 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat John Burroughs ran for reelection to a second term against his predecessor Republican Edwin L. Mechem in a rematch of the very close 1958 election. This time, Mechem narrowly defeated Burroughs by an even smaller margin than was seen in the previous election.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约翰·伯勒斯争取连任第二个任期，对手是前任州长、共和党人埃德温·L·米肯。两人曾在1958年的选举中激烈交锋；这次米肯以更小的差距险胜伯勒斯。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 8, 1960. Despite Republican Presidential candidate Richard Nixon defeating John F. Kennedy in the state by a close margin, popular incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Bob Bartlett was re-elected to a full term in office, defeating Republican dentist Lee McKinley. Bartlett was considered unbeatable within the state, having support from both Democrats & Republicans.

zh.t: 1960年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。尽管共和党总统候选人理查德·尼克松在该州以微弱优势击败约翰·F·肯尼迪，广受欢迎的民主党籍时任联邦参议员鲍勃·巴特利特仍成功当选完整任期，击败共和党候选人、牙医李·麦金利。巴特利特被视为在该州不可战胜，因为他同时得到民主党人和共和党人的支持。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Senator John Sparkman was re-elected to a third full term in office over Republican Julian Elgin.

zh.t: 1960年阿拉巴马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员约翰·斯帕克曼击败共和党候选人朱利安·埃尔金，成功连任第三个完整任期。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 8, 1960, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Estes Kefauver won re-election, defeating Republican candidate A. Bradley Frazier.

zh.t: 1960年田纳西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 田纳西州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各级州和地方选举同期进行。民主党籍时任参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗击败共和党候选人A·布拉德利·弗雷泽，成功连任。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Margaret Chase Smith was re-elected to a third term over Democratic State Representative Lucia Cormier, the floor leader of the Maine House of Representatives. This was the first election in United States Senate history in which the major-party nominees were both women, a fact that drew national and international press attention to what several newspapers dubbed the "Petticoat Race."

zh.s: 缅因州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员玛格丽特·蔡斯·史密斯击败民主党候选人、州众议员兼缅因州众议院党团领袖露西娅·科米尔，成功连任第三个任期。这是美国联邦参议院历史上主要政党的提名人首次都是女性，此事引起全国及国际媒体关注，几家报纸将这场选举称作“裙装竞选”。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the incumbent Vice President, Republican Party (United States) Richard Nixon, running with former United Nations Ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 55.01 percent of the popular vote, against the Democratic nominee, Massachusetts Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年怀俄明州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、前美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得55.01%的普选票，赢得怀俄明州；民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: The 1960 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee C. Farris Bryant defeated Republican nominee George C. Petersen with 59.85% of the vote.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人C·法里斯·布莱恩特以59.85%的得票率击败共和党候选人乔治·C·彼得森。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the last election in which Mississippi had eight electoral votes: the Great Migration of Black Americans caused the state to lose congressional districts for the third time in four censuses before the next election.

zh.t: 1960年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，密西西比州于11月8日举行投票，选出8名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。这是密西西比州最后一次拥有8张选举人票。在下一次选举前的四次人口普查中，非裔美国人大迁徙使该州第三次失去联邦众议院选区。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Texas Senator Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1960年路易斯安那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年路易斯安那州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得路易斯安那州，他的竞选搭档是来自得克萨斯州的参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 8, 1960. All contemporary fifty states took part, and Florida voters selected 10 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Republican candidate Richard Nixon won against John F. Kennedy by 46,776 votes and by 3.02%.

zh.t: 1960年美国佛罗里达州总统选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1960年11月8日举行总统选举，当时美国全部50个州都参加了选举。佛罗里达州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人理查德·尼克松以46,776票、3.02个百分点的优势击败约翰·F·肯尼迪。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in California took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose 32 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon, over the Democratic nominee, Massachusetts Senator John F. Kennedy.

zh.t: 1960年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，加利福尼亚州于11月8日举行投票，选出32名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党候选人、副总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州联邦参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪。

en.s: The 1960 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joseph L. Donovan defeated Republican nominee Kenneth O'Brien Joyce.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1960年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿约瑟夫·L·多诺万击败共和党候选人肯尼斯·奥布莱恩·乔伊斯。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年马里兰州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得马里兰州，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Senator Joseph C. O'Mahoney was first appointed to the U.S. Senate from Wyoming's Class 1 Senate seat in 1934, and was re-elected in 1934, 1940, and 1946 before losing re-election in 1952. He was then elected to the Class 2 Senate seat in 1954.

zh.t: 1960年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1960年怀俄明州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约瑟夫·C·奥马奥尼最初于1934年获任命，填补怀俄明州第一类参议员席位，随后在1934年、1940年和1946年当选连任，直到1952年竞选连任失败。之后，他在1954年当选为第二类参议员席位。

en.s: The 1960 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Wesley Powell defeated Democratic nominee Bernard L. Boutin with 55.46% of the vote.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长韦斯利·鲍威尔以55.46%的得票率击败民主党候选人伯纳德·L·布坦。

en.s: The Niemba ambush took place on 8 November 1960, when an Irish Army patrol in Congo-Léopoldville was ambushed, the first time the Irish Army was embroiled in battle since the 1922–23 Irish Civil War. Ireland had deployed troops as United Nations Operation in the Congo (ONUC) peacekeepers.

zh.s: 尼恩巴伏击事件发生于1960年11月8日。当时，刚果（利奥波德维尔）的一支爱尔兰军队巡逻队遭伏击。这是爱尔兰军队自1922至1923年爱尔兰内战以来首次卷入战斗。爱尔兰此前已派遣部队作为联合国驻刚果行动的维和人员。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert S. Kerr ran for re-election to a third term. He won the Democratic primary in a landslide and then faced former U.S. Attorney B. Hayden Crawford, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Even as Vice President Richard Nixon was winning Oklahoma in a landslide over John F.

zh.t: 1960年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1960年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·S·克尔竞选连任第三个任期。他以压倒性优势赢得民主党初选，随后在普选中面对共和党候选人、前联邦检察官B. 海登·克劳福德。尽管副总统理查德·尼克松在总统选举中以压倒性优势击败约翰·F·肯尼迪，克尔仍大幅击败克劳福德，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with former United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 62.07% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、前美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得62.07%的普选票，赢得内布拉斯加州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Louisiana took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Senator Allen J. Ellender won re-election to a fifth term.

zh.t: 1960年路易斯安那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员艾伦·J·埃伦德成功连任第五个任期。

en.s: The 1960 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 1960. Voters elected members of the Arizona House of Representatives in all 80 of the state's House districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1960.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1960年11月8日举行众议院选举，选出州众议院80个选区的议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦众议院和州参议院等其他职位的选举同期进行。党内初选于1960年9月13日举行。

en.s: The 1960 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Republican nominee Norman A. Erbe defeated Democratic nominee Edward Joseph McManus with 52.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人诺曼·A·厄布以52.14%的得票率击败民主党候选人爱德华·约瑟夫·麦克马纳斯。

en.s: The 1960 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 8, 1960. Heading into this election, Stratton was seen as vulnerable to being unseated if the Democrats ran a strong candidate, as he had only narrowly won reelection in 1956 (despite a strong overall performance by the Republican party in the state that year), and since the Democratic Party had nationally had a strong performance in the 1958 elections.

zh.s: 1960年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月8日举行。选举前，外界认为现任州长斯特拉顿有可能被赶下台：他在1956年仅以微弱优势连任，尽管当年共和党在该州整体表现强劲；而民主党在1958年全国选举中表现出色。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Theodore F. Green did not seek re-election. Democrat Claiborne Pell won the seat, defeating Republican Raoul Archambault Jr.

zh.t: 1960年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 罗得岛州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员西奥多·F·格林没有争取连任。民主党人克莱伯恩·佩尔击败共和党候选人小拉乌尔·阿尚博，赢得该席位。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon of California, over the Democratic nominee, Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年缅因州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国50个州均参加了这次选举。选民选出5名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的副总统理查德·尼克松，胜过民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 54.63% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年科罗拉多州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得54.63%的普选票，赢得科罗拉多州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1960年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，北卡罗来纳州于11月8日举行投票，选出14名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州曾是邦联州，长期实行种族隔离法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政坛也一直由民主党主导。

en.s: The 1960 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent governor Paul Fannin ran for reelection against former Democratic state representative Lee Ackerman in the general election, easily winning a second term. Fannin was sworn in to his second term on January 3, 1961. Both candidates ran unopposed in their respective party's primary.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。时任州长保罗·法宁没有遭遇党内挑战，民主党前州众议员李·阿克曼也同样在党内初选中无人竞争。法宁在大选中轻松连任第二个任期，并于1961年1月3日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 1960 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee and incumbent mayor of Wilmington Eugene Lammot defeated Republican nominee William Roth.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1960年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、威尔明顿市时任市长尤金·拉莫特击败共和党候选人威廉·罗斯。

en.s: The 1960 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Walter Mondale defeated Republican nominee Gaylord A. Saetre.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1960年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任代理检察长沃尔特·蒙代尔击败共和党候选人盖洛德·A·塞特雷。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Senator James Eastland was re-elected to a fourth term in office against nominal opposition. The primary race attracted little attention and as was typical of elections in the South at this time, the general election was a foregone conclusion in favor of the Democratic candidate, Eastland.

zh.t: 1960年密西西比州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 密西西比州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员詹姆斯·伊斯特兰以几乎没有对手的局面成功连任第四个任期。初选关注度很低，和当时南方常见的情况一样，大选结果早已注定由民主党候选人伊斯特兰获胜。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Lyndon B. Johnson, who was simultaneously running for Vice President of the United States, was re-elected to a third term in office. Johnson had Texas law changed to allow him to run for both offices at once. As of 2026, this is the last time the Democrats won the Class 2 Senate seat in Texas.

zh.t: 1960年得克萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员林登·B·约翰逊同时竞选美国副总统，并成功连任第三个任期。约翰逊推动修改得克萨斯州法律，使自己可以同时竞选这两个职位。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次赢得得州第二类参议员席位。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts, over the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon of California.

zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，罗得岛州于11月8日举行投票，与当时美国全部50个州同期进行。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持马萨诸塞州民主党籍参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪，击败加利福尼亚州共和党籍副总统理查德·尼克松。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Styles Bridges won re-election to a fifth term in office, defeating Democrat Herbert Hill. Bridges died on November 26, 1961, less than one year after his term began. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1960.

zh.t: 1960年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯击败民主党候选人赫伯特·希尔，成功连任第五个任期。布里奇斯于1961年11月26日去世，距新任期开始不到一年。党内初选于1960年9月13日举行。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 20 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年密歇根州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出20名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得密歇根州，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 59.02% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得59.02%的普选票，赢得俄克拉何马州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: The 1960 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1960, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Thomas Eagleton defeated Republican nominee Donald J. Stohr.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1960年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党候选人托马斯·伊格尔顿击败共和党候选人唐纳德·J·斯托尔。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1960年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得该州，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the vice president of the United States Richard Nixon and the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. defeated the Democratic ticket of the junior U.S. senator from Massachusetts John F. Kennedy and the senior U.S. senator from Texas Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1960年印第安纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年11月8日，印第安纳州举行美国总统选举，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、美国副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败民主党候选人：来自马萨诸塞州的联邦参议院初级议员约翰·F·肯尼迪，以及来自得克萨斯州的联邦参议院资深议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 56.71% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年艾奥瓦州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得56.71%的普选票，赢得艾奥瓦州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 8, 1960, in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 13, 1960.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1960年11月8日举行大选。选举包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、州检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和州审计长等全州职位；也包括联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长顾问等选区职位，以及州和地方层级的公投议题。民主党和共和党的候选人由1960年9月13日举行的党内初选选出。

en.s: The 1960 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 1960. Voters elected all 28 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. At the time, each of Arizona's 14 counties elected two state senators for a total of 28 members of the Arizona Senate. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1960. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a supermajority of 27 seats over the single Republican Senator.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1960年11月8日举行州参议院选举，选出全部28名州参议员，任期两年。当时，该州14个县各选出两名州参议员。党内初选于1960年9月13日举行。选举前，民主党在州参议院占有27席，构成绝对多数；共和党只有1席。

en.s: The 1960 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee John B. Swainson narrowly defeated Republican nominee Paul D. Bagwell with 50.48% of the vote. As of 2026, this remains the last time the elected Governor of Michigan was a member of the same party as the outgoing Governor. In this case, both Swainson and outgoing Governor G. Mennen “Soapy” Williams were Democrats.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·B·斯温森以50.48%的得票率险胜共和党候选人保罗·D·巴格韦尔。截至2026年，这是该州最后一次由与卸任州长同党的候选人当选州长；在这次选举中，斯温森和卸任州长G·梅南·“肥皂泡”·威廉斯都属于民主党。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John L. McClellan was re-elected to a fourth term in office. Because McClellan faced only token opposition in the general election, his unopposed victory in the July 26 primary was tantamount to election.

zh.t: 1960年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿肯色州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·L·麦克莱伦成功连任第四个任期。由于他在大选中只面对象征性的竞争，他在7月26日党内初选中无人挑战、直接胜出，实际上已相当于当选。

en.t: 1960 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1960 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 1960, to elect members to serve in the 87th United States Congress. They coincided with the election of President John F. Kennedy. This was the first house election to feature all 50 current U.S. states. There were 437 seats, the most in U.S. history: 435 from the reapportionment in accordance with the 1950 census, and one seat for each of the new states of Alaska and Hawaii.

zh.s: 美国于1960年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出第87届国会议员。选举与约翰·F·肯尼迪当选总统同期进行。这是首次有美国现有50个州全部参加的联邦众议院选举，共有437个席位，是美国历史上席位最多的一届：435席是根据1950年人口普查结果重新分配的，另有席位分属新加入联邦的阿拉斯加州和夏威夷州。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Gordon Allott was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic Lieutenant Governor Robert Lee Knous.

zh.t: 1960年科罗拉多州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员戈登·阿洛特击败民主党候选人、副州长罗伯特·李·诺斯，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate elections in Oregon
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate elections in Oregon took place on November 8, 1960. First-term Democrat Richard L. Neuberger had been diagnosed with testicular cancer in 1958 that became terminal by 1960 — but was kept from the public. Neuberger remained at home in early 1960, reportedly battling the flu. Though still publicly seeking re-election, he told his campaign chair, attorney Jack Beatty, "Remember, there's always another Neuberger," referring to his wife.

zh.t: 1960年俄勒冈州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1960年俄勒冈州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍首任期参议员理查德·L·纽伯格于1958年被诊断出睾丸癌，到1960年已发展至晚期，但这一情况一直对公众保密。1960年初，纽伯格留在家中休养，据称在与流感抗争。尽管他仍公开表示寻求连任，却告诉竞选主席、律师杰克·比蒂：“记住，总会有另一个纽伯格”，指的是他的妻子。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 54.81 percent of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年犹他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得54.81%的普选票，赢得犹他州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.s: The 1960 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Governor Orval Faubus won election to a fourth term, defeating Republican nominee Henry M. Britt with 69.21% of the vote. That year, Faubus simultaneously ran for president under the white supremacist National States' Rights Party.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以69.21%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨利·M·布里特，赢得第四个任期。同年，福布斯还代表白人至上主义的国家权利党竞选总统。

en.s: The 1960 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Governor J. Caleb Boggs was term-limited, having served two consecutive terms. Boggs instead ran for the U.S. Senate. Democratic nominee former governor Elbert N. Carvel defeated Republican nominee John W. Rollins with 51.73% of the vote. This was the first gubernatorial election in Delaware where a single candidate won over 100,000 votes.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长J·迦勒·博格斯受任期限制，不能竞选第三个连续任期，因此转而竞选联邦参议员。民主党候选人、前州长埃尔伯特·N·卡维尔以51.73%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·W·罗林斯。这是特拉华州州长选举中首次有一名候选人获得超过10万张选票。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Democratic nominee, Senator John F. Kennedy of Massachusetts, over the Republican nominee, Vice President Richard Nixon of California.

zh.t: 1960年美国康涅狄格州总统选举
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，康涅狄格州于11月8日举行投票，与当时美国全部50个州的选举同期进行。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持马萨诸塞州民主党籍参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪，击败加利福尼亚州共和党籍副总统理查德·尼克松。

en.s: The 1960 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Republican nominee John Anderson Jr. defeated Democratic incumbent George Docking with 55.5% of the vote.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人小约翰·安德森以55.5%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长乔治·多金。

en.s: The 1960 Alaska House of Representatives election was held on November 8, 1960, concurrently with the 1960 United States elections to elect members of the Alaska House of Representatives to the 2nd Alaska State Legislature. It was Alaska's first House election as a state. All 40 seats of the House were up for election, with 20 seats being won by Democrats, one by Independent Democrat Robert I.

zh.s: 1960年阿拉斯加州众议院选举于11月8日举行，与1960年美国选举同时举行，选出议员组成阿拉斯加州第二届州议会。这是阿拉斯加州建州后的首次众议院选举。众议院40个席位全部改选，其中20席由民主党赢得，1席由独立民主党人罗伯特·I·迪特曼赢得。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Patrick McNamara was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating U.S. Representative Alvin M. Bentley.

zh.t: 1960年密歇根州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 密歇根州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员帕特里克·麦克纳马拉击败联邦众议员阿尔文·M·本特利，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Karl E. Mundt ran for re-election to his third term. He was challenged by Congressman George McGovern. Both Mundt and McGovern won their respective primaries unopposed and the campaign between the two began. Despite Richard Nixon's landslide victory in the state in the year's presidential election, the race between Mundt and McGovern was quite close.

zh.t: 1960年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1960年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任参议员卡尔·E·蒙特竞选连任第三个任期，众议员乔治·麦戈文向他发起挑战。蒙特和麦戈文均在各自党内初选中无人竞争，随后两人展开普选竞选。尽管理查德·尼克松在当年总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得该州，蒙特与麦戈文的参议员选举仍十分接近。

en.s: The 1960 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic Governor Ralph Herseth was defeated by Republican nominee Archie M. Gubbrud, who won 50.73% of the vote, Gubbrud defeated Herseth again 2 years later.

zh.s: 南达科他州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人阿奇·M·古布鲁德以50.73%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长拉尔夫·赫塞斯。两年后，古布鲁德再次击败赫塞斯。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Republican Senator Andrew Frank Schoeppel won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1960年堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员安德鲁·弗兰克·舍佩尔成功连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For six decades up to 1950 South Carolina was a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1960年美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1960年美国总统选举期间，南卡罗来纳州于11月8日举行投票，选出8名选举人，由他们组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。1950年以前的六十年间，南卡罗来纳州一直由民主党主导，实行一党制。

en.s: The 1960 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee William L. Guy defeated Republican nominee and Lieutenant Governor Clarence P. Dahl with 49.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 北达科他州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·L·盖伊以49.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人、副州长克拉伦斯·P·达尔。

en.s: The 1960 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960, and featured attorney and frequent political candidate Frank B. Morrison, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, state Senator John Cooper. Incumbent Governor Ralph Brooks did not seek re-election, and instead ran for the U.S. Senate. However, on September 9, 1960, Brooks died, elevating Lieutenant Governor Dwight Burney to the governorship for the final months of Brooks's term.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党人、律师兼多次参选的弗兰克·B·莫里森击败共和党候选人、州参议员约翰·库珀。时任州长拉尔夫·布鲁克斯没有争取连任，转而竞选联邦参议员，但于1960年9月9日去世。副州长德怀特·伯尼因此接任州长，完成布鲁克斯任期的最后几个月。

en.s: The 1960 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Prior to the election, on September 9, 1960, Nebraska Governor Ralph G. Brooks died while in office. This caused then Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Dwight Burney to become Governor of Nebraska two months before the election in which he was running for reelection as lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 1960年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1960年11月8日举行副州长选举。州长拉尔夫·G·布鲁克斯于1960年9月9日在任内去世，时任副州长德怀特·伯尼因此接任州长。两个月后举行选举时，伯尼仍竞选连任副州长。

en.s: The 1960 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1960. Democratic nominee Terry Sanford defeated Republican nominee Robert L. Gavin with 54.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1960年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人特里·桑福德以54.45%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·L·加文。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 53.78 percent of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年爱达荷州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得53.78%的普选票，赢得爱达荷州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 1960年阿肯色州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪赢得阿肯色州，他的竞选搭档是参议员林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 55.42% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.t: 1960年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1960年北达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得55.42%的普选票，赢得北达科他州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 50.68% of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年华盛顿州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得50.68%的普选票，赢得华盛顿州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), running with United States Ambassador to the United Nations Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., with 53.59 percent of the popular vote, against Senator John F.

zh.s: 1960年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出10名选举人组成选举人团，由其选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松与竞选搭档、美国驻联合国大使小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇获得53.59%的普选票，赢得肯塔基州；民主党候选人、参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪紧随其后。

en.t: 1960 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1960. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator J. Allen Frear Jr. ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was narrowly defeated by Republican Governor of Delaware J. Caleb Boggs.

zh.t: 1960年特拉华州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 特拉华州于1960年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员小J·艾伦·弗里尔争取连任第三个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党籍州长J·迦勒·博格斯。

en.s: The 1960 United States Senate elections coincided with the election of John F. Kennedy as president on November 8, 1960. The 33 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections. A special election was also held on June 28, 1960, for a mid-term vacancy in North Dakota where Democrats flipped a seat to expand their majority to 66–34.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日，第二组的33个联邦参议院席位举行例行选举，与约翰·F·肯尼迪当选总统的选举同日举行。同年6月28日，北达科他州还因任期中途出现空缺举行特别选举，民主党夺得一个席位，将参议院多数扩大为66席对共和党34席。

en.s: The 1960 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1960, between incumbent Democratic governor Albert Rosellini and State Superintendent of Public Instruction Lloyd J. Andrews, nominated by the Republican Party. Rosellini was re-elected to a second term as Governor of Washington, in a close race with Andrews. The election was the first in Washington state history to feature televised gubernatorial debates.

zh.s: 1960年华盛顿州州长选举于11月8日举行，现任民主党州长阿尔伯特·罗塞利尼对阵共和党提名的州公共教育总监劳埃德·J.安德鲁斯。罗塞利尼在一场势均力敌的选举中击败安德鲁斯，赢得第二个州长任期。这是华盛顿州历史上首次举行电视州长辩论的选举。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 8, 1960, as part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Senator John F. Kennedy (D–Massachusetts), running with Senator Lyndon B.

zh.s: 佐治亚州的1960年美国总统选举于1960年11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出12名代表（选举人）进入选举人团，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪（民主党，马萨诸塞州）在佐治亚州获胜，他与参议员林登·B。

en.s: The 1960 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1960 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1960 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1960年11月8日，美国艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，选民在50个选区中的29个选区选出州参议员。该州参议员每届任期四年。

en.t: 1960 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1960 United States presidential election in Ohio on November 8, was part of the 1960 United States presidential election. Voters chose 25 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio was won by Republican Party candidate, incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon of California, with a 53.28% popular vote majority, defeating Democratic Party candidate and Massachusetts Senator John F.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州的1960年美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出25名代表（选举人）进入选举人团，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州）在俄亥俄州获胜，得票率为53.28%，击败民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·F。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1962
en.s: The 1962 Oregon United States Senate election was held on November 8, 1962 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of Oregon. Democratic Senator Wayne Morse decided to seek re-election for a fourth term. He defeated Republican candidate Sig Unander in the general election.

zh.t: 1962年俄勒冈州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1962年俄勒冈州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行，选出该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍参议员韦恩·莫尔斯决定竞选连任，争取第四个任期，并在普选中击败共和党候选人西格·乌南德。

en.s: The 1962 Labour Party deputy leadership election took place on 8 November 1962, after sitting deputy leader George Brown was challenged by Harold Wilson.

zh.s: 1962年11月8日，英国工党举行副领袖选举。哈罗德·威尔逊挑战时任副领袖乔治·布朗。

en.s: Aero Flight 217 was a domestic passenger flight from Helsinki, Finland, to Mariehamn in the autonomous territory of Åland, operated by the Finnish flag carrier Aero O/Y (now Finnair). On 8 November 1963, the aircraft serving the flight crashed in poor visibility while attempting to land on a non-precision approach at Mariehamn Airport in the municipality of Jomala, resulting in the deaths of 22 people out of 25 on board.

zh.s: Aero 217号航班是芬兰国内客运航班，从赫尔辛基飞往奥兰自治区玛丽港，由芬兰国家航空公司Aero O/Y（现芬兰航空）运营。1963年11月8日，飞机在能见度不佳时尝试以非精密进近方式降落于约马拉市镇的玛丽港机场，随后坠毁。机上25人中有22人遇难。

en.s: General elections were held in Tunisia on 8 November 1964 to elect a President and Chamber of Deputies. A year earlier, the country had been formally declared a one-party state with the Socialist Destourian Party (PSD, formerly the Neo Destour) as the sole legal party. However, the country had effectively been a one-party state since independence in 1956.

zh.s: 突尼斯于1964年11月8日举行大选，选出总统和众议院议员。此前一年，该国正式宣布实行一党制，社会主义宪政党（PSD，前身为新宪政党）成为唯一合法政党。不过，从1956年独立起，突尼斯实际上一直是一党制国家。

en.s: The Battle of Gang Toi (8 November 1965) was fought during the Vietnam War between Australian troops and the Viet Cong. The battle was one of the first engagements between the two forces during the war and occurred when A Company, 1st Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment (1 RAR) struck a Viet Cong bunker system defended by Company 238 in the Gang Toi Hills, in northern Bien Hoa Province. It occurred during a major joint US-Australian operation codenamed Operation Hump, involving the US 173rd Airborne Brigade, to which 1 RAR was attached.

zh.s: 1965年11月8日，越南战争期间，澳大利亚军队与越南共产党武装在冈托伊交战。这是双方在战争中的首次交战之一。当时，澳大利亚皇家团第一营（1 RAR）A连袭击了同奈省北部冈托伊丘陵的越共地堡系统。此次行动属于美国和澳大利亚联合开展的大规模“驼峰行动”；1 RAR隶属参与行动的美国第173空降旅。

en.s: American Airlines Flight 383 was a nonstop flight from New York City to Cincinnati on November 8, 1965. The aircraft was a Boeing 727, with 57 passengers, and 5 crew on board. The aircraft crashed on final approach to the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport located in Hebron, Kentucky, United States. Only three passengers and one flight attendant survived the accident.

zh.t: 美国航空383号航班空难（1965年）
zh.s: 美国航空383号航班于1965年11月8日从纽约市直飞辛辛那提。飞机为波音727，机上有57名乘客和5名机组人员。飞机在最后进近时于美国肯塔基州赫布伦的辛辛那提/北肯塔基国际机场附近坠毁。事故中只有3名乘客和1名空乘人员幸存。

en.s: The 1965 Canadian federal election was held on November 8, 1965, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 27th Parliament of Canada. The Liberal Party of Prime Minister Lester B. Pearson was re-elected to government, winning more seats than any other party. It won more seats in the House even though it received a smaller share of the popular vote.

zh.s: 加拿大于1965年11月8日举行联邦大选，选出第27届国会的众议院议员。总理莱斯特·B·皮尔逊领导的自由党再次执政，赢得的席位多于其他任何政党。尽管自由党的普选票占比有所下降，众议院席位仍有所增加。

en.s: Operation Hump was a search and destroy operation initiated by United States and Australian forces on 5 November 1965, during the Vietnam War. The US-Australian objective was to drive out Viet Cong (VC) unit who had taken up positions on several key hills in War Zone D in an area about 17.5 miles (28.2 km) north of Bien Hoa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “驼峰”行动是越南战争期间的一次搜索与摧毁行动，由美国和澳大利亚部队于1965年11月5日发起。美澳部队的目标是赶走占据D战区几座要地的越共部队；该地区位于边和以北约17.5英里（28.2公里）处。

en.s: The Florida gubernatorial election of 1966 took place on November 8, 1966. During the primary election, the results from the Democratic Party was close among three of the four candidates. Thus, the top two Democrat candidates – incumbent Governor of Florida William "Haydon" Burns and Mayor of Miami Robert King High – competed in a runoff election on May 24, 1966. In an upset outcome, Robert King High was chosen over W. Haydon Burns as the Democratic Gubernatorial nominee. In contrast, the Republican primary was rather uneventful, with businessman Claude Roy Kirk Jr. easily securing the Republican nomination against Richard Muldrew.

zh.s: 1966年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党初选中，四名候选人里有三人的得票接近，因此得票最高的两人——时任州长威廉·“海登”·伯恩斯和迈阿密市长罗伯特·金·海伊——于5月24日参加决选。罗伯特·金·海伊意外击败伯恩斯，成为民主党州长候选人。共和党初选竞争平淡，商人克劳德·罗伊·柯克轻松击败理查德·马尔德鲁，获得提名。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1966
en.s: The 1960 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent United States Senator Lee Metcalf, who was first elected to the Senate in 1960, ran for re-election. He won the Democratic primary uncontested, and moved on to the general election, where he was opposed by Tim M. Babcock, the Republican nominee and the Governor of Montana. Though the race remained close, Metcalf was able to expand on his 1960 margin of victory, and defeated Babcock to win a second term.

zh.t: 1966年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举于1966年11月8日举行。时任联邦参议员李·梅特卡夫于1960年首次当选，此次竞选连任。他在民主党初选中无人挑战，随后进入大选，对手是共和党提名人、蒙大拿州州长蒂姆·M·巴布科克。尽管选情胶着，梅特卡夫仍扩大了相较1960年的胜选幅度，击败巴布科克并赢得第二届任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 1966
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Paul Douglas, seeking a fourth term in the United States Senate, faced off against Republican Charles H. Percy, a businessman and the 1964 Republican nominee for Governor of Illinois. A competitive election ensued, featuring campaign appearances by former Vice-President Richard M. Nixon on behalf of Percy. Ultimately, Percy ended up defeating Senator Douglas by a fairly wide margin, allowing him to win what would be the first of three terms in the Senate.

zh.t: 1966年美国联邦参议院伊利诺伊州选举
zh.s: 1966年11月8日，伊利诺伊州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员保罗·道格拉斯竞选第四个任期，对手是共和党商人查尔斯·H·珀西；珀西曾在1964年代表共和党竞选伊利诺伊州州长。竞选竞争激烈，前副总统理查德·M·尼克松为珀西助选。最终，珀西以较大优势击败道格拉斯，赢得他在参议院的第一个任期。

en.s: The 1966 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina, USA. It marked the first time since the gubernatorial election of 1938 that the Democratic candidate faced opposition from a Republican candidate. Governor Robert Evander McNair prevailed as the winner of the election and continued as the 108th governor of South Carolina, but Joseph O. Rogers, Jr had a respectable showing for the first Republican candidate in 28 years.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。这是自1938年以来首次有共和党候选人挑战民主党州长候选人。州长罗伯特·埃万德·麦克奈尔获胜，继续担任南卡罗来纳州第108任州长。共和党候选人小约瑟夫·O·罗杰斯表现不俗，是该党28年来首位参选州长的人。

en.s: Elections were held on November 8, 1966, unless otherwise noted. Only 35 of the nation's Governors were up for election. The results of the election were that 12 Democrats and 23 Republicans won election, bringing the partisan reflection of the nation's states to 25 Democrats and 25 Republicans. States that did not have a Gubernatorial election in 1966 include: DE, IL, IN, KY, LA, MS, MO, MT, NJ, NC, ND, UT, VA, WA, WV. Of these 15, there were 13 Democrats and 2 Republicans.

zh.s: 除另有说明外，州长选举均于1966年11月8日举行。全美50个州中有35州举行州长选举，结果是12名民主党人和23名共和党人当选，使全美各州州长的党派分布变为民主党25席、共和党25席。1966年未举行州长选举的15个州是特拉华、伊利诺伊、印第安纳、肯塔基、路易斯安那、密西西比、密苏里、蒙大拿、新泽西、北卡罗来纳、北达科他、犹他、弗吉尼亚、华盛顿和西弗吉尼亚。这15州的州长中有13名民主党人和2名共和党人。

en.t: United States Senate special election in South Carolina, 1966
en.s: The 1966 South Carolina United States Senate special election was held on November 8, 1966 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina. The election resulted from the death of Senator Olin D. Johnston in 1965. Then Governor Donald S. Russell entered in a prearranged agreement with Lieutenant Governor Robert Evander McNair in which Russell would resign his post so that he could be appointed Senator. However, former Governor Fritz Hollings won the Democratic primary election and went on to beat Republican state senator Marshall Parker in the general election to fill the remaining two years of the unexpired term.

zh.t: 1966年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1966年11月8日，南卡罗来纳州举行联邦参议院特别选举，以选出该州联邦参议员。奥林·D·约翰斯顿参议员于1965年去世，因而触发特别选举。当时州长唐纳德·S·罗素与副州长罗伯特·埃万德·麦克奈尔事先达成协议：罗素辞去州长职务，以便获任命为参议员。然而，前州长弗里茨·霍林斯赢得民主党初选，并在普选中击败共和党州参议员马歇尔·帕克，赢得剩余两年任期。

en.s: The Maryland gubernatorial election of 1966 was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic Governor J. Millard Tawes was unable to seek a third term in office. In the election to succeed him, George P. Mahoney, a controversial segregationist, emerged from the Democratic primary due to splintered support for the two major candidates. Baltimore County Executive Spiro Agnew, who would later go on to be selected by Richard M. Nixon as his running mate in 1968, was nominated by the Republican Party as their gubernatorial candidate. Mahoney and Agnew squared off, along with independent candidate Hyman A. Pressman.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长J·米勒德·陶斯受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。继任者选举中，两名主要候选人支持率分散，颇具争议的民主党隔离主义者乔治·P·马奥尼因此赢得党内初选。巴尔的摩县行政长官斯皮罗·阿格纽获共和党提名，后来在1968年成为理查德·M·尼克松的竞选搭档。马奥尼、阿格纽和独立候选人海曼·A·普雷斯曼参加了普选。

en.s: The Alabama gubernatorial election of 1966 took place on November 8, 1966, and saw the election of Lurleen Burns Wallace as Governor over U.S. Representative James D. Martin.

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 1966
en.s: The 1966 South Carolina United States Senate election was held on November 8, 1966 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina simultaneously with the special election to fill out the remainder of Olin D. Johnston's term. Incumbent Senator Strom Thurmond, who had switched parties from Democratic to Republican in 1964, easily defeated state senator Bradley Morrah in the general election.

zh.t: 1966年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1966年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行，同时举行特别选举，以填补奥林·D·约翰斯顿任期剩余的部分。时任参议员斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德于1964年从民主党转投共和党，他在普选中轻松击败州参议员布拉德利·莫拉。

en.s: The Arkansas gubernatorial election of November 8, 1966 was the first time since Reconstruction that a member of the Republican Party was elected governor. The same year, during a midterm election, Republicans made some gains in the traditionally Democratic southern stronghold – including winning the governorship in Florida (also first time since Reconstruction), and narrowly losing the gubernatorial race in Georgia (when a GOP candidate won a plurality, but the Democratic-controlled legislature selected their own candidate).

zh.s: 1966年11月8日举行的阿肯色州州长选举中，共和党人首次在重建时期结束后当选州长。同年中期选举期间，共和党在传统上由民主党占优势的南方取得了一些进展：他们也首次在重建时期结束后赢得佛罗里达州州长选举；在佐治亚州，共和党候选人虽以相对多数胜出，但由民主党控制的州议会选出了民主党候选人，因此共和党最终落败。

en.s: The 1966 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966 for the post of governor of Alaska. Republican challenger Walter Hickel narrowly defeated incumbent Democratic governor Bill Egan, falling just 3 votes short of an overall majority.

zh.s: 1966年阿拉斯加州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。共和党挑战者沃尔特·希克尔以3票之差未能获得过半数，但仍险胜民主党籍时任州长比尔·伊根。

en.s: The 1966 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Connally was easily reelected to a third term, winning 73% of the vote to Republican T.E. Kennerly's 26%. The election is, to date, the last time that a candidate for governor won more than 70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1966年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任民主党州长约翰·康纳利轻松连任，开启第三个任期，得票率为73%；共和党候选人T·E·肯纳利获得26%。这是迄今最后一次有州长候选人的得票率超过70%。

en.s: The Nevada gubernatorial election of 1966 occurred on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democrat Grant Sawyer ran unsuccessfully for re-election to a third term as Governor of Nevada. He was defeated by Republican candidate Paul Laxalt.

zh.s: 1966年内华达州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任民主党州长格兰特·索耶竞选连任，争取第三个任期，但未能成功，败给共和党候选人保罗·拉克萨尔特。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1966 took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democrat Philip H. Hoff ran successfully for re-election to a third term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Republican candidate Richard A. Snelling.

zh.s: 1966年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月8日举行。时任民主党州长菲利普·H·霍夫成功连任，争取第三个任期，并击败共和党候选人理查德·A·斯内林。

en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 8, 1966. Democratic State Senator William Spong, Jr. defeated Republican James Ould and Independent F. Lee Hawthorne.

zh.s: 1966年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍州参议员小威廉·斯庞击败共和党人詹姆斯·奥尔德和独立候选人F·李·霍桑。

en.s: The 1966 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Governor John A. Volpe was reelected to a four-year term. He defeated former Attorney General Edward J. McCormack, Jr. in the general election. This was the first election held since Governor's Term of office was extended from two to four years.

zh.s: 1966年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行。州长约翰·A·沃尔普成功连任，开始四年任期，并在普选中击败前总检察长小爱德华·J·麦科马克。这是州长任期从两年延长至四年后举行的首次选举。

en.s: The 1966 gubernatorial election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 1966. Republican Warren P. Knowles won the election with 54% of the vote, winning his second term as Governor of Wisconsin and defeating Democrat Patrick Lucey.

zh.s: 1966年威斯康星州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党人沃伦·P·诺尔斯以54%的得票率获胜，击败民主党人帕特里克·卢西，赢得第二个州长任期。

en.s: The Oregon gubernatorial election of 1966 took place on November 8, 1966. Republican nominee Tom McCall defeated Democratic nominee Robert W. Straub to win the election.

en.s: The 1966 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Harold Levander defeated Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party challenger Karl Rolvaag.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1966
en.s: The 1966 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 1966 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. All six incumbents were re-elected and the composition of the state delegation remained five Democrats and one Republican.

zh.t: 1966年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1966年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，任期两年。6名时任议员均成功连任，该州代表团仍由5名民主党人和1名共和党人组成。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Virginia, 1966
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate special election in Virginia was held on November 8, 1966 alongside the other U.S. Senate election in Virginia. Incumbent Senator Harry F. Byrd, Sr. had retired the previous year due to health reasons, and his son Harry F. Byrd, Jr. had been appointed to replace him. Byrd defeated Republican Lawrence M. Traylor and independent candidate John W.

zh.t: 1966年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1966年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举于11月8日举行，同时该州还举行了常规联邦参议员选举。时任参议员哈里·F·伯德因健康原因于前一年退休，其子哈里·F·伯德二世获任命接替他。伯德击败共和党候选人劳伦斯·M·特雷勒和弗吉尼亚州保守党候选人约翰·W·卡特，完成父亲第六届任期剩余部分。由于伯德于1970年改换党籍，这也是民主党直到1988年才再次赢得该席位的最后一次。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1966
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1966 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 8, 1966. Republicans gained three seats from the Democrats. There was a mid-decade redistricting of the California districts in 1966.

zh.t: 1966年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1966年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举旨在选出该州的联邦众议员，于11月8日与联邦众议院普选同时举行。共和党从民主党手中赢得3个席位。加州选区在1966年进行了一次十年中期的重新划分。

en.s: The 1966 Hawaii gubernatorial election was Hawaii's third gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 8, 1966, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic candidate, incumbent Governor of Hawaii John A. Burns over Republican candidate, State Senator Randolph Crossley. Despite the close race, Burns received more votes than Crossley in every county in the state except Honolulu, which Crossley won by less than one percentage point.

zh.s: 1966年夏威夷州州长选举是该州第三次州长选举，于11月8日举行。民主党候选人、时任州长约翰·A·伯恩斯击败共和党候选人、州参议员兰道夫·克罗斯利，成功连任。尽管选情接近，伯恩斯在除火奴鲁鲁以外的每个县都比克罗斯利得票多；克罗斯利在火奴鲁鲁仅以不到一个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1966
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1966 in Massachusetts was held on November 8, 1966 with Republican State Attorney General Edward Brooke defeating his challengers. Republican incumbent, Leverett Saltonstall, was retiring after serving for 22 years.

zh.t: 1966年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1966年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍州总检察长爱德华·布鲁克击败对手。共和党籍时任参议员莱韦雷特·索尔顿斯托尔在任职22年后退休。

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1966 was held on November 8, 1966. The election was a contest between incumbent Governor Pat Brown, the Democratic candidate, and actor Ronald Reagan, the Republican candidate. Reagan mobilized conservative voters and defeated Brown.

zh.s: 1966年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人、时任州长帕特·布朗与共和党候选人、演员罗纳德·里根展开角逐。里根动员保守派选民，击败布朗。
