en.s: The 1966 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joseph L. Donovan defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for the 45th District William J. O'Brien.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1966年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿约瑟夫·L·多诺万击败共和党候选人威廉·J·奥布莱恩。奥布莱恩当时是明尼苏达州众议院第45选区的现任众议员。

en.s: The 1966 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Governor John Reed was defeated by the Democratic Secretary of State Kenneth M. Curtis. Reed had assumed the office of Governor of Maine in 1959, following the death of incumbent Democrat Clinton Clauson. Reed was elected to finish Clauson's term in a 1960 special election, and was then re-elected in 1962 and became the first person to serve a full four-year term as Governor of Maine.

zh.s: 缅因州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长约翰·里德败给民主党籍州务卿肯尼斯·M·柯蒂斯。1959年，民主党籍州长克林顿·克劳森去世后，里德接任州长；他在1960年特别选举中当选，完成克劳森未满的任期，随后于1962年连任，并成为首位完整任职四年的缅因州州长。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Clifford P. Case defeated Democratic nominee Warren W. Wilentz with 60.02% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1966. Case was unopposed, while Wilentz easily won his primary over Dr. David Frost, who opposed the Vietnam War, and John J.

zh.t: 1966年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1966年新泽西州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任参议员克利福德·P·凯斯以60.02%的得票率击败民主党候选人沃伦·W·威伦茨。初选于9月13日举行。凯斯没有对手；威伦茨则轻松击败反对州销售税的约翰·J·温伯里，赢得党内提名。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator John Sherman Cooper was elected to a second consecutive term in office, defeating Democrat John Y. Brown Sr. in a rematch of the 1946 special election. This would be the first statewide election in Kentucky in which a Republican won Elliott County, and the only one until 2016 when Donald Trump won the county for president.

zh.t: 1966年肯塔基州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 肯塔基州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员约翰·谢尔曼·库珀击败民主党人老约翰·Y·布朗，当选并连续担任第二个任期。这是两人在1946年特别选举后的再次交锋。这是肯塔基州首次有共和党人在全州选举中赢得艾略特县；直到2016年唐纳德·特朗普在总统选举中赢得该县之前，此后没有其他共和党候选人做到这一点。

en.s: The 1966 Alabama State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1966, to elect the Alabama State Treasurer to a four-year term. The primary election was held on May 3, 1966, and the primary runoff was held on May 31, 1966.

zh.t: 1966年阿拉巴马州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1966年11月8日举行州财政部长选举，选出任期四年的州财政部长。党内初选于1966年5月3日举行，初选决选于5月31日举行。

en.s: The 1966 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democrat Harold Hughes defeated Republican nominee William G. Murray with 55.34% of the vote. This was the last time a Democrat was elected governor of Iowa until 1998.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长哈罗德·休斯以55.34%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·G·默里。这是民主党直到1998年才再次在艾奥瓦州赢得州长选举。

en.s: The 1966 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Governor Nils Boe defeated Democratic nominee Robert Chamberlin with 57.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 南达科他州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长尼尔斯·博以57.71%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·张伯伦。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 8, 1966, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Republican nominee Howard Baker won the election, defeating Democratic nominee and Tennessee Governor Frank G. Clement with 55.7% of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年田纳西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 田纳西州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，与其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各级州和地方选举同期进行。共和党候选人霍华德·贝克以55.7%的得票率击败民主党候选人、田纳西州州长弗兰克·G·克莱门特。

en.s: The 1966 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican John Arthur Love defeated Democratic nominee Robert Lee Knous with 54.05% of the vote.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长约翰·亚瑟·洛夫以54.05%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·李·诺斯。

en.s: The 1966 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democrat John W. King defeated Republican nominee Hugh Gregg with 53.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约翰·W·金以53.88%的得票率击败共和党候选人休·格雷格。

en.s: The 1966 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent governor Samuel Pearson Goddard ran for reelection to a second term as governor, narrowly winning the Democratic Party nomination as he was challenged by Justice of the Peace Norman Green. Goddard went on to lose the general election to former mayor of Phoenix Jack Williams. This is the last time that an incumbent governor of Arizona lost reelection.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。时任州长塞缪尔·皮尔逊·戈达德争取连任第二个任期，在与太平绅士诺曼·格林竞争后，以微弱优势赢得民主党提名。戈达德随后在大选中败给菲尼克斯前市长杰克·威廉斯。这是亚利桑那州时任州长在连任竞选中落败的最后一次。

en.s: The 1966 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Democrat Jack M. Campbell could not run for reelection to a third term. Republican David Cargo defeated Democrat Gene Lusk in a close race.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长杰克·M·坎贝尔受任期限制，不能争取连任第三个任期。共和党人戴维·卡戈在一场势均力敌的选举中击败民主党人吉恩·拉斯克。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator Len Jordan was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic U.S. Representative Ralph Harding.

zh.t: 1966年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 爱达荷州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员伦·乔丹击败民主党籍联邦众议员拉尔夫·哈丁，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1966 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Charles S. Bresler.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1966年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任州审计长路易斯·L·戈尔茨坦击败共和党候选人查尔斯·S·布雷斯勒。

en.s: The 1966 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican George W. Romney defeated Democratic nominee Zolton Ferency with 60.54% of the vote. This election marked the first time the governor was elected to a four-year term, following the adoption of new state constitution in 1963.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长乔治·W·罗姆尼以60.54%的得票率击败民主党候选人佐尔坦·费伦齐。这是密歇根州根据1963年新州宪法首次选举四年任期的州长。

en.s: The 1966 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Governor Clifford Hansen declined to seek a second term, instead opting to run for the U.S. Senate. Stanley Hathaway, the former Goshen County Prosecuting Attorney, won the Republican primary, and faced attorney Ernest Wilkerson, the Democratic nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 1966年怀俄明州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任州长克利福德·汉森决定不竞选连任第二个任期，转而竞选联邦参议员。前戈申县检察官斯坦利·海瑟薇赢得共和党初选，并在普选中面对民主党候选人、律师欧内斯特·威尔克森。

en.s: The 1966 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Robert E. Hansen.

zh.t: 1966年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1966年11月8日举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任州审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主党—农工党候选人罗伯特·E·汉森。

en.s: The 1966 Macon County Sheriff election was held on November 8, 1966, to elect the sheriff of Macon County, Alabama. The primary election was held on May 3, and the primary runoff was held on May 31.

zh.t: 1966年阿拉巴马州梅肯县警长选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州梅肯县于1966年11月8日举行警长选举，选出任期四年的警长。党内初选于5月3日举行，初选决选于5月31日举行。

en.s: The 1966 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966, and featured former Wausa Mayor Norbert Tiemann, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, Lieutenant Governor Philip Sorensen. This was the first gubernatorial election in Nebraska in which the term in office was extended from two to four years, with a limit of two consecutive terms.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党候选人、前沃萨市市长诺伯特·蒂曼击败民主党候选人、副州长菲利普·索伦森。这是该州首次将州长任期从两年延长至四年，并规定最多连续担任两个任期。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic Senator Thomas J. McIntyre won re-election to a full term, having first been elected in a special election in 1962. This was the first time that a Democrat was reelected to the Senate from New Hampshire.

zh.t: 1966年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员托马斯·J·麦金太尔成功当选完整任期；他此前于1962年在特别选举中首次当选。这是民主党人首次在新罕布什尔州成功连任联邦参议员。

en.s: The 1966 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican John Chafee defeated Democratic nominee Horace E. Hobbs with 63.30% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长约翰·查菲以63.30%的得票率击败民主党候选人霍勒斯·E·霍布斯。

en.s: The 1966 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966, and featured political newcomer John Everroad, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Ross Rasmussen, a member of the Nebraska Legislature.

zh.t: 1966年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1966年11月8日举行副州长选举。共和党政治新秀约翰·埃弗罗德击败民主党候选人罗斯·拉斯穆森；拉斯穆森是内布拉斯加州议会议员。

en.s: The 1966 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Douglas M. Head defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Wayne H. Olson. To date, this is the last time a Republican won the attorney general's office in Minnesota.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1966年11月8日举行州检察长选举。共和党候选人、前州众议员道格拉斯·M·黑德击败民主党—农工党候选人韦恩·H·奥尔森。截至目前，这是共和党人最后一次赢得明尼苏达州检察长职位。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jennings Randolph won re-election to a third term and a second full term.

zh.t: 1966年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员詹宁斯·伦道夫成功连任第三个任期，也是第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 1966 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Jim Rhodes defeated Democratic nominee Frazier Reams Jr. with 62.18% of the vote. This election was the first time since 1942 that an incumbent Republican Governor of Ohio was re-elected.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长吉姆·罗兹以62.18%的得票率击败民主党候选人小弗雷泽·里姆斯。这是共和党籍时任州长自1942年以来首次在俄亥俄州成功连任。

en.s: The 1966 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Republican nominee Robert Finch defeated Democratic incumbent Glenn M. Anderson with 59.79% of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于1966年11月8日举行副州长选举。共和党候选人罗伯特·芬奇以59.79%的得票率击败民主党籍时任副州长格伦·M·安德森。

en.s: The 1966 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 8, 1966, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Harold M. Mulvey was appointed to the office by Governor John N. Dempsey in 1963 to fill the vacancy left by Albert L. Coles, who resigned to become judge of the Connecticut Superior Court.

zh.t: 1966年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1966年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长哈罗德·M·马尔维于1963年由州长约翰·N·邓普西任命上任，以填补艾伯特·L·科尔斯辞职后留下的空缺；科尔斯辞职是为了出任康涅狄格州高等法院法官。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Tower was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic Attorney General of Texas Waggoner Carr. Tower became the first Republican ever reelected to the Senate from Texas or any former Confederate state.

zh.t: 1966年得克萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·陶尔击败民主党候选人、得克萨斯州检察长瓦格纳·卡尔，成功连任第二个任期。陶尔是德州以及任何前邦联州历史上首位成功连任联邦参议员的共和党人。

en.t: 1966 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1966 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 8, 1966, to elect members to serve in the 90th United States Congress. They occurred in the middle of President Lyndon B. Johnson's second term.

zh.s: 美国于1966年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出第90届国会议员。选举在林登·B·约翰逊总统第二个任期中段举行。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic Senator B. Everett Jordan was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican businessman John Shallcross. Democrats would not win this seat again until 2008.

zh.t: 1966年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员B·埃弗里特·乔丹击败共和党商人约翰·沙尔克罗斯，成功连任第二个任期。民主党直到2008年才再次赢得这个席位。

en.s: The 1966 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. The election pitted Democratic Robert Docking against incumbent Republican William H. Avery. On the campaign trail, Docking attacked Avery for his administration's unpopular income and sales tax hikes. Avery was also hurt by a contentious court ordered school district unification process that took place during his term.

zh.s: 1966年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人罗伯特·多金与共和党籍现任州长威廉·H·艾弗里展开竞争。竞选期间，多金批评艾弗里政府不得人心的所得税和销售税上调。艾弗里还因任内一项有争议、由法院命令实施的学区合并程序而受损。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Margaret Chase Smith was re-elected to a fourth term over Democratic State Senator Elmer H. Violette.

zh.s: 缅因州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员玛格丽特·蔡斯·史密斯击败民主党籍州参议员埃尔默·H·维奥莱特，成功连任第四个任期。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Bob Bartlett was re-elected to a third term in office in a landslide, defeating Republican dentist Lee McKinley in a rematch of their 1960 race. Bartlett would not complete the term, dying in office on December 11, 1968, following complications after heart surgery.

zh.t: 1966年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员鲍勃·巴特利特在与共和党候选人、牙医李·麦金利的再次交锋中，以压倒性优势成功连任第三个任期。1968年12月11日，巴特利特因心脏手术后的并发症在任内去世，未能完成任期。

en.s: The 1966 Massachusetts general election was held on November 8, 1966, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 13. At the federal level, Republican Edward Brooke was elected to the United States Senate over Democrat Endicott Peabody and Democrats won seven of twelve seats in the United States House of Representatives. Former Speaker of the House Joseph W.

zh.s: 1966年马萨诸塞州普选于11月8日在全州举行，初选于9月13日举行。在联邦层面，共和党人爱德华·布鲁克当选联邦参议员，击败民主党人恩迪科特·皮博迪；民主党人赢得联邦众议院12个席位中的7席。前众议院议长约瑟夫·W·马丁二世在共和党初选中输给玛格丽特·赫克勒，成为唯一未能连任的现任议员。

en.t: 1966 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1966 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 8, 1966, to elect the state's at-large representative. This election was held alongside the state's governor election. Incumbent Democrat, Walter S. Baring Jr. won re-election to another term in Congress by a landslide margin of 32.37% also carrying every county in the state with over 60 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 内华达州于1966年11月8日（星期二）举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州唯一的众议员。选举与该州州长选举同期举行。民主党籍时任众议员小沃尔特·S·巴林以32.37个百分点的优势大胜连任，得票率超过60%，并赢得州内所有县。

en.s: The 1966 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Haskell Holman defeated Republican nominee William T. Zimmerman.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1966年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任州审计长哈斯克尔·霍尔曼击败共和党候选人威廉·T·齐默曼。

en.t: 1966 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1966 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 8, 1966 to elect the state's two At-large representatives. This would be the last time New Mexico would use at-large districts instead of Single-member districts.

zh.t: 1966年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1966年11月8日（星期二）举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州两名全州范围内的众议员。这是新墨西哥州最后一次采用全州范围的选区，此后改用单一议员选区。

en.s: The 1966 Florida Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the Attorney General of Florida. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Earl Faircloth was re-elected to a second term against Republican challenger Ellis Rubin.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1966年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党籍时任检察长厄尔·费尔克洛斯击败共和党挑战者埃利斯·鲁宾，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in New Mexico was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Clinton Anderson won re-election to a fourth term. Democrats would not win this seat again until 2008.

zh.t: 1966年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员克林顿·安德森成功连任第四个任期。民主党直到2008年才再次赢得这个席位。

en.s: The 1966 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 1966. Voters elected all 30 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. Following the landmark Reynolds v. Sims (1964) US Supreme Court decision, every state had to redraw state electoral districts to be approximately equal in population. Before Reynolds, the Arizona Senate consisted of 28 members with two elected Senators from each of the state's 14 counties.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1966年11月8日举行州参议院选举，选出全部30名州参议员，任期两年。美国最高法院在1964年作出“雷诺兹诉西姆斯案”裁决后，各州都必须重新划分州级选区，使各选区人口大致相等。在此之前，亚利桑那州参议院有28名成员，该州14个县各选出两名参议员。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator J. Caleb Boggs was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic nominee James M. Tunnell Jr. As of 2024, this is the last time Republicans won Delaware's Class 2 Senate seat.

zh.t: 1966年特拉华州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 特拉华州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员J·迦勒·博格斯击败民主党候选人小詹姆斯·M·塔内尔，成功连任第二个任期。截至2024年，这是共和党人最后一次赢得特拉华州第二类参议员席位。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 8, 1966. Primaries were held on June 14, 1966.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1966年11月8日（星期二）举行选举。党内初选于1966年6月14日举行。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Claiborne Pell successfully sought re-election, defeating Republican Ruth M. Briggs with 67.66% of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 罗得岛州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员克莱伯恩·佩尔以67.66%的得票率击败共和党候选人露丝·M·布里格斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 1966 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1966. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate James B. Goetz defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger Robert E. Short.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1966年11月8日举行副州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人詹姆斯·B·戈茨击败明尼苏达州民主党—农工党候选人罗伯特·E·肖特。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator Jack Miller was re-elected to a second term in office over Democrat E.B. Smith. After this race, no incumbent would be re-elected to either of Iowa's Senate seats until Chuck Grassley was elected to his second term 20 years later.

zh.t: 1966年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员杰克·米勒击败民主党人E·B·史密斯，成功连任第二个任期。在这次选举之后，艾奥瓦州两个参议员席位的时任议员都没有再连任，直到20年后查克·格拉斯利赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1966 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee Francis B. Burch defeated Republican nominee William O. Doub.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1966年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党候选人弗朗西斯·B·伯奇击败共和党候选人威廉·O·道布。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator Carl Curtis ran for a third term and was challenged by Governor Frank B. Morrison, the Democratic nominee. While Morrison had been re-elected as Governor in 1964 by a wide margin, the nationwide environment favored Republican candidates, and Curtis was re-elected overwhelmingly, defeating Morrison with 61% of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员卡尔·柯蒂斯争取第三个任期，对手是民主党候选人、州长弗兰克·B·莫里森。莫里森曾在1964年以较大优势连任州长，但当年全国选举形势有利于共和党。柯蒂斯最终以61%的得票率大胜莫里森，成功连任。

en.s: The 1966 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Frank G. Clement was term-limited and was prohibited by the Constitution of Tennessee from seeking another term. Former Democratic governor Buford Ellington defeated both independent candidates H.L. Crowder and Charlie Moffett with 81.2% of the vote.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长弗兰克·G·克莱门特受任期限制，依据《田纳西州宪法》不能再争取一个任期。民主党前州长布福德·埃灵顿以81.2%的得票率击败两名独立候选人H·L·克劳德和查理·莫菲特。

en.s: The 1966 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 1966, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The sole non-Democrat to win a seat was conservative Republican Leland Childs of Jefferson County. Childs was the first Republican state senator elected in decades. The Democratic primaries were held on May 3 with runoffs on May 31, which candidates had until March 1 to qualify for.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1966年11月8日（星期二）举行州参议院选举，选出35名任期四年的州参议员。唯一当选的非民主党人是杰斐逊县保守派共和党人利兰·柴尔兹。他是数十年来首位当选的共和党籍州参议员。民主党初选于5月3日举行，初选决选于5月31日举行，候选人必须在3月1日前完成参选登记。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 8, 1966, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James B. Pearson defeated Democratic nominee James Floyd Breeding with 52.15% of the vote.

zh.t: 1966年堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，与其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各级州和地方选举同期进行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员詹姆斯·B·皮尔森以52.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·弗洛伊德·布里丁。

en.t: 1966 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1966 United States Virgin Islands legislative election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1966, to elect members of the 7th Virgin Islands Legislature. Voters were allowed to choose multiple candidates per district. The 1966 Amending Act set the number of senators to fifteen, and set the number of senators elected per district as follows: Four elected at-large Five from Saint Thomas Five from Saint Croix One from Saint John The senators elected incumbent Earle B.

zh.s: 1966年美属维尔京群岛立法机构选举于11月8日星期二举行，选出第七届维尔京群岛议会的议员。选民可以在各选区选择多名候选人。1966年修正法案将参议员人数定为15人：全区选举4人、圣托马斯选区5人、圣克罗伊选区5人、圣约翰选区1人。当选参议员推举现任议员Earle B. Ottley担任议长。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 8, 1966. First-term Republican Senator Milward Simpson, who was first elected in the 1962 special election, declined to seek re-election because of his declining health. Governor Clifford Hansen won the Republican primary and faced Democratic Congressman Teno Roncalio in the general election. Despite the strong performance by Republicans nationwide, and the strong Republican victory in the gubernatorial election, the race was quite close.

zh.t: 1966年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1966年怀俄明州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍首任期参议员米尔沃德·辛普森曾于1962年特别选举中首次当选，但因健康状况日益恶化而决定不竞选连任。州长克利福德·汉森赢得共和党初选，并在普选中面对民主党籍联邦众议员特诺·朗卡利奥。尽管共和党在全国表现强劲，且在州长选举中大胜，这场参议员选举仍十分接近。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator Gordon Allott was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democratic State Senator Roy Romer. Romer would later be elected three terms as Treasurer of Colorado and another three terms as governor.

zh.t: 1966年科罗拉多州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员戈登·阿洛特击败民主党候选人、州参议员罗伊·罗默，成功连任第三个任期。罗默后来三度当选科罗拉多州财政部长，又三度当选州长。

en.s: The 1966 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Republican Dewey F. Bartlett defeated Democrat Preston J. Moore and Independent H. E. Ingram. John Newbold Camp unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination, while former governor Raymond D. Gary, then-Tulsa County district attorney and future governor David Hall, attorney general Charles R.

zh.s: 1966年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党候选人杜威·F·巴特利特击败民主党候选人普雷斯顿·J·摩尔和独立候选人H. E. 英格拉姆。约翰·纽博尔德·坎普未能赢得共和党提名；前州长雷蒙德·D·加里、当时的塔尔萨县检察官兼未来州长戴维·霍尔、州总检察长查尔斯·R·内斯比特，以及前州参议员基思·卡特赖特均未能赢得民主党提名。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Republican Senator Karl E. Mundt ran for re-election to his fourth term. He was challenged in the Republican primary by a John Birch Society member, but easily turned away the challenge. In the general election, he faced State Representative Donn Wright, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 1966年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1966年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍现任参议员卡尔·E·蒙特竞选连任第四个任期。他在共和党初选中受到一名约翰·伯奇协会成员挑战，但轻松击退了对方。普选中，他面对民主党候选人、州众议员唐·赖特。

en.s: The 1966 Alabama Superintendent of Education election was held on November 8, 1966, to elect the Alabama Superintendent of Education to a four-year term. The primary election was held on May 3. This election was the final election to the superintendent office, becoming a position appointed by the Alabama State Board of Education.

zh.t: 1966年阿拉巴马州教育总监选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1966年11月8日举行教育总监选举，选出任期四年的教育总监。党内初选于5月3日举行。这是阿拉巴马州最后一次通过选举产生教育总监，此后该职位改由州教育委员会任命。

en.t: 1966 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The Alaska congressional election of 1966 was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1966. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1967. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1967, to January 3, 1969. Incumbent representative Ralph Rivers lost re-election to a fifth term by a margin of 3.2%.

zh.t: 1966年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于1966年11月8日（星期二）举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州唯一的联邦众议员。该议员的任期于1967年1月3日届满，新当选者将于1967年1月3日至1969年1月3日任职两年。民主党籍时任众议员拉尔夫·里弗斯争取第五个任期，但以3.2%的差距落败。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1966. Democratic Senator Fred R. Harris ran for re-election to a second term, and his first full term. After winning an easy victory in the Democratic primary, he faced attorney Pat J. Patterson, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Patterson wasn't viewed as a strong candidate against Harris, but the national Republican landslide helped make the race somewhat close.

zh.t: 1966年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍参议员弗雷德·R·哈里斯争取连任第二个任期，这也是他的第一个完整任期。他在民主党初选中轻松获胜，随后在大选中对阵共和党候选人、律师帕特·J·帕特森。帕特森被认为实力不强，但共和党在全国选举中大胜，使这场选举变得较为接近。

en.t: 1966 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Walter Mondale, who had originally been appointed in 1964 to replace Hubert Humphrey after Humphrey was elected Vice President of the United States, defeated Republican challenger Robert A. Forsythe, to win a full term.

zh.t: 1966年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1966年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员沃尔特·蒙代尔击败共和党挑战者罗伯特·A·福赛斯，当选完整任期。蒙代尔最初于1964年获任命，接替当选美国副总统的休伯特·汉弗莱。

en.s: The 1966 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 1966. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in new multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. House, and State Senate. Following the landmark Reynolds v. Sims (1964) US Supreme Court decision, every state had to redraw state electoral districts to be approximately equal in population.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1966年11月8日举行州众议院选举，在新划定的多议员选区选出全部60名众议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦众议院和州参议院等其他职位的选举同期进行。美国最高法院1964年作出具有里程碑意义的“雷诺兹诉西姆斯案”裁决后，各州都必须重新划分州级选区，使各选区人口大致相等。

en.t: 1966 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1966 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 8, 1966, to decide who would represent Delaware's at-large congressional district in the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Representative Harris McDowell ran for re-election to a sixth term but lost to Republican challenger William Roth by 11 percentage points. Prior to the election, the seat was regarded as being a safe Democratic seat.

zh.t: 1966年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 特拉华州于1966年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，决定由谁代表该州全州范围的选区进入联邦众议院。民主党籍时任众议员哈里斯·麦克道尔争取第六个任期，但以11个百分点之差败给共和党挑战者威廉·罗斯。选前，这个席位被认为稳属民主党。

en.s: The 1966 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966. Incumbent Democrat John N. Dempsey defeated Republican nominee E. Clayton Gengras with 55.68% of the vote. In 1962, Connecticut voters overwhelmingly approved of 5 Constitutional Amendments placed on the ballot. Among these was a proposition to end the Governor and Lieutenant Governor from running separately in an election, which won, 81% to 19%.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约翰·N·邓普西以55.68%的得票率击败共和党候选人E·克莱顿·坚格拉斯。1962年，康涅狄格州选民以压倒性多数通过了5项宪法修正案。其中一项修正案规定，州长和副州长不再分别参加选举，最终以81%对19%的票数通过。

en.s: The 1966 United States Senate elections were elections on November 8, 1966, for the United States Senate which occurred midway through the second (and only full) term of President Lyndon B. Johnson. The 33 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，美国举行联邦参议院选举，当时正值总统林登·B·约翰逊第二个、也是唯一完整任期的中期。第二组的33个席位进行例行改选，另有特别选举填补空缺。

en.s: The 1966 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1966, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Georgia House of Representatives George T. Smith ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、时任州众议员乔治·T·史密斯在没有对手的情况下参选并当选。

en.s: The 1966 New York gubernatorial election was held in the US state on November 8, 1966, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Republican Nelson Rockefeller won reelection. As of 2022, this is the last time Manhattan (New York County) voted for a Republican in a statewide election.

zh.s: 1966年纽约州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出州长和副州长。现任共和党州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒赢得连任。截至2022年，这是曼哈顿（纽约县）最后一次在全州选举中投票支持共和党。

en.s: The 1966 Georgia gubernatorial election was held in the U.S. state on November 8, 1966. After an election that exposed divisions within the Georgia Democratic Party (giving the Georgia Republican Party a shot at the Governor's Mansion for the first time in the twentieth century), segregationist Democrat Lester Maddox was elected Governor of Georgia. The voting also brought future President Jimmy Carter to statewide prominence for the first time.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于1966年11月8日举行州长选举。选举暴露了佐治亚州民主党内部的分歧，也让共和党首次在20世纪有机会赢得州长职位。最终，支持种族隔离的民主党人莱斯特·马多克斯当选州长。此次投票也让未来总统吉米·卡特首次在全州范围内崭露头角。

en.s: The 1966 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Republican nominee Don Samuelson defeated Democratic nominee Cecil Andrus with 41.4% of the vote in a four-way race (two independents). In early August, three-term incumbent Robert E. Smylie, the dean of American governors, was soundly defeated in the Republican primary by Samuelson. Andrus was a close runner-up in the Democratic primary to Charles Herndon, who was killed in a plane crash six weeks later in September.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，爱达荷州举行州长选举。共和党候选人唐·塞缪尔森在四人竞选中获得41.4%的选票，击败民主党候选人塞西尔·安德鲁斯及两名独立候选人。此前，塞缪尔森在8月党内初选中击败已任三届州长的罗伯特·E·斯迈利。

en.s: The 1966 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 8. Republican Ray Shafer, the state's incumbent Lieutenant Governor, was elected to the state's highest office after holding off a charge from future governor Milton Shapp.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任副州长雷·谢弗击败后来担任州长的米尔顿·沙普，当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1966 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1966 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 32 of the state senate's 61 districts. At this time, the Iowa Senate still had several multi-member districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. The Iowa Senate was expanded from 59 to 61 members and new district maps were drawn for the 1966 election.

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，选民在61个选区中的32个选区选出州参议员。当时州内仍有选区一次选出多名议员。州参议院也在这次选举前从59席扩至61席，并重新划定选区；参议员每届任期四年。

en.s: The 1966 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on Tuesday November 8, Incumbent United States Senator John Sparkman was re-elected to a fourth full term in office over Republican candidate John Grenier

zh.s: 1966年11月8日，阿拉巴马州举行美国参议院选举。现任参议员约翰·斯帕克曼击败共和党候选人约翰·格雷尼尔，成功当选第四个完整任期。

en.s: The Vienna Convention on Road Traffic is an international treaty designed to facilitate international road traffic and to increase road safety by establishing standard traffic rules among the contracting parties. The convention was agreed upon at the United Nations Economic and Social Council's Conference on Road Traffic (7 October – 8 November 1968) and concluded in Vienna on 8 November 1968.
en.n: The Vienna Convention on Road Traffic is signed to facilitate international road traffic and to increase road safety by standardising the uniform traffic rules among the signatories.

zh.s: 《维也纳道路交通公约》是一项国际条约，旨在通过统一缔约方的交通规则，便利国际道路交通并提高道路安全。该公约在联合国经济及社会理事会于1968年10月7日至11月8日召开的道路交通会议上达成，并于1968年11月8日在维也纳缔结。
zh.n: 《维也纳道路交通公约》签署，旨在便利国际道路交通、提高道路安全，并统一缔约方的交通规则。

en.s: The 1970 Hessian state election was held on 8 November 1970 to elect the 7th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a majority of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) led by Minister-President Albert Osswald. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU), which had taken a hard line against the SPD under new leader Alfred Dregger, recorded a major swing of 13 percentage points in its favour, to the detriment of the SPD and National Democratic Party, the latter losing all its seats after a single term in the Landtag.

zh.s: 黑森州于1970年11月8日举行选举，选出第七届黑森州议会。由州长阿尔贝特·奥斯瓦尔德领导的社会民主党（SPD）在选前执政并占多数。反对党基督教民主联盟（CDU）在新任领导人阿尔弗雷德·德雷格尔带领下对社民党采取强硬立场，得票率大幅上升13个百分点，以社民党和德国国家民主党为代价。德国国家民主党在州议会仅任职一届后失去全部席位。

en.s: A senatorial election were held in the Philippines on November 8, 1971. The opposition Liberal Party took 5 seats in the Philippine Senate while 3 seats were taken by the Nacionalista Party, the administration party; a consequence of the Plaza Miranda bombing on August 21, 1971 which wounded all the Liberal Party's candidates and almost took the lives of John Henry Osmeña and Jovito Salonga. Their terms as senators were cut short due to the declaration of martial law by Philippines Ferdinand Marcos on September 23, 1972. Due to the ratification of a new constitution in 1973, Senate was abolished and the unicameral parliamentary Batasang Pambansa was instituted.

zh.s: 1971年11月8日，菲律宾举行参议员选举。反对党自由党赢得菲律宾参议院5席，执政党国民党赢得3席。这一结果发生在1971年8月21日米兰达广场爆炸案之后；爆炸造成自由党所有候选人受伤，约翰·亨利·奥斯梅尼亚和霍维托·萨隆加险些丧命。由于菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯于1972年9月23日宣布戒严，他们的参议员任期被缩短。1973年新宪法获批准后，参议院被废除，改设一院制议会巴丹桑潘班萨。

en.s: The untitled fourth studio album by the English rock band Led Zeppelin, commonly known as Led Zeppelin IV, was released on 8 November 1971, by Atlantic Records. It was produced by the band's guitarist, Jimmy Page, and recorded between December 1970 and February 1971, mostly in the country house Headley Grange. The album contains one of the band's best-known recordings, the eight-minute-long "Stairway to Heaven".

zh.t: 齐柏林飞艇第四张专辑
zh.s: 英国摇滚乐队齐柏林飞艇的第四张录音室专辑没有正式名称，通常称为《齐柏林飞艇IV》。专辑由大西洋唱片于1971年11月8日发行，由乐队吉他手吉米·佩奇担任制作人，录制时间为1970年12月至1971年2月，大部分录音在乡间别墅黑德利庄园完成。专辑收录了乐队最知名的作品之一、时长8分钟的《天堂阶梯》。

en.t: American pay television network Home Box Office (HBO) launches
en.s: Home Box Office (HBO) is an American premium television network and service, which is the flagship property of namesake parent Home Box Office, Inc., a subsidiary of Warner Bros. Discovery. The overall Home Box Office business unit is based at Warner Bros. Discovery's corporate headquarters inside 30 Hudson Yards in Manhattan.

zh.s: HBO是美国的付费电视网和服务，也是华纳兄弟探索公司旗下同名子公司的旗舰业务。HBO整体业务部门设在华纳兄弟探索公司总部，地址为曼哈顿哈德逊广场30号。

en.s: The Glasgow Govan by-election was held on 8 November 1973, following the death of John Rankin, Labour Party Member of Parliament for the Glasgow Govan constituency. Rankin had died one month earlier, on 8 October 1973. Rankin had held the seat since 1955. With the exception of a narrow Conservative victory in 1950, the seat had been solidly Labour-held since 1918. For the by-election the Labour Party nominated Harry Selby, a veteran activist in Glasgow and a former Trotskyist. The Conservative Party, long the main opposition in the constituency, nominated John Mair, but as they were in mid-term government, they expected little from the election.

zh.s: 1973年11月8日，英国格拉斯哥戈文选区举行议会补选。工党下议员约翰·兰金于一个月前的10月8日去世，触发补选；他自1955年起代表该选区。除1950年保守党曾以微弱优势获胜外，该选区自1918年以来一直由工党牢牢控制。工党提名格拉斯哥资深活动人士、前托洛茨基主义者哈里·塞尔比。长期以来该选区主要反对党保守党提名约翰·梅尔，但保守党当时执政，因此并不指望在补选中取得太多成绩。

en.s: The Berwick-upon-Tweed by-election, 1973 was a parliamentary by-election held on 8 November 1973 for the British House of Commons constituency of Berwick-upon-Tweed. It was one of four UK by-elections held on the same day. The by-election took place during the 1970s Liberal Party revival. This was the fifth Liberal gain during the 1970-1974 Parliament. Although largely overshadowed by the SNP's spectacular victory in Glasgow Govan on the same day, it was the narrowest by-election result since the Carmarthen by-election of 1928.

zh.s: 1973年11月8日，英国下议院贝里克-特威德选区举行议会补选。这是当天英国举行的四场补选之一。补选发生在20世纪70年代自由党复兴期间，是1970至1974年本届议会中自由党第五次从其他政党手中赢得席位。尽管这次补选的关注度远不及同日苏格兰民族党在格拉斯哥戈文选区的惊人胜利，它的胜负差距仍是1928年卡马森补选以来最小的。

en.s: The Cabinda War is an ongoing separatist insurgency, waged by the Front for the Liberation of the Enclave of Cabinda (FLEC) against the government of Angola. FLEC aims at the restoration of the self-proclaimed Republic of Cabinda, located within the borders of the Cabinda province of Angola.

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1977 occurred on Tuesday, November 8, 1977. Incumbent mayor Abraham Beame, a Democrat, was challenged by five other Democrats, including Representative Ed Koch, New York Secretary of State Mario Cuomo, and feminist activist and former Representative Bella Abzug for the Democratic nomination. Koch won the initial vote in the Democratic primary as well as a runoff vote held between him and Cuomo. In the general election, Koch beat Cuomo, who ran on the Liberal Party ticket, and Roy M. Goodman, who ran on the Republican ticket.

zh.s: 1977年11月8日星期二，纽约市举行市长选举。民主党籍时任市长亚伯拉罕·比姆面对五名民主党挑战者，包括联邦众议员埃德·科赫、纽约州州务卿马里奥·科莫，以及女权活动人士、前联邦众议员贝拉·阿布祖格。科赫先在民主党初选首轮投票中领先，随后在与科莫之间的决选中获胜。普选中，科赫击败了代表自由党参选的科莫和代表共和党参选的罗伊·M·古德曼。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1977 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 8, 1977. Incumbent Democrat Brendan Byrne defeated Republican nominee Raymond Bateman with 55.71% of the vote.

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1977 were held on November 8, 1977 in two states. There was no change in the number of governorships controlled by the Major parties.

en.s: The 1977 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1977. Democratic nominee Chuck Robb defeated Republican nominee A. Joe Canada Jr. with 54.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1977年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人查克·罗伯以54.24%的得票率击败共和党候选人小A·乔·加拿大。

en.t: 1977 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 8, 1977 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Paul O'Dwyer ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated in the Democratic primary by Carol Bellamy in a historic upset. After winning the general election easily over Republican John Esposito and Conservative Abe Hirschfeld, Bellamy became the first woman elected to citywide office in New York City history.

zh.s: 纽约市于1977年11月8日举行市议会主席选举。民主党籍时任主席保罗·奥德怀尔争取连任第二个任期，但在民主党初选中爆冷败给卡萝尔·贝拉米。贝拉米随后在大选中轻松击败共和党候选人约翰·埃斯波西托和保守党候选人阿贝·赫希菲尔德，成为纽约市历史上首位当选全市职位的女性。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in American Samoa on 8 November 1977, with a run-off between the top two candidates on 22 November. Peter Tali Coleman was elected with 56% of the vote in the second round. This election was the first gubernatorial election ever to be held in American Sāmoa. It featured multiple two-person tickets for governor and lieutenant governor. The leading slates were Peter Coleman–Tufele Liʻamatua; A.

zh.s: 美属萨摩亚于1977年11月8日举行州长选举，得票最高的两名候选人于11月22日进行决选。彼得·塔利·科尔曼在第二轮投票中以56%的得票率当选。这是美属萨摩亚首次举行州长选举。本次选举有多组州长与副州长搭档参选，主要组合包括彼得·科尔曼—图费莱·利阿马图阿、A. P. 卢塔利—福福·I. F. 苏尼亚，以及A. U. 富艾莫诺—卢图·特纳里。

en.s: The Buffalo mayoral election of 1977 took place in Buffalo, New York, USA, on November 8, 1977, and resulted in the election of Jimmy Griffin to his first term as mayor.

zh.s: 1977年布法罗市长选举于1977年11月8日在美国纽约州布法罗举行，吉米·格里芬当选，开始他的第一个市长任期。

en.s: The 1977 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 8, 1977, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was won by Dennis Kucinich. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 4 primary advancing to the general election. In an upset defeat, incumbent mayor Ralph Perk failed to advance past the primary.

zh.s: 1977年克利夫兰市长选举于11月8日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。丹尼斯·库西尼奇赢得选举。该选举正式采用无党派形式，10月4日初选中得票前两名的候选人进入大选。现任市长拉尔夫·珀克意外地未能通过初选。

en.s: The 1977 New Jersey Senate election coincided with Brendan Byrne's re-election to a second term as Governor of New Jersey. The election coincided with Governor Brendan Byrne's re-election over Senator Raymond Bateman. Byrne narrowly survived a primary election that eliminated seven incumbent Democratic Senators. Despite the intra-party division and early polls indicating Byrne was an underdog in the general election, Byrne survived and the Democrats preserved their large majority in the Senate, with Republicans only gaining three seats.

zh.s: 1977年11月8日，新泽西州举行州参议院选举，同时举行州长选举。民主党籍州长布伦丹·伯恩此前在党内初选中险胜，党内分歧也使七名民主党现任州参议员落选。最终伯恩击败共和党州参议员雷蒙德·贝特曼连任州长；共和党虽在参议院增加三席，民主党仍保持明显多数。

en.s: The 1977 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election in Allentown, the third largest city in Pennsylvania. Incumbent Democratic mayor Joseph S. Daddona was unexpectedly defeated by Republican political outsider and air-force Colonel Frank Fischl, who won by a margin of 121 votes.

zh.s: 1977年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长约瑟夫·S·达多纳意外落败；共和党候选人、空军上校弗兰克·菲施尔以121票的微弱优势当选。

en.s: In the 1977 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor Mills E. Godwin, Jr., a Republican, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. John N. Dalton, the Lieutenant Governor of Virginia, was nominated by the Republican Party to run against the Democratic nominee, former Lieutenant Governor of Virginia Henry Howell. This was the only instance in Virginia's history in which the Republican Party won the gubernatorial election for a third time consecutively.

zh.s: 1977年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长小米尔斯·E·戈德温因任期限制不能连任。共和党推举时任副州长约翰·N·道尔顿，与民主党候选人、前副州长亨利·豪厄尔竞选。共和党最终连续第三次赢得该州州长职位，这在弗吉尼亚州历史上仅此一次。

en.s: The 1978 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 1978, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. While 35 districts were up for election, only nine saw Republican opposition. Both of the state's Black senators, U. W. Clemon and J. Richmond Pearson, won re-election, with the newly elected Michael Figures joining their ranks.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1978年11月8日（星期二）举行州参议院选举，选出35名任期四年的州参议员。35个选区都举行了选举，但只有9个选区有共和党候选人参选。阿拉巴马州两名黑人参议员U·W·克莱蒙和J·里士满·皮尔森都成功连任，新当选的迈克尔·菲格斯也加入他们。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 8 November 1981. Voter turnout was 94.5% in the Chamber election and 94.6% in the Senate election. Elections were also held for the nine provincial councils and for the Council of the German Cultural Community. They were the first elections after the voting age was lowered from 21 to 18. This contributed to the success of the socialist parties and the green parties (Agalev and Ecolo). The traditionally largest Christian People's Party saw significant losses, with only 43 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives.

zh.s: 1981年11月8日，比利时举行大选。众议院选举投票率为94.5%，参议院选举投票率为94.6%。选民还选举了九个省议会和德语文化共同体委员会。这是投票年龄从21岁降至18岁后的首次选举。此次变化推动了社会党和绿党（阿加列夫党与埃科洛党）取得成功。传统上规模最大的基督教人民党损失惨重，在众议院212席中只赢得43席。

en.s: Aeroméxico Flight 110 was a scheduled domestic commercial flight from Acapulco to Guadalajara. On November 8, 1981, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 operating the flight experienced a cabin decompression and crashed near Zihuatanejo while initiating an emergency descent, killing all 18 people on board.

zh.t: 墨西哥航空110号航班空难
zh.s: 墨西哥航空110号航班是从阿卡普尔科飞往瓜达拉哈拉的定期国内商业航班。1981年11月8日，执行该航班的麦克唐纳·道格拉斯DC-9客机发生客舱失压，在进行紧急下降时于锡瓦塔内霍附近坠毁，机上18人全部遇难。

en.s: The 1982 Toronto municipal election was held on November 8, 1982, in Metropolitan Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Mayors, controllers, city councillors and school board trustees were elected in the municipalities of Toronto, York, East York, North York, Etobicoke and Scarborough. Art Eggleton was re-elected as Mayor of Toronto, and Mel Lastman was re-elected as Mayor of North York.

zh.s: 1982年多伦多市政选举于1982年11月8日在加拿大安大略省大多伦多地区举行。多伦多、约克、东约克、北约克、怡陶碧谷和士嘉堡各市镇选出了市长、财政监察官、市议员和教育局委员。阿特·艾格尔顿连任多伦多市长，梅尔·拉斯特曼连任北约克市长。

en.s: The city of Ottawa, Canada held municipal elections on November 8, 1982. Mayor Marion Dewar was re-elected, defeating conservative alderman Darrel Kent.

en.s: TAAG Flight 462 was a TAAG Angola Airlines flight which crashed just after the Boeing 737-200 took off from Lubango Airport in Lubango, Angola, on a regular domestic service as Flight DT 462 to Quatro de Fevereiro Airport in Luanda on November 8, 1983. All 130 occupants onboard were killed.

zh.s: TAAG安哥拉航空462号航班在执行从安哥拉卢班戈飞往罗安达四月四日机场的定期国内航班时，于1983年11月8日从卢班戈机场起飞后不久坠毁。机上130人全部遇难。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1983 took place on November 8, 1983, and saw the reelection of Republican William H. Hudnut III to a third term. In 1982, the two-term limit on the mayoralty was removed (leaving no limits on the number of terms). This enabled Hudnut to run for a, previously prohibited, third term. Top prospective Democratic candidates declined to run, and Hudnut ultimately faced John J.

zh.t: 1983年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1983年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月8日举行，共和党籍威廉·H·哈德纳特三世成功连任，开始第三个任期。1982年，市长任期两届的限制被取消，市长任期次数不再受限，因此哈德纳特得以竞选此前不允许的第三个任期。民主党几位主要潜在人选都放弃参选，哈德纳特最终面对约翰·J·沙利文。

en.s: The 1983 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1983, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat William Winter was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As of 2023, this is the last time that Hinds County has voted for the Republican candidate. As of 2026, this is the most recent Mississippi gubernatorial election to feature major party nominees who are now both deceased.

zh.s: 1983年密西西比州州长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州州长。民主党籍现任州长威廉·温特受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二个任期。截至2023年，这是欣兹县最后一次投票支持共和党候选人。截至2026年，这是最近一次密西西比州州长选举中两大党提名人均已去世。

en.s: The 1983 Kentucky lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1983, to elect the lieutenant governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Martha Layne Collins chose not to seek re-election to a second term, instead choosing to run for governor. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Steve Beshear beat Republican nominee Eugene P. Stuart.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于1983年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长玛莎·莱恩·柯林斯没有争取连任第二个任期，转而竞选州长。民主党籍时任州检察长史蒂夫·贝希尔击败共和党候选人尤金·P·斯图尔特。

en.s: All 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia were up for election on November 8, 1983, alongside the Virginia House of Delegates election.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州参议院全部40个席位于1983年11月8日改选，与州众议院选举同期举行。

en.s: The 1983 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1983. Democratic nominee Martha Layne Collins defeated Republican nominee Jim Bunning with 54.50% of the vote, replacing outgoing governor John Y. Brown Jr., and becoming the first female governor of Kentucky.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于1983年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人玛莎·莱恩·柯林斯以54.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人吉姆·邦宁，接替卸任州长小约翰·Y·布朗，并成为肯塔基州首位女州长。

en.s: The 1983 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 8, 1983, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Willis Tucker ran for re-election to a second term. As the first county executive, Tucker was tasked with reorganizing county government, and internal party opposition to his reorganization scheme prompted an intra-party challenge.

zh.s: 1983年11月8日，华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长威利斯·塔克争取第二个任期。他是该县首任县长，曾负责改组县政府；他的改组方案在党内引发反对，因此遭遇同党人士挑战。

en.s: The 1983 Durham mayoral election was held on November 8, 1983, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina.

zh.s: 1983年11月8日，北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市举行市长选举。

en.s: The 1983 mayoral election was held on Tuesday November 8, to elect the mayor of San Francisco. Democratic candidate incumbent mayor Dianne Feinstein, who had previously been subjected to a failed recall election on April 26 (winning with an 83-percent-favorable vote), was re-elected to her second and final term as mayor. Feinstein, winning with 80.10%, defeated Cesar Ascarrunz, Gloria E. La Riva, Pat Wright, Brian Lantz, and Carrie Drake.

zh.s: 1983年旧金山市长选举于11月8日星期二举行。现任市长、民主党人黛安·范士丹在4月26日的罢免投票中以83%的支持票挺过罢免，此后赢得连任，开始第二个、也是最后一个任期。她以80.10%的得票率击败塞萨尔·阿斯卡伦斯、格洛丽亚·E.拉里瓦、帕特·赖特、布莱恩·兰茨和卡丽·德雷克。

en.t: 1983 United States Senate special election in Washington
en.s: The 1983 United States Senate special election in Washington was a special election held to fill the seat which had been held by longtime Senator Henry Jackson, who unexpectedly died on September 1. Three-term former Governor Dan Evans was appointed by Governor John Spellman on September 8, and he won the special election over congressman Mike Lowry on November 8.

zh.t: 1983年华盛顿州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1983年华盛顿州美国参议院特别选举用于填补长期担任参议员的亨利·杰克逊突然去世后留下的席位。州长约翰·斯佩尔曼于9月8日任命曾任三届州长的丹·埃文斯接任。11月8日，埃文斯在特别选举中击败国会议员迈克·劳里。

en.s: The 1983 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the election of Wilson Goode. Goode won the Democratic nomination by defeating former mayor Frank Rizzo, as well as several minor candidates, in the Democratic primary. Goode was elected the first African American mayor of Philadelphia.

zh.s: 1983年费城市长选举中，威尔逊·古德当选。他在民主党初选中击败前市长弗兰克·里佐和几名小党候选人，获得民主党提名。古德成为费城首位非裔美国人市长。

en.s: The 1983 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 8. The election took place mid-way through the first term of Governor Thomas Kean. Democrats gained a net of two seats after flipping the 11th, 13th, and 38th districts. Meanwhile, Republicans flipped the 18th.

zh.s: 1983年11月8日，新泽西州举行州参议院选举，当时州长托马斯·基恩的首个任期进行到中段。民主党拿下第11、第13和第38选区，共和党则赢得第18选区；民主党净增两席。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1986
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 8, 1986. Incumbent Bob Packwood ran for re-election. U.S. Congressman Jim Weaver received the Democratic nomination. A populist Democratic congressman from Eugene, Oregon, he was a darling of the environmentalists. Weaver supported the Oregon Wilderness Act of 1984. Packwood was confident despite the popular opponent, because had more money and a better campaign organization. After winning the party nomination, Weaver was the subject of a House Ethics Committee probe into his campaign finances, and withdrew his candidacy. Rick Bauman was selected to replace Weaver on the ballot, and lost handily to Packwood.

zh.t: 1986年美国联邦参议院俄勒冈州选举
zh.s: 1986年11月8日，俄勒冈州举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员鲍勃·帕克伍德竞选连任。联邦众议员吉姆·韦弗赢得民主党提名。他来自尤金，是一名民粹派议员，也是环保人士支持的对象，并支持1984年《俄勒冈荒野法案》。尽管韦弗很受欢迎，帕克伍德仍信心十足，因为他资金更多、竞选组织更完善。韦弗赢得党内提名后，因竞选财务问题接受联邦众议院道德委员会调查，随后退出竞选。里克·鲍曼获选接替他列入选票，但最终大败给帕克伍德。

en.s: The Remembrance Day bombing (also known as the Enniskillen bombing or Poppy Day massacre) took place on 8 November 1987 in Enniskillen, County Fermanagh, Northern Ireland. A Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) bomb exploded near the town's war memorial (cenotaph) during a Remembrance Sunday ceremony, which was being held to commemorate British military war dead. Eleven people (ten civilians and a police officer), many of them old age pensioners, were killed and 63 were injured. The IRA said it had made a mistake and that its target had been the British soldiers parading to the memorial.

zh.t: 阵亡将士纪念日爆炸案
zh.s: 1987年11月8日，北爱尔兰弗马纳郡恩尼斯基林发生阵亡将士纪念日爆炸案，又称恩尼斯基林爆炸案或罂粟花日屠杀。爱尔兰共和军临时派在纪念星期日仪式期间，于当地战争纪念碑附近引爆炸弹。仪式旨在纪念阵亡的英国军人。爆炸造成11人死亡，其中10人是平民、1人是警察；另有63人受伤。爱尔兰共和军称行动出了差错，原定目标是游行前往纪念碑的英国士兵。

en.t: United States presidential election in Oklahoma, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 8, 1988. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Oklahoma voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Oklahoma was won by incumbent United States Vice President George H. W. Bush of Texas, who was running against Massachusetts Governor Michael Dukakis. Bush ran with Indiana Senator Dan Quayle as Vice President, and Dukakis ran with Texas Senator Lloyd Bentsen. Oklahoma weighed in for this election as 4% more Republican than the national average.

zh.t: 1988年美国总统选举俄克拉何马州投票
zh.s: 1988年11月8日，俄克拉何马州举行总统选举投票。全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。俄克拉何马州选民选出8名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。来自得克萨斯州的共和党籍时任副总统乔治·H·W·布什击败马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯，赢得该州。布什的竞选搭档是来自印第安纳州的参议员丹·奎尔；杜卡基斯的竞选搭档是来自得克萨斯州的参议员劳埃德·本特森。俄克拉何马州比全国平均水平多出4个百分点支持共和党。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 8, 1988 as part of the 1988 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominee, Vice President George H. W. Bush, over the Democratic nominee, Massachusetts Governor Michael Dukakis, by a margin of 5.10%. Bush took 51.98% of the vote to Dukakis's 46.87%. Although Dukakis won only Hartford County, he took 47-49% of the vote in five other counties, making it a close race statewide.

zh.t: 1988年美国总统选举康涅狄格州投票
zh.s: 1988年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，康涅狄格州举行投票，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、副总统乔治·H·W·布什击败民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯，以5.10个百分点的优势赢得康涅狄格州。布什获得51.98%的选票，杜卡基斯获得46.87%。杜卡基斯只赢得哈特福德县，但在另外五个县也获得47%至49%的选票，使全州选情相当接近。

en.t: United States presidential election in Oregon, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 8, 1988 as part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven electors of the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by the Democratic nominee, Massachusetts governor Michael Dukakis, over the Republican nominee, Vice President George H. W. Bush. Oregon was one of just 10 states won by Dukakis in an election won by Vice President Bush. It also marked the first victory by a Democratic presidential candidate in Oregon since 1964; Democrats have won every presidential election in Oregon since.

zh.t: 1988年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票
zh.s: 1988年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，俄勒冈州举行投票。选民选出7名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯击败共和党候选人、副总统乔治·H·W·布什，赢得俄勒冈州。虽然布什赢得全国选举，杜卡基斯仍在俄勒冈州之外的另外九个州获胜。这也是民主党候选人自1964年以来首次在俄勒冈州获胜；此后该州的每次总统选举均由民主党候选人赢得。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1988 was the 51st quadrennial United States presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1988. Incumbent Vice President George H. W. Bush won the Republican nomination, and chose Senator Dan Quayle of Indiana as his running mate. The Democrats nominated Governor Michael Dukakis of Massachusetts, with Senator Lloyd Bentsen of Texas – who had coincidentally defeated Bush in a U.S. Senate race 18 years earlier – as his running mate. Due to the restrictions of the Twenty-second Amendment to the United States Constitution, incumbent President Ronald Reagan was ineligible to seek a third term.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日星期二，美国举行第51次四年一度总统选举。共和党提名时任副总统乔治·H·W·布什，他选择印第安纳州参议员丹·奎尔为竞选搭档。民主党提名马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯，并由得克萨斯州参议员劳埃德·本特森担任竞选搭档。18年前，本特森曾在联邦参议院选举中击败布什。根据《第二十二条修正案》的限制，共和党籍时任总统罗纳德·里根不能竞选第三个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 8, 1988, as part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Washington, D.C. was a landslide in favor of the Democratic candidate, Governor Michael Dukakis of Massachusetts. Vice President George H. W. Bush lost the District, though his percentage of 14.30% remains the highest amount any Republican candidate has garnered as of the 2012 election in D.C.

zh.t: 1988年美国总统选举哥伦比亚特区投票
zh.s: 1988年11月8日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，哥伦比亚特区举行总统选举投票。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。哥伦比亚特区以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯。副总统乔治·H·W·布什在该区落败，但截至2012年，他在华盛顿特区获得的14.30%选票仍是共和党候选人在当地的最高得票率。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1988
en.s: The 1988 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 8, 1988. The incumbent, North Dakota Democratic NPL Party (Dem-NPL) Senator Quentin Burdick, sought and received re-election to his sixth term, defeating Republican candidate Earl Strinden. en.s: The 1988 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Governor of Montana Ted Schwinden, who was first elected in 1980 and was re-elected in 1984, declined to seek re-election to a third term, creating an open seat. Stan Stephens, the former President of the Montana Senate, won a close Republican primary, and advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Thomas Lee Judge, Schwinden's predecessor as Governor and the Democratic nominee. Though the general election was hotly-contested, Stephens ultimately defeated Judge, becoming the first Republican to win a gubernatorial election in Montana since 1964.

en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 8, 1988. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose 7 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Mississippi was won by incumbent United States Vice President George H. W. Bush of Texas, who was running against Massachusetts Governor Michael Dukakis. Bush ran with Indiana Senator Dan Quayle as Vice President, and Dukakis ran with Texas Senator Lloyd Bentsen. Mississippi weighed in for this election as 6% more Republican than the national average.

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 8, 1988, as part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirty-six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New York was won by Democratic Governor Michael Dukakis of Massachusetts with 51.62% of the popular vote over Republican Vice President George H.W. Bush of Texas, who took 47.52%. 1988 would mark the end of an era in New York's political history. Since the 1940s, New York had been a Democratic-leaning swing state, usually voting Democratic in close elections, but often by small margins.

zh.s: 1988年纽约州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出36名选举人组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯赢得纽约州，得票率为51.62%；共和党候选人、时任副总统乔治·H·W·布什得票率为47.52%。1988年标志着纽约州政治史上一个时代的结束。自20世纪40年代以来，纽约州一直是倾向民主党的摇摆州，竞争激烈时通常支持民主党，但优势往往不大。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 8, 1988. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1988 United States presidential election. en.s: The 1988 Indiana Gubernatorial Election was held on November 8, 1988 in all 92 counties in the state of Indiana. Incumbent Governor Robert D. Orr, a Republican, was ineligible to run for a third consecutive term due to term limits set forth in the Indiana Constitution. In the general election, the Republican nominee, Lieutenant Governor John Mutz, was defeated by Democrat Indiana Secretary of State Evan Bayh by a margin of six percentage points. Bayh was the first Democrat to be elected Governor of Indiana since Roger D. Branigin's victory during the 1964 Democratic landslides twenty-four years previously.

en.t: United States Senate election in Texas, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Lloyd Bentsen won re-election to a fourth term defeating Republican Representative Beau Boulter. Bentsen easily won the Democratic nomination for another term, while Boulter came through a run-off in the Republican primary defeating Wes Gilbreath. After being nominated for the senate Bentsen was chosen by Michael Dukakis as his vice-presidential running mate and therefore ran for both the Senate and the vice-presidency at the same time. Bentsen was always the favorite for the senate election and won with 59.2% of the vote, compared to 40% for Boulter.

zh.t: 1988年美国联邦参议院得克萨斯州选举

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1988
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 8, 1988 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Voters chose 25 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania narrowly voted for the Republican nominee, Vice President George H. W. Bush, over the Democratic nominee, Massachusetts governor Michael Dukakis. As of 2012, this is the last election where Pennsylvania was carried by the Republican presidential candidate. This was also the first election since 1932 that Pennsylvania did not vote the same as neighboring New York, and the last time as of 2012 that has happened.

Bangerter defeated Democratic nominee Ted Wilson and independent Merrill Cook with 40.13% of the vote. As of 2023, this is the closest a Democrat has come to winning the governorship in Utah since Scott M. Matheson left office in 1985.

Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. en.s: The 1988 West Virginia Attorney General election took place on November 8, 1988, to elect the Attorney General of West Virginia. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Charlie Brown won re-election to a second term unopposed, as the Republicans did not field a candidate. However, just nine months later, Brown would resign in August 1989 in exchange for an end to a grand jury investigation into allegations that he lied under oath and into his campaign financial records.

Cheney defeated Bryan Sharratt with 66.62% of the vote.

zh.t: 1988年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 怀俄明州于1988年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举。迪克·切尼赢得最后一个众议员任期，之后辞职，出任乔治·H·W·布什政府的国防部长。切尼以66.62%的得票率击败布赖恩·沙拉特。

en.s: The 1988 Delaware gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Republican governor Mike Castle won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee labor lawyer Jacob Kreshtool in a landslide. Both were unopposed in their respective primaries. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican was elected Governor of Delaware.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1988年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长迈克·卡斯尔成功连任第二个任期，在大选中以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、劳工律师雅各布·克雷施图尔。两人在各自党内的初选中都没有对手。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选特拉华州州长。

en.s: The 1988 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 1988. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1988. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 19 seats over the Democrats' 11 seats.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1988年11月8日举行州参议院选举，在该州全部30个立法选区选出州参议员，任期两年。党内初选于1988年9月13日举行。选举前，共和党在州参议院以19席对民主党的11席占多数。

en.s: The 1988 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1988, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general William L. Webster defeated Democratic nominee Michael A. Wolff.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1988年11月8日举行州检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任检察长威廉·L·韦伯斯特击败民主党候选人迈克尔·A·沃尔夫。

en.t: 1988 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1988 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 8, 1988, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 1988 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 6-3 Democratic majority.

zh.t: 1988年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 田纳西州于1988年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，决定该州由谁代表进入联邦众议院。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州代表团仍由民主党以6席对3席占多数。

en.s: The 1988 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1988. Republican nominee Jim Gardner defeated Democratic nominee Tony Rand with 50.64% of the vote, becoming the first Republican elected lieutenant governor of North Carolina in the twentieth century.

zh.t: 1988年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1988年11月8日举行副州长选举。共和党候选人吉姆·加德纳以50.64%的得票率击败民主党候选人托尼·兰德，成为20世纪首位当选北卡罗来纳州副州长的共和党人。

en.s: The 1988 West Virginia State Auditor election took place on November 8, 1988, to elect the West Virginia State Auditor. Incumbent Democratic State Auditor Glen Gainer Jr. won re-election to a fourth term, defeating Republican nominee and Worker's Compensation Commissioner Nelson B.

zh.t: 1988年西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 1988年西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州审计长。民主党籍现任审计长格伦·盖纳二世击败共和党候选人、工人赔偿委员会委员纳尔逊·B·罗宾逊，成功连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1988 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 1988, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state treasurer Wendell Bailey defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Bob Holden and Libertarian nominee Gerald R. Geier.

zh.t: 1988年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 密苏里州于1988年11月8日举行州财政部长选举。共和党候选人、时任州财政部长温德尔·贝利击败民主党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员鲍勃·霍尔登和自由党候选人杰拉尔德·R·盖尔。

en.s: The 1988 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Republican Edward D. DiPrete defeated Democratic nominee Bruce Sundlun with 50.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1988年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长爱德华·D·迪普雷特以50.83%的得票率击败民主党候选人布鲁斯·桑德伦。

en.t: 1988 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1988 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 8, 1988, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1988, the United States House elections in other states, the presidential election, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1988年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1988年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州代表进入联邦众议院。根据1980年美国人口普查结果，得克萨斯州拥有27个席位。选举与1988年联邦参议院选举、其他州的联邦众议院选举、总统选举以及各级州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 1988 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1988. Democratic nominee Mel Carnahan defeated Republican nominee Richard B. "R.B." Grisham with 51.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1988年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党候选人梅尔·卡纳汉以51.81%的得票率击败共和党候选人理查德·B·“R·B·”格里沙姆。

en.s: The 1988 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1988, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Republican nominee Dale E. Wolf defeated Democratic nominee Gary E. Hindes.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1988年11月8日举行副州长选举。共和党候选人戴尔·E·沃尔夫击败民主党候选人加里·E·欣德斯。

en.t: 1988 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1988 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 8, 1988, to elect members to serve in the 101st United States Congress. They coincided with the election of George H. W. Bush as president. Although Bush won with a strong majority, his Republican Party lost a net of two seats to the Democratic Party, slightly increasing the Democratic majority in the House.

zh.s: 美国于1988年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出第101届国会议员。选举与乔治·H·W·布什当选总统同期进行。尽管布什获得明显多数，共和党仍净失去两个席位，民主党在众议院的多数席位略有增加。

en.t: 1988 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1988 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 8, 1988, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to United States Senate and United States House of Representatives as well as various state and local elections. Republican Orrin Hatch won re-election against Democratic challenger Brian Moss, the son of Hatch's predecessor Frank Moss.

zh.s: 犹他州于1988年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各级州和地方选举同期进行。共和党候选人奥林·哈奇击败民主党挑战者布赖恩·莫斯，成功连任。莫斯是哈奇前任、联邦参议员弗兰克·莫斯的儿子。

en.t: 1988 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 8, 1988. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1988 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Georgia was won by incumbent Vice President George H. W. Bush of Texas, who was running against Massachusetts Governor Michael Dukakis.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日，佐治亚州举行美国总统选举投票。美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。佐治亚州选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。时任副总统、来自得克萨斯州的乔治·H·W·布什在该州击败马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯。

en.t: 1988 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1988 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Daniel J. Evans decided to retire instead of running for re-election to a full term, after being appointed to the seat in 1983, and won election to a partial term that same year. Republican former U.S. Senator Slade Gorton, who had just lost a re-election bid in 1986, won the open seat.

zh.t: 1988年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1988年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党参议员丹尼尔·J.埃文斯决定退休，不再竞选完整任期。他于1983年获任命进入参议院，同年又当选完成部分任期。曾任美国参议员的共和党人斯莱德·戈顿在1986年竞选连任失利后，于这次选举中赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 8, 1988. Primaries were held March 15, 1988. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, one seat on the Cook County Board of Appeals, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行大选，初选已于3月15日举行。选民改选巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、县上诉委员会一个席位、水务管理区董事会三个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 1988 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Democratic governor Booth Gardner won a second term, defeating Republican state representative Bob Williams in a landslide. This election was the first time since 1960 that an incumbent Democratic governor of Washington was re-elected. Gardner won the highest share of the vote since Clarence D. Martin in 1936.

zh.s: 1988年华盛顿州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党州长布思·加德纳击败共和党州众议员鲍勃·威廉姆斯，以压倒性优势赢得第二个任期。这是自1960年以来，华盛顿州民主党现任州长首次赢得连任。加德纳的得票率是自1936年克拉伦斯·D.马丁以来最高的。

en.s: The 1988 Washington Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1988, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Washington. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Ralph Munro won re-election against Democratic nominee John O'Hagan McKee.

zh.s: 1988年华盛顿州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿拉尔夫·芒罗击败民主党候选人约翰·奥哈根·麦基，赢得连任。

en.t: 1988 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1988 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 8, 1988. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan won re-election to a third term in a landslide, versus Republican nominee Robert McMillan. McMillan, who ran a "low-budget" challenge to the two-term senator, was largely ignored by Moynihan in the public sphere.

zh.s: 1988年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党参议员丹尼尔·帕特里克·莫伊尼汉大胜共和党候选人罗伯特·麦克米伦，赢得第三个任期。麦克米伦以“低预算”方式挑战这位已任职两届的参议员，莫伊尼汉在公开场合基本没有理会他。

en.s: The 1988 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 15 of the 31 State Senate. The winners of this election served in the 71st Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州参议院选举，在31个席位中的15个席位选出州参议员。当选议员进入第71届得克萨斯州议会。

en.s: The 1988 California State Senate elections were held on November 8 in the twenty odd-numbered Senate districts. There was no change to the representation of the Democratic and Republican parties.

zh.t: 1988年加利福尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 1988年11月8日，加利福尼亚州举行州参议院选举，20个奇数编号选区改选。选举后，民主党和共和党各自占有的席位数量没有变化。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1988 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 1988 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. The Democrats retained their majority in the State Senate, having a 23-13 majority over the Republicans, although losing their supermajority.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日，康涅狄格州举行州参议院选举，全部36个席位改选。议员每届任期两年。民主党以23席对共和党13席保住多数地位，但失去原有的三分之二以上席位优势。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1988 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1988 United States elections. Iowans elected state senators in even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate with half of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary on June 7, 1988 determined which candidates to the general election. Primary election results can be obtained here.

zh.s: 1988年11月8日，艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，偶数编号选区改选。州参议员每届任期四年，约半数席位每两年改选一次；各党候选人已通过同年6月7日的初选产生。

en.t: 1988 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 1988 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 8, 1988, Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, instead, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election. It does not cast direct electoral votes for president and vice president. Vice President George H. W.

zh.t: 1988年美国总统选举：关岛非正式民调
zh.s: 关岛于1988年11月8日举行美国总统选举非正式民调。关岛是属地而非州，因此无权选出选举人团成员；该属地会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统意向投票，不直接投票选出总统和副总统。副总统乔治·H·W。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1989 Battle of Amgala took place on 8 November 1989, when two POLISARIO mechanized columns launched a massive attack against Moroccan troops in the Amgala region, managing to cross the Moroccan Wall and advance twenty kilometers in direction to Smara, to finally retreat to their positions in the Liberated territories. It would be the last military operation of the Western Sahara War until the 1991 Operation Rattle.

zh.s: 1989年安姆加拉战役发生于11月8日。波利萨里奥阵线的两个机械化纵队向摩洛哥军队发动大规模进攻，突破摩洛哥墙，并向斯马拉方向推进20公里，最后撤回其在解放区的阵地。这是西撒哈拉战争中最后一次军事行动，直到1991年“响尾蛇”行动才再度发生军事行动。

en.s: The 1990 Iowa gubernatorial election took place November 8, 1990. Incumbent Republican Governor of Iowa Terry Branstad ran for re-election to a third term as governor. On the Democratic side, state representative Donald Avenson won his party's nomination and both Branstad and Avenson moved on to the general election. Branstad won re-election to a third term as governor, defeating Avenson by a margin of over 20 points.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于1990年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长特里·布兰斯塔德争取第三个任期。民主党方面，州众议员唐纳德·阿文森赢得党内提名。布兰斯塔德和阿文森随后进入大选，布兰斯塔德以超过20个百分点的优势击败阿文森，成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: A 1990 by-election was held for the United Kingdom House of Commons for one Member of Parliament (MP) in the constituency of Bradford North, in West Yorkshire, England, on 8 November 1990 owing to the death of the sitting MP Pat Wall. Bradford is a city based on heavy engineering and textile industries.

zh.s: 1990年11月8日，英格兰西约克郡的布拉德福德北区举行英国下议院补选，选出一名议员，填补时任议员帕特·沃尔去世后留下的空缺。布拉德福德是重型工程和纺织业发达的城市。

en.s: The 1992 AFC Asian Cup final was a football match which determined the winner of the 1992 AFC Asian Cup, the 10th edition of the AFC Asian Cup, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of the Asian Football Confederation.

zh.s: 1992年11月8日，亚洲足球联合会举办第十届亚洲杯决赛，决出该届赛事的冠军。亚洲杯每四年举行一次，参赛队伍为亚足联成员协会的男子国家队。

en.t: Pancrase: Yes, We Are Hybrid Wrestlers 3
en.s: Pancrase: Yes, We Are Hybrid Wrestlers 3 was a mixed martial arts event held by Pancrase Hybrid Wrestling. It took place at Kobe World Commemoration Hall in Kobe, Japan on November 8, 1993.

zh.s: Pancrase：我们是混合式摔角手 3是Pancrase Hybrid Wrestling举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于1993年11月8日在日本神户的神户世界纪念馆举行。

en.s: The 1993 Kazakhstan Cup final was the second final of the Kazakhstan Cup. The match was contested by Dostyk and Taraz at Central Stadium in Almaty. The match was played on 8 November 1993 and was the final match of the competition.

zh.s: 1993年哈萨克斯坦杯决赛是该赛事的第二届决赛。比赛于1993年11月8日在阿拉木图中央体育场举行，由多斯特克对阵塔拉兹。这是本届赛事的最后一场比赛。

en.s: The 1994 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Ann Richards was defeated in her bid for reelection by Republican nominee George W. Bush, the son of former President George H. W. Bush. Although prior to the election year, Governor Ann Richards held a large approval rating as the state economy was strong into the mid-term election. George Bush's campaigning on cultural and religious issues resonated with many Texan voters and Governor Richard's lead over Bush significantly narrowed up to election day into a tossup.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长安·理查兹竞选连任，但败给共和党候选人乔治·W·布什，后者是前总统乔治·H·W·布什之子。选举年到来之前，得州经济仍然强劲，理查兹的支持率很高。布什围绕文化和宗教议题展开竞选，获得许多得州选民支持，理查兹对布什的领先优势逐步缩小，选情到选举日已难分胜负。
