en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming, 1994
en.s: The 1994 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming were held on November 8, 1994 to determine who will represent the state of Wyoming in the United States House of Representatives. Wyoming has one, at large district in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census, due to its low population. Representatives are elected for two-year terms. This election was for an open seat because incumbent Craig L. Thomas retired to run for U.S. Senator for Wyoming.

zh.t: 1994年美国联邦众议院怀俄明州选举
zh.s: 1994年11月8日，怀俄明州举行联邦众议院选举，以确定该州由谁代表进入联邦众议院。由于人口较少，依据1990年美国人口普查，怀俄明州只有一个全州选区。联邦众议员任期两年。本次选举是开放席位选举，时任议员克雷格·L·托马斯决定退休，转而竞选怀俄明州联邦参议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Maryland gubernatorial election of 1994 was held on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic Governor William Donald Schaefer was ineligible for re-election. Executive Parris Glendening emerged victorious from the Democratic primary after defeating several candidates. Former State Delegate Ellen Sauerbrey, who would also be the 1998 Republican nominee for Governor, won her party's nomination. The election between Glendening and Sauerbrey was extremely contentious, and ended with the Sauerbrey campaign challenging the results. Ultimately, despite the controversial nature of the election, Executive Glendening narrowly beat Sauerbrey's spirited challenge.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长威廉·唐纳德·谢弗受限制，不能竞选连任。继任者选举中，多名候选人分散了主要人选的支持率，前执行长帕里斯·格伦登赢得民主党初选。前州众议员艾伦·索尔布里后来也在1998年获共和党州长提名，她此次获得共和党提名。格伦登和索尔布里之间的选举竞争十分激烈，索尔布里竞选团队对结果提出质疑。尽管选举过程备受争议，格伦登最终仍以微弱优势击败索尔布里的有力挑战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1994 California gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, in the midst of that year's Republican Revolution. Incumbent Republican Pete Wilson easily won re-election over his main challenger, Democratic State Treasurer Kathleen Brown, the daughter of Pat Brown and younger sister of Jerry Brown, both of whom had previously served as governor. Although Wilson initially trailed Brown in the polls as a result of the state's faltering economy, his signature opposition to affirmative action and state services for illegal immigrants (with the associated Proposition 187) eventually led to his win.

en.s: The U.S. Senate election, 1994 was an election held on November 8, 1994, in which the Republican Party was able to take control of the Senate from the Democrats. In a midterm election, the opposition Republicans held the traditional advantage. Congressional Republicans campaigned against the early presidency of Bill Clinton, including his unsuccessful health care plan. The Republicans successfully defended all of its seats and captured eight seats from the Democrats, including the seats of sitting Senators Harris Wofford (PA) and Jim Sasser (TN), as well as six open seats in Arizona, Maine, Michigan, Ohio, Oklahoma, and Tennessee.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1994
en.s: The 1994 U.S. House of Representatives election (also known as the Republican Revolution) was held on November 8, 1994, in the middle of President Bill Clinton's first term. As a result of a 54-seat swing in membership from Democrats to Republicans, the Republican Party gained a majority of seats in the United States House of Representatives for the first time since 1952 and a majority of votes for the first time since 1946. It was also the largest seat gain for the Republican Party since 1946. The Democratic Party had run the House for all but four of the preceding 62 years.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，美国举行联邦众议院选举。这次选举也称“共和党革命”，在民主党籍总统比尔·克林顿首个任期中举行。共和党从民主党手中净增54席，自1952年以来首次赢得联邦众议院多数席位，自1946年以来首次赢得多数选票。这也是共和党自1946年以来最大的一次席位增长。此前62年中，民主党控制众议院的时间除四年外一直占多数。

Branstad ultimately won re-election to a fourth term as governor, defeating Bonnie Campbell by a comfortable margin.

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Maine was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator and Senate Majority Leader George J. Mitchell decided to retire, instead of seeking a third full term. Congressman Tom Andrews won the Democratic primary unopposed, while Congresswoman Olympia Snowe won the Republican primary unopposed. Snowe was not challenging Leader Mitchell for his Senate seat, she ran the seat when it became open upon his retirement announcement on March 3rd 1994.

zh.s: 1994年缅因州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员兼参议院多数党领袖乔治·J·米切尔决定退休，不再竞选第三个完整任期。联邦众议员汤姆·安德鲁斯在民主党初选中无人竞争；联邦众议员奥林匹亚·斯诺则在共和党初选中无人竞争。斯诺并非要挑战米切尔、争夺他的参议员席位；米切尔于1994年3月3日宣布退休后，该席位空出，斯诺遂竞选这一席位。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Howard Metzenbaum decided to retire after 19 years in the United States Senate. Republican nominee Mike DeWine won the open seat against Democratic nominee Joel Hyatt, Metzenbaum's son-in-law. Independent candidate, conservative anti-abortion activist Joe Slovenec performed very well, getting over 7% of the vote.

zh.t: 1994年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员霍华德·梅岑鲍姆在参议院任职19年后决定退休。共和党候选人迈克·德怀恩赢得空出的席位，击败了民主党候选人乔尔·海亚特；海亚特是梅岑鲍姆的女婿。独立候选人、保守派反堕胎人士乔·斯洛维内茨表现不错，获得超过7%的选票。

en.s: The 1994 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Timothy R. Mayberry.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任州审计长路易斯·L·戈尔茨坦击败共和党候选人蒂莫西·R·梅伯里。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 8, 1994 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 20, 1994.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1994年11月8日举行大选。选举包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、州检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和州审计长等全州职位；也包括联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长顾问等选区职位，以及州和地方层级的公投议题。民主党和共和党的候选人由1994年9月20日举行的党内初选选出。

en.s: The 1994 Rhode Island gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1994. Republican Lincoln Almond defeated Democrat Myrth York and independent candidate Robert J. Healey. Incumbent Democrat Bruce Sundlun was defeated by York in the Democratic primary. Almond was the first governor elected to a four-year term, as opposed to two years.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党人林肯·阿尔蒙德击败民主党人迈尔思·约克和独立候选人罗伯特·J·希利。民主党籍时任州长布鲁斯·桑德伦在党内初选中败给约克。阿尔蒙德是该州首位当选四年任期的州长，此前州长任期为两年。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Missouri was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Danforth decided to retire and not seek re-election. Former Governor John Ashcroft won the Republican primary and faced Democratic Congressman Alan Wheat in the general election. Ashcroft defeated Wheat in a landslide, winning 60 percent of the vote to Wheat's 36 percent.

zh.t: 1994年密苏里州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 密苏里州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员约翰·丹佛斯决定退休，不再争取连任。前州长约翰·阿什克罗夫特赢得共和党提名，在大选中对阵民主党籍联邦众议员艾伦·惠特。阿什克罗夫特以压倒性优势获胜，得票率为60%，惠特为36%。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Rhode Island was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Chafee won re-election to a fourth term, as well as his planned final term. Chafee died of heart-failure on October 24, 1999, at Walter Reed Army Medical Center, having already announced his intention to retire in 2000 on March 15, 1999.

zh.t: 1994年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 罗得岛州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员约翰·查菲成功连任第四个任期，这也是他计划中的最后一个任期。查菲于1999年10月24日在沃尔特·里德陆军医疗中心因心力衰竭去世；此前，他已于1999年3月15日宣布计划在2000年退休。

en.s: The 1994 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 8, 1994, to elect the Texas Attorney General. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Dan Morales won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Don Wittig, 53.7% to 43.4%. As of 2026, this is the last time a Democrat has won election to the office of Texas Attorney General.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1994年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党籍时任检察长丹·莫拉莱斯以53.7%对43.4%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐·维蒂格，成功连任第二个任期。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次当选得克萨斯州检察长。

en.s: The 1994 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 1994, to elect the Minnesota Attorney General for a four-year term. Incumbent DFLer Skip Humphrey ran for re-election to a fourth term, ultimately defeating Republican nominee Sharon Anderson. The election marked the seventh attorney general race in a row won by the DFL since 1970.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1994年11月8日（星期二）举行州检察长选举，选出任期四年的州检察长。民主党—农工党籍时任检察长“跳过”汉弗莱争取第四个任期，最终击败共和党候选人莎伦·安德森。这是自1970年以来，民主党—农工党连续第七次赢得州检察长选举。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 1994 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1994 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 8, 1994, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Incumbent Shadow Senator Florence Pendleton won reelection to a second term.

zh.t: 1994年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于1994年11月8日举行影子联邦参议员选举，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的影子参议员。该职位只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会由美国联邦参议院正式宣誓就职或列入该院。影子参议员弗洛伦斯·彭德尔顿成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1994 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Former United States Associate Attorney General Frank Keating pulled an upset in the three-way race to become only the third Republican governor in Oklahoma history. The Democratic vote was split between Lieutenant Governor Jack Mildren, an Oklahoma Sooners star quarterback from 1969 to 1971, and former Democratic congressman Wes Watkins, who ran as an independent.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。前美国司法部助理部长弗兰克·基廷在三人竞逐中爆冷胜出，成为俄克拉何马州历史上第三位共和党籍州长。民主党选票被副州长杰克·米尔德伦和以独立候选人身份参选的前民主党籍联邦众议员韦斯·沃特金斯分散。米尔德伦曾在1969年至1971年担任俄克拉何马大学橄榄球队的明星四分卫。

en.s: The 1994 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1994, to elect the governor of Connecticut. Republican John G. Rowland won the open seat following the retirement of A Connecticut Party Governor Lowell Weicker. The election was a four-way race between A Connecticut Party Lieutenant Governor Eunice Groark, Republican U.S. Congressman John G. Rowland, Democratic state comptroller Bill Curry, and independent conservative talk show host Tom Scott.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举，选出该州州长。共和党人约翰·G·罗兰在“康涅狄格党”州长洛厄尔·韦克尔退休后赢得空出的席位。四名主要候选人分别是“康涅狄格党”副州长尤尼斯·格罗克、共和党籍联邦众议员约翰·G·罗兰、民主党籍州审计长比尔·柯里，以及保守派独立脱口秀主持人汤姆·斯科特。

en.s: The 1994 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joan Growe defeated Independent-Republican nominee Richard Kimbler and Grassroots nominee Dale D. Wilkinson.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1994年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿琼·格罗击败独立共和党候选人理查德·金布勒和草根党候选人戴尔·D·威尔金森。

en.s: On November 8, 1994, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor. It featured the return of Marion Barry, who served as mayor from 1979 until 1991. Barry served six months in prison on a cocaine conviction. After his release from prison, Barry ran successfully for the Ward 8 city council seat in 1992, running under the slogan "He May Not Be Perfect, But He's Perfect for D.C."

zh.t: 1994年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 1994年11月8日，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区举行市长选举。曾于1979年至1991年担任市长的马里昂·巴里再次成为选举焦点。他曾因可卡因案服刑6个月，出狱后于1992年竞选并当选第八选区市议员。

en.s: The 1994 Florida Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1994. Democratic incumbent Bob Butterworth defeated Republican nominee Henry Ferro with 57.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1994年11月8日举行州检察长选举。民主党籍时任检察长鲍勃·巴特沃思以57.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨利·费罗。

en.s: The 1994 Florida Treasurer election took place on November 8, 1994 to elect the Treasurer, Insurance Commissioner, and Fire Marshal of Florida, alongside many other elections in the state and around the country. Incumbent Treasurer Tom Gallagher was term-limited and unable to run again. In his place, Democrat Bill Nelson was elected with 51.7% of the vote, defeating Republican State Rep. Tim Ireland.

zh.t: 1994年佛罗里达州财政部长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1994年11月8日举行财政部长选举，选出该州财政部长、保险专员和消防总监，并与州内及全国许多其他选举同期举行。民主党籍时任财政部长汤姆·加拉格尔受任期限制，不能继续参选。接替他参选的民主党人比尔·纳尔逊以51.7%的得票率当选，击败共和党候选人、州众议员蒂姆·爱尔兰。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in New Mexico was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democrat Jeff Bingaman won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1994年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员杰夫·宾格曼成功连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1994 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1994 congressional elections in Tennessee were held on November 8, 1994, to determine who would represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 1994 elections, Republicans gained two seats, putting the Tennessee delegation at a 5-4 Republican majority. The last time Republicans won a majority in the House delegation was in 1972.

zh.t: 1994年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 田纳西州于1994年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，决定由谁代表该州进入联邦众议院。选举后，共和党赢得两个席位，田纳西州代表团中的共和党议员以5席对4席占多数。共和党人上一次在该州联邦众议院代表团中占多数是在1972年。

en.s: The 1994 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 8, 1994, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 53rd session as part of the 1994 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 16. All odd-numbered seats were up for election, as well as districts 20, 22, and 28. Both Republicans and Democrats flipped one seat.

zh.s: 怀俄明州于1994年11月8日举行州参议院选举，选出第53届州议会议员。党派初选于8月16日举行。所有奇数编号席位，以及第20、22和28选区的席位都进行改选。共和党和民主党各赢得一个原属对方的席位。

en.s: The 1994 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic Governor Mike Sullivan was unable to seek a third term because of newly imposed term limits, and instead ran for the U.S. Senate. State Senate President Jim Geringer won the Republican primary and faced Secretary of State Kathy Karpan, the Democratic nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 1994年怀俄明州州长选举于11月8日举行。新实行的任期限制使民主党籍现任州长迈克·沙利文无法竞选第三个任期，因此他转而竞选联邦参议员。州参议院议长吉姆·格林杰赢得共和党初选，并在普选中面对民主党候选人、州务卿凯西·卡潘。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Utah was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Orrin Hatch won re-election to a fourth term. This was Orrin Hatch's best performance from all of his runs for senate.

zh.s: 犹他州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员奥林·哈奇成功连任第四个任期。这是哈奇历次参议院竞选中表现最好的一次。

en.s: The 1994 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994. Republican Bill Graves, the incumbent Secretary of State of Kansas, won the open seat vacated by the pending retirement of incumbent Democratic Governor Joan Finney. Graves defeated Democrat Jim Slattery, the congressman from the second congressional district. Slattery himself defeated incumbent Lieutenant Governor Jim Francisco and state representative Joan Wagnon in the Democratic primary.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党人、时任州务卿比尔·格雷夫斯赢得空出的州长职位；民主党籍时任州长琼·芬尼即将退休，不再争取连任。格雷夫斯击败了来自第二国会选区的民主党籍联邦众议员吉姆·斯莱特里。斯莱特里此前在民主党初选中击败了时任副州长吉姆·弗朗西斯科和州众议员琼·瓦格农。

en.s: The 1994 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Republican Governor Jim Edgar won reelection in a landslide. Edgar carried 101 of the state's 102 counties over the Democratic nominee, State Comptroller Dawn Clark Netsch, with Netsch only winning Gallatin County by a narrow margin. This was the first time in Illinois that a woman was a major party's nominee for governor, with 2006 being the only other time.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长吉姆·埃德加以压倒性优势连任。他在102个县中的101个县获胜；民主党候选人、州审计长唐·克拉克·内奇仅以微弱优势赢得加拉廷县。这是伊利诺伊州历史上首次由女性获得主要政党的州长候选人提名；之后仅在2006年再次出现这种情况。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1994 took place on November 8, 1994. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1994年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行县行政长官选举。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县都选出了县行政长官。

en.s: The 1994 Guam gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the Governor of Guam. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Guam Legislature Carl Gutierrez defeated Republican nominee Francisco Blas Aguon Sr.

zh.s: 关岛于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党候选人、关岛立法机关时任议员卡尔·古铁雷斯击败共和党候选人弗朗西斯科·布拉斯·阿贡老。

en.s: The 1994 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Independent Republican nominee Judi Dutcher defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Donald Moe and Grassroots nominee Steven C. Anderson.

zh.t: 1994年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于1994年11月8日举行州审计长选举。独立共和党候选人朱迪·达彻击败民主党—农工党候选人、前明尼苏达州参议员唐纳德·莫和草根党候选人史蒂文·C·安德森。

en.t: 1994 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 1994 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 8, 1994, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Republican Pauline R. Kezer did not seek re-election to a second term, instead opting to run for governor. Democratic nominee and state representative from the 18th district Miles S. Rapoport narrowly defeated Republican nominee Andrea Scott by 2,237 votes, a margin of just 0.22%.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1994年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党籍时任州务卿波琳·R·凯泽没有争取连任第二个任期，转而竞选州长。民主党候选人、州第18选区众议员迈尔斯·S·拉波波特以2,237票之差险胜共和党候选人安德烈娅·斯科特，得票率仅领先0.22%。

en.s: The 1994 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 1994, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 13, 1994. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Governor, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1994年11月8日（星期二）举行州众议院选举，党内初选于1994年9月13日（星期二）举行。选民在多议员选区中选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年。选举与全国及亚利桑那州其他选举同期进行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。

en.s: The 1994 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 8, 1994, as part of the 1994 United States elections, including the 1994 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection. Republicans tied themselves to the tax-cutting debate surrounding the gubernatorial election between Prince George's County Executive Parris Glendening and House Minority Leader Ellen Sauerbrey, which led to the party gaining 17 seats from the Democrats.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行众议院选举，与1994年美国各地选举同期进行，其中包括马里兰州州长选举。州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。共和党将自己与州长候选人、乔治王子县行政长官帕里斯·格伦登和众议院少数党领袖埃伦·索尔布雷之间的减税辩论联系起来，最终比民主党多赢得17个席位。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Nevada was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democrat Richard Bryan won re-election to a second term. This was the last time a Democrat won Nevada's Class 1 Senate Seat until Jacky Rosen was elected to it in 2018.

zh.t: 1994年内华达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 内华达州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员理查德·布莱恩成功连任第二个任期。直到2018年杰基·罗森当选之前，此后再没有民主党人赢得内华达州第一类参议员席位。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate Election in Maryland was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic Senator Paul Sarbanes won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.t: 1994年马里兰州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员保罗·萨班斯成功连任第四个任期。

en.t: 1994 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the United States Virgin Islands on November 8, 1994, to elect a new governor and lieutenant governor, 15 members of the Legislature of the Virgin Islands and the Delegate to the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛于1994年11月8日举行大选，选出新任总督和副总督、美属维尔京群岛立法机关的15名议员，以及一名联邦众议院代表。

en.s: The 1994 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 1994. Republican nominee Candice Miller defeated incumbent Democrat Richard H. Austin with 53.56% of the vote, amidst a national Republican landslide.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1994年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人坎迪丝·米勒以53.56%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州务卿理查德·H·奥斯汀。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 1994 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 8, 1994, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Two-term incumbent and inaugural office-holder Charles Moreland declined to run for reelection and was succeeded by fellow Democrat John Capozzi.

zh.t: 1994年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于1994年11月8日举行联邦众议员选举，选出该区的影子众议员。与没有投票权的联邦众议院代表不同，影子众议员只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或在联邦众议院取得席位。两届时任影子众议员、首任议员查尔斯·莫兰德没有争取连任，由同为民主党人的约翰·卡波齐接替。

en.s: The 1994 Arkansas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1994, as a part of the United States gubernatorial elections, 1994. Incumbent Governor Jim Guy Tucker, who following the resignation of Bill Clinton in 1992 following his election to the presidency, won a full term in a landslide victory despite a national Republican landslide. This would be the last time a Democrat was elected Governor until 2006.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长吉姆·盖伊·塔克赢得完整任期，并以压倒性优势获胜。比尔·克林顿于1992年当选总统后辞去州长职务，塔克随后接任。直到2006年，这还是民主党人最后一次当选阿肯色州州长。

en.s: The 1994 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democrat Bob Bullock successfully ran for re-election against Republican Attorney Tex Lezar and won in a landslide. Bullock had announced his intent to run for re-election through a newsletter in September 1992; the early announcement was a signature of his and allowed him to begin fundraising much earlier and helped to dissuade potential opponents from challenging him.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1994年11月8日举行副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长鲍勃·布洛克成功连任，竞选中以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人、律师特克斯·利扎尔。布洛克早在1992年9月就通过一份通讯宣布将争取连任；他的提前宣布是其竞选的标志，让他能更早筹款，也劝退了可能的挑战者。

en.s: The 1994 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, to select the governor of the state of Colorado. Although Colorado voters passed a term limits ballot measure in 1990 limiting the governors to two consecutive terms, it was not retroactive and only applied for terms beginning in 1991 or later, thus Roy Romer, the Democratic incumbent first elected in 1986, was able to run for reelection for a third term.

zh.s: 1994年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州州长。科罗拉多州选民在1990年通过公投限制州长连续任期不得超过两届，但该限制不溯及既往，只适用于1991年或之后开始的任期。因此，1986年首次当选的民主党籍现任州长罗伊·罗默得以竞选连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1994 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Margaret B. Kelly defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Steve Danner and Libertarian nominee Grant Stauffer.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1994年11月8日举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任州审计长玛格丽特·B.凯利击败民主党候选人、时任密苏里州参议员史蒂夫·丹纳和自由意志党候选人格兰特·斯陶弗，成功连任。

en.s: The 1994 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 8, 1994, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general J. Joseph Curran Jr. defeated Republican nominee Richard D. Bennett.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人、时任总检察长J.约瑟夫·柯伦二世击败共和党候选人理查德·D.贝内特。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 8, 1994. Primaries were held on March 15, 1994. These elections saw the Republican Party make significant gains, and conversely saw the Democratic Party see significant losses. The Republican Party captured the State House and retained control of the State Senate and, winning them a trifecta of state government control.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1994年11月8日星期二举行选举，初选在同年3月15日举行。共和党取得显著进展，民主党则明显失利。共和党赢得州众议院，并保住州参议院多数席位，从而同时掌控州长职位和州议会两院。

en.s: The 1994 Maryland Senate election were held on November 8, 1994, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland. Republicans picked up six seats from the Democrats by tying themselves to the tax-cutting debate surrounding the gubernatorial election between Parris Glendening and Ellen Sauerbrey.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1994年11月8日举行州参议院选举，选出州参议院全部47个选区的议员。每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年。此次选举与联邦及州级多项选举同时举行，包括州长选举。共和党借助州长选举中帕里斯·格伦登与艾伦·索尔兹伯里围绕减税展开的辩论，从民主党手中赢得6席。

en.t: 1994 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election
en.s: The 1994 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election was held on November 8, 1994 to elect the Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries. A.W. Todd lost re-election to a second consecutive term.

zh.t: 1994年阿拉巴马州农业与工业事务专员选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1994年11月8日举行农业与工业事务专员选举。A.W.托德未能再次当选，无法连续第二次连任。

en.s: The 1994 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 1994. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 13, 1994. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1994年11月8日举行参议院选举，选民选出州参议院全部30个选区的议员，任期两年。初选于同年9月13日举行。选举前，共和党在州参议院占18席，多于民主党的12席。

en.s: The 1994 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democrat Frank J. Kelley defeated Republican nominee John Smietanka with 57.41% of the vote. Coinciding with Governor John Engler’s landslide re-election victory, Kelley’s margin of victory decreased from the previous election.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1994年11月8日举行总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长弗兰克·J.凯利以57.41%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·斯米坦卡。同期举行的州长选举中，约翰·恩格勒大胜连任；与上次选举相比，凯利的领先幅度有所缩小。

en.s: The 1994 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 1994, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Joseph M. Suggs Jr. was appointed to the office by the Connecticut General Assembly to complete the term of Francisco L. Borges, who resigned to become an executive at the New York-based Financial Guaranty Insurance Company. Suggs lost election to a full term to Republican nominee Chris Burnham.

zh.t: 1994年康涅狄格州州财政长选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1994年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任州财政长约瑟夫·M.萨格斯二世此前由州议会任命，接替辞职的弗朗西斯科·L.博尔赫斯，完成其剩余任期。博尔赫斯辞职后，成为总部位于纽约的金融担保保险公司的高管。萨格斯未能赢得完整任期，败给共和党候选人克里斯·伯纳姆。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Arizona was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Dennis DeConcini decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican nominee Jon Kyl won the open seat, becoming the first Republican to win Arizona's Class 1 Senate seat since Paul Fannin in 1970. Democrats would not win this seat again, or any Senate race in the state, until Kyrsten Sinema's victory in 2018.

zh.t: 1994年亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1994年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员丹尼斯·德孔奇尼决定退休，没有竞选第四个任期。共和党候选人乔恩·凯尔赢得空出的席位，成为自1970年保罗·范宁以来首位赢得亚利桑那州第一类参议院席位的共和党人。直到2018年克尔斯滕·西内马胜选前，民主党此后一直未能赢得该席位或该州任何一场参议院选举。

en.s: The 1994 Tennessee gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 1994 to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Ned McWherter was term-limited, leaving the governorship an open seat. Republican congressman Don Sundquist was elected Governor of Tennessee, defeating Democratic nominee Phil Bredesen, the mayor of Nashville, who later won Tennessee's governorship in 2002 & 2006.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1994年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长内德·麦克沃特任期届满，无法竞选连任，州长职位因此空缺。共和党籍联邦众议员唐·桑德奎斯特当选州长，击败民主党候选人、纳什维尔市长菲尔·布雷德森。布雷德森后来于2002年和2006年两度当选田纳西州州长。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Washington was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Senator Slade Gorton won re-election to a second consecutive term. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican, a man, or a non-Catholic won a U.S. Senate election in Washington.

zh.t: 1994年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1994年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任参议员斯莱德·戈顿赢得连任，开始连续第二个任期。截至2026年，这是共和党人、男性或非天主教徒最后一次赢得华盛顿州第1类美国参议院席位。

en.s: The 1994 Little Rock mayoral election took place on November 8, 1994, to elect the mayor of Little Rock, Arkansas. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Dalton J. "Jim" Dailey, Jr. This was the first time that voters directly elected the mayor of Little Rock since the city had previously adopted a council–manager government style of government in 1957. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 1994年小石城市长选举于11月8日举行，选出阿肯色州小石城市市长。现任市长道尔顿·J.“吉姆”·戴利二世再次当选。这是该市1957年改为市议会-经理制后，首次由选民直接选举市长。选举正式采用无党派形式。

en.s: The 1994 New York State Comptroller election took place on November 8, 1994. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Carl McCall narrowly defeated Republican nominee Herbert London.

zh.s: 1994年纽约州审计长选举于11月8日举行。民主党候选人、现任审计长卡尔·麦考尔险胜共和党候选人赫伯特·伦敦。

en.s: On November 8, 1994, gubernatorial elections were held in 36 states and two territories across the United States. Many seats held by Democratic governors switched to the Republicans during the time known as the Republican Revolution. Notably, this marked the first time since 1969 that Republicans secured the majority of governorships in an election cycle.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，美国36个州和两个属地举行州长选举。许多由民主党州长执掌的州转而选出共和党州长，这段时期被称为“共和党革命”。这是自1969年以来，共和党首次在一个选举周期中赢得多数州长职位。

en.s: The 1994 New York gubernatorial election was an election for the state governorship held on November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic governor Mario Cuomo ran for a fourth term, but was defeated by Republican George Pataki in an upset victory. Pataki had previously been described by the New York Daily News as "a little-known Republican state senator."

zh.s: 1994年纽约州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党州长马里奥·科莫竞选第四个任期，但意外败给共和党人乔治·帕塔基。《纽约每日新闻》此前称帕塔基是“一位名不见经传的共和党州参议员”。

en.s: The 1994 Georgia gubernatorial election occurred on November 8, 1994, to elect the next governor of Georgia from 1995 to 1999. Incumbent Democratic governor Zell Miller, first elected in 1990, ran for a second term. In his party's primary, Miller received three challengers, but easily prevailed with just over 70% of the vote. The contest for the Republican nomination, however, was a competitive race.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，佐治亚州举行州长选举，选出1995年至1999年的州长。1990年首次当选的民主党籍现任州长泽尔·米勒争取连任；尽管有三人参加党内初选挑战，他仍以略高于70%的得票率胜出。共和党的提名竞选则更为激烈。

en.s: The 1994 New York Attorney General election took place on November 8, 1994. Republican nominee Dennis Vacco narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Karen Burstein. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican was elected Attorney General of New York.

zh.s: 1994年纽约州检察长选举于11月8日举行。共和党候选人丹尼斯·瓦科险胜民主党候选人凯伦·伯斯坦。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选纽约州检察长。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 8, 1994. Primaries were held March 15, 1994. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, both seats of the Cook County Board of Appeals, seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships in the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行大选，初选已于3月15日举行。选民改选县估税官、县书记官、警长、财政官、县委员会议长、全部17名县委员、上诉委员会两个席位、水务管理区董事会部分席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 1994 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 1994, to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia, concurrently with the 1994 gubernatorial election, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Georgia is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举，与州长、联邦众议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。佐治亚州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in New York was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan won re-election to a fourth term. As of 2024, this is the last time a man has won the Class 1 Senate seat from New York.

zh.s: 1994年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党参议员丹尼尔·帕特里克·莫伊尼汉赢得连任，开始第四个任期。截至2024年，这是男性最后一次赢得纽约州第1类参议院席位。

en.t: 1994 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1994 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 8, 1994, to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia had eleven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 1994, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1994年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1994年11月8日，佐治亚州举行联邦众议院选举，改选该州全部11个席位。这一席位数依据1990年美国人口普查确定。此次选举与联邦参议院、其他州的联邦众议院及各级州和地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1994 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in all 31 State Senate districts due to redistricting. Half of the seats were elected for two-year terms and the other half were elected for four-year terms. The winners of this election served in the 74th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州参议院选举。由于选区重新划分，全部31个席位都参与改选，其中一半选出任期两年的议员，另一半选出任期四年的议员。当选议员进入第74届州议会。

en.s: The 1994 Hawaii gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 3, to elect the next Governor of Hawaii. Incumbent Governor of Hawaii John D. Waihee III was prevented from seeking a third term as Governor due to term limits, creating an open seat.

zh.s: 夏威夷州于11月3日（星期二）举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。时任州长约翰·D·怀希三世受任期限制，不能竞选第三届，因此该职位开放竞选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1994 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1994 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1994 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，艾奥瓦州举行州参议院选举，50个选区中的25个奇数编号选区改选。州参议员每届任期四年，约半数席位每两年改选一次。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1994 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 74th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans gained a net of two seats from the Democrats, reducing the Democratic majority to 89 out of 150 seats.

zh.s: 1994年11月8日，得克萨斯州举行州众议院选举，全部150个选区改选。共和党从民主党手中净增两席，使民主党席位降至150席中的89席，但仍保持多数。当选议员任期两年，进入第74届州议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1994 United States Senate election in Vermont
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Vermont was held, where incumbent centrist Republican senator Jim Jeffords won re-election to a second term against state senator Jan Backus and independent Gavin Mills. He won every county in the state.

zh.t: 1994年佛蒙特州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1994年11月8日，佛蒙特州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员吉姆·杰福兹击败州参议员简·巴克斯和独立候选人加文·米尔斯，连任第二届，并在全州每个县都获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1994 Oakland mayoral election was held on June 7, 1994, and November 8, 1994, to elect the mayor of Oakland, California. It saw the reelection of Elihu Harris. Since no candidate secured a majority in the first round, a runoff election was held between the top-two finishers, Harris and Ted Dang.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1994年奥克兰市长选举于6月7日和11月8日举行，选出加利福尼亚州奥克兰市市长。以利休·哈里斯成功连任。首轮投票中无人获得过半选票，因此得票最高的两位哈里斯和特德·当进入第二轮。
zh.n: 原文资料框将此条日期定为第二轮投票日。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1994 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Republican councilman Robert W. "Bo" Williams in the race to succeed incumbent Hazel Beard. The primary election was held on October 1, 1994. Williams and fellow councilman Roy Cary advanced to the general election held on November 8, 1994. Notably, incumbent mayor Beard decided not to run for re-election though she has served only one term and was eligible to contest another race.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1994年什里夫波特市长选举中，共和党市议员罗伯特·W·“博”·威廉姆斯当选，接替现任市长黑泽尔·比尔德。初选于1994年10月1日举行，威廉姆斯和另一名市议员罗伊·凯里进入11月8日举行的大选。比尔德虽只任职一届且仍符合参选资格，但决定不竞选连任。
zh.n: 原文资料框将此条日期定为第二轮投票日。

en.s: The 1995 United Nations Security Council election was held on 8 November 1995 at United Nations Headquarters in New York City during the 50th session of the United Nations General Assembly. The General Assembly elected five non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year terms commencing on 1 January 1996. The five candidates elected were Chile, Egypt, Guinea-Bissau, Poland, and the Republic of Korea with Guinea-Bissau and South Korea being elected for the first time.

zh.t: 1995年联合国安全理事会非常任理事国选举
zh.s: 1995年11月8日，第50届联合国大会在纽约联合国总部举行安全理事会非常任理事国选举。大会选出5个非常任理事国席位，任期两年，自1996年1月1日起算。智利、埃及、几内亚比绍、波兰和韩国当选，其中几内亚比绍和韩国是首次当选。

en.s: Ultimate Jeopardy was the third and final Ultimate Jeopardy professional wrestling supercard produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). It took place on November 8, 1997 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. Excerpts from Ultimate Jeopardy aired on episodes #238 and #239 of the syndicated television show ECW Hardcore TV on November 15 and 22, 1997.

zh.s: 《终极危机》是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第三场、也是最后一场同名职业摔角大型赛事。赛事于1997年11月8日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。赛事片段于11月15日和22日播出的联合发行电视节目《ECW硬核电视》第238集和第239集中播出。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt in three stages between 18 October and 8 November 2000. The result was a victory for the ruling National Democratic Party (NDP), which won 353 of the 454 seats, with 35 of the 72 independents elected joining the NDP after the elections. The banned Muslim Brotherhood came in a distant second, with 17 of its candidates elected running as independents.

zh.s: 埃及议会选举分三个阶段举行，时间为2000年10月18日至11月8日。执政的国家民主党获胜，赢得454席中的353席。72名当选的无党派人士中，有35人在选举后加入国家民主党。被取缔的穆斯林兄弟会排在第二，其17名候选人以无党派人士身份参选并当选。

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 1441 is a United Nations Security Council resolution adopted unanimously by the United Nations Security Council on 8 November 2002, offering Iraq under Saddam Hussein "a final opportunity to comply with its disarmament obligations" that had been set out in several previous resolutions (Resolutions 660, 661, 678, 686, 687, 688, 707, 715, 986, and 1284).

zh.t: 联合国安理会第1441号决议
zh.s: 联合国安理会第1441号决议于2002年11月8日经联合国安理会一致通过，给予萨达姆·侯赛因领导下的伊拉克“最后一次履行解除武装义务的机会”。这些义务载于此前的多项决议中，包括第660、661、678、686、687、688、707、715、986和1284号决议。

en.t: 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in Beijing between November 8 and 14, 2002. It was preceded by the 15th National Congress and was succeeded by the 17th National Congress. 2,114 delegates and 40 specially invited delegates represented the party's estimated 66 million members.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 中国共产党第十六次全国代表大会
zh.s: 中国共产党第十六次全国代表大会于2002年11月8日至14日在北京举行。大会由中共十五大召开，之后是中共十七大。代表和特邀代表共2,154人，代表全党约6600万名党员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: 2003 Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party leadership election
en.s: A leadership election for Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party (KDU-ČSL) was held on 8 November 2003. The incumbent leader Cyril Svoboda was unexpectedly defeated by Miroslav Kalousek.

zh.t: 2003年基督教与民主联盟—捷克斯洛伐克人民党领导人选举
zh.s: 基督教与民主联盟—捷克斯洛伐克人民党（KDU-ČSL）于2003年11月8日举行领导人选举。时任领导人西里尔·斯沃博达意外败给米罗斯拉夫·卡卢塞克。

en.s: The 2003 Akron mayoral election was held on Tuesday November 4, Incumbent Democratic Mayor Don Plusquellic ran for re-election to a fifth term. He was challenged by State Representative Bryan C. Williams, the Republican nominee. Plusquellic defeated Williams in a landslide, winning 71 percent of the vote to Williams's 29 percent, as voters simultaneously rejected a ballot measure to establish mayoral term limits.

zh.s: 阿克伦市长选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。时任民主党市长唐·普拉斯奎利克竞选连任第五届，共和党提名人、州众议员布赖恩·C·威廉姆斯向他发起挑战。普拉斯奎利克以压倒性优势击败威廉姆斯，得票率为71%，威廉姆斯为29%；选民同时否决了一项设立市长任期限制的提案。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 2005 was a race for the Governor of New Jersey. It was held on November 8, 2005. Democratic Acting Governor Richard Codey, who replaced Governor Jim McGreevey in 2004 after his resignation, did not run for election for a full term of office. The primary election was held on June 7, 2005. U.S. Senator Jon Corzine won the Democratic nomination with no serious opposition. Former Mayor Doug Forrester received the Republican nomination with a plurality of 36%. Corzine defeated Forrester in the general election.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，新泽西州举行州长选举。民主党籍代理州长理查德·科迪于2004年接替辞职的州长吉姆·麦格里维，但没有参选完整任期。初选于2005年6月7日举行。联邦参议员乔恩·科尔津在没有有力对手的情况下赢得民主党提名。前市长道格·福雷斯特以相对多数票获得共和党提名，得票率为36%。科尔津在普选中击败福雷斯特。

en.s: The Virginia Attorney General election of 2005 took place on November 8, 2005, to elect the Attorney General of Virginia. Jerry Kilgore, who had been elected Attorney General in 2001, resigned in February 2005 to run for Governor, as is the tradition in Virginia. He was replaced by Judith Jagdmann, the Deputy Attorney General for the Civil Litigation Division, who did not run in the election. The Republican primary was won by State Delegate Bob McDonnell, who defeated attorney Steve Baril. State Senator Creigh Deeds was unopposed in the Democratic primary.

zh.t: 2005年弗吉尼亚州司法部长选举
zh.s: 2005年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行司法部长选举。杰里·基尔戈尔2001年当选司法部长，2005年2月辞职竞选州长，符合弗吉尼亚州的惯例；副司法部长朱迪思·贾格曼接替他，但没有参选。共和党初选由州众议员鲍勃·麦克唐纳胜出，他击败了律师史蒂夫·巴里尔。州参议员克雷·迪兹在民主党初选中没有对手。麦克唐纳以360票优势赢得普选，因差距很小而进行了重新计票。他与州长蒂姆·凯恩、副州长比尔·博林于2006年1月14日宣誓就职。

en.s: The California special election of 2005 was held on November 8, 2005 after being called by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger on June 13, 2005.

zh.s: 2005年加利福尼亚州特别选举于2005年11月8日举行，此前州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格于同年6月13日宣布举行选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 2005 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2005. The incumbent mayor, Tom Murphy of the Democratic Party chose not to run for what would have been a record fourth straight term.

zh.s: 2005年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于2005年11月8日星期二举行。民主党籍时任市长汤姆·墨菲决定不再竞选连任，因此没有争取创纪录的第四个连续任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 2005 occurred on Tuesday November 8, 2005, with incumbent Republican mayor Michael Bloomberg soundly defeating former Bronx borough president Fernando Ferrer, the Democratic nominee. They also faced several third party candidates.

zh.s: 2005年纽约市市长选举于11月8日星期二举行。共和党籍时任市长迈克尔·布隆伯格大胜民主党提名人、前布朗克斯区区长费尔南多·费雷尔。另有几名第三党候选人参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 13 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party.

zh.s: 2005年辛辛那提市长选举于11月8日举行，选出俄亥俄州辛辛那提市市长。该选举正式按无党派选举举行，9月13日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入普选，不论其党派归属。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 2005 were held on November 8, 2005. Two states, New Jersey and Virginia, and the Northern Mariana Islands, voted to select a governor, as well as other statewide offices and members of state legislatures.

zh.s: 美国于2005年11月8日举行州长选举。新泽西州、弗吉尼亚州和北马里亚纳群岛选出州长，同时还选举了其他州级公职和州议会议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 2005 occurred on Tuesday, November 8, 2005 between incumbent mayor Thomas Menino and City Councilor Maura Hennigan. Menino was re-elected to a fourth term.

zh.s: 2005年波士顿市长选举于11月8日星期二举行，候选人为时任市长托马斯·梅尼诺和市议员莫拉·亨尼根。梅尼诺连任，开启第四个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Virginia gubernatorial election of 2005 was a race for the Governor of Virginia, United States, held on November 8, 2005, and won by Democrat Tim Kaine. Virginia is the only state in the United States to prohibit governors from serving successive terms, so the popular incumbent, Mark R. Warner, could not run for reelection.

zh.s: 2005年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行。民主党人蒂姆·凯恩赢得州长选举。弗吉尼亚州是美国唯一禁止州长连续任职的州，因此广受欢迎的时任州长马克·R·华纳不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2005 Rochester mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, in the city of Rochester, New York, United States. Robert Duffy was elected to succeed outgoing mayor William A. Johnson Jr. who chose not to seek a fourth term.

zh.s: 美国纽约州罗切斯特市于2005年11月8日举行市长选举。罗伯特·达菲当选，接替不再竞选第四个任期的即将卸任市长威廉·A.约翰逊二世。

en.s: The 2005 Minneapolis City Council elections were held on November 8, 2005 to elect the 13 members of the Minneapolis City Council for four-year terms. The election saw the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) make a net gain of two seats, giving them a 12-to-1 majority in the Council. Both incumbent Green Party of Minnesota members lost their seats, though the party secured a pickup in Ward 2 with Cam Gordon narrowly winning against the DFL-endorsed candidate.

zh.t: 2005年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯市于2005年11月8日举行市议会选举，选出13名议员，任期四年。明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党净增2席，在市议会以12比1占据多数。明尼苏达州绿党两名时任议员都失去席位，但该党在第2选区赢得一席：卡姆·戈登以微弱优势击败获民主—农民—劳工党背书的候选人。

en.s: The 2005 Toledo, Ohio mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005. Incumbent Mayor Jack Ford ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by a crowded field of candidates, with former Mayor Carty Finkbeiner, former County Commissioner Keith Wilkowski, and City Councilman Rob Ludeman. Ford significantly outraised his opponents, but faced a difficult re-election campaign.

zh.t: 2005年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 2005年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长杰克·福特竞选连任第二个任期。他面对众多候选人，包括前市长卡蒂·芬克拜纳、前县委员基思·威尔科夫斯基和市议员罗布·卢德曼。福特筹得的竞选资金远多于对手，但连任之路并不轻松。

loc: 美国宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦

en.s: The 2005 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 8, 2005, and resulted in the Democrat Ed Pawlowski, being elected to his first of four terms over Republican challenger and former mayor, William L Heydt.

zh.t: 2005年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦于2005年11月8日举行市长选举。民主党人埃德·帕夫洛夫斯基击败共和党对手、前市长威廉·L.海特，当选市长，开始其四届任期中的第一届。

en.s: The 2005 United States state legislative elections were held on November 8, 2005. Two legislative chambers in two states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in two states. Both chambers of the Northern Mariana Islands legislature was up. Democrats maintained control of the New Jersey General Assembly and Republicans maintained control of the Virginia House of Delegates.

zh.s: 美国各州议会于2005年11月8日举行选举。两个州的两个议院按常规安排举行选举。这些非大选年份的选举与其他州和地方选举同时举行，其中包括两个州的州长选举。北马里亚纳群岛议会两院也都改选。民主党继续控制新泽西州议会，共和党继续控制弗吉尼亚州众议院。

en.s: The 2005 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 8, 2005, for all 80 seats in the lower house of the New Jersey Legislature. The election coincided with a gubernatorial election where Democrat Jon Corzine won. Democrats held a 47-33 majority in the lower house prior to the election. The members of the New Jersey Legislature are chosen from 40 electoral districts.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，新泽西州议会下院80个席位均在当天改选。本次选举与州长选举同期举行，民主党人乔恩·科尔津当选州长。投票前，民主党在下院占47席，共和党占33席。新泽西州议员由40个选区选出。

en.s: The 2005 Dayton mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005. Incumbent Mayor Rhine McLin ran for re-election to a second term. She was challenged by homebuilder David Bohardt and former police major Barbara Temple. McLin argued that, while the city's revenues had fallen in worse economic times, she made progress on housing and economic development, while her opponents argued that she had mismanaged the city.

zh.s: 2005年俄亥俄州代顿市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长莱茵·麦克林竞选连任第二个任期。她面对建房商戴维·博哈特和前警察局长芭芭拉·坦普尔的挑战。麦克林表示，尽管该市收入下滑幅度超过经济状况更差时期，她仍在住房和经济发展方面取得进展；对手则指责她管理不善。

en.t: 2005 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2005 New York City borough president elections were held on November 8, 2005 to elect the presidents of each of the five boroughs in New York City. They coincided with other city elections, including for mayor, comptroller, public advocate, and city council. Primary elections were held on September 13, 2005.

zh.t: 2005年纽约市五大行政区区长选举
zh.s: 2005年11月8日，纽约市五大行政区均举行行政区长选举。此次选举与市长、主计长、市公益维护官和市议会选举同期举行。初选于2005年9月13日举行。

en.s: The 2005 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2005, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Virginia. Republican nominee Bill Bolling narrowly defeated Democrat Leslie Byrne despite incumbent Lieutenant Governor Tim Kaine's victory in the concurrent gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于2005年11月8日举行副州长选举。共和党候选人比尔·博林以微弱优势击败民主党候选人莱斯利·伯恩，尽管民主党候选人蒂姆·凯恩在同期州长选举中胜出。

en.s: The 2005 mayoral election in Atlanta, Georgia took place on November 8, 2005, alongside other Atlanta municipal races. Incumbent Mayor Shirley Franklin faced no serious opposition and was reelected with 90.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 2005年亚特兰大市长选举于11月8日举行，与其他亚特兰大市政选举同时进行。现任市长雪莉·富兰克林没有遇到有力对手，以90.49%的得票率再次当选。

en.s: The 2005 Durham mayoral election was held on November 8, 2005, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2005年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长比尔·贝尔再次当选。

en.s: The 2005 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 8, 2005, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Allen Joines.

zh.s: 2005年北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于11月8日举行，艾伦·乔因斯再次当选。

en.s: The 2005 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the election Tony Chavonne, who unseated incumbent mayor Marshall Pitts Jr.

zh.s: 2005年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举于11月8日举行。托尼·沙冯击败现任市长马歇尔·皮茨二世，当选市长。

en.s: The 2005 Seattle mayoral election took place November 8, 2005. Incumbent Mayor Greg Nickels was elected to a second term. As of 2025, this is the most recent Seattle mayoral election in which the incumbent was elected to a second term.

zh.s: 2005年西雅图市长选举于2005年11月8日举行。现任市长格雷格·尼克尔斯当选连任，开始第二个任期。截至2025年，这是西雅图市长选举中最近一次由现任市长成功连任。

en.s: The 2005 Buffalo Mayoral Election took place on November 8, 2005. After incumbent Anthony M. Masiello, a Democrat, announced on April 29, 2005, that he would not seek a fourth term as mayor, a field of several Democratic candidates emerged, from which New York State Senator Byron Brown emerged victorious in the primary election.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，纽约州布法罗市举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长安东尼·M·马西耶洛已于4月29日宣布不竞选第四个任期。随后多名民主党人参加党内初选，纽约州参议员拜伦·布朗获得提名。

en.s: The 2005 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 8, 2005. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Glenn Reibman ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by John Stoffa, a member of the Northampton Area School District Board, who attacked Reibman over a series of controversial tax increases. Stoffa narrowly defeated Reibman in the primary, winning the nomination with 52 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州北安普敦县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长格伦·赖布曼争取第三个任期，但在党内初选中遭北安普敦地区学区董事约翰·斯托法挑战。斯托法批评一系列有争议的增税，以52%的得票率险胜赖布曼，获得民主党提名。

en.s: The 2005 Detroit mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, following a primary election on August 2, 2005. Incumbent Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick, who was first elected in 2001, ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by a large field of candidates, including former Deputy Mayor Freman Hendrix, City Councilwoman Sharon McPhail, and State Senator Hansen Clarke.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，密歇根州底特律市举行市长选举，初选已于8月2日举行。2001年首次当选的现任市长夸梅·基尔帕特里克争取第二个任期。挑战者包括前副市长弗里曼·亨德里克斯、市议员莎伦·麦克菲尔和州参议员汉森·克拉克。

en.s: The 2005 Lansing mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, with a primary election taking place on August 2, 2005. Incumbent Mayor Tony Benavides ran for re-election to a second term and a first full term. In a rematch of the 2003 special election, State Senator Virgil Bernero ran against Benavides.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，密歇根州兰辛市举行市长选举，初选已于8月2日举行。现任市长托尼·贝纳维德斯争取第二个任期，也是首个完整任期。州参议员维吉尔·伯内罗再次挑战他，两人曾在2003年特别选举中交手。

en.s: The 2005 Lehigh County Executive election was held on November 8, 2005. Incumbent Republican County Executive Jane Ervin ran for re-election to a second term. She narrowly defeated engineer Kevin Ryan in the Republican primary, winning 53-47 percent, and advanced to the general election, where she was opposed by former Bethlehem Mayor Don Cunningham, the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县举行县长选举。共和党籍现任县长简·欧文争取第二个任期，在党内初选中以53%对47%险胜工程师凯文·瑞安。大选对手是民主党候选人、前伯利恒市长唐·坎宁安。

en.s: The 2005 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 8, 2005, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 4 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Jane L. Campbell ran for re-election to a second term in office, but lost the general election to Cleveland City Council President Frank G.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州克利夫兰市于2005年11月8日举行市长选举。选举正式不设党派，10月4日初选中得票最高的两名候选人不论党派均进入大选。时任民主党市长简·L·坎贝尔竞选连任第二届，但在大选中败给克利夫兰市议会主席弗兰克·G。

en.s: The 2005 King County Executive election was held on November 8, 2005. The election, which was the first to take place after Washington's blanket primary was invalidated, used separate primaries. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Ron Sims, who unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination for Governor in 2004, ran for re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2005年11月8日，华盛顿州金县举行县长选举。这是该州的统一初选制度被判无效后，首次改用各党分别举行初选的选举。民主党籍现任县长罗恩·西姆斯曾在2004年争取州长提名但未成功，这次争取第三个县长任期。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2005 was held on Tuesday, November 8.

en.s: Elections are held every four years in the off-year immediately after United States presidential election years in Albany, New York, to elect the city's mayor.

zh.s: 纽约州奥尔巴尼每四年举行一次市长选举，安排在美国总统选举年的次年，以选出该市市长。

en.s: The 2005 Minneapolis municipal elections in the U.S. state of Minnesota held a scheduled primary election on 13 September and a general election on 8 November. Voters in the city elected: 1 mayor 13 city council members, elected by ward 6 Minneapolis Public Library trustees 2 members of the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and 3 at-large and 6 elected by district members of the Park and Recreation Board.

zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市于2005年9月13日举行初选，并于11月8日举行大选。选民选出市长、13名市议员、6名公共图书馆理事、税收与评估委员会的2名成员，以及公园与娱乐委员会的9名成员，其中3名由全市选出，另外6名由各选区选出。

en.s: The 2005 Scottish Conservative Party leadership election was an internal party election to elect a new leader of the Scottish Conservative Party, the third largest political party in the devolved Scottish Parliament. The election was held following the resignation of David McLetchie following an expenses scandal. Following McLetchie's resignation on 31 October 2005, Annabel Goldie had become acting leader, and Goldie was declared leader after being the only declared candidate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2005年苏格兰保守党党魁选举旨在为苏格兰议会第三大党选出新党魁。时任党魁戴维·麦克莱奇因开支丑闻辞职后，该党举行了选举。麦克莱奇于2005年10月31日辞职后，安娜贝尔·戈尔迪先任代理党魁；她是唯一宣布参选的人选，最终获宣布当选。

en.s: The 2008 New Zealand general election was held on 8 November 2008 to determine the composition of the 49th New Zealand parliament. The conservative National Party, headed by its Parliamentary leader John Key, won the largest share of votes and seats, ending nine years of government by the social democratic Labour Party, led by Helen Clark. Key announced a week later that he would lead a National minority government with confidence-and-supply support from the ACT, United Future and Māori parties. The Governor-General swore Key in as New Zealand's 38th Prime Minister on 19 November 2008.

zh.s: 2008年11月8日，新西兰举行大选，决定第49届新西兰议会的组成。约翰·基领导的保守派国家党赢得最多选票和席位，结束了海伦·克拉克领导的社会民主党工党九年的执政。一周后，基宣布将领导国家党少数派政府，并获得行动党、联合未来党和毛利党的信任与支持。总督于2008年11月19日任命基为新西兰第38任总理。

en.s: The 2009 Norwegian Football Cup final was played between Molde FK and Aalesunds FK on 8 November 2009 on Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, Norway. With both clubs hailing from Møre og Romsdal, the match was dubbed as a local derby between the league silver medalists from Molde and the pride of Ålesund, who ended up as number four from the bottom in the league.

zh.s: 2009年挪威足球杯决赛于2009年11月8日在挪威奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场举行，对阵双方是莫尔德足球俱乐部和奥勒松足球俱乐部。两队都来自默勒-鲁姆斯达尔郡，这场比赛因此被称为一场地方德比：莫尔德是联赛亚军，奥勒松则以联赛倒数第四名收官。

en.s: The 2009 Korean FA Cup final was a football match played on 8 November 2009 at Seongnam Stadium in Seongnam that decided the champions of the 2009 Korean FA Cup. It was contested between Seongnam Ilhwa Chunma and Suwon Samsung Bluewings and kicked off at 14:00 (KST).

zh.s: 2009年韩国足总杯决赛于2009年11月8日在城南体育场举行，决出当届冠军。参赛球队是城南一和天马和水原三星蓝翼，比赛于韩国标准时间14:00开球。

en.s: The 2009 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 8, 2009, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Tony Chavonne.

zh.s: 2009年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举于11月8日举行，现任市长托尼·沙冯再次当选。

en.t: K-1 World MAX 2010 -70kg World Championship Tournament final
en.s: K-1 World MAX 2010 –70 kg World Championship Tournament Final was a martial arts event to be held by the K-1 on Monday, November 8, 2010 at the Ryōgoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.t: K-1 World MAX 2010 –70公斤级世界冠军赛决赛
zh.s: K-1 World MAX 2010 –70公斤级世界冠军赛决赛是一场格斗赛事，原定于2010年11月8日星期一在日本东京两国国技馆举行，由K-1主办。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 2011 took place on November 8, 2011. Voters elected the Mayor of Indianapolis, members of the Indianapolis City-County Council, as well as several other local officials. Incumbent Republican Greg Ballard was seeking a second term. Democrats nominated former deputy mayor Melina Kennedy to run against Ballard. Ballard defeated Kennedy 51% to 47%. The Indianapolis City-County elections took place alongside the mayoral election, with Democrats taking a 16–13 majority. This marked the first time in Indianapolis history that a Republican mayor would lead with a Democratic council.

zh.t: 2011年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2011年11月8日，印第安纳波利斯举行市长选举，同时选出市县议会议员和其他地方官员。共和党籍时任市长格雷格·巴拉德竞选连任第二个任期。民主党提名前副市长梅丽娜·肯尼迪与巴拉德竞争。巴拉德以51%对47%的得票率击败肯尼迪。市县议会选举也同期举行，民主党赢得16比13的多数。这是印第安纳波利斯历史上首次由共和党市长与民主党控制的议会搭档。

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 2011 was the 84th mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2011. Democratic party incumbent mayor Michael B. Coleman defeated Republican party nominee Earl W. Smith. The scheduled primary was canceled because neither party had challengers and third party candidates failed to meet requirements. However, write-in candidate Jeffrey E. Brown was also in the field. Coleman was re-elected to a fourth term and is now the longest-serving mayor of Columbus.

zh.t: 2011年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 2011年11月8日，俄亥俄州哥伦布举行第84次市长选举。民主党籍时任市长迈克尔·B·科尔曼击败共和党候选人厄尔·W·史密斯。由于两党都没有挑战者、第三党候选人也不符合资格，原定初选取消。写入式候选人杰弗里·E·布朗也参加了选举。科尔曼连任第四个任期，成为哥伦布任职时间最长的市长。

en.s: The 2011 Mississippi gubernatorial election occurred on November 8, 2011. Incumbent Republican Governor of Mississippi Haley Barbour was unable to run for a third term due to term limits. Republican nominee, Lieutenant Governor Phil Bryant, defeated the Democratic nominee, Hattiesburg Mayor Johnny DuPree. Sworn in on January 10, 2012, Bryant became only the third Republican Governor of Mississippi since Reconstruction.

zh.s: 2011年密西西比州州长选举于11月8日举行。共和党籍时任州长海利·巴伯因任期限制不能竞选第三个任期。共和党提名人、副州长菲尔·布莱恩特击败民主党提名人、哈蒂斯堡市长约翰尼·杜普里。布莱恩特于2012年1月10日宣誓就职，成为重建时期结束以来密西西比州第三位共和党籍州长。

en.s: The state of Kentucky elected a Secretary of State on Tuesday, November 8, 2011. Primaries for this election were held on Tuesday, May 17, 2011. In the general election, Democrat Alison Lundergan Grimes defeated the Republican candidate, Bill Johnson.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日星期二选举州务卿。初选于同年5月17日星期二举行。普选中，民主党人艾莉森·伦德根·格里姆斯击败共和党候选人比尔·约翰逊。

en.s: The Kentucky gubernatorial election, 2011 was held to elect the Governor of Kentucky on November 8, 2011. Incumbent Democrat Steve Beshear won re-election, defeating Republican challenger David L. Williams, then the president of the state senate, and Gatewood Galbraith, an independent candidate.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长史蒂夫·贝希尔成功连任，击败共和党挑战者、时任州参议院议长戴维·L·威廉姆斯和独立候选人盖特伍德·加尔布雷思。

en.s: The state of Kentucky will elected an Auditor of Public Accounts November 8, 2011. Primaries for this election were held on Tuesday May 17, 2011. In the November 8, 2011 general election, Democrat Adam Edelen was elected to his first term as Auditor. The auditor checks the financial books of all state agencies, school districts and county governments and performs special investigations.

zh.t: 2011年肯塔基州公共审计长选举
zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日选举公共审计长。初选于同年5月17日星期二举行。11月8日普选中，民主党人亚当·埃德伦当选，开始首个任期。审计长负责检查州政府机构、学区和县政府的财务账目，并进行特别调查。

en.s: The state of Kentucky elected an Attorney General on Tuesday, November 8, 2011. Primaries for this election was held on Tuesday, May 17, 2011. In the general election, incumbent Jack Conway defeated his challenger, Todd P'Pool.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日星期二选举总检察长。初选于同年5月17日星期二举行。普选中，时任总检察长杰克·康威击败挑战者托德·普尔。

en.s: The Tucson, Arizona mayoral election of 2011 occurred on November 8, 2011 to select the next Mayor of Tucson, and occurred simultaneously with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. Although not term-limited, incumbent Mayor Bob Walkup did not run for re-election, leaving Tucson's chief executive office open and competitive, with seven candidates filing to run in the race.

zh.s: 2011年亚利桑那州图森市市长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任市长，同时选出图森市议会第1、2和4选区的议员。时任市长鲍勃·沃尔克虽不受任期限制，但没有竞选连任，因此市长职位空缺且竞争激烈，共有7名候选人登记参选。

en.s: The 2011 Baltimore mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011. Because Baltimore's electorate is overwhelmingly Democratic, Stephanie Rawlings-Blake's victory in the Democratic primary on September 13, 2011 all but assured her of victory in the general election.

zh.s: 2011年巴尔的摩市长选举于11月8日举行。由于巴尔的摩选民绝大多数支持民主党，斯蒂芬妮·罗林斯-布莱克于2011年9月13日赢得民主党初选后，几乎已确保赢得普选。

en.s: The Houston Mayoral Election of 2011 took place on November 8, 2011. The incumbent Mayor Annise Parker ran for a second two-year term in office and was re-elected. There were four other declared candidates: Long time Houstonian Jack O'Connor, a manufacturing businessman. Native Houstonian, Houston Deputy Fire Chief Fernando Herrera, Kevin Simms, a former volunteer intern in Councilman Jarvis Johnson's office and local businessman Dave Wilson.

zh.s: 2011年休斯敦市长选举于11月8日举行。时任市长安妮丝·帕克竞选第二个两年任期并成功连任。另有4名候选人参选：在休斯敦生活多年的制造业商人杰克·奥康纳、土生土长的休斯敦人兼副消防局长费尔南多·埃雷拉、凯文·西姆斯（曾在市议员贾维斯·约翰逊办公室做志愿实习生）以及当地商人戴夫·威尔逊。

en.s: The 2011 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States. Incumbent Michael Nutter had been Mayor of Philadelphia since 2008 after being elected in the 2007 election, and was re-elected with approximately 75% of the vote. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2011.

zh.s: 2011年费城（美国宾夕法尼亚州）市长选举于11月8日举行。时任市长迈克尔·纳特自2008年当选后一直担任市长，此次以约75%的得票率连任。初选于2011年5月17日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 8, 2011. Primary elections were held on June 7. The only state positions up in this election cycle were all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly and all 40 seats in the Senate. In addition to the State Legislative elections, numerous county offices and freeholders in addition to municipal offices were up for election.

zh.s: 美国新泽西州于2011年11月8日举行大选，初选于6月7日举行。本轮选举中，唯一进行改选的州级职位是新泽西州众议院全部80个席位和参议院全部40个席位。此外，众多县级公职、县自由持有者职位和市级职位也进行选举。

en.s: The 2011 United States state legislative elections were held on November 8, 2011. Eight legislative chambers in four states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in four states. These were the first elections to be affected by redistricting after the 2010 census. Additionally, the first wave of recall elections occurred in the Wisconsin Senate; while Republicans lost seats, they maintained a narrow majority.

zh.s: 美国各州议会于2011年11月8日举行选举。4个州的8个议院按常规安排改选。这些非大选年份的选举与其他州和地方选举同时举行，其中包括4个州的州长选举。这是2010年人口普查后首次受选区重划影响的选举。此外，威斯康星州参议院首次举行罢免选举。共和党虽失去席位，仍以微弱优势保持多数。

en.s: The 2011 Minnesota elections took place on November 8, 2011 in the U.S. State of Minnesota to elect various nonpartisan municipal offices. There were also township elections and several legislative special elections for the Minnesota House and Senate.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行地方选举，包括无党派的市政职位选举、镇区选举，以及州众议院和州参议院的若干特别选举。

en.s: The 2011 Virginia state elections took place on November 8, 2011. All 140 seats in the Virginia General Assembly were up for re-election, as were many local offices.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州选举。州议会140个席位和多个地方职位均在此次选举中改选。

en.s: The 2011 Indianapolis City–County Council elections took place on November 8, 2011. All 29 seats were up for re-election, 25 districts and 4 at-large seats, on the Indianapolis City–County Council. Prior to the elections Republicans held a 15–13–1 seat majority. Following the elections Democrats gained control of the council with a 16–13 majority. This marked the first time in Indianapolis history that a Republican mayor would lead with a Democratic council.

zh.t: 2011年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举
zh.s: 印第安纳波利斯市县议会于2011年11月8日举行选举，改选全部29席，包括25个选区席位和4个不分区席位。选举前，共和党占15席，民主党占13席，另有1名独立议员。选举后，民主党以16比13的席位优势控制议会。这是印第安纳波利斯历史上首次出现共和党市长领导民主党控制的市议会。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Mississippi on November 8, 2011. All of Mississippi's executive offices were up for election, as well as legislative elections for the State Senate and House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 2, 2011, with runoff elections on the 24th if needed. General election runoffs were held on November 29 if needed.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，密西西比州举行普选，选举州行政部门各职位，并改选州参议院和州众议院席位。初选于8月2日举行；如有需要，初选决选于8月24日举行。普选决选如有需要，则于11月29日举行。

en.s: The state of Kentucky elected a Treasurer November 8, 2011. Primaries for this election were held on Tuesday May 17, 2011. The Kentucky Treasurer is elected every 4 years. The treasurer, who can serve two terms, acts as the state's chief elected fiscal officer. Incumbent Todd Hollenbach defeated his two challengers.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日选举州财政长。初选于同年5月17日星期二举行。州财政长每四年选举一次，最多可任两届，是由选民选出的州级首席财政官员。时任州财政长托德·霍伦巴赫击败两名对手。

en.s: The 2011 Kentucky Commissioner of Agriculture election was held on November 8, 2011, to elect the Kentucky Commissioner of Agriculture. Incumbent Commissioner Richie Farmer was term-limited and ineligible for reelection. He was succeeded by Republican representative James R. Comer.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2011年11月8日举行农业专员选举。时任专员里奇·法默因任期限制不能竞选连任，由共和党州众议员詹姆斯·R.科默接任。

en.s: The 2011 Boise mayoral election took place on November 8, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Dave Bieter ran for re-election to a third term. In a year of low contestation for municipal elections, Bieter's only opponent was David Hall, a college student at the College of Western Idaho. Bieter easily won re-election, receiving 74 percent of the vote to Hall's 26 percent.

zh.s: 博伊西市于2011年11月8日举行市长选举。时任市长戴夫·比特竞选连任第三个任期。该年市政选举竞争不激烈，比特唯一的对手是爱达荷西部学院学生戴维·霍尔。比特轻松连任，获得74%的选票，霍尔获得26%。

en.s: The 2011 Akron mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Don Plusquellic ran for re-election to a seventh term, after defeating a recall attempt in 2009. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by City Councilman Michael Williams, and won by a wide margin. In the general election, he faced Republican Jennifer Hensal, an attorney.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，俄亥俄州阿克伦举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长唐·普拉斯奎利克竞选第七个任期，此前他于2009年击退罢免行动。市议员迈克尔·威廉姆斯在民主党初选中挑战他，但普拉斯奎利克以较大优势胜出。普选中，他面对共和党候选人、律师詹妮弗·亨萨尔。

en.s: Portland, Maine, held an election for mayor on November 8, 2011. In November 2010, Portland voters approved a citywide referendum changing the city charter to recreate an elected mayor position that had previously been removed in 1923. From 1923 until 2011, city councilors chose one of themselves each year to serve as mayor, a primarily ceremonial position. On November 8, 2011, former State Senator and candidate for U.S.

zh.s: 缅因州波特兰于2011年11月8日举行市长选举。2010年11月，波特兰选民通过全市公投修改市宪章，恢复民选市长职位；该职位此前于1923年被取消。从1923年到2011年，市议员每年从议员中推选一人担任市长，主要履行礼仪性职责。2011年11月8日，前州参议员、联邦众议院候选人迈克尔·F·布伦南当选市长。

en.s: The 2011 Spokane mayoral election took place on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Spokane, Washington. It saw David Condon unseat incumbent mayor Mary Verner.

zh.s: 2011年华盛顿州斯波坎市长选举于11月8日举行。戴维·康登击败现任市长玛丽·维纳，当选市长。

en.s: The 2011 Flint mayoral election took place on November 8, 2011, with a primary election taking place on August 2, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Dayne Walling, who was first elected in the 2009 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. He faced several opponents, and ultimately advanced to the general election against former City Administrator Darryl Buchanan, who unsuccessfully ran in the 2009 election.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，密歇根州弗林特市举行市长选举，初选已于8月2日举行。现任市长戴恩·沃林在2009年特别选举中首次当选，这次争取一个完整任期。他在多名挑战者中进入大选，对手是前市政主管达里尔·布坎南；布坎南曾在2009年参选但未当选。

en.s: The 2011 Greensboro mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Greensboro, North Carolina. It saw the election of Robbie Perkins, who unseated incumbent mayor Bill Knight.

zh.s: 2011年北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒市长选举于11月8日举行。罗比·珀金斯击败现任市长比尔·奈特，当选市长。

en.s: The 2011 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Tony Chavonne.

zh.s: 2011年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举于11月8日举行，现任市长托尼·沙冯再次当选。

en.s: The 2011 San Francisco mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of San Francisco. The incumbent Ed Lee, appointed to fill the vacant mayoral seat, succeeded in his bid to become the first elected Asian-American mayor of a major American city.

zh.s: 2011年旧金山市长选举于11月8日星期二举行。代理市长李孟贤成功当选，成为美国主要城市首位经选举产生的亚裔美国人市长。

en.s: The 2011 Grand Rapids mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011. Incumbent Mayor George Heartwell ran for re-election. He did not face a serious challenger, and was opposed by unemployed personal trainer Michael-Paul Gionfriddo. Heartwell won his third term in a landslide, winning 81 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2011年大急流城市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长乔治·哈特韦尔竞选连任，没有遇到有力对手。失业的私人健身教练迈克尔-保罗·乔恩弗里多参选。哈特韦尔以压倒性优势赢得第三个任期，得票率为81%。

en.s: The 2011 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 8, 2011. Incumbent County Executive Dan Onorato, who was the unsuccessful Democratic nominee for Governor in 2010, announced on January 13, 2011, just months after the election, that he would not seek a third term. Rich Fitzgerald, the President of the County Council, won the Democratic primary over County Controller Mark Patrick Flaherty, and then faced Mt.

zh.t: 2011年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 阿勒格尼县行政长官选举于2011年11月8日举行。时任行政长官丹·奥诺拉托曾在2010年作为民主党州长候选人参选但未能当选。他于2011年1月13日宣布不竞选第三届任期。县议会主席里奇·菲茨杰拉德在民主党初选中击败县审计长马克·帕特里克·弗莱厄蒂，随后将面对芒特……

en.s: The 2011 Durham mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2011年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举于11月8日举行，现任市长比尔·贝尔再次当选。

en.s: The 2011 South Bend, Indiana mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011. After serving for fourteen years, incumbent mayor Steve Luecke announced that he would not seek reelection. Luecke's decision not to run for reelection made the 2011 election the first open election for mayor of South Bend in 24 years.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，印第安纳州南本德市举行市长选举。任职14年的现任市长史蒂夫·吕克宣布不再竞选连任，使这成为该市24年来首次没有现任市长参选的市长选举。

en.s: The 2011 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 8, 2011, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Aaron Reardon ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by Republican State Representative Mike Hope. In the primary election, Reardon led hope by a narrow margin, winning just 52 percent of the vote to Hope's 48 percent.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长亚伦·里尔登争取第三个任期，对手是共和党籍州众议员迈克·霍普。初选中，里尔登以52%对48%的得票率小幅领先。

en.s: The 2011 Des Moines mayoral election was held on November 8, 2011, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw Frank Cownie win reelection, running unopposed.

zh.s: 2011年艾奥瓦州得梅因市长选举于11月8日举行。弗兰克·科尼在没有对手的情况下赢得连任。

en.s: Prior to the election, Democrats held 22 seats, and Republicans held 18 seats. Redistricting caused the 13th district to be moved from Hampton Roads to Northern Virginia and the 22nd district to be moved from the Roanoke area to a district stretching from Lynchburg to Richmond. Republicans gained two seats, making the Senate tied with 20 Democrats and 20 Republicans.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州参议院选举。选前民主党占22席、共和党占18席。重新划分选区后，共和党净增两席，使两党各占20席。此次调整还将第13选区从汉普顿地区移至北弗吉尼亚，并将第22选区从罗阿诺克附近移至林奇堡至里士满一带。

en.s: All 80 seats in the General Assembly were up for election this year. In each Legislative district, there are two people elected; the top two winners in the general election are the ones sent to the Assembly. Typically, the two members of each party run as a team in each election. After the previous election, Democrats captured 47 seats while the Republicans won 33 seats.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，新泽西州举行州众议院选举，全部80个席位改选。每个立法选区选出两名议员，得票前两名进入州众议院。上届选举后，民主党占47席，共和党占33席。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2011 was held on Tuesday, November 8. Before the election, the House of Delegates consisted of 58 Republicans, 39 Democrats, 2 Independents, with one vacant seat previously held by a Republican (Glenn Oder of the 94th district, who resigned in August 2011). Redistricting eliminated three seats: Southwestern Virginia's 2nd district, the Martinsville-area 10th district, and the Norfolk-based 87th district.

zh.s: 2011年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行州众议院选举。选前共和党占58席、民主党占39席，另有两名独立议员和一个空缺席位。重新划分选区后，州内三个原有选区被撤销，分别位于西南部、马丁斯维尔一带和诺福克。

en.t: 18th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 18th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in the Great Hall of the People, Beijing from 8 to 14 November 2012. The National Congress is the highest organ of the party, and is stipulated to be held every five years. The conference had 2,268 delegates. The CCP Congress endorsed the amendments to the CCP constitution, membership list of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and elected the 18th Central Committee of the CCP.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 中国共产党第十八次全国代表大会
zh.s: 中国共产党第十八次全国代表大会于2012年11月8日至14日在北京人民大会堂举行。党章规定，全国代表大会每五年召开一次，是党的最高领导机关。本次大会共有2,268名代表，表决通过党章修正案和中央纪律检查委员会委员名单，并选举产生中共第十八届中央委员会。

en.s: On November 8, 2013, clashes broke out between Malian forces and the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA) in Amazragane, Ménaka Region, Mali.

zh.s: 2013年11月8日，马里军队与阿扎瓦德民族解放运动（MNLA）在马里梅纳卡区阿马兹拉加内发生冲突。

en.s: The 2013 Dayton mayoral election took place on November 8, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Gary Leitzell ran for re-election to a second term. Leitzell was challenged by City Commissioner Nan Whaley and former Common Pleas Court Judge A.J. Wagner. Whaley emerged as a frontrunner in the race, earning the endorsement of the Montgomery County Democratic Party and significantly outraising both Leitzell and Wagner.

zh.s: 2013年代顿市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长加里·莱策尔竞选连任第二个任期。市政委员南·惠利和普通诉讼法院前法官A. J. 瓦格纳向他发起挑战。惠利逐渐成为领先候选人，获得蒙哥马利县民主党的支持，筹得的竞选资金也远超莱策尔和瓦格纳。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Shogun vs. Saint Preux
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Shogun vs. Saint Preux (also known as UFC Fight Night 56) was a mixed martial arts event held at the Ginásio Municipal Tancredo Neves in Uberlândia, Brazil, on November 8, 2014.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：肖冈对阵圣普吕
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：肖冈对阵圣普吕（又称UFC格斗之夜56）是一场综合格斗赛事，于2014年11月8日在巴西乌贝兰迪亚的坦克雷多·内维斯市政体育馆举行。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Rockhold vs. Bisping
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Rockhold vs. Bisping (also known as UFC Fight Night 55) was a mixed martial arts event held at the Allphones Arena in Sydney, Australia on November 8, 2014.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：洛克霍尔德对阵比斯平
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：洛克霍尔德对阵比斯平（又称UFC格斗之夜55）是一场综合格斗赛事，于2014年11月8日在澳大利亚悉尼的全电话竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2014 Durand Cup final was a football match on 8 November 2014 at Raia Sports Complex, Raia, Goa. It was the final match of the 2014 Durand Cup, the 127th season of the Durand Cup, a football competition for the Indian football system. Salgaocar F.C. won the cup by defeating Pune F.C. 1–0.

zh.s: 2014年杜兰德杯决赛于2014年11月8日在果阿邦拉亚的体育综合场举行。这是第127届杜兰德杯的决赛。杜兰德杯是印度足球体系的一项赛事。萨尔加奥卡足球俱乐部以1比0击败浦那足球俱乐部，夺得冠军。

en.s: 2014 J.League Cup final was the 22nd final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at Saitama Stadium 2002 in Saitama on November 8, 2014. Gamba Osaka won the championship.

zh.s: 2014年J联赛杯决赛是该项赛事第22届决赛，于2014年11月8日在埼玉2002体育场举行。大阪钢巴夺得冠军。

en.s: General elections were held in Myanmar on 8 November 2015, with the National League for Democracy winning a supermajority of seats in the combined national parliament. Voting occurred in all constituencies, excluding seats appointed by the military, to select Members of Assembly to seats in both the upper house (the House of Nationalities) and the lower house (the House of Representatives) of the Assembly of the Union, and State and Region Hluttaws. Ethnic Affairs Ministers were also elected by their designated electorates on the same day, although only select ethnic minorities in particular states and regions were entitled to vote for them.

zh.s: 2015年11月8日，缅甸举行大选，昂山素季领导的全国民主联盟在联邦议会两院合计赢得绝对多数席位。除由军方任命的席位外，全国各选区均举行投票，选出联邦议会人民院和民族院议员，以及各邦和省议会的议员。民族事务部长也在当天由指定选区选出，但只有特定邦和省的部分少数民族选民有资格投票选举这些职位。

en.s: The 2015 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2015 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 8 November 2015 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin, and was contested between Cork City and Dundalk. Dundalk were looking to achieve the Double, having already won the league title.

zh.s: 2015年FAI杯决赛是2015年爱尔兰足协杯的决赛。比赛于2015年11月8日在都柏林阿维瓦体育场举行，由科克城对阵邓多克。邓多克此前已赢得联赛冠军，正争取同时夺得联赛和杯赛冠军。

en.s: 2015 Svenska Supercupen (Swedish Super Cup 2015), was the 9th and last edition Svenska Supercupen annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Allsvenskan and Svenska Cupen competitions. The match was played on 8 November 2015 at the Nya Parken, Norrköping, between the 2015 Allsvenskan champions, IFK Norrköping, and the 2014–15 Svenska Cupen winners IFK Göteborg.

zh.s: 2015年瑞典超级杯是该项年度足球赛事的第9届、也是最后一届，由上一赛季瑞典足球超级联赛和瑞典杯的冠军球队参赛。比赛于2015年11月8日在北雪平的新公园球场举行，参赛球队是2015年瑞典超冠军北雪平和2014至2015赛季瑞典杯冠军哥德堡。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 2016
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia was held on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 general election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participate. D.C. voters will choose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. On March 12 and June 14, 2016, voters chose delegates to the Republican and Democratic National Conventions respectively. The District of Columbia has voted for the Democratic ticket in every election since 1964, which was the first election in which DC voters were allowed to participate.

zh.t: 2016年哥伦比亚特区美国总统选举
zh.s: 2016年哥伦比亚特区美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年全美大选的一部分。当年美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了总统选举。特区选民通过普选选出代表进入选举人团。2016年3月12日和6月14日，选民分别选出共和党和民主党全国代表大会的代表。自1964年特区居民首次获准参与总统选举以来，特区在每届选举中都支持民主党候选人。
