en.s: The 2016 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate are to be held on November 8, 2016, with all odd-numbered districts being contested. Primary elections were held on April 26, 2016. The term of office for those elected in 2016 will begin when the Senate convenes in January 2017. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected to four-year terms, with 25 of the 50 seats contested every two years. Republicans have controlled the chamber since the 1994 election (23 years) and Democrats are competing to retake the majority.

zh.t: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州参议院于2016年11月8日举行选举，所有奇数编号选区均参与竞选。初选于2016年4月26日举行。2016年当选议员的任期从2017年1月参议院开会时开始。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选50个席位中的25席。共和党自1994年选举以来一直控制参议院（截至本次选举日已23年），民主党则力图重新取得多数席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in Idaho, 2016
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Idaho shall take place on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participate. Idaho voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. On 8 March 2016, voters expressed their preferences for the Republican and Constitution parties nominee for President. The Democratic Party held a caucus on March 26. Registered members of the party only voted in their party's primary, while voters who were unaffiliated chose any one primary in which to vote.

zh.s: 2016年爱达荷州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年全美大选的一部分。美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。爱达荷州选民通过普选选出代表进入选举人团。2016年3月8日，选民表达了对共和党和宪法党的总统候选人提名人选的偏好；民主党于3月26日举行党团会议。登记为民主党成员的选民只能参加该党初选，无党派选民则可选择参加任一初选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho, 2016
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho occurs on November 8, 2016. The constituency will determine two runners from the state of Idaho to perform in the U.S. House, taking one of the state's two congressional districts. Idaho's voting system is a mixed primary system. The running parties decide who will vote. The Democratic Party permits unaffiliated voters to vote in the primary.

zh.t: 2016年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 爱达荷州联邦众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行，选出两名议员，分别代表该州的两个国会选区。爱达荷州采用混合式初选制度。民主党允许无党派选民参加其初选；共和党则允许登记选民参加。无党派选民可以在选举日选择加入一个政党，但下次选举时必须继续与该党结盟。初选于5月17日举行。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma, 2016
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma will occur on November 8, 2016. Voters will determine five candidates to serve in the U.S. House, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The primaries were held on June 28.

zh.t: 2016年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行。选民从该州5个国会选区各选出一名议员，进入联邦众议院。初选于6月28日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Baltimore mayoral election is set to be held along with the 2016 General Election on November 8, 2016. Stephanie Rawlings-Blake, the incumbent mayor, is not running for reelection. Due to the heavy Democratic Party leanings in Baltimore, winning the Democratic Party primary election is considered tantamount to election as mayor.

zh.s: 2016年巴尔的摩市长选举与全美大选于11月8日同期举行。时任市长斯蒂芬妮·罗林斯-布莱克没有竞选连任。由于巴尔的摩长期倾向民主党，赢得民主党初选通常就被视为几乎等同于当选市长。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii, 2016
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in the 50th state and islandic state Hawaii occurs on November 8, 2016. The electorate will determine two candidates to act in the U.S. House, each from the state's two districts. Hawaii is one of 14 states that employ an open primary system, meaning voters do not have to state a party affiliation in the election.

zh.t: 2016年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 夏威夷州于2016年11月8日举行联邦众议院选举，选出两名议员，分别代表该州的两个选区。夏威夷州是采用开放式初选制度的14个州之一，这意味着选民参加初选时无需申报党派。初选于8月13日举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the United States on November 8, 2016. The Republican ticket of businessman Donald Trump and Indiana governor Mike Pence defeated the Democratic ticket of former secretary of state Hillary Clinton and Virginia junior senator Tim Kaine, in what was considered one of the biggest political upsets in American history. It was the fifth and most recent presidential election in which the winning candidate lost the popular vote.

zh.s: 美国于2016年11月8日举行总统选举。共和党组合、商人唐纳德·特朗普和印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯击败民主党组合、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿和弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员蒂姆·凯恩。这是美国历史上第五次、也是最近一次出现胜选者输掉普选票的总统选举。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in North Carolina was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. North Carolina voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州结果
zh.s: 2016年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州投票于11月8日星期二举行，是当年总统选举的一部分；全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。北卡罗来纳州选民通过普选选出总统选举人，选举人团将代表该州投票。共和党提名人为商人唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯；民主党提名人为前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Illinois was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Illinois voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州结果
zh.s: 2016年美国总统选举伊利诺伊州投票于11月8日星期二举行，是当年总统选举的一部分；全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。伊利诺伊州选民通过普选选出总统选举人，选举人团将代表该州投票。共和党提名人为商人唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯；民主党提名人为前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Volusia County Chair election was held on November 8, 2016, following a primary election on August 30, 2016, to elect the Volusia County Chair. Incumbent County Chair Jason Davis ran for re-election to a second term, and was challenged by three opponents: Ormond Beach Mayor Ed Kelley, Orange City Mayor Tom Laputka, and activist Greg Gimbert. Though the race was formally nonpartisan, all four candidates were Republicans.

zh.t: 2016年沃卢西亚县议会主席选举

zh.s: 2016年新泽西州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。新泽西州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表本州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Delaware gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2016, to elect the governor of Delaware, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic governor Jack Markell was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a third term in office.

zh.s: 2016年特拉华州州长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州州长，并与当年美国总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任州长杰克·马凯尔受任期限制，不能竞选连任第三个任期。

en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in Kentucky was held November 8, 2016 to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Kentucky, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年肯塔基州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2016年肯塔基州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表肯塔基州的联邦参议员。此次选举与当年美国总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Michigan on November 8, 2016. There were voting machine failures on election day.

zh.s: 美国密歇根州于2016年11月8日举行普选。选举当天，投票机发生故障。

en.s: The 2016 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2016, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Primary elections were held March 15. In North Carolina, the Governor and Lieutenant Governor are elected separately.

zh.t: 2016年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 2016年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选举该州副州长，并与当年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。初选于3月15日举行。在北卡罗来纳州，州长和副州长分别选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont on November 8, 2016. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election as well as Vermont's Class III Senate seat and at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 9, 2016.

zh.s: 美国佛蒙特州于2016年11月8日举行普选。州内所有行政部门职位、佛蒙特州第三类联邦参议员席位以及该州联邦众议院的全州单一席位均进行选举。初选于2016年8月9日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Iowa Senate election was held on November 8, 2016. The Senate seats for the twenty-five even-numbered districts were up for election. Senate terms are staggered so that half the membership is elected every two years, with each Senators serving a four-year term. Prior to the election, the Democrats were in the majority.

zh.s: 2016年艾奥瓦州参议院选举于11月8日举行，25个偶数编号选区的席位进行改选。参议员任期交错安排，因此每两年改选约半数席位；每位参议员任期为四年。选举前，参议院由民主党占多数。

en.s: The 2016 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 8, 2016, with all districts being contested. The primary elections were held on April 26, 2016. The term of office for those elected in 2016 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2017. Pennsylvania state representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行，所有选区均有竞选。初选于2016年4月26日举行。2016年当选议员的任期从2017年1月众议院开会时开始。宾夕法尼亚州众议员任期为两年，每两年改选全部203个席位。

en.s: A special election for Illinois Comptroller took place on November 8, 2016. After comptroller Judy Baar Topinka died shortly after her reelection in 2014, Republican Governor Bruce Rauner appointed Leslie Munger, a former business executive and unsuccessful 2014 nominee for the Illinois House of Representatives, to fill her seat at the beginning of his term in 2015.

zh.t: 2016年伊利诺伊州审计长特别选举
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州审计长特别选举于2016年11月8日举行。审计长朱迪·巴尔·托平卡于2014年成功连任后不久去世。共和党籍州长布鲁斯·劳纳任命莱斯利·芒格接替她，填补这一职位；芒格曾任企业高管，并在2014年竞选伊利诺伊州众议员时落选。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota

zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州于2016年11月8日举行普选。州参议院和州众议院所有席位、10名总统选举人以及该州8个联邦众议院席位均进行选举。初选于2016年8月9日举行。选民还通过了一项明尼苏达州宪法修正案。

The winners were elected to a four-year term from January 3, 2017, to January 3, 2021.

zh.s: 2016年波多黎各市镇选举于11月8日举行，选出波多黎各78个市镇的市长；当天还选举了总督、驻美国国会常驻专员、参议员和众议员。当选者任期四年，从2017年1月3日至2021年1月3日。

en.t: 2016 North Carolina Council of State election
en.s: Elections were held in North Carolina on November 8, 2016, to select the ten officers of the North Carolina Council of State. This elections coincided with the presidential election, elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the Senate and state elections to the General Assembly and judiciary. Primary elections were held March 15. The ten members of the North Carolina Council of State are statewide-elected officers serving four-year terms.

zh.t: 2016年北卡罗来纳州州务委员会选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2016年11月8日举行选举，选出州务委员会的10名官员。此次选举与总统选举、联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及州议会和司法系统选举同时进行。初选于3月15日举行。州务委员会的10名成员由全州选民选出，任期四年。

en.s: The 2016 Montana Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2016, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Montana. en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in Hawaii was held November 8, 2016, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The primaries were held August 13. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Brian Schatz won reelection to his first full term in office, defeating Republican former state legislator John Carroll.

zh.t: 2016年夏威夷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 夏威夷州于2016年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，并与总统、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。初选于同年8月13日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员布赖恩·沙茨赢得连任，获得其首个完整任期，击败共和党候选人、前州议员约翰·卡罗尔。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Mexico on November 8, 2016. A special election was held for Secretary of State, along with all seats in both houses of the New Mexico Legislature.

en.s: The Washington State House elections, 2016 are biennial elections in which each of the 49 legislative districts in Washington choose two people to represent them in the Washington State House of Representatives. Roughly half of the members of the Washington Senate are elected concurrently to four-year terms from identical legislative districts. The election was held on November 8, 2016.

en.s: The Illinois general election was held on November 8, 2016. Primaries were held March 15. zh.s: 伊利诺伊州普选于2016年11月8日举行，初选于3月15日举行。除总统、参议院和众议院的联邦选举外，伊利诺伊州众议院全部118个席位、参议院59个席位中的40个席位也进行改选；此外还举行了州审计长特别选举、司法选举，并就一项全州公投提案进行表决。

en.s: The 2016 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2016. Under Washington's top-two primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the August 2 primary, residents voted for one of several candidates from a range of party affiliations. The top two finishers, incumbent Governor Jay Inslee (Democratic) and Port of Seattle Commissioner Bill Bryant (Republican), moved on to the November general election, which Inslee won.

zh.s: 华盛顿州于2016年11月8日举行州长选举。根据该州的前两名初选制度，所有候选人不分党派同列在选票上。8月2日的初选中，选民从多个党派的候选人中投票，得票前两名的时任州长、民主党人杰伊·英斯利和西雅图港务局委员、共和党人比尔·布莱恩晋级11月普选。英斯利赢得普选。

en.t: 2016 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 8, 2016, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Franklin Garcia won reelection unopposed.

zh.t: 2016年哥伦比亚特区影子众议员选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于2016年11月8日举行联邦众议院影子代表选举。影子代表与没有表决权的正式代表不同，只获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得众议院席位。时任影子代表、民主党人富兰克林·加西亚没有对手，成功连任。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives election in Guam
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives election in Guam was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from Guam's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the larger 2016 Guamanian general election, the 2016 United States House of Representatives elections, and the 2016 United States general elections.

zh.s: 2016年关岛联邦众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，选出一名无投票权的众议院代表，代表关岛单一国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括规模更大的2016年关岛普选、2016年联邦众议院选举以及2016年美国大选。

en.s: The 2016 Utah Senate election was held on November 8, 2016. Fifteen Senate seats were up for election. Prior to the election, the Republicans held a majority.

zh.s: 2016年犹他州参议院选举于11月8日举行，15个参议院席位进行改选。选举前，共和党占多数。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of South Carolina, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出7名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的7个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Alabama, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出7名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的7个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in North Dakota was held November 8, 2016, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of North Dakota, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年北达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2016年北达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表北达科他州的联邦参议员。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2016 California State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, with the primary election held on June 7, 2016. Voters in the 80 districts of the California State Assembly elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President and the state senate.

zh.t: 2016年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，初选于同年6月7日举行。加利福尼亚州州众议院80个选区的选民选出各自代表。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国总统和州参议院选举。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in South Dakota was held on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. South Dakota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting the Republican nominee, celebrity Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and her running mate, Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2016年南达科他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。南达科他州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、名人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in West Virginia was held on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 general election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. West Virginia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting the Republican nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and her running mate, Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2016年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国大选的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。西弗吉尼亚州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Alaska Senate election were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, with the primary election on August 16, 2016. Voters in the 10 districts of the Alaska Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President and the state assembly. In Alaska, congressional and state-level elections use a top-four primary system.

zh.s: 2016年阿拉斯加州参议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，初选于2016年8月16日举行。阿拉斯加州参议院10个选区的选民选出各自代表。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国总统和州众议院选举。阿拉斯加州的联邦和州级选举采用“四人初选”制度。

en.s: The 2016 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2016. Republican Sean Reyes, incumbent Attorney General of Utah, was elected to his second full term in office, defeating Democrat Jon Harper in a landslide. Reyes overperformed Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump in the concurrent presidential election by over 20%, though Harper only underperformed Democratic nominee Hillary Clinton by around 2%.

zh.s: 犹他州于2016年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长肖恩·雷耶斯成功当选，开始第二个完整任期，以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人乔恩·哈珀。同期总统选举中，雷耶斯的表现比共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普高出20多个百分点；哈珀的表现则比民主党候选人希拉里·克林顿低约2个百分点。

en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 8, 2016, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Indiana. The election was held alongside the presidential election and 2016 Indiana elections. Republican incumbent Dan Coats, who had served in the Senate since 2011 and previously from 1989 to 1999, ultimately chose to not seek reelection.

zh.t: 2016年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2016年印第安纳州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表印第安纳州的联邦参议员。此次选举与总统选举及2016年印第安纳州其他选举同时举行。共和党籍现任参议员丹·科茨自2011年起、以及此前1989年至1999年间在参议院任职，最终决定不竞选连任。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Auditor General election of 2016 was held on November 8, 2016. The primary election was held on April 26, 2016.

zh.t: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举于11月8日举行，初选于2016年4月26日举行。

en.s: The 2016 United States state legislative elections were held on November 8, 2016, for 86 state legislative chambers in 44 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 65 percent of all upper house seats and 85 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Nine legislative chambers in the five permanently inhabited U.S. territories and the federal district of Washington, D.C. also held elections.

zh.s: 2016年美国州议会选举于11月8日举行，涉及44个州的86个州议会院。全美各州上院约65%的席位和下院约85%的席位进行改选。美国5个永久有人居住的属地和华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的9个议会院也举行了选举。

en.s: The 2016 Massachusetts elections were held on November 8, 2016, throughout Massachusetts. At the federal level, all 9 Massachusetts seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election. At the state level, all 160 seats of the Massachusetts House of Representatives and all 40 seats of the Massachusetts Senate were up for election. Primary elections were held on September 8.

zh.s: 2016年马萨诸塞州选举于11月8日在全州举行。联邦层面，马萨诸塞州联邦众议院全部9个席位进行改选；州级层面，州众议院全部160个席位和州参议院全部40个席位进行改选。初选于9月8日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Alaska House of Representatives election were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, with the primary election on August 16, 2016. Voters in the 40 districts of the Alaska House of Representatives elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. president and the state Senate. The Democrats, three Republicans, and two independents formed a governing coalition with Bryce Edgmon serving as speaker.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于2016年11月8日举行众议院选举，改选全部40个选区的议员。初选于同年8月16日举行。选举与总统和州参议院等职位的选举同时举行。民主党、3名共和党人和2名独立人士组成执政联盟，由布赖斯·埃德蒙担任议长。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Hawaii was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Hawaii voters chose four electors to represent the state in the Electoral College by popular vote.

zh.s: 2016年夏威夷州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。夏威夷州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的4名选举人。

en.s: The 2016 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 2016. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on August 30, 2016. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 2016年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月8日举行。选民在该州全部30个立法选区选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于2016年8月30日举行。选举前，共和党占18席，多于民主党的12席。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Oregon was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Oregon voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.s: 2016年俄勒冈州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。俄勒冈州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of New Hampshire, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出2名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的2个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A general election was scheduled in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 8, 2016. Along with the presidential election, one United States Senate seat and Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election, as were all the seats in both chambers of the Idaho Legislature. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2016.

zh.s: 爱达荷州原定于2016年11月8日举行普选。除总统选举外，联邦参议院的1个席位、爱达荷州在联邦众议院的2个席位，以及州议会两院的全部席位也进行改选。初选于2016年5月17日举行。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Minnesota was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Minnesota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against DFL nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2016年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。明尼苏达州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党农民劳工党（DFL）候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Maine was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated.

zh.s: 2016年缅因州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the 18 U.S. representatives from the state of Illinois, one from each of the state's 18 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出18名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的18个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the State of Oregon, one from each of the state's 5 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well a senatorial election and the special gubernatorial election, and elections to local offices. The primaries were held on May 17.

zh.t: 2016年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出5名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的5个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、参议院选举、州长特别选举以及地方职位选举同时举行。初选于5月17日举行。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Alabama was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Alabama voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.t: 2016年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2016年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。阿拉巴马州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Tennessee State Senate election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect 16 of the 33 seats for the Tennessee's State Senate. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on August 4, 2016.

zh.s: 2016年田纳西州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选州参议院33个席位中的16个。此次选举与总统、联邦众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。初选于2016年8月4日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect the Missouri Secretary of State, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and those to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic secretary of state Jason Kander did not run for re-election to a second term in office and instead unsuccessfully ran in that year's U.S.

zh.s: 2016年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州务卿。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。民主党籍现任州务卿杰森·坎德决定不竞选连任第二个任期，而是转而参加当年的密苏里州联邦参议院选举，挑战共和党籍现任参议员罗伊·布朗特，但未能胜选。

en.s: The 2016 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect the Oregon Secretary of State. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Jeanne Atkins declined to seek election; she was appointed in March 2015 following Kate Brown's ascension to the governorship. Republican Dennis Richardson defeated Democrat Brad Avakian to become the first Republican elected to statewide office in Oregon since 2002, and the first to hold this office since 1985.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于2016年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿珍妮·阿特金斯没有参选。她于2015年3月获任命接替升任州长的凯特·布朗。共和党人丹尼斯·理查森击败民主党人布拉德·阿瓦基安，当选州务卿。这是自2002年以来首位当选俄勒冈州全州职位的共和党人，也是自1985年以来首位担任州务卿的共和党人。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的6个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Vermont was held on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Vermont voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and his running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence, against the Democratic Party's nominee, former U.S.

zh.s: 2016年佛蒙特州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。佛蒙特州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的3名选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 8, 2016, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Washington. Incumbent Democratic Senator Patty Murray ran for re-election to a fifth term, and won by a significant margin, winning 59% of the vote, to Republican Chris Vance's 41%.

zh.t: 2016年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 华盛顿州于2016年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍时任参议员帕蒂·默里竞选第五个任期，并以59%的得票率大幅胜出。共和党候选人克里斯·万斯获得41%。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on Tuesday, November 8, 2016. Primaries were held on March 1, 2016, with runoffs taking place on May 24, 2016.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2016年11月8日星期二举行选举。初选于2016年3月1日举行，第二轮初选于同年5月24日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Missouri elections took place on November 8, 2016. Republicans swept all statewide offices up for election, expanding their footprint in the state. The only two remaining Democratic statewide officeholders after this cycle were U.S. Senator Claire McCaskill and State Auditor Nicole Galloway.

zh.s: 密苏里州于2016年11月8日举行选举。共和党赢得所有改选的全州职位，在该州进一步扩大优势。本轮选举后，州内仅剩的两名民主党籍全州民选官员是联邦参议员克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔和州审计长妮可·加洛韦。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2016 to elect all 41 members to Texas' House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives and state senate. The primary election was held on March 1, 2016 with a run-off on May 24, 2016. The winners of this election served in the 85th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2016年11月8日举行众议院选举，选出州众议院全部41名议员。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2016年3月1日举行，第二轮初选于5月24日举行。本次选举的胜出者在第85届得克萨斯州议会任职。

en.s: The Pennsylvania attorney general election of 2016 took place on November 8, 2016, to elect a new Pennsylvania attorney general. Democratic incumbent Kathleen Kane originally indicated her intention to seek re-election, but dropped out after she was criminally charged with violating grand jury secrecy laws stemming from alleged leaks of grand jury investigation details to embarrass a political enemy.

zh.t: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2016年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出新任州总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长凯瑟琳·凯恩最初表示有意竞选连任，但在因刑事指控退出竞选；指控称，她违反大陪审团保密规定，泄露大陪审团调查细节以使一名政治对手难堪。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Guam on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, along with the election for the Guam delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives. The Democratic Party won nine of the fifteen seats in the Legislature and maintained control of Guam's delegate seat. The fifteen elected members of the 34th Guam Legislature were inaugurated on January 2, 2017.

zh.s: 关岛于2016年11月8日举行立法机构选举，同时选出关岛驻美国联邦众议院代表。民主党赢得立法机构15席中的9席，并继续控制关岛驻众议院代表一席。第34届关岛立法机构的15名当选成员于2017年1月2日宣誓就职。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the 16 U.S. representatives from the state of Ohio, one from each of the state's 16 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年俄亥俄州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年俄亥俄州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出16名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的16个国会选区。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2016 Colorado State Senate elections were held on November 8, 2016 to elect 18 of the 35 members of Colorado's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives and state senate. The primary election was held on June 28, 2016. There was no change in the composition of the Senate as both Democrats and Republicans gained one seat each, winning 10 and 8 seats respectively.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于2016年11月8日举行州参议院选举，改选全部35席中的18席。初选于同年6月28日举行。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院等职位的选举同时举行。参议院席位分布没有变化，民主党和共和党各增加1席，最终分别赢得10席和8席。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election which was also held in the other 49 states and in the District of Columbia. Voters were asked to pick 6 electors to be pledged for a candidate in the Electoral College.

zh.s: 2016年犹他州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，与其他49个州和哥伦比亚特区的总统选举同时进行。选民需选出6名承诺支持某位候选人的选举人，进入选举人团。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Arkansas was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Arkansas voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.s: 2016年阿肯色州美国总统选举于11月8日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。阿肯色州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿及其竞选搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Delaware Senate election was held on November 8, 2016 to elect 11 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the Presidency, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on September 13, 2016. Delaware Republicans needed to have a net gain of two seats to flip the chamber from the Democrats.

zh.s: 2016年特拉华州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的11个。此次选举与总统、联邦众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。初选于2016年9月13日举行。特拉华州共和党需要净增2席，才能从民主党手中夺回州参议院的多数。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Rhode Island voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. Prior to the election, Rhode Island was considered to be a state Clinton would win or a safe blue state.

zh.s: 2016年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月8日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了选举。罗得岛州选民通过普选选出代表本州进入选举人团的4名选举人。选举前，罗得岛州被认为希拉里·克林顿有望胜出，或是民主党稳固的“蓝州”。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives election in Montana was held on November 8, 2016, to elect the U.S. representative from Montana's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. At the time, Montana's congressional district had a PVI of R+7.

zh.t: 2016年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表蒙大拿州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与2016年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。当时，蒙大拿州国会选区的党派倾向指数为共和党+7。

en.s: The 2016 Wilmington mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, to elect the mayor of Wilmington, Delaware. Incumbent mayor Dennis P. Williams ran for reelection to a second term, but was defeated in the Democratic primary on September 13, 2016, by Mike Purzycki, the former executive director of the Riverfront Development Corporation. Purzycki defeated Republican Robert Martin and Delaware Independent Steven Washington in the general election.

zh.s: 2016年特拉华州威尔明顿市长选举于11月8日星期二举行。前河滨开发公司执行董事、民主党人迈克·普尔齐基击败共和党人罗伯特·马丁和独立候选人史蒂文·华盛顿，当选市长。现任民主党市长丹尼斯·P.威廉姆斯于2016年9月13日民主党初选中败给普尔齐基；他原本打算竞选连任，争取第二个任期。

en.s: The 2016 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 8, 2016, to elect the county executive of Pierce County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Pat McCarthy was term-limited and could not run for re-election, instead successfully running for State Auditor. Four candidates ran to succeed McCarthy: County Councilman Rick Talbert, a Democrat, and State Senator Bruce Dammeier, former State Senator Larry Faulk, and County Council Chairman Dan Roach, all Republicans.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，华盛顿州皮尔斯县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长帕特·麦卡锡受任期限制不能连任，转而成功当选州审计长。争取接替她的四人是民主党籍县议员里克·塔尔伯特，以及共和党人州参议员布鲁斯·达迈尔、前州参议员拉里·福克和县议会议长丹·罗奇。

en.s: The 2016 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 8, 2016. Incumbent County Executive L. Brooks Patterson ran for re-election to a seventh term. Former State Representative Vicki Barnett won the Democratic primary and opposed Patterson in the general election. Patterson defeated Barnett with 54 percent of the vote, a significantly narrower margin than his past victories.

zh.s: 2016年奥克兰县行政长官选举于11月8日举行。现任行政长官L.布鲁克斯·帕特森竞选连任，争取第七个任期。前州众议员维姬·巴尼特赢得民主党初选，在大选中对阵帕特森。帕特森以54%的得票率击败巴尼特，领先优势明显小于他以往的胜选。

en.s: The 2016 Washington Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2016. Incumbent Republican Kim Wyman won reelection over Democratic nominee Tina Podlodowski, the two having received the most votes in an August 2016 primary election. Kim Wyman was endorsed by the three preceding secretaries of state (Ralph Munro, Sam Reed, and Bruce Chapman), as well as the Seattle Times, King County Director of Elections Julie Wise, Pierce County Auditor Julie Anderson, the Washington Education Association, the Rental Housing Association of Washington, and the Sheet Metal, Air, Rail and Transportation Union.

zh.s: 2016年华盛顿州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党人金·怀曼击败民主党候选人蒂娜·波德洛多夫斯基，赢得连任。两人是在2016年8月初选中得票最多的候选人。怀曼获得了前三任州务卿拉尔夫·芒罗、山姆·里德和布鲁斯·查普曼的背书，也获得《西雅图时报》、金县选举主任朱莉·怀斯、皮尔斯县审计长朱莉·安德森、华盛顿州教育协会、华盛顿州租赁住房协会以及钣金、航空、铁路和运输工人工会的支持。

en.t: 2016 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2016 United States Senate election in Georgia was held November 8, 2016, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Georgia, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年佐治亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2016年11月8日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议院选举，选出该州的一名联邦参议员。此次选举与美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举，以及联邦众议院和州、地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.t: 2016 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2016 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 8, 2016. Six of the eleven seats of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were contested in this election. Three incumbents were termed out of office and three ran for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，旧金山市监事会举行选举，11个席位中的六个改选。三名现任监事受任期限制不能连任，另三人争取连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在制度上不分党派，但旧金山多数候选人仍得到不同政党的资助和支持。

en.s: The 2016 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Allen Joines. This election saw mayoral elections in Winston-Salem shift from odd-numbered years to presidential election years.

zh.s: 2016年北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于11月8日举行，艾伦·乔因斯再次当选。该市从这一年起将市长选举从奇数年改到总统选举年举行。

en.s: The 2016 New York State Assembly elections were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, with the primary election on September 13, 2016. Voters in the 150 districts of the New York State Assembly elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, the U.S. Senate and the state senate.

zh.s: 纽约州众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行，初选已于9月13日举行。全州150个选区各选出一名州众议员。此次选举与美国总统、联邦参议院及州参议院等职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: Georgia's state elections were held on November 8, 2016.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2016年11月8日举行州级选举。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 8, 2016. Primaries were held March 15, 2016. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, Cook County Board of Review districts 1 and 2, four seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行大选，初选已于3月15日举行。选民改选巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、县估税复核委员会第1和第2选区委员、水务管理区董事会四个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 2016 New Castle County Executive election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, to elect the County Executive of New Castle County, Delaware. Democrat Matt Meyer defeated Republican Mark Blake with 66.6% of the vote. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Thomas P. Gordon had controversially sought an unprecedented fourth term in office, but lost the primary in an upset to Meyer by a 4-point margin.

zh.t: 2016年新卡斯尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2016年特拉华州新卡斯尔县行政长官选举于2016年11月8日星期二举行。民主党人马特·迈耶以66.6%的得票率击败共和党人马克·布莱克。现任民主党行政长官托马斯·P.戈登曾计划竞选史无前例的第四个任期，但在初选中意外败给迈耶，落后4个百分点。

en.s: The 2016 Jackson Executive special election took place on November 8, 2016. County Executive Mike Sanders, who was re-elected to a third term in 2014, resigned from office on December 31, 2015. Former County Legislator Fred Arbanas was briefly appointed to serve as acting County Executive until the County Legislature selected an interim replacement to serve until the special election.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，杰克逊县举行县长特别选举。迈克·桑德斯曾在2014年第三次当选县长，但于2015年12月31日辞职。前县议员弗雷德·阿巴纳斯短暂代理县长，随后县议会选出一名临时接任者，任职至特别选举。

en.t: 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2016 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on November 8, 2016, to elect the fourteen U.S. representatives from the state of Georgia, one from each of the state's fourteen congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2016年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2016年11月8日，佐治亚州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州14个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与美国总统、联邦参议院及各级州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in the Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The Northern Mariana Islands did not participate in the November 8, 2016 general election for President of the United States, because it is a territory and not a state. However, the five non-incorporated territories that send delegates to the House of Representatives participated in the presidential primaries of both major parties. In the presidential primaries, voters expressed their preferences for the Democratic and Republican parties' respective nominees for president.

zh.t: 2016年北马里亚纳群岛总统选举
zh.s: 北马里亚纳群岛没有参加2016年11月8日举行的美国总统大选，因为它是属地而不是州。不过，向美国众议院派出代表的5个未合并属地都参加了两大党的总统初选。初选中，选民表达了对民主党和共和党各自总统候选人提名人的支持意向。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential election in Georgia was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016, as part of the 2016 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Georgia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, businessman Donald Trump, and running mate Indiana Governor Mike Pence against the Democratic Party nominee, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, and her running mate Virginia Senator Tim Kaine.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，佐治亚州与美国其他49个州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举投票。选民通过普选选出代表该州的选举人。共和党候选人、商人唐纳德·特朗普和搭档、印第安纳州州长迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前国务卿希拉里·克林顿和搭档、弗吉尼亚州参议员蒂姆·凯恩。

en.s: The 2016 Georgia House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2016, as part of the biennial United States elections. Georgia voters elected state representatives in all 180 of the state house's districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Georgia House of Representatives. The primary elections took place on May 24, 2016.

zh.s: 佐治亚州众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行，全州180个选区各选出一名任期两年的州众议员。初选已于5月24日举行。

en.s: The 2016 Oregon gubernatorial special election took place on November 8, 2016, to elect the Governor of Oregon, concurrently with the 2016 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections for the U.S. Senate and U.S. House of Representatives, other gubernatorial elections and various state and local elections. The election determined who would fill the remaining two years of the term of Democratic governor John Kitzhaber, who was re-elected in 2014 and resigned in February 2015.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，俄勒冈州举行州长特别选举，与美国总统、国会及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。此次选举决定由谁完成民主党籍州长约翰·基茨哈伯剩余的两年任期。基茨哈伯于2014年连任，随后在2015年2月辞职。

en.s: The 2016 Cuyahoga County Council election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect members of the County Council of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. Even-numbered districts were up for election to four-year terms. The Republicans defended their single seat up for election, while the Democrats defended all 4 of theirs, maintaining the partisan balance in the chamber. The only contested district was District 2, which was won by incumbent Democratic council member Dale Miller.

zh.s: 2016年俄亥俄州库亚霍加县议会选举于11月8日举行，选出县议会议员。偶数编号选区改选，议员任期为4年。共和党保住了参选的唯一席位，民主党也保住了自己的4个席位，议会党派席位格局没有变化。唯一有对手竞争的是第2选区，现任民主党议员戴尔·米勒获胜。

en.s: The 2016 Miami-Dade County mayoral election took place on November 8, 2016. After a primary on August 30, incumbent Mayor Carlos A. Giménez defeated Miami-Dade School Board member Raquel Regalado on November 8. The election was officially nonpartisan. The race was marred by controversy, including attempts by Regalado to take Giménez off the ballot and accusations that Giménez was responsible for flyers suggesting Regalado was in association with then Republican Presidential nominee Donald Trump.

zh.s: 2016年迈阿密-戴德县县长选举于11月8日举行。经过8月30日的初选，现任县长卡洛斯·A.希门尼斯在大选中击败迈阿密-戴德县学校董事会成员拉克尔·雷加拉多。选举正式采用无党派形式。选举过程伴有争议，包括雷加拉多试图取消希门尼斯的候选人资格，以及有人指责希门尼斯应对传单负责；传单暗示雷加拉多与当时的共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普有关联。

en.t: 2016 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2016 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 8, 2016. Incumbent CEO Burrell Ellis was indicted for perjury and attempted theft by extortion in 2013 and was suspended from office by Governor Nathan Deal on July 16, 2013, who appointed County Commissioner Lee May as interim CEO. Burrell was term-limited and could not seek another term, and May declined to run in the 2016 election.

zh.t: 2016年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2016年11月8日，佐治亚州迪卡尔布县举行行政长官选举。时任行政长官伯勒尔·埃利斯曾在2013年因涉嫌作伪证和企图以胁迫方式盗窃而被起诉，州长内森·迪尔于当年7月16日暂停其职务，并任命县委员李·梅临时接任。埃利斯受任期限制不能再参选，梅也没有参加2016年选举。

en.s: The 2016 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held to elect the Mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 8, 2016, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives, Senate and gubernatorial elections. This marked the fifth election to the office since the post was created in 2000. Incumbent Democratic County Mayor Ben McAdams ran and won re-election to a second term against Republican candidate David Robinson.

zh.s: 2016年犹他州盐湖县县长选举于11月8日举行，与总统、众议院、参议院和州长选举同时进行。这是该职位自2000年设立以来的第五次选举。现任民主党县长本·麦克亚当斯击败共和党候选人大卫·罗宾逊，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: 2016 United States presidential election in the U.S. Virgin Islands
en.s: The U.S. Virgin Islands did not participate in the November 8, 2016 general election because it is a territory and not a state. However, the five non-incorporated territories that send Delegates to the House of Representatives did participate in the presidential primaries. In presidential caucuses, Virgin Islands voters expressed their preferences for the Democratic and Republican parties' respective nominees for president.

zh.t: 2016年美属维尔京群岛总统选举
zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛没有参加2016年11月8日的美国总统大选，因为它是属地而不是州。不过，向美国众议院派出代表的5个未合并属地参加了总统初选。维尔京群岛选民在党团会议中表达了对民主党和共和党各自总统候选人提名人的支持意向。

en.s: The 2016 Bay County Executive election was held on November 8, 2016. Incumbent County Executive Thomas L. Hickner, who was first elected in 1992, ran for re-election to his seventh term. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by former Congressman James Barcia. Barcia ultimately defeated Hickner in the primary by a wide margin, winning 56 percent of the vote to Hickner's 38 percent, and was unopposed in the general election.

zh.s: 2016年贝县行政长官选举于11月8日举行。现任行政长官托马斯·L.希克纳于1992年首次当选，这次竞选第七个任期。前国会议员詹姆斯·巴西亚在民主党初选中以56%对38%的得票率大胜希克纳，随后在没有对手的情况下赢得大选。

en.t: 2016 West Virginia House of Delegates election
en.s: Elections to the West Virginia House of Delegates took place on November 8, 2016. All 100 seats in the West Virginia House of Delegates were up for election, with 13 Republican and 8 Democratic incumbents not running for re-election. The Republican majority sustained a net loss of 1 seat, decreasing the majority from 64 seats to 63.

zh.t: 2016年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2016年11月8日举行，改选全部100个席位。13名共和党现任议员和8名民主党现任议员没有竞选连任。共和党的多数席位净减少1席，从64席降至63席。

en.s: The 2016 San Diego City Attorney election occurred on Tuesday, November 8, 2016. The primary election was held on Tuesday, June 7, 2016. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，圣迭戈市举行市检察长选举，初选已于6月7日举行。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在制度上不分党派，尽管多数候选人会表明政党倾向。此次选举分两轮进行：6月初选得票最多的两人进入11月决选。

en.s: The 2016 Summit County, Ohio Executive election took place on November 8, 2016. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Russ Pry ran for re-election to a third term. He won the Democratic primary unopposed, but announced that he would withdraw from the race after he was diagnosed with colon cancer, and died shortly thereafter. County Council President Ilene Shapiro became County Executive and was selected as the Democratic Party's nominee in the general election.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，俄亥俄州萨米特县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长拉斯·普赖争取第三个任期，曾在党内初选中无对手胜出。但他确诊结肠癌后宣布退出竞选，不久去世。县议会议长艾琳·夏皮罗接任县长，并成为民主党大选候选人。

en.s: The 2016 Georgia State Senate election was held on November 8, 2016. Georgia voters elected state senators in all 56 of the state senate's districts to the 154th Georgia General Assembly for two-year terms in the Georgia State Senate. The elections coincided with the 2016 United States presidential election, 2016 United States House of Representatives elections, 2016 Georgia House of Representatives election, and more.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，佐治亚州举行州参议院选举，在全部56个选区各选出一名任期两年的议员，进入第154届州议会。此次选举与美国总统、联邦众议院和佐治亚州众议院等选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2016 United States Senate elections were held on November 8, 2016. The presidential election, House elections, 14 gubernatorial elections, and many state and local elections were held concurrently. In the elections, 34 of the 100 seats—all Class 3 Senate seats—were contested in regular elections; the winners served six-year terms until January 3, 2023. Class 3 had last been up for election in 2010 when Republicans won a net gain of six seats.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，美国举行联邦参议院选举，与总统、联邦众议院、14场州长及许多州和地方选举同日举行。参议院100个席位中，第三组的34个席位例行改选，当选者任期六年，至2023年1月3日。第三组席位上次于2010年改选，当时共和党净增六席。

en.s: The 2016 Corpus Christi mayoral election was held on November 8, 2016, to elect the mayor of Corpus Christi, Texas. It saw the election of Dan McQueen, who unseated incumbent mayor Nelda Martinez.

zh.s: 2016年得克萨斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举于11月8日举行。丹·麦奎因击败现任市长内尔达·马丁内斯，当选市长。

en.s: The 2016 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Republican Sam Slom lost his bid for re-election, leaving the Democrats with no opposition in the Senate.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in San Diego in 2016 for mayor, city attorney, city council, and ballot measures. The primary election was held on Tuesday, June 7, 2016, and the general election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2016. Five of the nine council seats were contested. Two city council incumbents ran for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference.

en.s: U.S. Representative Mark Takai, who represented Hawaii's 1st congressional district, died July 20, 2016. A special election was held November 8, 2016. In special elections in Hawaii, all candidates run on one ballot with the highest vote recipient winning regardless of percentage. That is what allowed Republican Charles Djou to win the 2010 special election for this seat with 39.4% of the vote when two Democrats took 58.4% of the vote combined.

zh.s: 2016年11月8日，夏威夷州第一国会选区举行联邦众议员补选。原任议员马克·高井于同年7月20日去世，留下空缺。该州补选将所有候选人列在同一张选票上，由得票最多者直接当选，无需获得过半选票。

en.s: The 2016 elections for the Oregon Legislative Assembly determined the composition of both houses for the 79th Oregon Legislative Assembly. The Democratic Party maintained its 35-25 advantage in the Oregon House of Representatives while losing one seat in the Oregon State Senate to bring their advantage to 17-13 over the Republicans.

en.t: 2016 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2016 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 8, 2016. Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, who would then in turn cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president. To draw attention to this fact, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election as if they did elect members to the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2016年关岛美国总统非正式投票
zh.s: 关岛于2016年11月8日举行美国总统非正式投票。关岛是美国属地，不是州，因此不能选举选举人团成员，也不能通过选举人团直接投票选出总统和副总统。为引起公众对这一情况的关注，关岛会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统非正式投票，形式上模拟选举选举人团成员。

en.s: The 2016 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on November 8 and December 10, 2016, to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴吞鲁日于2016年11月8日举行市长选举，第二轮投票于12月10日举行，以选出路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长兼东巴吞鲁日教区行政长官。
zh.n: 原文资料框将此条日期定为首轮投票日。

en.t: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi publicly announces the withdrawal of ₹500 and ₹1000 denomination banknotes
en.s: On 8 November 2016, the Government of India announced the withdrawal of the legal-tender status of all ₹500 and ₹1,000 banknotes of the Mahatma Gandhi Series, effective from midnight that day. The Reserve Bank of India stated that the measure was intended to tackle counterfeiting, nullify black money held in cash and curb the financing of terrorism.

zh.t: 印度宣布废止500和1000卢比纸币
zh.s: 2016年11月8日，印度政府宣布废止圣雄甘地系列的所有500和1000卢比纸币的法定货币地位，措施自当日午夜起生效。印度储备银行表示，此举旨在打击伪钞、清除以现金持有的黑钱，并遏制恐怖主义融资。

en.s: The 2016 Fresno mayoral election was held on June 7, 2016 and November 8, 2016 to elect the mayor of Fresno, California. It saw the election of Lee Brand. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan. Incumbent mayor Ashley Swearengin was term-limited.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2016年弗雷斯诺市长选举于6月7日和11月8日举行，以选出加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺市市长。李·布兰德当选。现任市长阿什利·斯瓦伦金因任期限制不能参选。加利福尼亚州的市政选举正式采取无党派形式。
zh.n: 原文资料框将此条日期定为第二轮投票日。

en.s: The 2018 Genesis (aka Impact!: Genesis) was a special episode of Impact! and the eleventh Genesis professional wrestling event produced by the Impact Wrestling promotion, which took place throughout November 8–10, 2017 at the Aberdeen Pavilion in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada and aired on Pop on January 25, 2018. Five matches were contested at the event.

zh.s: 《Genesis》（又称《Impact!：Genesis》）是《Impact!》的一期特别节目，也是Impact Wrestling推广公司举办的第11场Genesis职业摔角赛事。赛事于2017年11月8日至10日在加拿大安大略省渥太华的阿伯丁馆举行，并于2018年1月25日在Pop电视台播出。赛事共进行了5场比赛。

en.t: The Louvre Abu Dhabi was inaugurated by the French president Emmanuel Macron and then-crown prince of Abu Dhabi Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
en.s: The Louvre Abu Dhabi (Arabic: اللوفر أبوظبي, romanized: al-lūfr ʔabū ẓaby; French: Louvre Abou Dabi) is an art museum located on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It runs under an agreement between the UAE and France, signed in March 2007, that allows it to use the Louvre's name until 2047, and has been described by the Louvre as "France's largest cultural project abroad."

zh.t: 阿布扎比卢浮宫由法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和阿布扎比王储穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬主持揭幕
zh.s: 阿布扎比卢浮宫（阿拉伯语：اللوفر أبوظبي，转写：al-lūfr ʔabū ẓaby；法语：Louvre Abou Dabi）是位于阿联酋阿布扎比萨迪亚特岛的艺术博物馆。根据阿联酋与法国于2007年3月签订的协议，博物馆可使用“卢浮宫”名称至2047年。卢浮宫称其为“法国在海外规模最大的文化项目”。

en.s: Global Wars 2018 was a professional wrestling tour and livestreaming event co-produced by the American Ring of Honor (ROH) and Japanese New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) promotions. The tour's four events took place on November 7 at the Androscoggin Bank Colisee in Lewiston, Maine, November 8 at Lowell Memorial Auditorium in Lowell, Massachusetts, November 9 at Buffalo RiverWorks in Buffalo, New York and November 11 at Mattamy Athletic Centre in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: Global Wars 2018是由美国荣誉之环（ROH）和日本新日本职业摔角（NJPW）联合制作的职业摔角巡演及直播赛事。巡演的四场比赛分别于11月7日在缅因州刘易斯顿的安德罗斯科金银行体育馆、11月8日在马萨诸塞州洛厄尔的洛厄尔纪念礼堂、11月9日在纽约州布法罗的布法罗RiverWorks，以及11月11日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的Mattamy体育中心举行。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Myanmar on 8 November 2020. Voting occurred in all constituencies, excluding seats appointed by or reserved for the military, to elect members to both the upper house — the Amyotha Hluttaw (the House of Nationalities) and the lower house — the Pyithu Hluttaw (the House of Representatives) of the Assembly of the Union, as well as State and Regional Hluttaws (legislatures).

zh.s: 缅甸于2020年11月8日举行大选。全国各选区都举行了投票，但由军方任命或保留给军方的席位除外，以选出联邦议会的上院民族院和下院人民院议员，以及各邦和省级议会议员。

en.s: The 34th Tokyo International Film Festival was a film festival that took place from 30 October to 8 November 2021. This was the first iteration of the festival in two years, as the 33rd Tokyo International Film Festival due to be held in 2020 was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic French actress Isabelle Huppert served as jury president.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第34届东京国际电影节于2021年10月30日至11月8日举行。这是该电影节两年来首次举办；原定于2020年举行的第33届电影节因新冠疫情取消。法国女演员伊莎贝尔·于佩尔担任评审团主席。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin fall general election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 8, 2022. All of Wisconsin's partisan executive and administrative offices were up for election, as well as one of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats, and Wisconsin's eight seats in the U.S. House of Representatives. The fall election also filled the seventeen odd-numbered seats in the Wisconsin Senate and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly for the 106th Wisconsin Legislature.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于2022年11月8日举行秋季普选。该州所有党派公职和行政职位都进行选举，同时改选一个联邦参议院席位、全部8个联邦众议院席位、州参议院17个奇数选区席位，以及第106届州议会的全部99个州众议院席位。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Ohio was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Ohio. Republican writer and venture capitalist JD Vance defeated Democratic U.S. representative Tim Ryan to succeed retiring incumbent Republican Rob Portman.

zh.t: 2022年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2022年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月8日举行，选出代表俄亥俄州的联邦参议员。共和党作家、风险投资家JD·万斯击败民主党联邦众议员蒂姆·瑞安，接替退休的共和党籍时任参议员罗布·波特曼。

en.t: 2022 Orange County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2022 Orange County Board of Supervisors elections were held on June 7 and November 8, 2022. Three of the five seats of the Orange County, California Board of Supervisors were up for election. This was the first set of elections held after the 2020 redistricting cycle. County elections in California are officially nonpartisan. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with the first round in June.

zh.s: 2022年橙县监事会选举于6月7日和11月8日举行。加利福尼亚州橙县监事会的5个席位中有3个进行改选。这是2020年选区重划周期后首次举行此类选举。加州县级选举正式按无党派选举举行。本次选举采用两轮制，第一轮于6月举行。

en.t: 2022 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2022 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election was held on June 7 and November 8, 2022, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in the state, the office is not elected under the state's top-two primary system. Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected at a primary election, with a runoff at a general election if no candidate receives a majority of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州公共教育总监选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州公共教育总监选举于6月7日和11月8日举行，选出加利福尼亚州公共教育总监。该职位不同于该州大多数其他选举，不采用前两名初选制，而是以无党派身份参加初选；如果没有候选人获得过半数选票，则在普选中进行决选。

en.s: The 2022 Gainesville, Florida mayoral election took place on November 8, 2022, following a primary election on August 23, 2022. Incumbent Mayor Lauren Poe was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. A crowded field emerged to succeed him. City Commissioner Harvey Ward and Ed Bielarski, the former general manager of the Gainesville Regional Utilities, placed first and second in the primary election with 28 and 26 percent, respectively.

zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州盖恩斯维尔市市长选举于11月8日举行，此前初选于同年8月23日举行。时任市长劳伦·坡受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。共有多名候选人参选接替他。市议员哈维·沃德和盖恩斯维尔地区公用事业公司的前总经理埃德·别拉尔斯基在初选中分列第一、第二，得票率分别为28%和26%。

en.s: The 2022 Texas House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect representatives from all 150 House of Representatives districts across the U.S. state of Texas. They were held alongside numerous other federal, state, and local elections, including the 2022 Texas State Senate election. The winners of this election served in the 88th Texas Legislature, with seats apportioned according to the 2020 United States census.

zh.s: 2022年得克萨斯州众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出美国得克萨斯州众议院150个选区的议员。选举与多项联邦、州和地方选举同时进行，包括2022年得克萨斯州参议院选举。胜选者将在第88届得克萨斯州议会任职，席位分配依据2020年美国人口普查结果。

en.s: A general election was held in Montana on November 8, 2022. Both of Montana's seats in the United States House of Representatives, all of the seats in the Montana House of Representatives, and half of the seats in the Montana Senate were up for election, as well as various local offices and ballot measures. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2022年11月8日举行普选。该州联邦众议院的2个席位、州众议院全部席位和州参议院一半席位进行改选，此外还有地方职位和公投提案。初选于2022年6月7日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Hawaii gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next governor of Hawaii. Incumbent Democratic governor David Ige was term-limited and ineligible to run for a third term. Incumbent lieutenant governor Josh Green was the Democratic nominee, and faced former lieutenant governor Duke Aiona, the Republican nominee. This marked the third time Aiona had been the Republican gubernatorial nominee, having previously run unsuccessfully in 2010 and 2014.

zh.s: 2022年夏威夷州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州长。民主党籍现任州长戴维·伊格受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。现任副州长乔希·格林获民主党提名，对阵共和党候选人、前副州长杜克·艾奥纳。这是艾奥纳第三次获共和党提名竞选州长；他此前曾在2010年和2014年参选，但均未当选。

en.s: Elections were held in Nevada on November 8, 2022. On that date, the state held elections for Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of State, Treasurer, Controller, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Nevada Senate, Nevada Assembly, and various others. In addition, several measures were on the ballot.

zh.s: 内华达州于2022年11月8日举行选举，当天改选州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财长、州审计长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州参议院和州众议院等职位。此外，选票上还列有若干公投提案。

en.s: The 2022 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Texas. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for governor of Texas. Primary elections were held on March 1, with runoffs being held on May 24 for instances in which no candidate received a majority of the initial vote.

zh.s: 2022年得克萨斯州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括州长选举。初选于3月1日举行；如无人获得初选多数票，则于5月24日举行第二轮初选。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 8, 2022. Voters in Guam chose their governor, non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, attorney general, and all fifteen members of the territorial legislature. The election coincided with the 2022 United States elections.

zh.s: 关岛于2022年11月8日举行普选。选民选出州长、一名无投票权的联邦众议院代表、总检察长和属地议会全部15名议员。此次选举与2022年美国选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Wisconsin. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Josh Kaul won re-election to a second term by a 1.33% margin. Party nominees were selected in a partisan primary on August 9, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年威斯康星州总检察长选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长乔什·考尔以1.33个百分点的优势胜出，成功连任第二个任期。两党候选人于同年8月9日的党内初选中产生。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada Assembly election was held on November 8, 2022. The election coincided with elections for other offices including for governor, the U.S. Senate, the U.S. House of Representatives, and the Nevada Senate. The primary election was held on June 14, 2022. Despite Republicans winning 56% of the popular vote among all State Assembly Districts, Democrats gained two seats, winning a supermajority of 28 out of 42 seats.

zh.s: 内华达州于2022年11月8日举行州众议院选举，并与州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院及州参议院等职位的选举同时举行。初选于同年6月14日举行。尽管共和党候选人在所有州众议院选区合计获得56%的普选票，民主党仍增加2席，以42席中的28席赢得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2022 North Dakota Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Wayne Stenehjem had announced before his death on January 28, 2022, that he was retiring, and was replaced by former United States Attorney for the District of North Dakota and former Lieutenant Governor Drew Wrigley, who successfully ran for a full term in his own right.

zh.t: 2022年北达科他州总检察长选举
zh.s: 北达科他州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长韦恩·斯滕耶姆在2022年1月28日去世前宣布退休。此前担任北达科他联邦检察官和副州长的德鲁·里格利接任，并成功当选，获得完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts general election was held on November 8, 2022, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections were held on September 6, 2022. The election includes: Federal elections for the US House of Representatives Statewide elections for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, secretary of the Commonwealth, treasurer, and auditor District elections for state representatives, state senators, and governor's councillors County elections for sheriff, district attorney, county commissioner (only in certain counties) Ballot questions at the state and local levels To register to vote, Massachusetts residents had to register by October 29, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州普选于11月8日在全州举行，初选于2022年9月6日举行。选举包括：联邦众议院选举；州级职位选举，包括州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财长和州审计长；选区选举，包括州众议员、州参议员和州长委员会成员；县级选举，包括警长、地方检察官、县专员（仅在部分县举行）；以及州和地方层面的公投提案。马萨诸塞州居民须在2022年10月29日前登记投票。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的6个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Oklahoma. Incumbent Republican governor Kevin Stitt was re-elected to a second term, with 55.5% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee Joy Hofmeister. Although Stitt won by a comfortable margin, and even expanded his margin from 2018, his performance was the worst of any 2022 Republican candidate for statewide office in Oklahoma.

zh.s: 2022年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长凯文·斯蒂特以55.5%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔伊·霍夫迈斯特，连任第二个任期。尽管斯蒂特以明显优势胜出，且比2018年进一步扩大了领先幅度，但他的表现仍是2022年俄克拉何马州所有州级职位共和党候选人中最差的。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next treasurer of Idaho. Incumbent Republican Julie Ellsworth won re-election, defeating Democratic challenger Deborah Silver. The primaries were on May 17, 2022.

zh.s: 爱达荷州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。共和党籍时任财政长朱莉·埃尔斯沃思击败民主党挑战者黛博拉·西尔弗，成功连任。初选于同年5月17日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Colorado State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Dave Young won re-election to a second term, improving on his 2018 results.

zh.t: 2022年科罗拉多州州财政长选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任财政长戴夫·扬成功连任第二个任期，得票表现超过2018年。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Iowa. Incumbent Republican Senator Chuck Grassley defeated Democratic nominee Michael Franken to win re-election to an eighth term. Grassley was first elected in 1980 and was most recently re-elected in 2016.

zh.t: 2022年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍时任参议员查克·格拉斯利击败民主党候选人迈克尔·弗兰肯，赢得连任，开始第八个任期。格拉斯利于1980年首次当选，最近一次连任是在2016年。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate elections in California
en.s: Two 2022 United States Senate elections in California were held concurrently on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of California. There were two ballot items for the same Class 3 seat: a special election to fill the seat for the final weeks of the 117th United States Congress (ending on January 3, 2023), and a general election for a full term (beginning on the same day), starting in the 118th United States Congress.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州的两场2022年联邦参议院选举于11月8日同时举行，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。两张选票对应同一个第三类席位：特别选举用于填补第117届国会最后几周的空缺，任期于2023年1月3日结束；普选则选出完整任期的参议员，新任期也从同日开始，属于第118届国会。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Indiana. Incumbent Senator Todd Young won a second term. Young announced on March 2, 2021, that he would be running for a second term. He was first elected to the Senate in 2016 with 52.1% of the vote, succeeding retiring fellow Republican Dan Coats.

zh.t: 2022年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 印第安纳州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。时任参议员托德·杨成功连任，开始第二个任期。杨于2021年3月2日宣布竞选连任第二个任期。他于2016年首次当选联邦参议员，得票率为52.1%，接替退休的共和党人丹·科茨。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in California
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in California were held on November 8, 2022, to elect representatives for the 52 seats in California (reduced from 53 in the redistricting cycle following the 2020 United States census). This marked the first time in the state's history that it lost a seat. This was the second election using congressional districts drawn by the California Citizens Redistricting Commission (after 2012 following the 2010 census).

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州52名联邦众议员，分别代表52个国会选区；在2020年人口普查后的重新划区中，该州席位从53席减至52席。这是加利福尼亚州历史上首次失去一个联邦众议院席位。这也是加州公民重新划区委员会绘制的新选区第二次用于选举；此前首次使用是在2012年（2010年人口普查后）。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Ohio. Incumbent Republican Governor Mike DeWine won a second term in a landslide, defeating Democratic nominee Nan Whaley, the former mayor of Dayton, with 62.4% of the vote. DeWine's 25-point victory marked the continuation of a trend in which every incumbent Republican governor of Ohio since 1994 has won re-election by a double-digit margin.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长迈克·德温以62.4%的得票率大胜，击败民主党候选人、代顿市前市长南·惠利，赢得第二个任期。德温以25个百分点的优势获胜，延续了自1994年以来俄亥俄州共和党籍时任州长连任时都以两位数优势获胜的趋势。

en.s: The 2022 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican Governor Chris Sununu won election to a fourth term, defeating Democratic nominee Tom Sherman. Sununu had "expressed interest" in running for the U.S. Senate in 2022 against incumbent Democrat (and former governor) Maggie Hassan. However, on November 9, 2021, he announced that he would instead run for a fourth term as governor.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长克里斯·苏努努击败民主党候选人汤姆·谢尔曼，赢得第四个任期。苏努努曾表示有意在2022年竞选联邦参议员，对手将是民主党籍时任参议员、前州长玛吉·哈桑。但他于2021年11月9日宣布，改为竞选第四个州长任期。

en.s: The 2022 California State Controller election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the California State Controller. Due to strict absolute lifetime term limit laws, incumbent Democratic State Controller Betty Yee was ineligible to run for a third term. Democrat Malia Cohen won the election, defeating Republican Lanhee Chen. Despite Chen's loss, the race was the closest of the 2022 elections in California, and Chen received more votes than any Republican candidate in the 2022 national election cycle.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州州审计长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行州审计长选举。由于该州法律严格限制官员一生可任职的届数，民主党籍时任审计长贝蒂·伊未能竞选第三个任期。民主党人玛莉亚·科恩击败共和党人兰希·陈，当选审计长。尽管陈落败，这场竞选仍是加州2022年各项选举中竞争最激烈的一场，他获得的选票也多于该年全国任何一名共和党候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. Arkansas voters elected state senators to the Arkansas Senate in each of the state's 35 senate districts. The primary elections in March 2022 determined which candidates would appear on the November 8, 2022, general election ballot.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州参议院选举是两年一度的2022年美国选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民在全州35个参议院选区分别选出州参议员。2022年3月举行的初选确定了哪些候选人进入11月8日的普选选票。

en.s: Kansas state elections were held in the state of Kansas on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on August 2, 2022. Voters elected all six executive officers, the lower house of the state legislature, and all of the state's delegations to the U.S. House.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于2022年11月8日举行州级选举，初选于2022年8月2日举行。选民选出全部6名州级行政官员、州议会下院全体议员，以及该州全部联邦众议院代表。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Arizona. Democratic secretary of state Katie Hobbs defeated Republican former television journalist Kari Lake. Hobbs succeeded Republican incumbent Doug Ducey who was term-limited and ineligible to seek a third term.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍州务卿凯蒂·霍布斯击败共和党候选人、前电视记者卡莉·莱克，当选州长。霍布斯接替因任期限制而无法竞选第三个任期的共和党籍时任州长道格·杜西。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect members to the Connecticut House of Representatives, one from each of the state's 151 General Assembly districts. The date of this the election corresponded with other elections in the state, including the U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Connecticut State Senate.

zh.s: 2022年康涅狄格州众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，选出康涅狄格州众议院议员，每个议员代表该州151个州议会选区之一。此次选举与该州其他选举同日举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和康涅狄格州参议院选举。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Vermont
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Vermont was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Vermont. It was held concurrently with U.S. Senate elections in other states, along with elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections across the country.

zh.t: 2022年佛蒙特州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年佛蒙特州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表佛蒙特州的联邦参议员。此次选举与其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及全国各地的州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Kansas State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Kansas State Treasurer. Incumbent Democrat Lynn Rogers was appointed on January 2, 2021, after his predecessor, Jake LaTurner, resigned after being elected to Congress. Republican Steven Johnson defeated Rogers in the general election.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任州财政长林恩·罗杰斯于2021年1月2日获任命接替杰克·拉图纳，后者当选联邦国会议员后辞职。共和党人史蒂文·约翰逊在普选中击败罗杰斯。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada lieutenant gubernatorial election occurred on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Nevada. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of Nevada. Primary elections were held on June 14. Nevada is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2022年内华达州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括州长选举。初选于6月14日举行。内华达州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2022.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于2022年11月8日举行普选，初选于2022年5月17日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 38 U.S. representatives from Texas, one from each of the state's 38 congressional districts. The state gained two seats after the results of the 2020 census. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
