zh.s: 2022年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出38名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的38个国会选区。该州在2020年人口普查后增加了2个席位。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 8, 2022, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Oye Owolewa was reelected to a second term.

zh.t: 2022年哥伦比亚特区影子众议员选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于2022年11月8日举行联邦众议院影子代表选举。影子代表与没有表决权的正式代表不同，只获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得众议院席位。时任影子代表奥耶·奥沃莱瓦成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Missouri House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election held on Tuesday, August 2, 2022. Missouri voters selected state representatives in all 163 seats of the House of Representatives to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Missouri state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Auditor, and Missouri Senate.

zh.s: 2022年密苏里州众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，初选于2022年8月2日星期二举行。选民选出州众议院全部163名议员，任期两年。此次选举与美国全国选举及密苏里州选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州审计长和州参议院选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 2022. All of Minnesota's executive officers were up for election, as well as all the seats in the Minnesota Senate and the Minnesota House of Representatives, several judicial seats, Minnesota's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives, and several seats for local offices.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2022年11月8日举行普选。州内全部行政官员、州参议院和州众议院所有席位、若干司法职位、该州在联邦众议院的8个席位，以及若干地方职位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2022 Utah House of Representatives election took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. Elections were held in 75 electoral districts to elect two-year term members to the Utah House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2022年犹他州众议院选举于11月8日举行，是两年一度的2022年美国选举的一部分。选举在75个选区举行，选出任期两年的犹他州众议院议员。

en.s: The 2022 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Kansas, with primary elections taking place on August 2, 2022. Governor Laura Kelly won election to a second term, defeating Republican State Attorney General Derek Schmidt in the general election by a margin of roughly 2.2 percentage points. This was the only statewide victory in 2022 for Democrats in Kansas.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍州长劳拉·凯利击败共和党候选人、州总检察长德里克·施密特，赢得第二个任期，领先约2.2个百分点。这是民主党在2022年堪萨斯州全州职位选举中唯一一次胜利。

en.s: The 2022 Texas Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022. Under the provisions of the Constitution of Texas, all 31 senate districts across the state of Texas were up for re-election, as the election was the first after the decennial United States Census. Numerous other federal, state, and local elections were also held on this date.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行。根据得克萨斯州宪法规定，由于这是十年一次的人口普查后的首次选举，全州31个州参议院选区均进行改选。当天还举行了多项联邦、州和地方选举。

en.t: 2022 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election
en.s: The 2022 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries to a four-year term.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举于11月8日举行，选出任期四年的农业与工业专员。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Maryland, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19.

zh.t: 2022年马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年马里兰州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出8名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的8个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。民主党和共和党的初选于7月19日举行。

en.t: 2022 South Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 South Dakota House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. All 70 seats in the South Dakota House of Representatives were up for election. Primary elections were held on June 7, 2022. The elections coincided with elections for other offices in South Dakota, including the US Senate, US House, South Dakota Governor, South Dakota Secretary of State, South Dakota Attorney General, and the South Dakota Senate.

zh.s: 2022年南达科他州众议院选举于11月8日举行，是两年一度的2022年美国选举的一部分。州众议院全部70个席位进行改选。初选于2022年6月7日举行。此次选举与南达科他州其他职位选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长、州务卿、总检察长和州参议院选举。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Oregon, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. Primaries for these seats were held on May 17, 2022. The elections coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2022年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的6个国会选区。初选于2022年5月17日举行。此次选举与其他联邦和州级职位的选举及初选同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Nevada, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Nevada gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年内华达州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出4名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的4个国会选区。此次选举与内华达州州长选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election having been held on Tuesday, September 6, 2022. Massachusetts voters selected all 40 members of the State Senate to serve two-year terms in the 2023–2024 Massachusetts legislature. The election coincided with United States national elections and Massachusetts state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Massachusetts House.

zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州参议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，初选于同年9月6日星期二举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出州参议院全部40名议员，任期两年，任职于2023—2024届州议会。此次选举与美国全国选举和马萨诸塞州选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院、州长和州众议院选举。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the U.S. House of Representatives and state senate. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022. Republicans expanded their supermajority in chamber as they did in the senate.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2022年11月8日举行选举，改选州众议院全部100名议员。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2022年6月7日举行。共和党扩大了在州众议院的超多数优势，州参议院也出现同样情况。

en.s: The 2022 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 8, 2022. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 17. Half of the senate (all even-numbered seats) were up for election. Republicans increased their majority in the chamber, gaining one seat. A numbered map of the senate districts can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2022年肯塔基州参议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党和民主党的初选于5月17日举行。参议院半数席位（所有偶数编号席位）进行改选。共和党扩大了在参议院的多数优势，增加1个席位。

en.s: All 62 members of the Wyoming House of Representatives were elected on November 8, 2022, as part of the 2022 Wyoming elections. Primary elections were held on August 16. Republicans expanded their supermajority, gaining six seats.

zh.s: 怀俄明州众议院全部62名议员于2022年11月8日选出，作为2022年怀俄明州选举的一部分。初选于8月16日举行。共和党扩大了超多数优势，增加6个席位。

en.s: The 2022 Illinois Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Illinois Secretary of State. Incumbent Democrat Jesse White did not seek re-election to a seventh term. Alexi Giannoulias, a former state treasurer, won the open seat.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2022年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿杰西·怀特没有竞选第七个任期。州财政长前任亚历克西·吉安努利亚斯赢得空出的席位。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Arizona concurrently with other federal and state elections. Incumbent Republican attorney general Mark Brnovich was term-limited and could not seek a third term in office. With a margin of 0.01%, Democrat Kris Mayes defeated Republican Abe Hamadeh in one of the closest elections in Arizona history, and the closest attorney general race of the 2022 election cycle.

zh.t: 2022年亚利桑那州总检察长选举
zh.s: 亚利桑那州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举，并与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行。共和党籍时任总检察长马克·布尔诺维奇因任期限制无法竞选第三个任期。民主党人克里斯·梅耶斯以0.01个百分点的优势击败共和党人阿贝·哈马德，成为亚利桑那州历史上胜负最接近的选举之一，也是2022年选举周期中最接近的一场总检察长选举。

en.s: The 2022 California State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election being held on June 7, 2022. All of the seats of the California State Assembly were elected as part of the 2022 California elections. Democrats gained two seats, increasing their supermajority to 62 out of 80 seats.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行州众议院选举。初选于同年6月7日举行，州众议院全部席位都进行改选。民主党增加2席，将其绝对多数扩大到80席中的62席。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 15 U.S. representatives from Ohio, one from each of the state's 15 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. Primary elections were held on May 3, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年俄亥俄州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄亥俄州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出15名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的15个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。初选于2022年5月3日举行。

en.s: An election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from American Samoa's at-large congressional district and 20 seat to the American Samoa House of Representatives. The election coincided with races for other federal and American Samoan territorial offices, including the larger American Samoa general election, as well as the nationwide 2022 United States House of Representatives elections and the 2022 United States general elections.

zh.s: 美属萨摩亚于2022年11月8日星期二举行选举，选出一名代表美属萨摩亚单一国会选区、无投票权的联邦众议院代表，以及美属萨摩亚众议院20个席位的议员。此次选举与其他联邦和美属萨摩亚属地职位选举同时举行，包括规模更大的美属萨摩亚普选、全美2022年联邦众议院选举和美国大选。

en.s: The 2022 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Oregon. Incumbent Kate Brown took office when fellow Democrat John Kitzhaber resigned on February 18, 2015. She won the subsequent 2016 special election and a full term in 2018. Due to term limits, she was unable to run again in 2022.

zh.s: 2022年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。现任州长凯特·布朗于2015年2月18日接替辞职的同党人士约翰·基茨哈伯就任；她随后赢得2016年特别选举，并于2018年赢得完整任期。由于任期限制，她不能在2022年再次参选。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Attorney General of Idaho. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Lawrence Wasden sought a sixth term in office, but was defeated in the Republican primary on May 17. Former Republican congressman Raúl Labrador won the general election, defeating Democratic candidate Tom Arkoosh.

zh.s: 爱达荷州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长劳伦斯·瓦斯登竞选第六个任期，但在5月17日的共和党初选中落败。前共和党籍联邦众议员劳尔·拉布拉多赢得普选，击败民主党候选人汤姆·阿库什。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Nevada. Incumbent Democratic governor Steve Sisolak ran for re-election to a second term, but lost in the general election to Republican Joe Lombardo, the Clark County Sheriff. This was the first time since 1966 that an incumbent Democratic governor lost reelection in Nevada, and the first since 1982 that any incumbent Governor of Nevada lost reelection.

zh.s: 内华达州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长史蒂夫·西索拉克竞选连任第二个任期，但在普选中败给共和党人、克拉克县警长乔·隆巴多。这是自1966年以来首位在内华达州竞选连任失败的民主党籍州长，也是自1982年以来首位连任失败的内华达州州长。

en.s: The 2022 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Michigan. Incumbent Democrat Jocelyn Benson decisively won reelection to a second term, defeating Republican Kristina Karamo by a nearly 14 percentage point margin. Michigan does not hold partisan primaries for statewide offices other than governor. Instead, the state parties hold conventions in August to nominate candidates for the general election.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2022年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿乔斯琳·本森以近14个百分点的优势击败共和党人克里斯蒂娜·卡拉莫，成功连任第二个任期。密歇根州除州长选举外，全州职位不举行党派初选，而由各党于8月召开代表大会提名普选候选人。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The primary elections for the Republican. Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 28, 2022. The 2022 election cycle was the first election following redistricting in 2020–21.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出5名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的5个国会选区。共和党、民主党和自由意志党的初选于2022年6月28日举行。2022年选举周期是2020—2021年重新划区后的首次选举。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts Treasurer and Receiver-General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Massachusetts Treasurer and Receiver-General. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Deb Goldberg won re-election, and was challenged by Libertarian Cristina Crawford.

zh.t: 2022年马萨诸塞州财政长兼接管官选举
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2022年11月8日举行财政长兼接管官选举。民主党籍时任财政长黛布·戈德堡成功连任，自由意志党候选人克里斯蒂娜·克劳福德参选。

en.s: The 2022 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Texas. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton won re-election to his third term. Paxton won 233 counties and won the popular vote by a margin of 9.7%, underperforming Governor Greg Abbott's concurrent bid for re-election by 1.1%.

zh.t: 2022年得克萨斯州总检察长选举
zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长肯·帕克斯顿赢得连任，开始第三个任期。他在233个县获胜，普选票领先9.7个百分点，比同期竞选连任的州长格雷格·阿博特少领先1.1个百分点。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Arkansas State Treasurer. Incumbent Republican Party Treasurer Dennis Milligan was term-limited and could not seek a third term. Republican candidate Mark Lowery won the general election, defeating Democratic candidate Pam Whitaker.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州州财长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财长。共和党籍现任州财长丹尼斯·米利根受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人马克·洛厄里在普选中击败民主党候选人帕姆·惠特克。

en.s: On November 8, 2022, Washington, D.C. held an election for its mayor. Incumbent Democrat Muriel Bowser was elected to a third term in a landslide. The Republican nominee, Stacia Hall, received 2,368 votes in the primary, and independent candidate Rodney "Red" Grant garnered 4,700 signatures to gain ballot access. Both appeared on the general election ballot, along with Libertarian Party candidate Dennis Sobin. D.C.

zh.s: 华盛顿特区于2022年11月8日举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长穆丽尔·鲍泽以压倒性优势当选，开启第三个任期。共和党候选人斯塔西亚·霍尔在初选中获得2,368票；独立候选人罗德尼·“雷德”·格兰特收集到4,700个签名，取得进入选票的资格。两人均进入普选选票，与自由意志党候选人丹尼斯·索宾同场竞选。华盛顿特区州权绿党提名人科伦·布朗未列入普选选票。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona elections were held in the state of Arizona on November 8, 2022, coinciding with the nationwide general election. All six executive offices were up for election, as well as a U.S. Senate seat, all of the state's U.S. House of Representatives seats, and the state legislature. In recent years, Arizona's status as a Republican stronghold has significantly weakened; since 2018, Democratic candidates have made substantial gains in the state's legislature, congressional delegation, and statewide executive offices.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于2022年11月8日举行选举，与全美普选同时进行。该州全部6个行政职位、一个联邦参议院席位、该州所有联邦众议院席位以及州议会席位均进行改选。近年亚利桑那州作为共和党稳固票仓的地位明显减弱；自2018年以来，民主党候选人在州议会、国会代表团和全州行政职位选举中均取得显著进展。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Alabama State Treasurer. Incumbent Republican Party Treasurer Young Boozer, who previously served in the office from 2011 to 2019, was appointed to the position October 1, 2021 after the previous treasurer, John McMillan, resigned. Boozer won a full term.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州州财政长选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。共和党籍时任财政长杨·布泽尔曾于2011年至2019年担任该职，2021年10月1日，在前任约翰·麦克米伦辞职后再次获任命。布泽尔赢得完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Oregon State Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 8, 2022, to elect 15 of the 30 members of the State Senate of the 82nd Oregon Legislature, along with one special election. A primary election was held in several districts on May 17, 2022. The election coincided with the election of the other house of the Legislative Assembly, the Oregon House of Representatives, and other elections.

zh.s: 2022年俄勒冈州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选第82届州议会参议院30个席位中的15个，另举行一场特别选举。部分选区于2022年5月17日举行初选。此次选举与州议会另一院——俄勒冈州众议院选举及其他选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Connecticut Attorney General William Tong won re-election to a second term. Tong outperformed all other statewide Democrats and was the only statewide candidate in Connecticut to win by a margin greater than 15 percent in 2022.

zh.t: 2022年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。时任总检察长威廉·汤成功连任第二个任期。他的表现超过其他所有民主党籍全州候选人，也是该州2022年唯一一位领先对手超过15个百分点的全州候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama Supreme Court election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect two justices to the Alabama Supreme Court. Primary elections were held on May 24, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举于11月8日举行，选出两名最高法院大法官。初选于2022年5月24日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 8, 2022. The statewide direct primary election was held on June 7, 2022. California voters elected all of California's seats to the United States House of Representatives, one seat to the United States Senate, all of the seats of the California State Assembly, all even-numbered seats of the California State Senate, and the Governor of California, as well as various statewide offices.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行选举，全州直接初选于2022年6月7日举行。选民选出该州全部联邦众议员、1名联邦参议员、州众议院全部议员、州参议院所有偶数编号席位以及州长，并选出若干其他全州职位。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of North Carolina. Republican Congressman Ted Budd won his first term in office, defeating Democratic nominee Cheri Beasley. Primary elections were scheduled for March 8, 2022, but were delayed by the North Carolina Supreme Court and rescheduled for May 17.

zh.t: 2022年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍联邦众议员特德·巴德首次当选，击败民主党候选人谢里·比斯利。初选原定于2022年3月8日举行，但因州最高法院介入而延期，改至5月17日。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next lieutenant governor of Idaho. It coincided with various other statewide races, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor. Idaho is one of 17 states that elect their lieutenant governor separately in both the primary and general elections.

zh.s: 2022年爱达荷州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任副州长。此次选举与其他全州选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州长选举。爱达荷州是17个在初选和普选中均将副州长与州长分别选举的州之一。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Hawaii was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Hawaii. The primary took place on August 13. Incumbent Democrat Brian Schatz won re-election to a second full term in a landslide, winning 71.2% of the vote to Republican state representative Bob McDermott's 26%.

zh.t: 2022年夏威夷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 夏威夷州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。初选于同年8月13日举行。民主党籍时任参议员布赖恩·沙茨以压倒性优势连任，开始第二个完整任期，获得71.2%的选票。共和党人、州众议员鲍勃·麦克德莫特获得26%。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the State of Iowa, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年爱荷华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年爱荷华州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出4名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的4个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Los Angeles County elections were held on November 8, 2022, in Los Angeles County, California, with nonpartisan blanket primary elections for certain offices being held on June 7. Two of the five seats of the Board of Supervisors were up for election, as well as two of the countywide elected officials, the Sheriff and the Assessor.

zh.s: 2022年洛杉矶县选举于11月8日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶县举行，部分职位于6月7日进行无党派综合初选。县监事会5个席位中的2个进行改选，县级直选官员中也有两职进行改选，分别为警长和评估官。

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Florida State Senate took place on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect state senators from all 40 districts. Although on ordinary years, 20 senators are elected at a time on a staggered basis, races following redistricting elect all 40 members to ensure that each member represents an equal number of constituents. The Republican Party expanded their Senate majority from 24 to 28, gaining a supermajority in the Senate.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于2022年11月8日举行州参议院选举，改选全部40个选区。通常每次选举按任期交错改选20名参议员；但选区重划后的选举改选全部40席，以确保每名议员代表的人口相同。共和党将其州参议院多数从24席扩大到28席，获得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2022 Florida House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the 2022 United States elections. Florida voters elected state representatives in all 120 of the state's house districts. The 120 State Representatives serve two-year terms in the Florida House of Representatives. A primary election on August 23, 2022, determined which candidates appeared on the November 8 general election ballot.

zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州众议院选举于11月8日举行，是2022年美国选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民在该州全部120个众议院选区选出州众议员，任期两年。初选于2022年8月23日举行，以确定哪些候选人进入11月8日普选选票。

en.s: The 2022 Maricopa County Attorney special election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the County Attorney for Maricopa County, Arizona. The election was held concurrently with other federal and state elections, as well as a special election for District 2 on the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors. The special election was called due to the resignation of Allister Adel in March 2022.

zh.t: 2022年马里科帕县检察官特别选举
zh.s: 2022年马里科帕县检察官特别选举于11月8日举行，选出亚利桑那州马里科帕县检察官。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举以及马里科帕县监事会第2选区特别选举同时举行。此次特别选举因前任艾莉斯特·阿德尔于2022年3月辞职而举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 17 U.S. representatives from Illinois, one from each of the state's 17 congressional districts (reduced from 18 in the redistricting cycle following the 2020 United States census). The elections coincided with the 2022 U.S.

zh.t: 2022年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出17名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的17个国会选区；在2020年人口普查后的重新划区中，席位从18个减至17个。此次选举与伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Massachusetts. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Maura Healey was eligible to seek a third term, but instead announced she would run for governor.

zh.t: 2022年马萨诸塞州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长莫拉·希利符合竞选第三个任期的资格，但宣布转而竞选州长。

en.s: The 2022 Alaska gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Alaska. Incumbent Republican governor Mike Dunleavy won re-election to a second term, becoming the first Republican governor to be re-elected to a second term since Jay Hammond in 1978 and the first governor, regardless of political affiliation, to be re-elected to a second term since Tony Knowles in 1998.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于2022年11月8日星期二举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长迈克·邓利维成功连任第二个任期。这是自1978年杰伊·哈蒙德以来，首位连任第二个任期的共和党州长；也是自1998年托尼·诺尔斯以来，首位成功连任第二个任期的州长，不论党派。

en.s: South Dakota state elections in 2022 were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on June 7, 2022 (with runoffs on August 16, 2022). All of South Dakota's executive officers were up for election, as well as South Dakota's at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 南达科他州于2022年11月8日星期二举行州级选举。初选于2022年6月7日举行，未决出结果的选举于8月16日举行第二轮投票。该州所有行政职位、以及在联邦众议院的单一席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of Alabama. Incumbent Republican Secretary of State John Merrill was term-limited and could not run for a third term. The Republican primary for this race was held on May 24, 2022. No candidate reached the threshold of 50 percent plus one vote, so an ensuing runoff to decide the nominee was held on June 21, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿约翰·梅里尔受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。共和党初选于2022年5月24日举行。由于没有候选人达到50%加1票的门槛，6月21日举行第二轮初选以确定提名人。

en.s: The 2022 Nebraska Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Nebraska. Incumbent Republican Bob Evnen won re-election to a second term unopposed. No Democratic candidates filed against him.

zh.t: 2022年内布拉斯加州州务卿选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于2022年11月8日举行州务卿选举。共和党籍时任州务卿鲍勃·埃夫宁没有对手，成功连任第二个任期。没有民主党候选人登记参选。

en.s: A general election was scheduled in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 8, 2022. All of Idaho's executive officers were up for election as well as both of Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives and one United States Senate seat. Primary elections elections were held on May 17, 2022.

zh.s: 爱达荷州原定于2022年11月8日举行普选。该州所有行政职位、在联邦众议院的两个席位以及一个联邦参议院席位均进行改选。初选于2022年5月17日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Tennessee, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年田纳西州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出9名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的9个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held November 8, 2022. Voters in each of Arizona's 30 legislative districts elected two state representatives to the Arizona House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary elections were set for August 2022.

zh.s: 2022年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月8日举行。该州30个立法选区各选出2名州众议员。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选定于2022年8月举行。

en.s: The 2022 Nebraska gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next governor of the U.S. state of Nebraska. Incumbent Republican governor Pete Ricketts was term-limited and unable to seek a third term. In the general election, Republican Jim Pillen won the gubernatorial election by a 23-point margin. Nebraska's primary elections were held on May 10.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长皮特·里基茨因任期限制无法竞选第三个任期。共和党人吉姆·皮伦在普选中以23个百分点的优势获胜。内布拉斯加州初选于同年5月10日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Louisiana. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator John Kennedy was first elected in 2016. He ran for re-election to a second term, and was re-elected after receiving a majority of votes in the first round.

zh.t: 2022年路易斯安那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·肯尼迪于2016年首次当选。他竞选连任第二个任期，并在第一轮投票中获得过半数选票，成功连任。

en.s: The 2022 South Carolina gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of South Carolina. Incumbent Republican Governor Henry McMaster ran for re-election for a second full term in office and secured the Republican nomination in the June 14 primary. Joe Cunningham, former United States representative from South Carolina's 1st congressional district, was the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 2022年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长亨利·麦克马斯特竞选第二个完整任期，并在6月14日的初选中获得共和党提名。民主党候选人为乔·坎宁安，他曾代表南卡罗来纳州第一国会选区担任联邦众议员。

en.t: 2022 Alabama State Board of Education election
en.s: The 2022 Alabama State Board of Education election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect four members to the Alabama State Board of Education. Primary elections were held on May 24.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州教育委员会选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州教育委员会选举于11月8日举行，选出4名州教育委员会委员。初选于5月24日举行。

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Illinois Senate occurred on November 8, 2022, to elect senators from all of the state's 59 legislative districts in the Illinois Senate. The primary election took place on Tuesday, June 28, 2022. The winners of this election would serve in the 103rd General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the state based on the 2020 United States census.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，改选州参议院全部59个立法选区的议员。初选于2022年6月28日星期二举行。本次选举的胜出者将在第103届州议会任职；席位根据2020年美国人口普查结果在各地分配。

en.s: The 2022 Indiana State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Indiana State Treasurer. Incumbent Republican Party Treasurer Kelly Mitchell was term-limited and could not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2022年印第安纳州州财长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财长。共和党籍现任州财长凯莉·米切尔受任期限制，不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 Oklahoma State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Oklahoma State Treasurer. The primary election was scheduled for Tuesday, June 28, 2022. Runoff primary elections, if necessary, would have been held on Tuesday, August 23, 2022. The deadline for candidates to file was April 15, 2022. Incumbent Republican Party Treasurer Randy McDaniel did not seek re-election.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州州财长选举
zh.s: 2022年俄克拉何马州州财长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财长。初选原定于2022年6月28日星期二举行；如有必要，第二轮初选将于8月23日星期二举行。候选人登记截止日期为2022年4月15日。共和党籍现任州财长兰迪·麦克丹尼尔决定不竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 2022, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 93rd Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on August 9, 2022. The election coincided with the election of the other chamber of the Legislature, the Senate.

zh.s: 2022年明尼苏达州众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第93届明尼苏达州议会众议院议员。部分选区于2022年8月9日举行初选。此次选举与州议会另一院——参议院的选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 New Mexico Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of New Mexico. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Hector Balderas was term-limited and could not seek re-election.

zh.t: 2022年新墨西哥州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年新墨西哥州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长赫克托·巴尔德拉斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Colorado was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Democratic Senator Michael Bennet was re-elected to a third term, defeating the Republican candidate, businessman Joe O'Dea. Originally appointed to the seat in 2009, Bennet won full terms in 2010 and 2016. Bennet won by nearly 15 points, significantly outperforming his polling.

zh.t: 2022年科罗拉多州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员迈克尔·贝内特击败共和党候选人、商人乔·奥戴，赢得第三个任期。贝内特于2009年获任命填补空缺，之后在2010年和2016年分别当选完整任期。这次他以近15个百分点的优势获胜，表现远超民调预测。

en.s: The 2022 Tennessee House of Representatives election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect 99 seats for the Tennessee House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the governor, U.S. House, and State Senate elections.

zh.s: 2022年田纳西州众议院选举于11月8日举行，改选州众议院99个席位。此次选举与州长、联邦众议院和州参议院选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Florida attorney general election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Florida attorney general. Incumbent Republican attorney general Ashley Moody was reelected for a second term, defeating Democratic challenger Aramis Ayala by a 21-point margin in a landslide victory. Moody received the most raw votes and the highest percentage of the vote of any statewide candidate in the 2022 Florida elections.

zh.t: 2022年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长阿什利·穆迪以21个百分点的优势大胜民主党挑战者阿拉米斯·阿亚拉，成功连任第二个任期。她在佛罗里达州2022年的选举中获得的总票数和得票率均高于其他任何全州候选人。

en.t: 2022 North Dakota Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2022 North Dakota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of North Dakota. Incumbent Independent Alvin Jaeger did not seek reelection to an eighth term.

zh.s: 2022年北达科他州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州务卿。独立人士、现任州务卿阿尔文·耶格尔决定不竞选第八个任期。

en.s: The 2022 South Dakota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the State Auditor of South Dakota. Incumbent Republican Rich Sattgast was re-elected, defeating Democratic challenger Stephanie Marty and Libertarian nominee Rene Meyer.

zh.t: 2022年南达科他州州审计长选举
zh.s: 南达科他州于2022年11月8日举行州审计长选举。共和党籍时任审计长里奇·萨特加斯特成功连任，击败民主党挑战者斯蒂芬妮·马蒂和自由意志党候选人雷内·迈耶。

en.s: The 2022 Iowa Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Iowa. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Tom Miller, who was first elected Attorney General in 1978, ran for re-election to an eleventh overall term, but was narrowly defeated by Republican nominee Brenna Bird, the county attorney for Guthrie County. Bird received 50.8% of the vote while Miller received 49.1% of the vote.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长汤姆·米勒于1978年首次当选，该年竞选第十一个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党候选人、格思里县检察官布伦娜·伯德。伯德获得50.8%的选票，米勒获得49.1%。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Democratic (DFL) Governor Tim Walz defeated the Republican nominee, physician and former state Senator Scott Jensen, winning a second term. Jensen's advantage in rural Greater Minnesota could not overcome Walz's large lead in the Twin Cities metropolitan area.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党—农民—劳工党籍时任州长蒂姆·沃尔兹击败共和党候选人、医生和前州参议员斯科特·詹森，赢得第二个任期。詹森在明尼苏达州乡村地区占优，但仍不敌沃尔兹在双城都会区的大幅领先。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Washington. Murray had won election to a fifth term in 2016 with 59% of the vote. Because Washington has a blanket primary system, parties did not nominate their own candidates to run in the general election.

zh.t: 2022年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表华盛顿州的联邦参议员。帕蒂·默里在2016年以59%的得票率当选，开启第五个任期。由于华盛顿州采用综合初选制度，各党不会单独提名候选人参加普选。

en.s: The 2022 Northern Mariana gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of the Northern Mariana Islands and the lieutenant governor of the Northern Mariana Islands to a four-year term in office. Because no candidate received 50% of the vote in the general election, the two highest-placing candidates advanced to a runoff election on November 25, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年北马里亚纳群岛州长选举
zh.s: 北马里亚纳群岛于2022年11月8日举行州长选举，选出州长和副州长，任期四年。普选中没有候选人获得50%的选票，得票前两名进入2022年11月25日举行的决选。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Louisiana, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年路易斯安那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年路易斯安那州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的6个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate from Wisconsin. The party primaries were held on August 9, 2022. Incumbent Republican Senator Ron Johnson won election to a third term, defeating Democratic Lieutenant Governor Mandela Barnes by 26,718 votes—a one-point margin of victory.

zh.t: 2022年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举。党内初选于同年8月9日举行。共和党籍时任参议员罗恩·约翰逊击败民主党候选人、州副州长曼德拉·巴恩斯，赢得第三个任期。约翰逊以26,718票的优势获胜，领先幅度约为1个百分点。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect 25 members to Montana's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022. Republicans expanded their supermajority in the chamber as they did in the house.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2022年11月8日举行参议院选举，选出25名州参议员。初选于同年6月7日举行。选举与联邦众议院和州众议院等职位的选举同时举行。共和党扩大了在州参议院的绝对多数，与其在州众议院的情况相同。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 8, 2022, to elect members of the Senate of the 93rd Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on August 9, 2022. The election coincided with the election of the other house of the Legislature, the Minnesota House of Representatives, and all other statewide elections.

zh.s: 2022年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第93届明尼苏达州议会参议院议员。部分选区于2022年8月9日举行初选。此次选举与州议会另一院——明尼苏达州众议院及全州其他选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Oklahoma. Incumbent senator James Lankford won re-election to a second full term, defeating cybersecurity professional Madison Horn (no relation to former U.S.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表俄克拉何马州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·兰克福德连任第二个完整任期，击败网络安全专业人士麦迪逊·霍恩。她与曾任联邦众议员的肯德拉·霍恩没有亲属关系；后者参加了同期举行的第二类联邦参议员特别选举。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the U.S. representative from South Dakota's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Dusty Johnson was re-elected with 81.0% of the vote in 2020.

zh.t: 2022年南达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年南达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍现任众议员达斯蒂·约翰逊在2020年以81.0%的得票率连任。

en.s: Elections for the Iowa House of Representatives were held on November 8, 2022. This was the first election for the Iowa House using the new legislative maps that were enacted following the 2020 census. Republicans expanded their majority in the chamber after a number of their members were defeated in primaries.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州众议院于2022年11月8日举行选举。这是该州2020年人口普查后按新议会选区举行的首次选举。多名共和党籍议员在初选中落败后，共和党仍扩大了在州众议院的多数席位。

en.t: 2022 South Dakota Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2022 South Dakota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of South Dakota. Incumbent Republican Steve Barnett ran for re-election, but was defeated at the state convention by Monae Johnson.

zh.s: 2022年南达科他州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿史蒂夫·巴内特竞选连任，但在州党代会上败给莫娜·约翰逊，未获提名。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all 110 members to Michigan's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including governor, State Senate and U.S. House of Representatives. Democrats won a majority of 56 out of 110 seats, winning control of the chamber for the first time since 2008.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2022年11月8日举行州众议院选举，改选全部110席。选举与州长、州参议院和联邦众议院等职位的选举同时举行。民主党赢得110席中的56席，首次自2008年以来控制州众议院。

en.t: 2022 New Mexico Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2022 New Mexico Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of New Mexico. Incumbent Democratic secretary Maggie Toulouse Oliver won re-election to a second term. She was elected to a full term with 57.8% of the vote in 2018.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于2022年11月8日举行州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿玛吉·图卢兹·奥利弗成功连任第二个任期。她在2018年首次当选完整任期，得票率为57.8%。

en.s: General elections took place on November 8, 2022, throughout the US state of Indiana.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于2022年11月8日举行普选。

en.s: The 2022 Michigan elections were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, throughout Michigan. The Democratic Party made historic gains, taking full control of state government for the first time since 1983 and marking a point where Democrats held all four elected statewide offices, both U.S. Senate seats, and both chambers of the Michigan Legislature.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2022年11月8日举行选举。民主党取得历史性进展，首次自1983年以来全面掌控州政府，并赢得全部4个全州直选职位、两席联邦参议员席位和州议会两院。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the U.S. representative from North Dakota's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Kelly Armstrong was re-elected with 69.0% of the vote in 2020.

zh.t: 2022年北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年北达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍现任众议员凯利·阿姆斯特朗在2020年以69.0%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2022 California State Treasurer election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the State Treasurer of California. Incumbent Democratic treasurer Fiona Ma won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州州财政长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任财政长菲奥娜·马成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 California Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of California. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Rob Bonta was appointed to the office on April 23, 2021, following the resignation of Xavier Becerra to become the U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services. Bonta won a full term.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长罗布·邦塔于2021年4月23日获任命接任哈维尔·贝塞拉，后者辞职出任美国卫生与公众服务部长。邦塔赢得完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election having been held on Tuesday, September 6, 2022. Massachusetts voters selected all 160 members of the State House to serve two-year terms in the 2023–2024 Massachusetts legislature. The election coincided with United States national elections and Massachusetts state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Massachusetts Senate.

zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，初选于同年9月6日星期二举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出州众议院全部160名议员，任期两年，任职于2023—2024届州议会。此次选举与美国全国选举和马萨诸塞州选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Illinois on November 8, 2022. The elections for United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, Governor, statewide constitutional officers, Illinois Senate, and Illinois House were held on this date.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2022年11月8日举行普选。当天举行了联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长、全州宪法官员、州参议院和州众议院选举。

en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Massachusetts. Republican former state representative Geoff Diehl, Democratic state Attorney General Maura Healey, and Libertarian Kevin Reed sought to succeed incumbent Governor Charlie Baker, who did not seek re-election after two terms.

zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人、前州众议员杰夫·迪尔，民主党候选人、州总检察长莫拉·希利，以及自由意志党候选人凯文·里德竞选接替现任州长查理·贝克；贝克在任两届后决定不寻求连任。

en.s: The 2022 Vermont Senate election took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial United States elections. The election coincided with elections for other offices including the U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Governor, and State House. Vermont voters elected all 30 state senators from 16 districts, with each district electing between one and three senators. State senators serve two-year terms in the Vermont Senate.

zh.s: 2022年佛蒙特州参议院选举于11月8日举行，是两年一度的美国选举的一部分。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州众议院选举。佛蒙特州选民从16个选区选出州参议院全部30名议员，各选区选出1至3名参议员。州参议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2022 Iowa State Auditor election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Iowa Auditor of State, concurrently with an election to the U.S. Senate, governor, U.S. House of Representatives, and other state and local elections. Primary elections were held on June 7, 2022. Incumbent Democratic auditor Rob Sand narrowly won re-election to a second term in office against Republican nominee Todd Halbur.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于2022年11月8日举行州审计长选举，并与联邦参议员、州长、联邦众议员等职位的选举同时举行。初选于同年6月7日举行。民主党籍时任审计长罗布·桑德击败共和党候选人托德·哈尔伯，险胜连任第二个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of South Dakota. Incumbent three-term Republican U.S. Senator John Thune, who was the Senate Minority Whip, was first elected in 2004, defeating Democratic incumbent Tom Daschle, the then-Senate Minority Leader. He ran for reelection to a fourth term.

zh.t: 2022年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表南达科他州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·图恩已任职三届，担任参议院少数党党鞭；他于2004年首次当选，击败时任民主党籍参议院少数党领袖汤姆·达施勒。本次他竞选第四个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Illinois. Incumbent Democratic senator Tammy Duckworth was re-elected for a second term against former U.S. House of Representatives candidate Kathy Salvi, the Republican nominee, winning by a margin of 15.3%, 0.2% more than her 2016 margin.

zh.t: 2022年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍时任参议员塔米·达克沃思击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议院候选人凯西·萨尔维，赢得第二个任期。达克沃思领先15.3个百分点，比2016年的领先幅度多0.2个百分点。

en.s: The 2022 New Hampshire Executive Council elections took place on November 8, 2022, to elect all five members of the Executive Council of New Hampshire. The party primaries were held on September 13. These elections are notable because although Democrats won the majority of the votes in the five concurrent elections, they only won one of the five seats.

zh.t: 2022年新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于2022年11月8日举行行政委员会选举，改选委员会全部5席。党内初选于同年9月13日举行。尽管民主党候选人在同时举行的5场选举中合计获得多数选票，但只赢得其中1席。

en.s: The 2022 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of Pennsylvania. Democratic state attorney general Josh Shapiro defeated Republican state senator Doug Mastriano to win his first term in office. Shapiro succeeded Democratic incumbent Tom Wolf, who was term limited. In the primaries on May 17, 2022, Shapiro was unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行州长和副州长选举。民主党籍州总检察长乔什·夏皮罗击败共和党籍州参议员道格·马斯特里亚诺，首次当选州长。夏皮罗接替因任期限制无法连任的民主党籍时任州长汤姆·沃尔夫。5月17日的初选中，夏皮罗没有对手，直接获得民主党提名。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Rhode Island, one from each of the state's 2 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年罗得岛州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年罗得岛州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出2名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的2个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Voters in 11 districts of the Nevada Senate elected their senators. The elections coincided with elections for other offices, including for governor, the U.S. Senate, the U.S. House and the Nevada Assembly. The primary elections were held on Tuesday, June 14, 2022. Democrats gained one seat, increasing their majority to 13 out of 21 seats, one seat shy of a two-thirds supermajority.

zh.s: 内华达州于2022年11月8日举行州参议院选举，改选11个选区。选举与州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院等职位的选举同时举行。初选于同年6月14日星期二举行。民主党增加1席，以21席中的13席扩大多数，距离获得三分之二绝对多数还差1席。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Alabama, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. Primaries in Alabama took place on May 24.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出7名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的7个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。阿拉巴马州初选于5月24日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022. Republican incumbent Kim Reynolds won re-election to a second full term, defeating Democratic nominee Deidre DeJear with 58.0% of the vote and winning seven counties she lost in 2018: Black Hawk, Clinton, Des Moines, Dubuque, Jefferson, Lee, and Scott. First elected as lieutenant governor in 2010, Reynolds assumed the governorship on May 24, 2017, following the resignation of Governor Terry Branstad to become the U.S. ambassador to China.

zh.s: 艾奥瓦州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。共和党籍时任州长金·雷诺兹以58.0%的得票率击败民主党候选人迪德丽·德吉尔，赢得第二个完整任期，并在布莱克霍克、克林顿、德梅因、迪比克、杰斐逊、李和斯科特7个她在2018年落败的县胜出。雷诺兹于2010年首次当选副州长；2017年5月24日，州长特里·布兰斯塔德辞职出任美国驻华大使后，她接任州长。

en.s: The 2022 Tennessee gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Tennessee, alongside other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Bill Lee was elected to a second term with 64.9% of the vote, defeating his Democratic challenger Jason Martin. Lee improved on his performance from 2018. The primary elections took place on August 4, 2022, with Lee and Martin winning their respective parties' nominations.

zh.s: 田纳西州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举，并与其他州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍时任州长比尔·李以64.9%的得票率击败民主党挑战者杰森·马丁，赢得第二个任期，且得票表现超过2018年。初选于同年8月4日举行，李和马丁分别获得本党提名。

en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Dan McKee became Rhode Island's governor on March 2, 2021, when term-limited Gina Raimondo resigned following her confirmation as United States Secretary of Commerce. Despite a heavily contested primary, McKee easily won a full term on Election Day, defeating Republican Ashley Kalus by more than 19 percentage points.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长丹·麦基于2021年3月2日接任州长，当时州长吉娜·雷蒙多因任期限制辞职，转任美国商务部长。尽管党内初选竞争激烈，麦基仍在普选中轻松赢得完整任期，以超过19个百分点的优势击败共和党候选人阿什莉·卡卢斯。

en.t: 2022 California State Board of Equalization election
en.s: The 2022 California State Board of Equalization elections took place on November 8, 2022, to elect all four seats of the State Board of Equalization, with the non-partisan blanket primary election taking place on June 7, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州均衡委员会选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州均衡委员会选举于11月8日举行，选出委员会全部4名委员。无党派综合初选于2022年6月7日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Wyoming Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Wyoming. On April 18, 2022, incumbent Republican Edward Buchanan announced that he would run for re-election, but on May 17 he reversed this decision, choosing not to seek a second term. State Representative Chuck Gray won the Republican nomination on August 16 with the backing of Donald Trump.

zh.s: 2022年怀俄明州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿爱德华·布坎南于2022年4月18日宣布竞选连任，但在5月17日改变决定，选择不竞选第二个任期。州众议员查克·格雷于8月16日获得共和党提名，并得到唐纳德·特朗普支持。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the 2022 United States elections during President Joe Biden's term. Representatives were elected from all 435 U.S. congressional districts across each of the 50 states to serve in the 118th United States Congress, as well as 5 non-voting members of the U.S.

zh.s: 2022年美国联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，是乔·拜登总统任期内的2022年美国选举的一部分。50个州全部435个国会选区均选出联邦众议员，进入第118届国会；哥伦比亚特区和5个有人居住的岛屿属地中4个还选出了5名无投票权的众议院代表。

en.s: The 2022 Indiana Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with elections in the U.S. state of Indiana, coinciding with other elections in the state, U.S. House, and Indiana House, as well as various other state and local elections. Voters elected members to 25 of the 50 seats in the Indiana Senate to serve four-year terms in single-member constituencies.

zh.s: 2022年印第安纳州参议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，与印第安纳州其他选举、联邦众议院和州众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。选民选出州参议院50个席位中的25个，议员从单一选区选出，任期四年。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Utah, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2022年犹他州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出4名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的4个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 California Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of California. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022. Incumbent Democrat Shirley Weber was appointed to the position in December 2020 by governor Gavin Newsom. Newsom had appointed incumbent secretary of state Alex Padilla to succeed Kamala Harris as California's junior U.S. senator after Harris was elected Vice President of the United States in 2020.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州务卿。初选于2022年6月7日举行。民主党籍现任州务卿雪莉·韦伯于2020年12月由州长加文·纽森任命。此前，纽森任命时任州务卿亚历克斯·帕迪利亚接替卡玛拉·哈里斯，担任加利福尼亚州资浅联邦参议员；哈里斯于2020年当选副总统后离开参议院。

en.t: 2022 Council of the District of Columbia election
en.s: On November 8, 2022, a general election was held for the Council of the District of Columbia. Elections were held in four wards as well as for chairperson of the council and two at-large seats. Democrats remained in control of the council, electing six out of the seven positions that were on the ballot. Kenyan McDuffie, formerly the Democratic councilperson for Ward 5, was elected to an at-large seat as an independent.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于2022年11月8日举行议会普选，改选4个选区、议会主席和2个不分区席位。民主党继续控制议会，赢得选票上的7席中的6席。曾代表第5选区的民主党籍议员肯扬·麦克达菲以独立人士身份当选不分区议员。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Governor Ned Lamont ran for election to a second term in office. The race simultaneously took place with the election to the state's Class III Senate seat. This election featured a rematch of the previous 2018 gubernatorial election, pitting Lamont against Republican Bob Stefanowski, whom he previously defeated by 3.2% of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长内德·拉蒙特竞选第二个任期。此次选举与该州第三类联邦参议院席位选举同时举行。本次州长选举是2018年选举的重赛，拉蒙特再次对阵共和党候选人鲍勃·斯特凡诺夫斯基；拉蒙特此前以3.2个百分点的优势击败过他。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina were held on November 8, 2022, to elect U.S. representatives from the state of North Carolina, concurrent with nationwide elections to the House of Representatives and U.S. Senate (including in North Carolina), alongside legislative elections to the state house and senate. Primaries were held on May 17, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州联邦众议员。此次选举与全美联邦众议院和参议院选举（包括北卡罗来纳州的选举）同时举行，也与州众议院和参议院选举同时举行。初选于2022年5月17日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Michigan gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Michigan. Incumbent Democratic Governor Gretchen Whitmer ran for election to a second term, and faced former political commentator Tudor Dixon in the general election. Whitmer defeated Dixon by a margin of nearly 11 percentage points, a wider margin than polls indicated as well as a wider margin than Whitmer's first victory four years prior.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长格雷琴·惠特默竞选连任第二个任期，对手是前政治评论员都铎·迪克森。惠特默以近11个百分点的优势击败迪克森，领先幅度超过民调预测，也高于她四年前首次当选时的优势。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the State of West Virginia, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出2名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的2个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 Rhode Island House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on September 13, 2022. Rhode Island voters elected state representatives in all 75 seats of the House of Representatives to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Rhode Island state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Rhode Island Senate.

zh.s: 2022年罗得岛州众议院选举于11月8日举行。初选于2022年9月13日举行。罗得岛州选民选出州众议院全部75名议员，任期两年。此次选举与美国全国选举和罗得岛州选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in the Northern Mariana Islands was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect the territory's delegate to the United States House of Representatives in the 118th United States Congress. The delegate, who is elected to a two-year term, represents the Northern Mariana Islands' at-large congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives.

zh.t: 2022年北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，选出一名代表该属地进入第118届国会的联邦众议院代表。该代表任期两年，代表北马里亚纳群岛单一国会选区。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of New Hampshire, one from each of the state's two congressional districts.

zh.t: 2022年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出2名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的2个国会选区。

en.s: The 2022 New Mexico State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next New Mexico State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Party Treasurer Tim Eichenberg was term-limited and could not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2022年新墨西哥州州财长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财长。民主党籍现任州财长蒂姆·艾肯伯格受任期限制，不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Maine. Incumbent Democratic governor Janet Mills won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee and former governor Paul LePage. Neither candidate faced any primary opposition. An independent candidate, Sam Hunkler, received 2% of the vote, the lowest total for a third party or independent gubernatorial candidate in the state since 1982.

zh.s: 缅因州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党籍时任州长珍妮特·米尔斯击败共和党候选人、前州长保罗·勒佩奇，成功连任第二个任期。两人都没有党内初选对手。独立候选人萨姆·亨克勒获得2%的选票，是该州自1982年以来得票率最低的第三党或独立派州长候选人。

en.s: The 2022 Delaware State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Delaware State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Party Treasurer Colleen Davis won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 特拉华州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任财政长科琳·戴维斯成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Utah Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. 15 of the 29 seats in the Utah Senate were up for election. The Democratic Convention was held on April 9, 2022. The Republican Convention was held on April 23, 2022. Primary elections were held on June 28, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年犹他州参议院选举于11月8日举行，是两年一度的2022年美国选举的一部分。州参议院29个席位中的15个进行改选。民主党州代表大会于2022年4月9日举行，共和党州代表大会于4月23日举行。初选于2022年6月28日举行。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the attorney general of South Carolina. Republican incumbent Alan Wilson won re-election to a fourth term unopposed. The only two candidates to file for the election were Wilson and another Republican attorney, Lauren Martel.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州总检察长选举
zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于2022年11月8日举行总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长艾伦·威尔逊没有对手，成功连任第四个任期。只有两名候选人登记参选：威尔逊和另一名共和党籍律师劳伦·马特尔。

en.t: 2022 New Mexico Commissioner of Public Lands election
en.s: The 2022 New Mexico Commissioner of Public Lands election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next New Mexico Commissioner of Public Lands. Incumbent Democratic Land Commissioner Stephanie Garcia Richard won re-election.

zh.t: 2022年新墨西哥州公共土地专员选举
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于2022年11月8日举行公共土地专员选举。民主党籍时任土地专员斯蒂芬妮·加西亚·理查德成功连任。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Nevada State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Zach Conine won re-election to a second term. With a margin of 1.7%, this was the closest state treasurer race of the 2022 election cycle.

zh.s: 内华达州于2022年11月8日举行州财政长选举。民主党籍时任财政长扎克·科宁成功连任第二个任期，领先1.7个百分点。这是2022年选举周期中胜负最接近的一场州财政长选举。

en.s: The 2022 United States state treasurer elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the state treasurer and equivalents in twenty-seven states, plus a special election in Utah. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2018. The treasurer of Vermont serves two-year terms and was last elected in 2020. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections.

zh.s: 2022年美国各州州财长选举于11月8日举行，在27个州选出州财长或同等职位官员；犹他州另举行一场特别选举。这组州的上一次选举于2018年举行。佛蒙特州州财长任期两年，最近一次选举于2020年举行。这些选举与多项联邦、州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Shawn Wooden did not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2022年康涅狄格州州财长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财长。民主党籍现任州财长肖恩·伍登决定不竞选连任。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Mexico on November 8, 2022.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于2022年11月8日举行普选。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona Senate election was held on November 8, 2022. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were scheduled for August 2, 2022. Prior to the elections, the Republican Party held a narrow majority over the Democratic Party, controlling 16 seats to their 14 seats.

zh.s: 2022年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月8日举行。该州30个立法选区各选出州参议员，任期两年。初选原定于2022年8月2日举行。选举前，共和党以16席对民主党的14席占据微弱多数。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Missouri, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年密苏里州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年密苏里州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出8名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的8个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the state auditor of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Incumbent DFLer Julie Blaha narrowly won re-election to a second term. Blaha was challenged by Republican candidate Ryan Wilson, Grassroot–Legalize Cannabis Party candidate Will Finn, and Legal Marijuana Now Party candidate Tim Davis. This election was the second-closest for Minnesota State Auditor ever, after 1934.

zh.t: 2022年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2022年11月8日举行州审计长选举。民主党—农民—劳工党籍时任审计长朱莉·布拉哈险胜连任第二个任期。她的对手包括共和党候选人瑞安·威尔逊、基层—大麻合法化党候选人威尔·芬恩，以及“现在就合法大麻党”候选人蒂姆·戴维斯。这是该州历史上胜负第二接近的州审计长选举，最近的一次发生在1934年。

en.s: The 2022 Tennessee State Senate election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect 17 of the 33 seats for the Tennessee's State Senate. The elections coincided with the Governor, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on August 4, 2022. Following the 2022 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving Tennessee's State Senate delegation at a 27–6 Republican supermajority.

zh.s: 田纳西州于2022年11月8日举行州参议院选举，改选33席中的17席。选举与州长、联邦众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。初选于同年8月4日举行。选举后没有席位易手，共和党继续以27比6的席位优势保持绝对多数。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Arkansas. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of Arkansas. Primary elections were held on May 24. Arkansas is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括州长选举。初选于5月24日举行。阿肯色州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.s: The 2022 Vermont House of Representatives election took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial United States elections. The election coincided with elections for other offices including the U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Governor, and State Senate. Vermont voters elected all 150 state representatives from 109 districts, with each district electing between one and two representatives. State representatives served two-year terms.

zh.s: 2022年佛蒙特州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，是美国两年一度选举的一部分。当天还举行了美国参议院、众议院、州长和州参议院等职位的选举。佛蒙特州选民选出全部150名州众议员，来自109个选区，每个选区选出1至2人。州众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 2022 Alaska Senate elections took place on November 8, 2022, with the primary elections being held on August 16, 2022. State senators serve four-year terms in the Alaska Senate, with half of the seats normally up for election every two years. However, because most districts were greatly changed in redistricting, elections were held for 19 of the 20 seats; the only exception is District T, represented by Democrat Donny Olson, which was mostly unchanged in redistricting and thus did not have an election.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉斯加州参议院选举于11月8日举行，初选于8月16日举行。州参议员任期为四年，通常每两年改选一半席位。但由于重划选区后多数选区变化很大，当年改选了20个席位中的19个。唯一未改选的是T选区。该选区在重划后基本没有变化，由民主党人唐尼·奥尔森代表。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Colorado. Incumbent Democrat Jena Griswold won re-election to a second term, improving on her 2018 results.

zh.s: 2022年科罗拉多州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出科罗拉多州州务卿。现任民主党人杰娜·格里斯沃尔德赢得连任，开始第二个任期，得票表现好于2018年。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all eight members to the Massachusetts Governor's Council. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including governor and U.S. House of Representatives. Democrats maintained all eight seats on the council and flipped the lieutenant governor seat, which presides over the council.

zh.t: 2022年马萨诸塞州州长委员会选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日举行选举，选出马萨诸塞州州长委员会的全部8名成员。当天还举行了州长和美国众议院等职位的选举。民主党保住了委员会的全部8个席位，并赢得副州长一职。副州长主持该委员会。

en.s: The 2022 Michigan Senate election occurred on November 8, 2022, to elect all 38 members to the Michigan Senate. The election coincided with elections for all of Michigan's constitutional offices; governor, attorney general, secretary of state and all 110 seats in the Michigan House of Representatives. Seats in the Michigan Senate were last elected in 2018.

zh.s: 2022年密歇根州参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出州参议院全部38名议员。当天还选举密歇根州各宪制职位，包括州长、州检察长、州务卿，以及众议院全部110个席位。密歇根州参议院上次选举是在2018年。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022. Elections were held to elect representatives from all 100 House of Representatives districts across the U.S. state of Arkansas. They were held alongside numerous other federal, state, and local elections, including the 2022 Arkansas Senate election.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州众议院选举于11月8日举行，改选全州100个众议院选区的议员。选举与多场联邦、州和地方选举同时举行，包括2022年阿肯色州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2022 Texas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Texas. Incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott won re-election to a third term, defeating the Democratic nominee, former Congressman Beto O'Rourke. All statewide elected offices were currently held by Republicans. In his previous gubernatorial race in 2018, Abbott won with 55.8% of the vote. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on March 1, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出得克萨斯州州长。现任共和党州长格雷格·阿博特击败民主党候选人、前国会议员贝托·奥罗克，赢得连任，开始第三个任期。当时该州所有全州民选职位均由共和党人担任。阿博特在2018年州长选举中获得55.8%的选票。两党的初选于2022年3月1日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Leslie Rutledge won re-election on November 6, 2018, to a second term. She was term-limited and had announced a campaign for lieutenant governor of Arkansas in 2022. Primary elections were held on May 24, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州检察长。现任共和党检察长莱斯利·拉特利奇于2018年11月6日赢得连任，开始第二个任期。由于任期限制，她不能再次竞选，并已宣布参加2022年阿肯色州副州长选举。初选于2022年5月24日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Colorado, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Colorado gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年科罗拉多州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年科罗拉多州美国众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州8名美国众议员，每个国会选区各选出1名。选举与科罗拉多州州长选举、其他美国众议院和参议院选举，以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of the state of Michigan. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Dana Nessel ran for re-election to a second term. She was first elected in 2018 with 49.0% of the vote. Michigan does not hold partisan primaries for statewide offices other than governor.

zh.s: 2022年密歇根州检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出州检察长。现任民主党检察长达娜·内塞尔竞选连任，争取第二个任期。她于2018年首次当选，得票率为49.0%。密歇根州全州职位通常不举行党派初选，州长一职除外。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Connecticut, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2022 U.S. Senate race in Connecticut and the 2022 Connecticut gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年康涅狄格州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年康涅狄格州美国众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州5名美国众议员，每个国会选区各选出1名。当天还举行了康涅狄格州美国参议员和州长选举，以及其他美国众议院、参议院、州和地方选举。

en.s: The 2022 West Virginia Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, and elected 17 of the chamber's 34 members. This coincided with elections in the House of Delegates, and the election of West Virginia's two representatives. Following the 2020 census, this was the first West Virginia Senate election held after redistricting. Primary elections were held on May 10, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选参议院34个席位中的17席。当天还举行了州众议院和两个美国众议院席位的选举。这是2020年人口普查后，西弗吉尼亚州首次在重划选区后举行参议院选举。初选于2022年5月10日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Ohio. Incumbent Republican Frank LaRose won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2022年俄亥俄州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出州务卿。现任共和党人弗兰克·拉罗斯赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Arizona was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Arizona. Democratic incumbent Mark Kelly won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican venture capitalist Blake Masters. Primaries in Arizona took place on August 2, 2022. Kelly won renomination without opposition, while Masters won the Republican nomination against a large field of candidates.

zh.t: 2022年亚利桑那州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年亚利桑那州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。民主党现任参议员马克·凯利击败共和党风险投资家布莱克·马斯特斯，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。亚利桑那州初选于8月2日举行。凯利在民主党初选中没有对手；马斯特斯则在多人角逐中赢得共和党提名。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Nevada. Incumbent Democratic senator Catherine Cortez Masto won re-election to a second term, narrowly defeating Republican challenger Adam Laxalt. Nevada's election results were slowed due to state law that allowed voters to submit mail-in ballots until November 12, and allowed voters to fix clerical problems in their mail-in ballots until November 14, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年内华达州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。现任民主党参议员凯瑟琳·科尔特斯·马斯托险胜共和党挑战者亚当·拉克索尔德，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。根据州法，选民可在11月12日前提交邮寄选票，也可在11月14日前修正邮寄选票中的文书问题，因此该州选举结果公布较慢。

en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all 50 members to North Carolina's Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The filing period lasted from February 24, 2022, to March 4, 2022, with the primary election being held on May 17, 2022 (prior to the redistricting challenges it was scheduled to be held on March 8, 2022).

zh.t: 2022年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日举行选举，改选北卡罗来纳州参议院全部50个席位。选举与美国参议院、众议院和州众议院等职位的选举同时举行。候选人登记期为2022年2月24日至3月4日，初选于5月17日举行。在重新划区争议发生前，初选原定于3月8日举行。

en.s: The 2022 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of California. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of California. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on June 7. California is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出加利福尼亚州副州长。当天还举行了多场联邦和州选举，包括加利福尼亚州州长选举。加州于6月7日举行无党派两轮初选。全美有21个州分别选举州长和副州长，加利福尼亚州是其中之一。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Mississippi, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年密西西比州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年密西西比州美国众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州4名美国众议员，每个国会选区各选出1名。选举与其他美国众议院、参议院以及州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: Two justices of the seven-member North Carolina Supreme Court and four judges of the fifteen-member North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 8, 2022, concurrently with other state elections. Terms for seats on each court are eight years. These elections were conducted on a partisan basis.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，北卡罗来纳州选民选出了州最高法院7名大法官中的2人，以及州上诉法院15名法官中的4人。选举与其他州选举同时举行。两院法官的任期均为8年。这些选举按党派进行。

en.s: The 2022 Iowa Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect members of the Iowa Senate from 25 odd-numbered districts. Senators serve four-year terms in single-member constituencies, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. Additionally, because the 2022 elections were the first elections since the 2020 United States Census and subsequent redistricting, elections were also held in 9 even-numbered districts where redistricting resulted in more than one incumbent wishing to represent the district.

zh.s: 2022年艾奥瓦州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选25个奇数编号选区的议员。州参议员任期为4年，每个选区选出1人，通常每轮选举改选一半席位。由于这是2020年美国人口普查及随后重划选区后的首次选举，当年也改选了9个偶数编号选区的议员，因为这些选区重划后有多名现任议员竞争同一席位。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Connecticut. Democrat Richard Blumenthal was first elected to this seat in 2010 with 55.2% of the vote over Republican Linda McMahon. He was then re-elected in 2016 with 63.2% of the vote over Republican Dan Carter.

zh.t: 2022年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。民主党人理查德·布卢门撒尔于2010年首次当选，得票率为55.2%，击败共和党人琳达·麦克马洪；2016年他再次当选，得票率为63.2%，击败共和党人丹·卡特。

en.t: 2022 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 70 seats in the New Mexico House of Representatives were up for election. The election coincided with elections for other offices including the United States House of Representatives, governor, attorney general, and secretary of state. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年新墨西哥州众议院选举于11月8日举行，是美国两年一度选举的一部分。州众议院全部70个席位都进行改选。当天还举行了美国众议院、州长、州检察长和州务卿等职位的选举。初选于2022年6月7日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Florida Chief Financial Officer election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Chief Financial Officer of Florida. Incumbent Republican CFO Jimmy Patronis won re-election to a second term with over 59% of the vote and a margin of victory of 19 percentage points.

zh.t: 2022年佛罗里达州首席财务官选举
zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州首席财务官选举于11月8日举行，选出该州首席财务官。现任共和党人吉米·帕特罗尼斯赢得连任，开始第二个任期，得票率超过59%，领先19个百分点。

en.s: The 2022 United States state legislative elections were held on November 8, 2022, for 88 state legislative chambers in 46 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 56 percent of all upper house seats and 92 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Additionally, six territorial chambers were up in four territories and the District of Columbia.

zh.s: 2022年美国州议会选举于11月8日举行，涉及46个州的88个州议会院。全美50个州中，约56%的州参议院席位和92%的州众议院席位进行改选。此外，4个属地和哥伦比亚特区的6个议会院也进行改选。

en.s: The 2022 Delaware Senate election were held on November 8, 2022, concurrently with the elections for the Delaware House of Representatives, to elect members to the Delaware General Assembly. All of the 21 seats in the Delaware Senate were up for election. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on September 13, 2022. Democrats gained one seat, increasing their supermajority to 15 out of 21 seats.

zh.s: 2022年特拉华州参议院选举于11月8日举行，与州众议院选举同时进行，改选特拉华州议会的参议院全部21个席位。两党的初选于2022年9月13日举行。民主党增加1席，取得15席，并扩大在参议院的绝对多数。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member to the United States Senate to represent the state of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican Senator John Boozman ran for a third term. He won the May 24, 2022 Republican primary with 58.03% of the vote and the general election with 65.73% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年阿肯色州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表阿肯色州的美国参议员。现任共和党参议员约翰·布兹曼竞选第三个任期。他在2022年5月24日举行的共和党初选中获得58.03%的选票，并在大选中获得65.73%的选票。

en.t: 2022 West Virginia House of Delegates election
en.s: The 2022 West Virginia House of Delegates election was held on November 8, 2022, electing all 100 members of the chamber. This coincided with the election of 17 of West Virginia's 34 state senators, and the election of West Virginia's two U.S. representatives. Primary elections were held on May 10, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月8日举行，改选该院全部100名议员。同期还改选了州参议院34个席位中的17个，并选出该州的2名联邦众议员。初选于2022年5月10日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Peter Neronha won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2022年罗得岛州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党检察长彼得·内罗尼亚赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Illinois gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Illinois, concurrently with the 2022 Illinois general election. Gubernatorial candidates ran on tickets with candidates for lieutenant governor.
