The incumbent governor and lieutenant governor, first-term Democrats JB Pritzker and Juliana Stratton, sought re-election together against Republican nominees Illinois State Senator Darren Bailey and his running mate Stephanie Trussell.

zh.s: 2022年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月8日举行，与伊利诺伊州普选同时进行。州长候选人与副州长候选人组成搭档参选。民主党籍现任州长和副州长J·B·普利兹克与朱莉安娜·斯特拉顿竞选连任，对阵共和党提名人、州参议员达伦·贝利及其竞选搭档斯蒂芬妮·特鲁塞尔。

en.s: The 2022 New York State Senate election was held on November 8, 2022. Elections were held to elect representatives from all 63 districts across the State of New York. This election coincided with New York elections for the governorship, U.S. Senate, and state assembly, among others. Districts for this election were redrawn following the 2020 United States census.

zh.s: 2022年纽约州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选该州63个选区的代表。此次选举与纽约州州长、联邦参议院和州众议院等选举同时举行。2020年美国人口普查后，本次选举的选区边界进行了重新划分。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next governor of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican Governor Asa Hutchinson was term-limited and could not seek a third term. Republican Sarah Huckabee Sanders, daughter of former Arkansas Governor Mike Huckabee, defeated Democrat Chris Jones to become the state’s first female governor and was sworn in on January 10, 2023.

zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州长。共和党籍现任州长阿萨·哈钦森受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人莎拉·赫卡比·桑德斯（前州长迈克·赫卡比之女）击败民主党候选人克里斯·琼斯，成为该州首位女性州长，并于2023年1月10日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2022 Maryland Senate election were held on November 8, 2022, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for governor of Maryland. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19, 2022. Democrats gained two seats, increasing their supermajority to 34 out of 47 seats.

zh.s: 2022年马里兰州参议院选举于11月8日举行，改选州参议院全部47个选区的议员。议员由单席选区选出，任期4年。选举与包括马里兰州州长选举在内的多场联邦和州选举同时举行。两党的初选于2022年7月19日举行。民主党增加2席，使其在47席中拥有34席，扩大了绝对多数。

en.s: The 2022 Alaska state elections took place on November 8, 2022. The state also held Regional Educational Attendance Area (REAA) elections on the first Tuesday in October.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于2022年11月8日举行州级选举。该州还于10月的第一个星期二举行了区域教育出席区（REAA）选举。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of Nevada. Incumbent Republican Barbara Cegavske was term-limited and could not seek a third term.

zh.s: 2022年内华达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿芭芭拉·切加夫斯克受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 San Diego City Council election was held on November 8, 2022. The primary election was held on June 7, 2022. Four of the nine seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates in each district.

zh.s: 2022年圣迭戈市议会选举于11月8日举行，初选于2022年6月7日举行。市议会9个席位中的4个进行改选。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在官方层面不标党派，但大多数议员会表明自己的党派倾向。本次选举采用两轮制：6月举行初选，11月由各选区得票最高的两名候选人进行决选。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 10 U.S. representatives from the state of Washington, one from each of the state's 10 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出10名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的10个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Vermont. Incumbent Republican governor Phil Scott won re-election to a fourth term in a landslide, defeating Democratic nominee Brenda Siegel. This race was one of six Republican-held governorships up for election in 2022 in a state carried by Joe Biden in the 2020 presidential election.

zh.s: 2022年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党州长菲尔·斯科特击败民主党候选人布伦达·西格尔，以明显优势赢得连任，开始第四个任期。这是2022年6个由共和党执政的州长职位之一，而该州在2020年总统选举中由乔·拜登获胜。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Alabama. Incumbent senator Richard Shelby was first elected in 1986 and re-elected in 1992 as a Democrat before becoming a Republican in 1994.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表阿拉巴马州的联邦参议员。现任参议员理查德·谢尔比于1986年首次当选，1992年以民主党人身份连任，之后于1994年转为共和党人。

en.s: The 2022 New York Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Letitia James was eligible for re-election, but originally decided to run for Governor of New York in 2022. On December 9, 2021, however, she suspended her gubernatorial campaign and announced that she would seek re-election as attorney general. Republicans nominated Michael Henry, an attorney from Queens.

zh.s: 2022年纽约州总检察长选举于11月8日举行。民主党籍现任总检察长利蒂希娅·詹姆斯符合竞选连任资格，但最初决定于2022年竞选州长。2021年12月9日，她暂停州长竞选，并宣布将寻求连任总检察长。共和党提名了来自皇后区的律师迈克尔·亨利。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama Public Service Commission election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect two members to the Alabama Public Service Commission. Primary elections were held on May 24, 2022, with the primary runoff being held on June 21.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举于11月8日举行，选出2名委员会委员。初选于2022年5月24日举行，第二轮初选于6月21日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Virgin Islands gubernatorial election
en.s: The 2022 U.S. Virgin Islands gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of the United States Virgin Islands. The election was held concurrently with the 2022 United States midterm elections. Incumbent Democratic governor Albert Bryan won a second four-year term in office, receiving 56% of the vote. He defeated Independent candidate and territorial senator Kurt Vialet, independent activist Ronald Pickard, and former senator Stephen Frett of the Independent Citizens Movement.

zh.t: 2022年美属维尔京群岛州长选举
zh.s: 2022年美属维尔京群岛州长选举于11月8日举行，与2022年美国中期选举同时进行。现任民主党州长艾伯特·布莱恩赢得连任，开始第二个四年任期，得票率为56%。他击败了独立候选人、属地参议员库尔特·维亚莱特、独立派活动人士罗纳德·皮卡德，以及独立公民运动党前参议员斯蒂芬·弗雷特。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Arkansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Arkansas gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年阿肯色州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿肯色州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出4名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的4个国会选区。此次选举与阿肯色州州长选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the attorney general of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Incumbent DFLer Keith Ellison narrowly won (50.37% to 49.53%) reelection to a second term against Republican challenger Jim Schultz. This attorney general election marked the fourteenth in a row won by the DFL.

zh.s: 2022年明尼苏达州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党-农民-劳工党成员基思·埃里森以微弱优势胜出，以50.37%对49.53%的得票率击败共和党挑战者吉姆·舒尔茨，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。这是民主党-农民-劳工党连续第14次赢得该职位。

en.s: The 2022 Delaware House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the 2022 United States elections. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. House, Attorney General, and state senate. Delaware voters elected state senators in all 41 of the state's Senate districts. 41 State Representatives serve four-year terms in the Delaware House of Representatives.

zh.s: 特拉华州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，是2022年美国选举的一部分。同期还举行了其他职位选举，包括联邦众议院、州检察长和州参议院选举。特拉华州选民选出了该州参议院全部41个选区的州参议员。州众议院有41名州众议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Alabama. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of Alabama. Primary elections were held on May 24, with runoffs scheduled for June 21 if a candidate failed to receive a majority of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括州长选举。初选于5月24日举行；如无人获得多数票，则于6月21日举行第二轮初选。

en.s: The 2022 Delaware Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Delaware. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Kathy Jennings won re-election to a second term. However, turnout was very low and the race was closer than anticipated, with Murray's 46.17% being the Republicans' best result in this race since 2006.

zh.s: 2022年特拉华州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党检察长凯西·詹宁斯赢得连任，开始第二个任期。但投票率很低，选情也比预期接近，默里获得46.17%的选票，是共和党候选人在这场选举中自2006年以来的最佳成绩。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Republican senator Lisa Murkowski won reelection to a fourth full term, defeating fellow Republican Kelly Tshibaka and Democrat Patricia Chesbro. This was the first U.S. Senate election in Alaska to be held under a new election process provided for in Ballot Measure 2.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党参议员丽莎·穆尔科斯基赢得连任，开始第四个完整任期，击败同为共和党人的凯莉·齐巴卡和民主党人帕特里夏·切斯布罗。这是阿拉斯加州首次按第2号选票措施规定的新选举制度举行美国参议院选举。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Incumbent DFLer Steve Simon won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2022年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党-农民-劳工党成员史蒂夫·西蒙赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of the state of Ohio. David Yost was re-elected to a second term in a landslide, defeating Democratic opponent Jeffrey Crossman by a comfortable 20 percentage points. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including that for governor of Ohio.

zh.s: 2022年俄亥俄州检察长选举于11月8日举行。戴维·约斯特以明显优势赢得连任，击败民主党对手杰弗里·克罗斯曼，领先20个百分点。当天还举行了包括俄亥俄州州长选举在内的多场联邦和州选举。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Idaho was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Idaho. Incumbent Republican Senator Mike Crapo was first elected in 1998 and ran for re-election to a fifth term in office. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年爱达荷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年爱达荷州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表爱达荷州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员迈克·克拉波于1998年首次当选，并竞选第五个任期。初选于2022年5月17日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Oklahoma House of Representative election took place on November 8, 2022. The primary elections for the Republican. Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 28, 2022. All candidates filed between the days of April 13–15, 2022. Oklahoma voters elected state representatives in all 101 House districts. State Representatives served two-year terms in the Oklahoma House of Representatives.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄克拉何马州众议院选举于11月8日举行。共和党、民主党和自由意志党的提名初选于2022年6月28日举行。候选人于2022年4月13日至15日期间登记参选。俄克拉何马州选民在全部101个众议院选区选出州众议员，任期两年。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Indiana, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections. Primary elections took place on May 3.

zh.t: 2022年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出9名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的9个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。初选于5月3日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 8, 2022, concurrently with elections for all other Class 3 U.S. senators and elections for the U.S. House of Representatives, to select a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Missouri. Incumbent senator Roy Blunt, a Republican, did not seek a third term in office.

zh.t: 2022年密苏里州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年密苏里州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，与其他所有第三类联邦参议院席位和联邦众议院选举同时进行，选出一名代表密苏里州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员罗伊·布朗特决定不竞选第三个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Idaho, one from both of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出2名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的2个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Virgin Islands legislative election
en.s: The 2022 United States Virgin Islands legislative election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect all fifteen seats in the Legislature of the Virgin Islands. The election coincided with the 2022 gubernatorial race and the 2022 United States elections. In the 2022 elections, the Democratic Party of the Virgin Islands gained one vacant seat from Independent Senator Janelle Sarauw who ran for lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 2022年美属维尔京群岛议会选举
zh.s: 2022年美属维尔京群岛议会选举于11月8日举行，改选维尔京群岛议会全部15个席位。选举与2022年州长选举及美国选举同时举行。2022年选举中，美属维尔京群岛民主党赢得了独立派参议员贾内尔·萨罗的一个空缺席位；萨罗当时竞选副州长。

en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island General Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the General Treasurer of Rhode Island. Incumbent general treasurer Seth Magaziner was term-limited and could not seek a third term in office, initially running for governor before dropping out to run for U.S. House instead. Former two-term Democratic mayor of Central Falls James Diossa defeated Republican James Lathrop, finance director of North Kingstown.

zh.s: 2022年罗得岛州财务长选举于11月8日举行。现任财务长塞思·马加齐纳因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。他最初竞选州长，后来退选并转而竞选美国众议员。曾任两届中央瀑布市市长的民主党人詹姆斯·迪奥萨击败了共和党人詹姆斯·拉思罗普。拉思罗普是北金斯敦市的财务主管。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in South Carolina
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in South Carolina was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of South Carolina. Incumbent Republican Senator Tim Scott won reelection to a second full term, defeating state representative Krystle Matthews. This was the third consecutive election for this seat where both major party nominees were black.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年南卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。现任共和党参议员蒂姆·斯科特赢得连任，开始第二个完整任期，击败了州众议员克里斯特尔·马修斯。这是该席位连续第三次由两大党提名黑人候选人角逐。

en.s: The Maryland Attorney General election of 2022 was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Brian Frosh was eligible to seek a third term in office, but announced that he would retire at the end of his term in early 2023. U.S.

zh.s: 2022年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长布莱恩·弗罗什符合竞选第三个任期的资格，但宣布将在2023年初任期结束时退休。联邦众议员、前副州长、2014年州长候选人安东尼·布朗赢得民主党提名；共和党提名了前安妮阿伦德尔县议员、2004年宪法党总统候选人迈克尔·佩罗特卡。

en.s: The 2022 South Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, electing the governor of South Dakota. Incumbent Republican Governor Kristi Noem defeated Democratic nominee Jamie Smith to win a second term. Despite speculation about this race potentially being competitive, Noem improved on her 2018 performance by 11 percentage points and won 17 counties that she lost in 2018.

zh.s: 2022年南达科他州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党州长克里斯蒂·诺姆击败民主党候选人杰米·史密斯，赢得第二个任期。虽然有人猜测这场选举可能竞争激烈，但诺姆的表现比2018年好11个百分点，并赢得了她在2018年失利的17个县。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Oregon
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Oregon. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ron Wyden, who was first elected in a 1996 special election, ran for a fifth full term. Jo Rae Perkins, who unsuccessfully ran for Oregon's other Senate seat in 2020, won the Republican primary with 33.3% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年俄勒冈州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年俄勒冈州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表俄勒冈州的联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员罗恩·怀登于1996年特别选举中首次当选，本次竞选第五个完整任期。曾于2020年竞选俄勒冈州另一个参议院席位但未成功的乔·雷·珀金斯，在共和党初选中以33.3%的得票率胜出。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho State Senate elections took place on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2022. Idaho voters elected state senators in all 35 seats of the Senate, electing one state senator and two state representatives in each of the 35 Idaho state legislative districts. State senators serve two-year terms in the Idaho Senate.

zh.s: 2022年爱达荷州参议院选举于11月8日举行，初选于2022年5月17日举行。爱达荷州选民选出州参议院全部35名议员；该州35个立法选区各选出1名州参议员和2名州众议员。州参议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2022 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Wyoming. Incumbent Republican governor Mark Gordon won a second term against Democratic Wyoming State Facilities Commission member Theresa Livingston. Livingston's vote percentage was the lowest for a Democratic candidate running for governor in Wyoming since it was admitted to the union in 1890, falling short of Leslie Petersen's 22.90% performance in 2010.

zh.s: 2022年怀俄明州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党州长马克·戈登击败民主党候选人、怀俄明州设施委员会成员特蕾莎·利文斯顿，赢得第二个任期。利文斯顿的得票率是怀俄明州1890年加入美国以来，民主党州长候选人的最低得票率，低于莱斯利·彼得森在2010年取得的22.90%。

en.s: The Wisconsin State Assembly elections of 2022 were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. This was the first and only election to take place after redistricting following the 2020 United States census, where the courts had put in place maps set out in the Johnson decision.

zh.s: 2022年威斯康星州众议院选举于11月8日星期二举行，州众议院全部99个席位进行改选。这是2020年美国人口普查后重新划区以来举行的首次、也是唯一一次选举；选区地图由法院在“约翰逊案”中确定。

en.s: The 2022 Maryland House of Delegates election was held on November 8, 2022, electing all 141 members of the chamber. This coincided with the election of all 47 of Maryland's state senators, along with other statewide offices. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19, 2022. Democrats gained three seats, increasing their supermajority to 102 out of 141 seats.

zh.s: 2022年马里兰州众议院选举于11月8日举行，改选众议院全部141个席位。当天还选举了州参议院全部47个席位和其他全州职位。两党的初选于2022年7月19日举行。民主党增加3席，在141席中取得102席，扩大了绝对多数。

en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Rhode Island. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of Rhode Island. Primary elections were held on September 13. Rhode Island is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2022年罗得岛州副州长选举于11月8日举行，选出该州副州长。此次选举与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括州长选举。初选于9月13日举行。罗得岛州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.s: The 2022 Vermont Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Vermont. Former Democratic Attorney General T.J. Donovan resigned after three terms in office. Susanne Young, appointed by Governor Phil Scott to fill the vacancy left by Donovan, was not running for a full term, and Vermont Republicans nominated Mike Tagliavia to run against Charity Clark, the Democratic candidate.

zh.s: 2022年佛蒙特州总检察长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任总检察长。民主党籍前总检察长T·J·多诺万在任三届后辞职。州长菲尔·斯科特任命苏珊娜·扬填补空缺，但她没有竞选完整任期。佛蒙特州共和党提名迈克·塔利亚维亚，对阵民主党候选人查丽蒂·克拉克。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of New Mexico, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the New Mexico gubernatorial election and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出3名联邦众议员，分别代表该州的3个国会选区。此次选举与新墨西哥州州长选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in North Dakota was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican John Hoeven was first elected in 2010 with 76% of the vote to succeed retiring Democratic–NPL incumbent Byron Dorgan, and won re-election in 2016 with 78.5% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年北达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年北达科他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·霍文于2010年首次当选，以76%的得票率接替退休的民主党—北达科他党现任参议员拜伦·多根；他在2016年以78.5%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. 17 of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin State Senate were up for election—the odd-numbered districts. This was the first election to take place after redistricting following the 2020 United States census. This was the only election to take place under the redistricting plan set out in 2022.

zh.s: 2022年威斯康星州参议院选举于11月8日星期二举行。州参议院33个席位中的17个进行改选，均为奇数编号选区。这是2020年美国人口普查后重新划区以来举行的首次选举，也是依据2022年确定的重新划区方案举行的唯一一次选举。

en.s: The 2022 California Insurance Commissioner election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Insurance Commissioner of California. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appeared on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举
zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举于11月8日举行，选出该州保险专员。根据加利福尼亚州无党派综合初选法，所有候选人不分党派，均列在同一张选票上。初选中，选民可以投给任何候选人，不受其党派归属限制。

en.s: The 2022 Kansas Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Kansas. Incumbent Republican Scott Schwab won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic candidate Jeanna Repass with 58.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年堪萨斯州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党人斯科特·施瓦布以58.4%的得票率击败民主党候选人珍娜·里帕斯，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 New York State Assembly election was held on November 8, 2022. Elections were held to elect representatives from all 150 districts across the State of New York. This election coincided with New York elections for the governorship, U.S. Senate, and state senate, among others. Districts for this election were redrawn following the 2020 United States census. Democrats had held a majority in the New York State Assembly since 1975.

zh.s: 2022年纽约州众议院选举于11月8日举行，改选纽约州全部150个选区的议员。此次选举与纽约州州长、联邦参议院和州参议院等选举同时举行。2020年美国人口普查后，本次选举的选区边界进行了重新划分。民主党自1975年以来一直在纽约州众议院占多数。

en.s: The 2022 New Mexico State Auditor election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next New Mexico State Auditor. Incumbent Democratic Auditor Brian Colón did not seek re-election, and instead opted to unsuccessfully run for Attorney General of New Mexico.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，新墨西哥州举行审计长选举。民主党籍现任审计长布赖恩·科隆没有竞选连任，转而竞选该州总检察长，但未能当选。

en.s: Missouri state elections were held on November 8, 2022, and the primary election were held on August 2, 2022. Missouri voters elected their Class 3 US Senator, State Auditor, all of the seats for the House of Representatives, all of the seats of the Missouri House of Representatives, and 17 of 34 seats in the Missouri State Senate.

zh.s: 密苏里州选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选于8月2日举行。选民选出一名第三组联邦参议员、州审计长、该州全部联邦众议员和州众议员，以及州参议院34个席位中的17席。

en.s: The 2022 Arkansas Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican John Thurston won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，阿肯色州举行州务卿选举。共和党籍现任州务卿约翰·瑟斯顿胜出，获得第二个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 11 U.S. representatives from the state of Virginia, one from each of the state's 11 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives. Pursuant to state law, primaries organized through the Department of Elections were held on June 21, 2022 (the third Tuesday of June).

zh.t: 2022年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，弗吉尼亚州举行联邦众议院选举，从全州11个国会选区各选出一名议员。此次选举与其他联邦众议院选举同日举行。根据州法律，由选举部门组织的初选已于6月21日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Kentucky House of Representatives election was held on November 8, 2022. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 17. All 100 seats of the house were up for election. Republicans increased their majority in the chamber, gaining five seats. A numbered map of the house districts can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2022年肯塔基州众议院选举于11月8日举行，众议院全部100个席位进行改选。共和党和民主党的初选于5月17日举行。共和党增加5席，扩大了在众议院的多数优势。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Florida. Incumbent Republican Senator Marco Rubio won re-election to a third term, defeating Democratic nominee Val Demings in a landslide victory. Rubio was first elected in 2010, filling the seat of appointed Senator George LeMieux.

zh.t: 2022年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。现任共和党参议员马尔科·鲁比奥大胜民主党候选人瓦尔·戴明斯，赢得连任，开始第三个任期。鲁比奥于2010年首次当选，接替获任命担任该席位的参议员乔治·勒米厄。

en.s: The 2022 Wyoming Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election held on Tuesday, August 16, 2022. Wyoming voters selected state senators in the 16 odd-numbered districts of the Senate to serve four-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Wyoming state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Wyoming House. Following the previous election in 2020, Republicans held a 28-to-2-seat supermajority over Democrats.

zh.s: 怀俄明州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选于8月16日举行。选民在16个奇数编号选区选出任期四年的州参议员。此次选举与联邦众议院、州长及州众议院等选举同日举行。上届选举后，共和党在州参议院以28席对民主党2席占绝对多数。

en.t: 2022 Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts election
en.s: Elections took place on November 8, 2022, to select the next Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts. Incumbent Republican Party Comptroller Glenn Hegar was elected to a third term over Democratic opponent Janet Dudding, with 56.4% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年得克萨斯州公共账户审计长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日举行选举，选出下一任得克萨斯州公共账户审计长。现任共和党审计长格伦·赫格尔击败民主党对手珍妮特·达丁，以56.4%的得票率赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 South Dakota Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. All 35 seats in the South Dakota Senate were up for election. Primary elections were held on June 7, 2022. The elections coincided with elections for other offices in South Dakota, including the US Senate, US House, South Dakota Governor, South Dakota Secretary of State, South Dakota Attorney General, and the South Dakota House.

zh.s: 南达科他州参议院全部35个席位于2022年11月8日改选，初选已于6月7日举行。此次选举与该州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长、州务卿、总检察长和州众议院选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 South Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 South Carolina House of Representatives election took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial United States elections. South Carolina voters elected state representatives in all 124 of the state's house districts. Republicans flipped eight seats held by Democrats, while Democrats flipped one seat held by a Republican; with their majority expanded by a net gain of seven seats, Republicans achieved a supermajority in the chamber.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年南卡罗来纳州众议院选举于11月8日举行，作为美国两年一度选举的一部分。州选民选出了全部124个州众议院选区的议员。共和党从民主党手中赢得8席，民主党从共和党手中赢得1席。共和党净增7席，扩大了多数优势并取得绝对多数。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent Maryland. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19, 2022. Incumbent Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen was first elected in 2016 with 60.9% of the vote, winning the seat of retiring incumbent Barbara Mikulski.

zh.t: 2022年马里兰州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，马里兰州举行联邦参议院选举，选出该州的一名联邦参议员。民主党和共和党的初选于7月19日举行。民主党籍现任参议员克里斯·范霍伦于2016年以60.9%的得票率首次当选，接替退休的芭芭拉·米库尔斯基。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next state treasurer of Wisconsin. Incumbent Democratic Party Treasurer Sarah Godlewski chose not to seek re-election, instead unsuccessfully running for US Senate. Republican John Leiber narrowly defeated Democrat Aaron Richardson in the general election. This was the only Wisconsin Executive office Republicans won in 2022.

zh.s: 2022年威斯康星州财务长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任州财务长。现任民主党财务长莎拉·戈德莱夫斯基没有寻求连任，而是转而竞选美国参议员，但未能胜出。共和党人约翰·莱伯在大选中险胜民主党人亚伦·理查森。这是共和党人在2022年赢得的唯一一个威斯康星州行政职位。

en.s: The 2022 Maryland Comptroller election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Comptroller of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic Comptroller Peter Franchot declined to run for a fifth term and instead ran unsuccessfully for Governor of Maryland.

zh.t: 2022年马里兰州财务审计长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，马里兰州举行财务审计长选举。民主党籍现任财务审计长彼得·弗兰肖没有竞选第五个任期，转而竞选州长，但未能当选。

en.s: The 2022 North Dakota Agriculture Commissioner election was held on November 8, 2022, in order to elect the Agriculture commissioner of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican Agriculture Commissioner Doug Goehring was re-elected to a fourth term against North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party challenger Fintan L. Dooley.

zh.t: 2022年北达科他州农业专员选举
zh.s: 2022年北达科他州农业专员选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党农业专员道格·戈林击败北达科他州民主党-无党派联盟党候选人芬坦·L.杜利，赢得连任，开始第四个任期。

en.s: The 2022 San Mateo County elections were held on November 8, 2022, in San Mateo County, California, with nonpartisan blanket primary elections for certain offices being held on June 7. Two of the five seats of the Board of Supervisors were up for election, as well as all seven of the countywide elected officials, the Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder, the County Controller, the Coroner, the District Attorney, the Sheriff, the County Superintendent of Schools, and the Treasurer-Tax Collector.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，加利福尼亚州圣马特奥县举行选举，部分职位的无党派初选已于6月7日举行。县政委员会五个席位中的两个进行改选，县级选举产生的七个职位也全部改选，包括财产估价兼县书记官兼档案官、县财务主管、法医、地区检察官、警长、县教育总监和财政兼税务主管。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of Idaho. Incumbent Republican Lawerence Denney was eligible to seek re-election but declined to run for a third term.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，爱达荷州举行州务卿选举。共和党籍现任州务卿劳伦斯·丹尼本有资格竞选连任，但决定不再竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Alabama. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Steve Marshall won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党检察长史蒂夫·马歇尔赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of Nebraska, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Nebraska gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，内布拉斯加州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州三个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与州长、联邦参议院以及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Governor Kay Ivey won her bid for a second full term with more than 66% of votes. This was the sixth consecutive time that a Republican was elected governor of Alabama. Ivey was sworn in for her second full term on January 16, 2023. Primary elections in Alabama were held on May 24.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任州长凯·艾维赢得连任，开始第二个完整任期，得票率超过66%。这是共和党人连续第六次当选阿拉巴马州州长。艾维于2023年1月16日宣誓就职。初选于5月24日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 28 U.S. representatives from Florida, one from each of the state's 28 congressional districts. The primary was held on August 23, 2022. The elections coincided with the 2022 United States Senate election in Florida, other elections to the House of Representatives, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州28个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。初选已于8月23日举行。此次选举与该州的联邦参议院选举，以及其他联邦、州和地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut State Senate election was held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. Connecticut voters elected senators in all of the 36 State Senate districts. State senators serve two-year terms in the Connecticut State Senate, with all 36 of the seats up for election each cycle. Primary elections were held in August 2022.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，康涅狄格州举行州参议院选举，全部36个选区各选出一名州参议员，任期两年。初选已于2022年8月举行。

en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island State Senate elections took place on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on September 13, 2022. Rhode Island voters elected state senators in all 38 seats of the Senate. State senators serve two-year terms in the Rhode Island Senate. The election coincided with United States national elections and Rhode Island state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Rhode Island House.

zh.s: 罗得岛州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选已于9月13日举行。州参议院全部38个席位进行改选，议员任期两年。此次选举与联邦众议院、州长和州众议院等选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on March 1, with runoffs held on May 24 for primary candidates who did not receive a majority of the vote. All of the states' executive offices were up for election, as well as all seats of the Texas Legislature and all 38 seats in the United States House of Representatives, an additional two of which were apportioned to the state following the 2020 redistricting cycle based on data from the 2020 census.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州选举于2022年11月8日举行。初选于3月1日举行；未有候选人获得过半数选票的初选，于5月24日进行决选。州行政职位、州议会全部席位和38个联邦众议院席位均进行改选。根据2020年人口普查数据重新划分席位后，该州的联邦众议院席位增加了两个。

en.s: The 2022 Indiana Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of Indiana. Holli Sullivan, a Republican who was appointed to replace Connie Lawson as Secretary of State in 2021, ran for a full term in office but was defeated at the Republican convention by Diego Morales.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，印第安纳州举行州务卿选举。共和党人霍莉·沙利文于2021年获任命，接替康妮·劳森出任州务卿。她争取完整任期，但在共和党大会上败给迭戈·莫拉莱斯，未能获得党内提名。

en.s: The 2022 Maine House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022, alongside the biennial United States elections. Maine voters elected members of the Maine House of Representatives via instant-runoff voting in all 151 of the state house's districts, as well as a non-voting member from the Passamaquoddy Tribe. These were the first elections in Maine following the 2020 United States redistricting cycle, which resulted in nearly all members being assigned to new districts.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，缅因州举行州众议院选举。选民通过即时决选投票，在全部151个州众议院选区选出议员，另选出一名帕萨马科迪部落的无表决权代表。这是该州在2020年美国人口普查后重新划分选区举行的首次选举，几乎所有议员都被划入新选区。

en.s: The 2022 California gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of California, with the statewide top-two primary election taking place on June 7, 2022. Incumbent Democratic Party Governor Gavin Newsom was elected to a second term after surviving a recall election in 2021 during his first term. The elections featured universal mail-in ballots; in-person voting was also available.

zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出州长。全州前两名初选于2022年6月7日举行。现任民主党州长加文·纽森在2021年成功抵御罢免后，赢得第二个任期。选举使用普遍邮寄投票，也开放现场投票。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate for Oklahoma. The election took place concurrently with the regularly scheduled election for Oklahoma's other Senate seat. The candidate filing deadline was between April 13 and 15, 2022. This special election was held to fill the remaining four years of incumbent Republican Senator Jim Inhofe's term.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，俄克拉何马州举行联邦参议院特别选举，填补共和党籍参议员吉姆·英霍夫剩余四年的任期。此次特别选举与该州另一个联邦参议院席位的例行选举同日举行。候选人报名于4月13日至15日进行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 26 U.S. representatives from the State of New York, one from each of the state's 26 congressional districts. The elections coincided with elections for governor, U.S. Senate, attorney general, comptroller, state senate, and assembly, and various other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，纽约州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州26个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与州长、联邦参议院、州总检察长、州审计长、州参议院和州众议院等选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Alaska House of Representatives elections were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election on August 16, 2022. Voters in the 40 districts of the Alaska House of Representatives elected their representatives, in conjunction with state senate elections and the biennial United States elections for federal offices.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选已于8月16日举行。全州40个州众议院选区各选出一名议员；州参议院及联邦职位选举也在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2022 Champaign County, Illinois Executive election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Darlene Kloeppel declined to seek re-election to a second term. Steve Summers, the Vice Chair of the County Board, won the Democratic nomination unopposed and faced Sadorus Village President Ted Myhre, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Summers defeated Myhre in a landslide, winning 57 percent of the vote to Myhre's 43 percent.

zh.s: 2022年尚佩恩县行政长官选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党行政长官达琳·克洛佩尔没有竞选连任。县委员会副主席史蒂夫·萨默斯在民主党初选中无人竞争，获得提名，并在大选中对阵共和党候选人、萨多鲁斯村村长泰德·迈尔。萨默斯以57%的得票率大胜迈尔，迈尔获得43%。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Wisconsin, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. Primaries were held on August 9, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，威斯康星州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州八个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。初选已于8月9日举行。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan were held on November 8, 2022, to elect representatives for the thirteen seats in Michigan (reduced from 14 in the redistricting cycle following the 2020 United States census). The deadline for candidates to file for the August 2 primary was April 19. The congressional makeup prior to the election was seven Democrats and seven Republicans.

zh.t: 2022年密歇根州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，密歇根州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州13个席位的代表。2020年美国人口普查后重新划分席位，该州席位由14个减为13个。8月2日初选的候选人报名截止日期为4月19日。选举前，该州的14名联邦众议员中，民主党和共和党各有七人。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Nevada. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Aaron Ford won re-election to a second term in office. As Ford narrowly won Carson City, this was the first time since 2014 that a Democrat had won a county or county-equivalent outside of Clark or Washoe County.

zh.s: 2022年内华达州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党检察长亚伦·福特赢得连任，开始第二个任期。由于福特险胜卡森城，这是自2014年以来，民主党首次赢得克拉克县或沃肖县以外的县或同级地区。

en.t: 2022 North Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 North Dakota House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. 66 of the seats in the North Dakota House of Representatives were up for election. Primary elections were held on June 14, 2022. The elections coincided with elections for other offices in North Dakota, including the US Senate, US House, North Dakota Secretary of State, North Dakota Attorney General, and the North Dakota Senate.

zh.s: 北达科他州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，66个席位进行改选，初选已于6月14日举行。此次选举与该州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州务卿、总检察长和州参议院等选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022. The Republican and Democratic primaries were held on May 24, 2022, and any races in which no candidate exceeded one-half plus one of the total votes advanced to a runoff on June 21, 2022. This was the first election cycle since 2002 in which the Libertarian Party of Alabama was on the ballot, as they exceeded the threshold for petition signatures needed to gain ballot access in Alabama.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行。共和党和民主党的初选已于5月24日举行，无人取得所需过半数选票的初选于6月21日进行决选。这是2002年以来该州自由意志党首次列入选票：该党提交的选民签名达到参选门槛。

en.s: The 2022 Florida Commissioner of Agriculture election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Florida Commissioner of Agriculture. Incumbent Democratic Commissioner of Agriculture Nikki Fried was eligible to run for a second term, but she instead ran for governor of Florida in 2022. Republican Wilton Simpson won the election with over 59% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年佛罗里达州农业专员选举
zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州农业专员选举于11月8日举行，选出州农业专员。现任民主党专员妮基·弗里德有资格竞选连任，但她转而参加佛罗里达州州长选举。共和党人威尔顿·辛普森以超过59%的得票率赢得选举。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Democratic lieutenant governor John Fetterman won his first term, defeating Republican surgeon Mehmet Oz. Fetterman succeeded Republican incumbent senator Pat Toomey, who did not seek re-election to a third term. This was the only U.S.

zh.t: 2022年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行联邦参议员选举，选出一名代表宾夕法尼亚联邦进入美国参议院的议员。民主党副州长约翰·费特曼赢得首个任期，击败共和党外科医生梅赫迈特·奥兹。费特曼接替没有寻求连任第三届的共和党时任参议员帕特·图米。这是唯一一场美国……

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 8, 2022, with all districts currently being decided. The term of office for those elected in 2022 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2023. Pennsylvania State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2022年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行州众议院选举，全部203个席位改选。州众议员任期两年；本次当选者的任期于2023年1月州众议院开会时开始。

en.s: The 2022 Hawaii Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect senators in all 25 districts of the state Senate of the U.S. state of Hawaii. Due to the chamber's use of the 2-4-4 term system, members were elected in single-member constituencies, with half of them serving two-year terms and the other half serving four-year terms.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，夏威夷州举行州参议院选举，在全部25个选区各选出一名议员。根据该州参议院的“2—4—4”任期安排，部分议员任期两年，其余任期四年。

en.t: 2022 New Hampshire House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2022 New Hampshire House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of New Hampshire on November 8, 2022, to elect all 400 members of the House of Representatives of the 168th New Hampshire General Court. A primary election was held in many districts on September 13, 2022. The election coincided with the election of the other house of the General Court, the New Hampshire Senate, and other elections.

zh.t: 2022年新罕布什尔州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，新罕布什尔州举行州众议院选举，选出第168届州议会众议院全部400名议员。许多选区的初选已于9月13日举行。此次选举与州参议院及其他职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Guamanian gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Guam. Incumbent Democratic governor Lou Leon Guerrero, who was elected in 2018 with 50.7% of the vote, sought a second term. She faced former Republican governor Felix Camacho. Guerrero defeated Camacho in the general election, winning a second term as governor.

zh.s: 2022年关岛州长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党州长卢·莱昂·格雷罗竞选连任。她于2018年首次当选，得票率为50.7%。她在大选中击败前共和党州长菲利克斯·卡马乔，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Brooks-Medicine Hat in Alberta, Canada, on November 8, 2022, following the resignation of incumbent United Conservative MLA Michaela Frey.

zh.t: 2022年布鲁克斯—梅迪辛哈特省议会补选
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，加拿大艾伯塔省布鲁克斯—梅迪辛哈特选区举行省议会补选。补选缘于联合保守党籍现任省议员米凯拉·弗雷辞职。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona were held on November 8, 2022, to determine the nine representatives of the state of Arizona. The elections coincided with the 2022 Arizona gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, the U.S. Senate, and various other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，亚利桑那州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州九名联邦众议员。此次选举与亚利桑那州州长、联邦参议院以及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: West Virginia held elections on November 8, 2022. Elections for the United States House of Representatives, as well as the House of Delegates and 17 of 34 Senate seats were held. These elections were held concurrently with other elections nationwide. Primary elections were held on May 10, 2022.

zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州于2022年11月8日举行选举，改选联邦众议员、州众议院议员和州参议院34个席位中的17席。初选已于5月10日举行；这些选举与全美其他选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Utah. Incumbent senator Mike Lee, who was first elected in 2010, won re-election to a third term, defeating Evan McMullin, an independent candidate who was endorsed by the Utah Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2022年犹他州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。现任参议员迈克·李击败独立候选人埃文·麦克马林，赢得连任，开始第三个任期。麦克马林获得犹他州民主党背书。

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Illinois House of Representatives were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect representatives from all 118 Representative districts in the Illinois House of Representatives. The primary election occurred on Tuesday, June 28, 2022. The winners of this election would serve in the 103rd General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the state based on the 2020 United States census.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，伊利诺伊州举行州众议院选举，在全部118个选区选出议员，初选已于6月28日举行。当选者将进入第103届州议会；此次选举采用了依据2020年美国人口普查结果重新划定的选区。

en.s: The 2022 Nebraska Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Nebraska. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Doug Peterson was eligible to run for a third term, but he announced on December 14, 2021, that he would not run for re-election. No Democratic candidates filed to run for the position, and Hilgers faced Legal Marijuana Now candidate, former Republican congressional candidate Larry Bolinger, in the general election.

zh.t: 2022年内布拉斯加州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，内布拉斯加州举行总检察长选举。共和党籍现任总检察长道格·彼得森有资格竞选第三个任期，但他已于2021年12月14日宣布不再连任。没有民主党候选人报名，共和党候选人迈克·希尔格斯在大选中对阵大麻合法化党候选人拉里·博林杰；后者曾以共和党人身份竞选联邦众议员。

en.s: The 2022 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Florida, alongside other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Ron DeSantis won re-election in a landslide, defeating the Democratic Party nominee, Charlie Crist, who served as governor of Florida from 2007 to 2011 as a Republican and later as an independent. No Democrat has been elected governor of Florida since 1994.

zh.s: 2022年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月8日举行，与其他州和地方选举同时进行。现任共和党州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯大胜民主党候选人查理·克里斯特，赢得连任。克里斯特曾于2007年至2011年担任佛罗里达州州长，当时是共和党人，后来成为独立人士。自1994年以来，还没有民主党人当选佛罗里达州州长。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022, along with the elections in the State Senate. The primary elections were held on June 28, 2022. Voters in all 65 districts of the state House elected their representative for a two-year term. These coincided with other Colorado elections of the same year and the biennial United States elections.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，与州参议院及其他职位的选举同日进行。初选已于6月28日举行。全州65个选区各选出一名任期两年的州众议员。

en.s: The 2022 Wyoming elections took place on November 8, 2022. The statewide direct primary election was held on August 16, 2022. Wyoming voters elected Wyoming's seat to the United States House of Representatives, all of the seats of the Wyoming House of Representatives, all even-numbered seats of the Wyoming Senate, governor of Wyoming, and various statewide offices.

zh.s: 怀俄明州选举于2022年11月8日举行。该州全州直接初选于2022年8月16日举行。选民选出了怀俄明州在美国众议院的代表、州众议院全体议员、州参议院所有偶数号席位、州长及多个全州职位的官员。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Kansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年堪萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，堪萨斯州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州四个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the U.S. representative from Vermont's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, as well as various other state and local elections. Incumbent Democrat Peter Welch was re-elected with 67.3% of the vote in 2020.

zh.t: 2022年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佛蒙特州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州唯一一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方选举同日举行。民主党籍时任议员彼得·韦尔奇曾在2020年以67.3%的得票率连任。

en.s: South Carolina state elections in 2022 were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. All of South Carolina's executive officers were up for election, as well as all of South Carolina's seven seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于2022年11月8日举行选举，改选州行政部门全部民选职位，以及该州的全部七个联邦众议院席位。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut elections were held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on August 9, 2022.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选已于8月9日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，怀俄明州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州唯一一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect senators in 17 odd-numbered districts of the Ohio Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Ohio and the Ohio House of Representatives.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，改选17个奇数编号选区的议员。各选区选出一名议员，任期四年。州长和州众议院等联邦、州级职位的选举也在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2022 Washington House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections on November 8, 2022. Washington state voters elected state representatives in all 98 seats of the House, electing two state representatives in each of the 49 Washington state legislative districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Washington House of Representatives. Following the previous election in 2020, Democrats held a 57-to-41-seat majority over Republicans.

zh.s: 华盛顿州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，全部98个席位进行改选：全州49个立法选区各选出两名州众议员，任期两年。2020年上届选举后，民主党以57席对共和党41席占多数。

en.t: 2022 South Carolina Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2022 South Carolina Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of South Carolina. Incumbent Republican Mark Hammond was seeking another term in office against Democratic challenger Rosemounda Peggy Butler, after defeating an opponent in the Republican primary. The last Democratic Secretary of State of South Carolina was John T. Campbell in 1991.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，南卡罗来纳州举行州务卿选举。共和党籍现任州务卿马克·哈蒙德在党内初选胜出后，竞选连任，对手是民主党人罗斯蒙达·佩吉·巴特勒。该州上一位民主党籍州务卿是1991年的约翰·T·坎贝尔。

en.s: The 2022 South Dakota Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of South Dakota. On June 21, 2022, former Republican Attorney General Jason Ravnsborg was convicted and removed from office for malfeasance of office. The State Senate further barred Ravnsborg from holding office in South Dakota. Republican Mark Vargo was appointed to fill the remainder of Ravnsborg's term and did not run for a full term.

zh.t: 2022年南达科他州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，南达科他州举行总检察长选举。6月21日，州参议院裁定共和党籍前总检察长杰森·拉文斯堡失职，将其免职，并禁止他再担任该州公职。随后，马克·瓦戈获任命完成剩余任期，但没有竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Connecticut State Comptroller election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Connecticut State Comptroller. Incumbent Democrat Natalie Braswell was appointed to the position by Governor Ned Lamont after the resignation of Kevin Lembo. She did not seek a full term.

zh.t: 2022年康涅狄格州财务主管选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，康涅狄格州举行财务主管选举。凯文·伦博辞职后，州长内德·拉蒙特任命民主党人娜塔莉·布拉斯韦尔接任；她没有竞选完整任期。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Hawaii, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，夏威夷州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州两个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 2022 were held on November 8, 2022. Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19, 2022. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Frederick County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, Prince George's County, and Wicomico County elected county executives.

zh.s: 马里兰州县长选举于2022年11月8日举行，民主党和共和党的初选已于7月19日举行。安妮阿伦德尔、巴尔的摩、弗雷德里克、哈福德、霍华德、蒙哥马利、乔治王子和威科米科八县各选出县长。

en.t: 2022 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 2022 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Denise Merrill planned to retire at the end of her elected term, but resigned on June 30 to care for her ailing husband. Governor Lamont appointed former associate attorney general Mark Kohler to the position. Kohler was sworn in on July 11.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，康涅狄格州举行州务卿选举。民主党籍现任州务卿丹妮丝·梅里尔原计划任满退休，但为照顾患病的丈夫，于6月30日提前辞职。州长内德·拉蒙特任命前副总检察长马克·科勒接任；科勒于7月11日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2022 Illinois Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Illinois. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Kwame Raoul won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2022年伊利诺伊州检察长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党检察长夸梅·劳尔赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Vermont lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the state of Vermont. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections, including for Governor of Vermont. Primary elections were held on August 9. Vermont is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佛蒙特州举行副州长选举，与州长等联邦和州级职位的选举同日举行。初选已于8月9日举行。佛蒙特州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho House of Representatives elections took place on November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on May 17, 2022. Idaho voters elected state representatives in all 70 seats of the House, electing two state representatives in each of the 35 Idaho state legislative districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Idaho House of Representatives. The election coincided with United States national elections and Idaho state elections, including U.S.

zh.s: 爱达荷州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选于同年5月17日举行。选民选出了众议院全部70个席位的州众议员，即该州35个立法选区各选出两人。州众议员任期两年。选举与美国全国选举和爱达荷州选举同期举行，包括美国……

en.s: The 2022 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of New Mexico. The election coincided with various other federal and state elections. Primary elections were held on June 7. Incumbent Democratic Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham won a second term by a margin of 6.38%. She was first elected in 2018 with 57.2% of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月8日举行，选出州长和副州长。当天还举行了多场联邦和州选举。初选于6月7日举行。现任民主党州长米歇尔·卢汉·格里沙姆以6.38个百分点的优势赢得第二个任期。她于2018年首次当选，得票率为57.2%。

en.s: The 2022 Oklahoma Senate general election were held on November 8, 2022. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 28, 2022. Runoff primary elections, if no candidate received 50% in the June 28 vote, took place on August 23. All candidates had to file between the days of April 13–15, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州参议院选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行。共和党、民主党和自由意志党的初选于6月28日举行；若无人获得半数选票，初选决选于8月23日举行。所有候选人须于4月13日至15日报名。

en.s: The 2022 Illinois's 1st congressional district election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the United States representative for Illinois's 1st congressional district, concurrently with elections for the other U.S. House districts in Illinois and the rest of the country, as well as the 2022 U.S. Senate race in Illinois, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年伊利诺伊州第1国会选区选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，伊利诺伊州第1国会选区举行联邦众议院选举，选出该选区的一名联邦众议员。此次选举与伊利诺伊州及全美其他国会选区的选举、该州联邦参议院选举，以及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Maine State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, with the primary election using instant-runoff voting being held on June 14, 2022, to elect the 131st Maine Senate. Voters in all 35 districts of the Maine Senate elected their state senators. These elections coincided with those for governor, U.S. House and the Maine House of Representatives. Democrats retained their 23–12 advantage in the chamber.

zh.s: 2022年缅因州参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出第131届州参议院。初选于2022年6月14日举行，采用即时决选投票制。州参议院全部35个选区都改选议员。选举与州长、美国众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。民主党保住了23席对12席的优势。

en.s: The 2022 North Dakota Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. 32 of the seats in the North Dakota State Senate were up for election. Primary elections were held on June 14, 2022. The elections coincided with elections for other offices in North Dakota, including the US Senate, US House, North Dakota Secretary of State, North Dakota Attorney General, and the North Dakota House of Representatives.

zh.s: 北达科他州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，32个席位进行改选，初选已于6月14日举行。此次选举与该州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州务卿、总检察长和州众议院等选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the U.S. representative from Delaware's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. The incumbent Democrat Lisa Blunt Rochester won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.t: 2022年特拉华州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年特拉华州美国众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表特拉华州单一国会选区的美国众议员。当天还举行了美国众议院、参议院以及州和地方职位的其他选举。现任民主党人丽莎·布朗特·罗切斯特赢得连任，开始第四个任期。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of New Hampshire. The primary elections were held on September 13, 2022. Incumbent Senator Maggie Hassan was re-elected over Republican retired brigadier general Don Bolduc by an unexpectedly large margin of 9.1% that surpassed most polls.

zh.t: 2022年新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表该州的美国参议员。初选于2022年9月13日举行。现任参议员玛吉·哈桑击败共和党候选人、退役准将唐·博尔杜克，赢得连任，领先9.1个百分点，优势超出多数民调的预期。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect representatives in all 99 districts of the Ohio House of Representatives. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to two-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Ohio and the Ohio Senate.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，俄亥俄州举行州众议院选举，全部99个选区各选出一名任期两年的议员。此次选举与州长、州参议院等联邦和州级职位的选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 12 U.S. representatives from the state of New Jersey, one from each of the state's 12 congressional districts. Republicans flipped one seat in the 7th district and reduced the Democratic majority in the delegation to 9–3.

zh.t: 2022年新泽西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年新泽西州美国众议院选举于11月8日举行，选出该州12名美国众议员，每个国会选区各选出1名。共和党在第7选区赢得1席，将民主党在该州代表团中的多数席位缩小至9席对3席。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Massachusetts, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，马萨诸塞州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州九个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin Secretary of State election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Wisconsin. Incumbent Democrat Doug La Follette won re-election to an unprecedented 12th term in the office, narrowly defeating Republican state legislator Amy Loudenbeck. With a margin of 0.29%, this was the closest secretary of state race of the 2022 election cycle.

zh.s: 2022年威斯康星州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党人道格·拉福莱特险胜共和党州议员艾米·劳登贝克，赢得连任，开始第12个任期。差距仅0.29个百分点，这是2022年选举周期中最接近的一场州务卿选举。

en.s: The general election of Missouri State Auditor occurred during the 2022 United States midterm election, along with the 2022 United States Senate election in Missouri, on November 8, 2022. Incumbent State Auditor Nicole Galloway, Missouri's only statewide elected Democrat, did not seek re-election to a second full term in office. Missouri State Treasurer Scott Fitzpatrick won the election, leaving Democrats with no statewide seats in Missouri.

zh.s: 密苏里州审计长大选于2022年美国中期选举期间的11月8日举行，与密苏里州美国参议院选举同时进行。现任审计长妮可·加洛韦是密苏里州唯一通过全州选举产生的民主党人，她没有寻求连任。密苏里州财务长斯科特·菲茨帕特里克赢得选举，民主党因此在密苏里州不再拥有任何全州民选职位。

en.s: The 2022 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor Larry Hogan was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. This was the first gubernatorial election in which both parties' nominees for lieutenant governor were women. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on July 19, with state delegate Dan Cox securing the Republican nomination, while author and former nonprofit CEO Wes Moore won the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，马里兰州举行州长选举。现任州长拉里·霍根受任期限制，不能连续竞选第三个任期。这是该州首次出现两大党副州长候选人都是女性的州长选举。7月19日初选后，州议员丹·考克斯获得共和党提名，作家、前非营利机构负责人韦斯·摩尔获得民主党提名。

en.s: A general election was held in the state of Oklahoma on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. The primary election was held on Tuesday, June 28, 2022. Runoff primary elections, where necessary, were held on Tuesday, August 23. The candidate filing period was April 13 to April 15, 2022.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州大选于2022年11月8日举行。初选已于6月28日举行，需要决选的初选于8月23日完成；候选人报名期为4月13日至15日。

en.s: The 2022 Oregon House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Primary elections were held on Tuesday, May 17, 2022. Voters in the 60 districts of the Oregon House of Representatives elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for State Senate. In total, 21 freshman representatives were elected in this cycle, 20 of them due to retirements, making up over a third of the chamber.

zh.s: 2022年俄勒冈州众议院选举于11月8日举行，初选于5月17日举行。州众议院60个选区均选出了议员。选举还与包括州参议院在内的其他职位选举同时举行。本轮选举共有21名新议员当选，其中20人是因现任议员退休而当选，占众议院三分之一以上。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado Senate elections took place on November 8, 2022, along with elections in the State House of Representatives, with the primary elections held on June 28, 2022. Voters in 17 out of the 35 districts of the Colorado Senate elected their representative for a four-year term. It coincided with other Colorado elections of the same year and the biennial United States elections.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，初选已于6月28日举行。州参议院35个选区中的17个选区各选出一名任期四年的议员；州众议院及其他联邦、州级职位也在同一天选举。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana were held on November 8, 2022, to elect two U.S. Representatives from Montana, one from each of its congressional districts. Prior to this election cycle, Montana had one at-large district, represented by Republican Matt Rosendale. However, during the 2020 redistricting cycle, Montana regained the 2nd district that it lost in 1993.

zh.t: 2022年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，蒙大拿州举行联邦众议院选举，在两个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此前该州只有一个覆盖全州的选区，由共和党人马特·罗森代尔代表。2020年重新划分席位后，蒙大拿州恢复了1993年失去的第二个选区。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Kansas. Incumbent Republican Senator Jerry Moran was first elected in 2010, winning the seat vacated by Sam Brownback, and ran for re-election to a third term in office. Democrat Mark Holland, the former mayor of Kansas City, was Moran's opponent in the general election.

zh.t: 2022年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，堪萨斯州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员杰里·莫兰于2010年首次当选，接替卸任的萨姆·布朗巴克，这次争取第三个任期。民主党候选人是前堪萨斯城市长马克·霍兰德。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Maine, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，缅因州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州两个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Oklahoma Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general of Oklahoma. The primary election was scheduled for Tuesday, June 28, 2022. The candidate filing deadline was April 15, 2022. Appointed incumbent Republican Attorney General John O'Connor sought election to a full term, but lost his party's nomination to Gentner Drummond. No Democratic candidates filed to run for the position.

zh.t: 2022年俄克拉何马州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，俄克拉何马州举行总检察长选举。初选定于6月28日，候选人报名截止日期为4月15日。共和党籍现任总检察长约翰·奥康纳原由任命上任，争取完整任期，但在党内提名竞选中败给根特纳·德拉蒙德。没有民主党候选人报名。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Minnesota, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，明尼苏达州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州八个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Alabama Senate elections took place on November 8, 2022, as part of the 2022 United States elections. Alabama voters elected state senators in all 35 of the state's Senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate in Montgomery. A primary election on May 24, 2022, and a runoff election on June 22, 2022, determined which candidates appear on the November 8 general election ballot for the Alabama Republican Party and the Alabama Democratic Party.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，是2022年美国选举的一部分。选民选出了该州参议院全部35个选区的参议员。州参议员任期四年，在蒙哥马利的阿拉巴马州参议院任职。2022年5月24日的初选及6月22日的决选，决定了共和党和民主党哪些候选人进入11月8日的大选选票。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 8, 2022, the District of Columbia held an election for its non-voting House delegate representing the District of Columbia's at-large congressional district. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. The incumbent was Democrat Eleanor Holmes Norton, who was re-elected with 86.83% of the vote in 2020.

zh.t: 2022年华盛顿特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，华盛顿特区选举一名代表全区的联邦众议院无表决权代表。此次选举与其他联邦、州和地方职位的选举同日举行。民主党籍现任代表埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿曾在2020年以86.83%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2022 Nevada State Controller election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next Nevada State Controller. Incumbent Democratic Controller Catherine Byrne did not seek re-election to a second term. Republican candidate Andy Matthews won the election, flipping the seat and marking the best performance for a Nevada Republican in a statewide race in 2022, as all other successful Republican candidates for statewide races won with pluralities of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年内华达州州审计长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党审计长凯瑟琳·伯恩没有竞选连任。共和党候选人安迪·马修斯赢得选举，拿下该席位。这是2022年全州选举中共和党候选人表现最好的一次。其他获胜的共和党候选人均以相对多数票胜出。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Kentucky was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent Kentucky. Incumbent Republican Rand Paul won re-election to a third term, defeating Democratic nominee Charles Booker with 61.8% of the vote. Paul was first elected in 2010 with 55.7% of the vote, filling the seat of retiring Jim Bunning, then re-elected in 2016 with 57.3% of the vote.

zh.t: 2022年肯塔基州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年肯塔基州美国参议院选举于11月8日举行，选出一名代表肯塔基州的美国参议员。现任共和党参议员兰德·保罗以61.8%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·布克，赢得连任，开始第三个任期。保罗于2010年首次当选，得票率为55.7%，接替退休的吉姆·邦宁；他又于2016年以57.3%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Indiana House of Representatives took place on Tuesday November 8, 2022, to elect representatives from all 100 districts in the Indiana House of Representatives. The primary election took place on Tuesday May 3, 2022. The Republican Party had held a House majority since 2011. The elections for Indiana United States Senator, Indiana's nine congressional districts, and the Indiana Senate were also held on this date.

zh.s: 印第安纳州众议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，在全部100个选区选出议员，初选已于5月3日举行。共和党自2011年以来一直在州众议院占多数。该州的联邦参议员、九个国会选区的联邦众议员以及州参议员也在同一天选举。

en.s: The 2022 Kansas Attorney General election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Kansas. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Derek Schmidt announced he would retire to run for governor. The Republican nominee was former Kansas Secretary of State Kris Kobach, and the Democratic nominee was former police officer, prosecutor, and state securities regulator Chris Mann.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，堪萨斯州举行总检察长选举。共和党籍现任总检察长德里克·施密特宣布不再连任，转而竞选州长。共和党提名候选人是前州务卿克里斯·科巴赫，民主党候选人是曾任警察、检察官和州证券监管官员的克里斯·曼。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the State Treasurer of Arizona, concurrently with other federal and state elections. Incumbent Republican Treasurer Kimberly Yee initially ran for governor, but suspended her campaign on January 15, 2022, and ran for re-election as the Republican nominee, defeating the Democratic nominee, State Senator Martín Quezada, by a margin of 11.4%.

zh.s: 2022年亚利桑那州财务长选举于11月8日举行，与其他联邦和州选举同时进行。现任共和党财务长金伯利·伊离开州长竞选后，作为共和党候选人竞选连任，并以11.4个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人、州参议员马丁·克萨达。

en.t: 2022 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and State Senate. The primary election was originally going to be held on March 8, 2022, with a run-off in June 2022; however, the North Carolina Supreme Court delayed the primary until May 17, 2022, pending challenges over the State's districts and paused candidate filing.

zh.t: 2022年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，北卡罗来纳州举行州众议院选举，选出全部120名议员。联邦参议院、联邦众议院及州参议院等职位也在同一天选举。初选原定于3月8日举行，并计划于6月决选；因选区划分受到质疑，州最高法院暂停候选人报名，将初选推迟到5月17日。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Guam
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Guam was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from Guam's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the larger 2022 United States House of Representatives elections and the 2022 Guamanian legislative election.

zh.t: 2022年关岛联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，关岛举行选举，选出该地区唯一一名联邦众议院无表决权代表。此次选举与美国其他联邦职位选举和关岛议会选举同日举行。

en.t: 2022 Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth election
en.s: The 2022 Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth. Incumbent Democrat William Galvin won re-election to an eighth term. Primary elections were held on September 6, with Galvin defeating Tanisha Sullivan, president of NAACP Boston, to win the Democratic nomination. Galvin has been Secretary since January 1, 1995.

zh.s: 2022年马萨诸塞州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党人威廉·加尔文赢得连任，开始第八个任期。初选于9月6日举行，加尔文击败波士顿全国有色人种协进会主席塔妮莎·沙利文，获得民主党提名。加尔文自1995年1月1日起担任州务卿。

en.t: 2022 Rhode Island Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2022 Rhode Island Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next secretary of state of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democrat Nellie Gorbea was term-limited and could not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，罗得岛州举行州务卿选举。民主党籍现任州务卿内莉·戈尔比亚受任期限制，不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jared Polis won election to a second term, defeating Republican University of Colorado regent Heidi Ganahl by a decisive margin. Ganahl conceded on election night. The primary election was held on June 28. Polis won two counties he lost in 2018: Grand and Las Animas.

zh.s: 2022年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党州长贾里德·波利斯击败共和党候选人、科罗拉多大学校董海蒂·加纳尔，以明显优势赢得第二个任期。加纳尔在投票当晚承认败选。初选于6月28日举行。波利斯赢得了两个他在2018年失利的县：格兰德县和拉斯阿尼马斯县。

en.s: The 2022 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Wisconsin. Democratic incumbent Tony Evers won a second term, defeating Republican nominee Tim Michels, who had previously lost by more than 10% when he ran unsuccessfully for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin in 2004. As Lieutenant Governor Mandela Barnes ran for the U.S.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于2022年11月8日举行州长选举。民主党时任州长托尼·埃弗斯成功连任第二届，击败共和党提名人蒂姆·米歇尔斯；米歇尔斯此前在2004年竞选威斯康星州联邦参议员时曾落败，得票差距超过10%。副州长曼德拉·巴恩斯竞选联邦……

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of South Carolina, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，南卡罗来纳州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州七个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries election was held on November 8, 2022, in order to elect the Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries. The election was held on a nonpartisan basis. Nevertheless, Christina Stephenson was favored by the Democrats while Cheri Helt was favored by the Republicans. The primary election was held on May 17, 2022 Incumbent Commissioner Val Hoyle did not seek reelection in order to run for the U.S.

zh.t: 2022年俄勒冈州劳工与工业专员选举
zh.s: 俄勒冈州劳工与工业专员选举于2022年11月8日举行，选出该州劳工与工业专员。选举不设党派，但克里斯蒂娜·斯蒂芬森受到民主党支持，谢里·赫尔特受到共和党支持。初选于2022年5月17日举行。时任专员瓦尔·霍伊尔没有寻求连任，而是竞选美国……

en.s: The 2022 Iowa Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Iowa. Incumbent Republican Paul Pate was re-elected, defeating Democratic opponent Joel Miller.

zh.s: 2022年艾奥瓦州州务卿选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党人保罗·佩特击败民主党对手乔尔·米勒，赢得连任。

en.s: The 2022 Ohio general elections took place on November 8, 2022, throughout the US state of Ohio.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国俄亥俄州全州举行大选。

en.t: 2022 Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2022 Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of Arizona. Incumbent Democratic Superintendent Kathy Hoffman was narrowly defeated in her run for a second term by former Republican Attorney General Tom Horne.

zh.t: 2022年亚利桑那州公共教育总监选举
zh.s: 2022年亚利桑那州公共教育总监选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党总监凯西·霍夫曼在竞选连任、争取第二个任期时，以微弱差距败给前共和党州检察长汤姆·霍恩。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania were held on November 8, 2022, to elect representatives for the 17 seats in Pennsylvania (reduced from 18 in the redistricting cycle following the 2020 United States census). Pennsylvania's legislature enacted new district maps in January 2022, which were promptly vetoed by Governor Tom Wolf. The state supreme court took control of the process and selected a map in February 2022.

zh.t: 2022年宾夕法尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州17个席位的代表。2020年美国人口普查后，该州席位由18个减为17个。州议会于2022年1月通过新选区地图，但州长汤姆·沃尔夫随即否决；州最高法院接手，并于2月选定地图。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general elections were held on November 8, 2022. Primaries were held on June 28, 2022. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all three seats of the Cook County Board of Review, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行大选，初选已于6月28日举行。选民改选县估税官、书记官、警长、财政官、县委员会议长、全部17名县委员、县估税复核委员会全部三个席位、水务管理区董事会三个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 2022 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the lieutenant governor of the U.S. state of Georgia. It coincided with various other statewide elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Governor of Georgia. Georgia is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举，与州长、联邦参议院和联邦众议院等选举同日举行。佐治亚州是21个单独选举副州长、而非与州长搭档共同选举的州之一。

en.s: The 2022 St. Louis County Executive special election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Sam Page, who was appointed in 2019 following the resignation of Steve Stenger and won a 2020 special election to serve out the remainder of Stenger's term, ran for re-election. He defeated lobbyist Jane Dueker, former chief of staff to Governor Bob Holden, in the general election, and advanced to the general election.

zh.t: 2022年圣路易斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 圣路易斯县行政长官特别选举于2022年11月8日举行。民主党籍时任行政长官山姆·佩奇于2019年在史蒂夫·斯滕格辞职后获任命，并在2020年特别选举中胜出，完成斯滕格剩余任期。佩奇竞选连任，在大选中击败游说人士简·杜克尔；杜克尔曾任州长鲍勃·霍尔登的幕僚长。

en.t: 2022 San Francisco District Attorney special election
en.s: The 2022 San Francisco District Attorney special election was held on November 8, 2022, following the successful recall of San Francisco District Attorney Chesa Boudin.
