It was held concurrent with the 2022 statewide general elections. Following Boudin's removal from office, Mayor London Breed appointed Brooke Jenkins as the interim District Attorney on July 8, 2022. After winning the special election, Jenkins served the remainder of the unexpired term until January 2025.

zh.t: 2022年旧金山地方检察官特别选举
zh.s: 2022年旧金山地方检察官特别选举于11月8日举行，此前旧金山地方检察官切萨·布丁遭罢免。选举与2022年全州大选同时举行。布丁离任后，市长伦敦·布里德于2022年7月8日任命布鲁克·詹金斯为临时地方检察官。詹金斯赢得特别选举后，完成未满任期，任职至2025年1月。

en.s: The 2022 Jefferson County Sheriff election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the sheriff of Jefferson County, Alabama. The primary election was held on May 24, 2022. Incumbent Democratic sheriff Mark Pettway was re-elected to a second consecutive four-year term.

zh.s: 2022年阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县警长选举于11月8日举行，选出县警长。初选于2022年5月24日举行。现任民主党警长马克·佩特韦再次当选，开始连续第二个四年任期。

en.s: The 2022 Georgia Secretary of State election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Secretary of State of Georgia. Incumbent Republican Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger won re-election to a second term. Raffensperger emerged as a major national figure in early January 2021 when he faced significant pressure from then-President Donald Trump to overturn the 2020 presidential election in Georgia.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行州务卿选举。共和党籍现任州务卿布拉德·拉芬斯珀格赢得连任，获得第二个任期。2021年1月初，他因承受时任总统唐纳德·特朗普施压、要求推翻佐治亚州2020年总统选举结果，而受到全国关注。

en.s: The 2022 San Jose mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next mayor of San Jose for a two-year term. A top-two primary was held on June 7, 2022, and no candidate received more than 50% in this primary election. Santa Clara County Supervisor Cindy Chavez and San Jose City Councilmember Matt Mahan advanced to a November 8 runoff election.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，加利福尼亚州圣何塞市举行市长选举，选出任期两年的市长。6月7日初选中无人获得过半数选票，圣克拉拉县委员辛迪·查韦斯与圣何塞市议员马特·马汉进入11月8日的决选。

en.s: The 2022 Jefferson County Commission election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect all members to the Jefferson County, Alabama Commission. Primary elections were held on May 22, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县委员会选举
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县于2022年11月8日举行委员会选举，选出委员会全部成员。初选于2022年5月22日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Bellevue, Nebraska mayoral election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Mayor Rusty Hike won re-election to a second term over City Councilman Thomas Burns with 55% of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年内布拉斯加州贝尔维尤市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长拉斯蒂·海克以55%的得票率击败市议员托马斯·伯恩斯，赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: 2022 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2022 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections were held on November 8, 2022. Five of the eleven seats on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were up for election. The election was conducted with ranked-choice voting. Four of the five incumbent supervisors were re-elected except for Gordon Mar, who lost to Joel Engardio by a small margin in District 4.

zh.s: 2022年旧金山监事会选举于11月8日举行，改选监事会11个席位中的5席。选举采用排序选择投票制。5名现任监事中有4人连任，戈登·马尔除外。他在第4选区以微弱差距败给乔尔·恩加迪奥。

en.t: 2022 Washington Secretary of State special election
en.s: The 2022 Washington Secretary of State special election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Kim Wyman, a Republican, resigned from the office on November 19, 2021, to become the senior election security lead for the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency in the Biden administration's Department of Homeland Security. Washington governor Jay Inslee, a Democrat, announced he would appoint state senator Steve Hobbs as her replacement, the first Democrat to hold the office in more than fifty years.

zh.t: 2022年华盛顿州州务卿特别选举
zh.s: 华盛顿州于2022年11月8日举行州务卿特别选举。共和党籍原州务卿金·怀曼已于2021年11月19日辞职，赴拜登政府的国土安全部网络安全和基础设施安全局负责选举安全工作。民主党籍州长杰伊·英斯利宣布任命州参议员史蒂夫·霍布斯接任；他是50多年来首位担任该职的民主党人。

en.s: The 2022 Reno mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the mayor of Reno, Nevada. Incumbent Hillary Schieve won re-election to a third and final term. Municipal elections in Nevada are nonpartisan. A blanket primary election was held on June 14, concurrently with the statewide primary elections.

zh.s: 2022年内华达州里诺市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长希拉里·希夫赢得连任，开始第三个、也是最后一个任期。内华达州市政选举采用无党派形式。初选于6月14日举行，与全州初选同时进行。

en.s: The 2022 Tallahassee mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect the Mayor of Tallahassee, Florida. The vote was held subsequently along with the other statewide elections. As of April 2022, four candidates had filed to run for the mayoral seat including. The candidates were Kristin Dozier, Leon County Commissioner, incumbent Tallahassee mayor John E. Dailey seeking a second term, Whitfield Leland III and Michael Ibrahim.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佛罗里达州塔拉哈西市与该州其他选举同日举行市长选举。截至当年4月，已有四人报名：利昂县委员克里斯廷·多齐尔、争取第二个任期的现任市长约翰·E·戴利、惠特菲尔德·利兰三世和迈克尔·易卜拉欣。

en.s: The 2022 Cuyahoga County Executive election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the County Executive of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Armond Budish was eligible to run for a third term, but instead chose to retire. In the primary, the Democrats nominated former president of University Circle Inc. Chris Ronayne, while the Republicans nominated former Cuyahoga County commissioner Lee Weingart.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，俄亥俄州凯霍加县举行县长选举。民主党籍现任县长阿蒙德·布迪什本有资格竞选第三个任期，但决定退休。民主党在初选中提名曾任 University Circle Inc. 总裁的克里斯·罗奈，共和党则提名前县委员李·温加特。

en.s: The 2022 Oakland mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the mayor of Oakland, California. Incumbent mayor Libby Schaaf was term-limited. Sheng Thao won the election and was inaugurated as mayor in January 2023. The position is non-partisan. The election was held using instant-runoff voting, the rules of which include voters ranking their top five candidates.

zh.s: 2022年加利福尼亚州奥克兰市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长利比·沙夫因任期限制不能竞选连任。沈陶赢得选举，并于2023年1月宣誓就任市长。该职位采用无党派选举，投票使用即时决选制，选民可按偏好为前5名候选人排序。

en.t: 2022 United States secretary of state elections
en.s: The 2022 United States secretary of state elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the secretaries of state in twenty-seven states. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections. The elections for secretary of state had taken on heightened importance due to former President Donald Trump's baseless claims that the 2020 election was stolen.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国27个州举行州务卿选举，与其他联邦、州和地方选举同日进行。前总统唐纳德·特朗普曾在没有证据的情况下声称2020年总统选举遭到窃取，使州务卿选举受到更多关注。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the U.S. Senate to represent the state of Georgia. Democratic incumbent Raphael Warnock won his first full term in office, defeating Republican former football player Herschel Walker. Under Georgia's two-round system, Warnock was re-elected in a runoff election on December 6 after neither candidate received over 50% of the vote on November 8.

zh.t: 2022年佐治亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员拉斐尔·沃诺克与共和党候选人、前美式橄榄球运动员赫歇尔·沃克竞争。当天无人获得过半数选票，两人进入12月6日的决选；沃诺克在决选中胜出，获得首个完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Los Angeles mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the mayor of Los Angeles, California. A top-two primary was held on June 7, 2022. Candidates could win the election outright by receiving more than 50% of the vote, but no candidate received a majority. More than forty candidates formed committees to run.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，加利福尼亚州洛杉矶市举行市长选举。6月7日先举行取前两名的初选，候选人若获得过半数选票即可直接当选，但无人达到这一门槛。超过40名有意参选者曾成立竞选委员会。

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the 14 U.S. representatives from the state of Georgia, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Georgia gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2022年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行联邦众议院选举，在全州14个国会选区各选出一名联邦众议员。此次选举与州长、联邦参议院及其他州和地方职位的选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Hennepin County Attorney election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the county attorney of Hennepin County, Minnesota. On September 1, 2021, incumbent county attorney Michael O. Freeman announced that he would retire at the end of his term after 24 years in the role. Former Hennepin County Chief Public Defender Mary Moriarty defeated former Hennepin County judge Martha Holton Dimick and became the first openly LGBTQ woman elected as Hennepin County Attorney.

zh.s: 2022年明尼苏达州亨内平县检察官选举于11月8日举行。现任检察官迈克尔·O.弗里曼于2021年9月1日宣布，任职24年后将在任期结束时退休。前亨内平县首席公设辩护人玛丽·莫里亚蒂击败前县法官玛莎·霍尔顿·迪米克，当选检察官，成为首位当选亨内平县检察官的公开出柜的LGBTQ女性。

en.s: The 2022 Georgia gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the governor of Georgia. Incumbent Republican Governor Brian Kemp won a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Stacey Abrams in a rematch. Abrams conceded on election night. The primary occurred on May 24, 2022. Kemp was sworn in for a second term on January 12, 2023.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长布赖恩·肯普再次击败民主党候选人斯泰茜·艾布拉姆斯，赢得第二个任期；艾布拉姆斯当晚承认败选。初选于5月24日举行，肯普于2023年1月12日宣誓开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2022 New York State Comptroller election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the New York State Comptroller. The incumbent Democratic Comptroller Thomas DiNapoli won re-election to a fourth term. Paul Rodríguez, a financial advisor from Queens, was the Republican nominee. In the general election, DiNapoli carried every county won by Kathy Hochul in the concurrent gubernatorial election as well as Rockland, Broome, Dutchess, Rensselaer, Saratoga, Warren, Essex, Clinton, and Franklin counties.

zh.s: 2022年纽约州审计长选举于11月8日举行。现任民主党审计长托马斯·迪纳波利赢得连任，开始第四个任期。共和党候选人是来自皇后区的财务顾问保罗·罗德里格斯。大选中，迪纳波利赢得了凯西·霍楚尔胜出的所有县，以及罗克兰、布鲁姆、达奇斯、伦斯勒、萨拉托加、沃伦、埃塞克斯、克林顿和富兰克林县。

en.s: The 2022 Illinois judicial elections consisted of both partisan and retention elections. The general election was held on November 8, 2022. These elections were a part of the 2022 Illinois elections.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，伊利诺伊州举行司法选举，既有党派候选人之间的选举，也有决定现任法官是否留任的投票。这些选举是该州当年选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2022 Wayne County Executive election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent County Executive Warren Evans ran for re-election. He defeated businessman Mohammed Alam in the Democratic primary, and then faced Mark Ashley Price, the Republican nominee and a member of the Highland Park School Board, in the general election. Evans defeated Ashley in a landslide, winning his third term with 72 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年韦恩县行政长官选举于11月8日举行。现任行政长官沃伦·埃文斯竞选连任。他在民主党初选中击败商人穆罕默德·阿拉姆，随后在大选中对阵共和党候选人马克·阿什利·普赖斯。普赖斯是海兰帕克学校董事会成员。埃文斯以72%的得票率大胜，赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Republican County Executive Steve Ehlmann ran for re-election to a fifth term. State Senator Bob Onder announced that he would challenge Ehlmann in the Republican primary, but ultimately dropped out of the race. Ehlmann ultimately faced perennial candidate Arnie Dienoff in the Republican primary, and defeated him in a landslide, winning 82 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，圣查尔斯县举行县长选举。共和党籍现任县长史蒂夫·埃尔曼争取第五个任期。州参议员鲍勃·翁德曾宣布在共和党初选中挑战他，后来退出。埃尔曼最终在初选中以82%的得票率大幅击败多次参选的阿尼·迪诺夫，获得党内提名。

en.s: The 2022 San Bernardino mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the mayor of San Bernardino, California. San Bernardino uses a top-two primary, and the first round of voting was held on June 7, 2022. Candidates could win the election outright by receiving more than 50% of the vote, but no candidate received a majority.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺市举行市长选举。该市采用初选取前两名的方式，第一轮投票于6月7日举行。候选人若获得过半数选票即可直接当选，但当时无人达到这一门槛。

en.s: The 2022 Jefferson County, Missouri Executive election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Republican County Executive Dennis Gannon ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by State Senator Paul Wieland in the Republican primary, and won renomination by a wide margin. In the general election, Gannon faced Democratic nominee Fran Newkirk, who previously served on several special districts in Antonia.

zh.t: 2022年密苏里州杰斐逊县县长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，密苏里州杰斐逊县举行县长选举。共和党籍现任县长丹尼斯·甘农争取第二个任期，在党内初选中以较大优势击败州参议员保罗·维兰德。大选中，他对阵民主党候选人弗兰·纽柯克；纽柯克此前曾在安东尼亚地区多个特别区任职。

en.s: The 2022 United States Senate elections were held on November 8, 2022, concurrently with other midterm elections at the federal, state, and local levels. Regularly scheduled elections were held for 34 of the 100 seats in the U.S. Senate, the winners of which would serve six-year terms beginning with the 118th United States Congress. Two special elections were held to complete unexpired terms.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国举行联邦参议院选举，与其他联邦、州和地方中期选举同日进行。参议院100个席位中，34席例行改选，当选者自第118届国会起任期六年；另有两场特别选举填补未满任期留下的空缺。

en.s: The 2022 Macomb County Executive election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent County Executive Mark Hackel ran for re-election to a fourth term. He was challenged by former County Commissioner Nicholyn Brandenburg, the Republican nominee. Despite Donald Trump's strong performance in the county in the 2016 and 2020 presidential elections, Hackel defeated Brandenburg in a landslide, winning 61 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2022年马科姆县行政长官选举于11月8日举行。现任行政长官马克·哈克尔竞选连任，争取第四个任期。共和党候选人是前县委员尼科琳·勃兰登堡。尽管唐纳德·特朗普在2016年和2020年总统选举中都在该县取得领先，哈克尔仍以61%的得票率大胜勃兰登堡。

en.s: The 2022 New York's 3rd congressional district election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the United States representative for New York's 3rd congressional district. Primary elections were held on August 23. In November 2021, incumbent Democratic US Representative Tom Suozzi announced he would not seek re-election and instead would run for governor, his 2020 Republican opponent George Santos was elected to succeed him.

zh.s: 2022年纽约州第3国会选区选举于11月8日举行，选出该选区的美国众议员。初选于8月23日举行。2021年11月，现任民主党众议员汤姆·苏奥齐宣布不再竞选连任，转而竞选州长。苏奥齐在2020年面对的共和党对手乔治·桑托斯当选，接替了他。

en.s: The 2022 North Las Vegas mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next mayor of North Las Vegas, Nevada. Incumbent mayor John Jay Lee retired to run unsuccessfully for governor of Nevada.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，内华达州北拉斯维加斯市举行市长选举。现任市长约翰·杰伊·李没有竞选连任，转而竞选内华达州州长，但未能当选。

en.s: The 2022 United States attorney general elections were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the attorneys general in thirty states, two territories, and one federal district. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2018. The attorney general of Vermont serves two-year terms and was last elected in 2020. Seven states do not popularly elect an attorney general.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国30个州、两个领地和一个联邦特区举行总检察长选举。这组州上次举行同类选举是在2018年；佛蒙特州总检察长任期两年，上次于2020年改选。另有七个州的总检察长并非由选民直接选出。

en.t: 2022 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2022 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of New York. Incumbent four-term Democratic Senator Chuck Schumer, who had served as Senate Majority Leader since 2021, was first elected in 1998, defeating Republican incumbent Al D'Amato. Schumer ran for a fifth term.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，纽约州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员查克·舒默自2021年起担任参议院多数党领袖。他于1998年首次当选，当时击败共和党籍现任议员阿尔·达马托；这次他争取第五个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Jackson Executive election took place on November 8, 2022. County Executive Frank White ran for re-election to a second full term. Owing to voter anger at property tax assessments, White faced a difficult campaign. He narrowly defeated attorney Stacy Lake in the Democratic primary, winning 53-47 percent, and then faced County Legislator Theresa Cass Galvin, the Republican nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，杰克逊县举行县长选举。现任县长弗兰克·怀特争取第二个完整任期，但地产税估值引发的选民不满使竞选变得艰难。他在民主党初选中以53%对47%险胜律师斯泰茜·莱克，大选对手是共和党籍县议员特蕾莎·卡斯·加尔文。

en.s: The 2022 Shreveport mayoral election took place on November 8, 2022, with a runoff election on December 10 because no candidate obtained a majority of the vote in the first round. It selected the next mayor of Shreveport, Louisiana. Incumbent Democratic mayor Adrian Perkins sought re-election to a second term in office, but finished fourth in the general election.

zh.s: 2022年什里夫波特市长选举于11月8日举行。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，决选于12月10日举行。选举选出路易斯安那州什里夫波特市下一任市长。现任民主党市长阿德里安·珀金斯竞选连任，争取第二个任期，但在首轮大选中排名第四。

en.s: The 2022 Georgia Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Attorney General of Georgia. Incumbent Republican attorney general Christopher M. Carr was appointed to the office on November 1, 2016, following the resignation of Sam Olens to become the president of Kennesaw State University. Carr won second full term in office over state senator Jen Jordan by a margin of 5.3%.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行总检察长选举。共和党籍现任总检察长克里斯托弗·M·卡尔于2016年11月1日获任命，接替辞职并出任肯尼索州立大学校长的萨姆·奥伦斯。他在此次选举中以5.3个百分点的优势击败州参议员珍·乔丹，赢得第二个完整任期。

en.s: Elections were held in the State of New York on November 8, 2022. On this date, the state held elections for the following offices: Governor and Lieutenant Governor (on one ticket), Attorney General, Comptroller, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, New York State Senate, New York State Assembly, and various others. Primary elections took place on June 28 and August 23, 2022.

zh.s: 纽约州于2022年11月8日举行选举，改选州长和副州长、州总检察长、州财务主管、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州参议员、州众议员等职位。州长与副州长组成搭档参选；初选分别于6月28日和8月23日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Georgia House of Representatives elections were held on November 8, 2022, as part of the biennial United States elections. The election coincided with elections for other offices including for governor, U.S Senate, U.S House, and State Senate. Georgia voters elected state representatives in all 180 of the state house's districts to the 157th Georgia General Assembly. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Georgia House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，佐治亚州举行州众议院选举，在全部180个选区各选出一名任期两年的议员，进入第157届州议会。州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院等职位也在同一天选举。

en.s: The 2022 Navajo Nation presidential election took place on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, to elect the president and vice president of the Navajo Nation. The primary election was held on August 2. Incumbent president Jonathan Nez ran for reelection with attorney Chad Abeyta as his running mate. Incumbent Vice President Myron Lizer did not seek re-election, instead running for U.S. House in Arizona.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，纳瓦霍族举行总统和副总统选举，初选已于8月2日举行。现任总统乔纳森·内兹争取连任，竞选搭档是律师查德·阿贝塔。现任副总统迈伦·利泽没有竞选连任，转而在亚利桑那州竞选美国联邦众议员。

en.t: 2022 District of Columbia Attorney General election
en.s: The 2022 District of Columbia Attorney General election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next attorney general for the District of Columbia. This was the third attorney general election in D.C. history. Incumbent attorney general Karl Racine had declined to run for reelection.

zh.t: 2022年华盛顿特区总检察长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，华盛顿特区举行总检察长选举。这是该特区历史上第三次选举总检察长；现任总检察长卡尔·拉辛没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 New York gubernatorial election took place on November 8, 2022 to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of New York. In August 2021, Lt. Gov. Kathy Hochul ascended to the governorship after Gov. Andrew Cuomo resigned in the wake of allegations of sexual harassment. A Democrat, Hochul sought a full term as governor in 2022 and defeated Jumaane Williams and Tom Suozzi in the June 28, 2022 Democratic primary.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，纽约州举行州长和副州长选举。2021年8月，时任州长安德鲁·科莫在受到性骚扰指控后辞职，副州长凯茜·霍楚尔继任。民主党人霍楚尔在2022年争取一个完整任期，并于6月28日党内初选中击败朱曼·威廉姆斯和汤姆·苏奥齐。

en.s: The 2022 Austin mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022, to elect the next mayor of Austin, Texas. The election was nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations did not appear on the ballot. Incumbent mayor Steve Adler was term-limited and could not run for re-election. In the general election, state representative Celia Israel and former mayor Kirk Watson took the first two spots, leading realtor Jennifer Virden and several other candidates.

zh.s: 2022年得克萨斯州奥斯汀市长选举于11月8日举行，选出下一任市长。选举采用无党派形式，选票上不标候选人所属政党。现任市长史蒂夫·阿德勒因任期限制不能竞选连任。在大选中，州众议员西莉亚·伊斯雷尔和前市长柯克·沃森得票前两名，领先房地产经纪人詹妮弗·维尔登和其他候选人。

en.s: Elections to the Georgia State Senate were held on November 8, 2022, alongside the other 2022 United States elections. All 56 seats were up for election. Democrats gained one seat, decreasing the Republican majority to 33 out of 56 seats.

zh.s: 佐治亚州参议院选举于2022年11月8日举行，全部56个席位改选。民主党净增一席，共和党仍占多数，但席位降至56席中的33席。

en.s: The 2022 Grand Island mayoral election was held on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Mayor Roger G. Steele ran for re-election to a second term, and narrowly defeated challenger Doug Brown to win re-election.

zh.s: 2022年格兰德艾兰市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长罗杰·G.斯蒂尔竞选连任，争取第二个任期，并以微弱优势击败挑战者道格·布朗，再次当选。

en.s: The 2022 Nebraska State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the Nebraska State Treasurer. Incumbent Republican Treasurer John Murante won reelection to his second term in office.

zh.t: 2022年内布拉斯加州财务长选举
zh.s: 2022年内布拉斯加州财务长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党财务长约翰·穆兰特赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: Thirty-six U.S. states and three territories vote for governor
en.s: On November 8, 2022, voters in 36 U.S. states and three territories cast ballots in gubernatorial elections alongside other midterm contests. Most of these offices had last been contested in regular elections in 2018. In the Northern Mariana Islands, no candidate won the required majority, so a separate runoff followed later in November.
en.n: November 8 was the general-election polling date; the Northern Mariana Islands runoff was held later.

zh.t: 美国36个州和三个领地举行州长选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国36个州和关岛、北马里亚纳群岛、美属维尔京群岛三个领地举行州长选举，与中期选举的其他投票同日进行。大多数席位上一次定期改选是在2018年。北马里亚纳群岛没有候选人获得规定的过半票数，因此在11月下旬另行举行决选。
zh.n: 11月8日是大选投票日；北马里亚纳群岛的决选在之后举行。

en.s: Legislative elections were held Guam on November 8, 2022, along with the election for the Guam delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives. Before the election, the Democratic Party holds eight of the fifteen seats in the Legislature while the Republican Party holds seven seats. The election resulted in a gain of one seat for the Democrats and a loss of one seat for Republicans.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，关岛举行立法选举，并同时选举关岛的美国众议院代表。选举前，民主党在立法议会15席中占8席，共和党占7席。选举后，民主党增加1席，共和党失去1席。

en.s: The 2022 South Carolina State Treasurer election took place on November 8, 2022, to elect the next South Carolina Treasurer. Incumbent Republican Party Treasurer Curtis Loftis was re-elected to a fourth term in office.

zh.t: 2022年南卡罗来纳州财务长选举
zh.s: 2022年南卡罗来纳州财务长选举于11月8日举行。现任共和党财务长柯蒂斯·洛夫蒂斯赢得连任，开始第四个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Little Rock mayoral election took place on November 8, 2022. Incumbent Mayor Frank Scott Jr. ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by businessman Steve Landers, the owner of the state's largest chain of car dealerships. Scott won re-election, receiving 49.8 percent of the vote to Landers's 40 percent, avoiding the need for a runoff election.

zh.s: 2022年小石城市长选举于11月8日举行。现任市长弗兰克·斯科特二世竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他击败了商人史蒂夫·兰德斯。兰德斯拥有该州规模最大的汽车经销店连锁。斯科特以49.8%的得票率对兰德斯的40%胜出，无需举行决选。

en.s: The 2022 Los Angeles City Controller election was held on held on November 8, 2022, to elect the Los Angeles City Controller. Incumbent City Controller Ron Galperin was unable to seek a third term due to term limits, and unsuccessfully ran for California State Controller. However, he was serving an extended second term due to a law that shifted election dates from an off-year election to a midterm and statewide election year.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，洛杉矶举行市审计长选举。时任市审计长罗恩·加尔佩林因任期限制不能再次参选，转而竞选加利福尼亚州审计长，但未能当选。由于选举日期改到与州中期选举同年，他的第二届任期有所延长。

en.t: 2022 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 2022 Cook County Board of Commissioners election saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms. The election coincided with other 2022 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including an election for the president of the Board of Commissioners) with the primary elections held on June 28, 2022 and the general election held on November 8, 2022.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，美国伊利诺伊州库克县举行县委员会选举，全部17个席位改选，议员任期四年。县委员会主席等职位也在同日改选；初选已于6月28日举行。

en.s: North Dakota held two statewide elections in 2022: a primary election on Tuesday, June 14, and a general election on Tuesday, November 8. In addition, each township elected officers on Tuesday, March 15, and each school district would hold their elections on a date of their choosing between April 1 and June 30.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，北达科他州举行全州大选，初选已于6月14日举行。该州各乡镇还在3月15日选举地方官员，各学区则自行选择4月1日至6月30日之间的日期举行选举。

en.s: The 2022 Washington State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Washington state voters elected state senators in 25 of the state's 49 Senate districts. The other 24 state senators were not up for re-election until the next biennial election in 2024. State senators served four-year terms in the Washington State Senate.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，华盛顿州举行州参议院选举，49个选区中的25个选区改选。其余24名州参议员要到2024年才改选。州参议员每届任期四年。

en.s: The 2022 Kansas House of Representatives elections took place as a part of the 2022 United States elections. All 125 seats in the Kansas House of Representatives were up for re-election. Representatives serve two year terms and are not term limited. Democrats gained 1 seat, decreasing the narrow Republican supermajority to 85 out of 125 seats.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，堪萨斯州举行州众议院选举，全部125个席位改选。议员任期两年，没有连任次数限制。民主党增加一席，共和党仍占85席，保住三分之二以上的多数优势，但优势有所缩小。

en.s: The 2022 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 8, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. The term of office for those elected in 2022 would begin when the Senate convenes in January 2023. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2022年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2022年11月8日，宾夕法尼亚州举行州参议院选举，50个选区中的25个选区改选。当选议员于2023年1月新一届议会开会时开始任期。州参议员每届任期四年，约半数席位每两年改选一次。

en.s: The 2022 New Hampshire Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2022 United States elections. New Hampshire voters elected state senators in all of the state's 24 senate districts. State senators serve two-year terms in the New Hampshire Senate, with all of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary elections held on September 13, 2022, determined which candidates would appear on the November 8, 2022, general election ballot.

en.s: The 2022 California State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 8, with the primary election having been held on Thursday, June 7. Voters in the 20 even-numbered districts of the California State Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with elections for other offices, including the state assembly. Democrats gained one seat, increasing their supermajority to 32 out of 40 seats, a four-fifths majority.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州参议院选举于11月8日（星期二）举行，初选已于6月7日（星期四）举行。选民在州参议院20个偶数号选区选出代表。选举同期还举行了包括州众议院在内的其他职位选举。民主党增加一个席位，达到40席中的32席，扩大了其五分之四多数优势。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont in 2022. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election as well as Vermont's Class 3 U.S. Senate seat and its lone seat in the U.S. House of Representatives.

en.t: 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The November 2022 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska was held on Tuesday, November 8, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of Alaska. Democratic incumbent Mary Peltola won re-election to a full term in office, defeating Republicans Sarah Palin and Nick Begich III and Libertarian Chris Bye in the runoff count.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，阿拉斯加州举行联邦众议员选举。民主党籍现任议员玛丽·佩尔托拉在排序选择制的计票中胜出，击败共和党候选人萨拉·佩林、小尼克·贝吉奇和自由意志党候选人克里斯·拜伊，赢得一个完整任期。

en.s: The 2022 Arizona Secretary of State election was held on Tuesday, November 8, to elect the next Secretary of State of Arizona. Incumbent Secretary of State Katie Hobbs declined to run for a second term, to instead run for governor. Primary elections were held on August 2, 2022. Democrat and former Maricopa County recorder Adrian Fontes defeated Republican representative Mark Finchem by 4.8%.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，亚利桑那州举行州务卿选举。时任州务卿凯蒂·霍布斯改为竞选州长，没有争取连任。民主党候选人、前马里科帕县选举登记官阿德里安·丰特斯以4.8个百分点的优势击败共和党籍州议员马克·芬彻姆。

en.s: The 2022 Colorado Attorney General election was held on Tuesday, November 8, to elect the attorney general of Colorado. Incumbent attorney general Phil Weiser won re-election to a second term, improving on his 2018 results.

zh.s: 2022年11月8日，科罗拉多州举行总检察长选举。现任总检察长菲尔·韦泽赢得连任，获得第二个任期；他的得票表现比2018年首次当选时更好。

en.s: The 2022 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 8 to elect the next governor of Idaho. Incumbent Brad Little, first elected in 2018, was elected to a second term, the eighth consecutive win by a Republican. The statewide primary was held on May 17; Little defeated incumbent lieutenant governor Janice McGeachin in the Republican primary, while Stephen Heidt won the Democratic primary.

en.s: The 2022 Anaheim mayoral election was held on Tuesday November 8, to elect the next mayor of Anaheim, California. One-term mayor Harry Sidhu, who was elected in 2018 with 32.5% of the vote, resigned in May 2022 amid corruption allegations and an investigation by the FBI regarding the sale of Angel Stadium.

The Republicans gained two seats in the Hawaii House of Representatives and increased their members from four to six.

en.s: The 2022 Long Beach mayoral election was held on June 7, 2022. Because no candidate reached 50% of the vote, there was a runoff election on November 8, 2022.
